Alpha1 was constitutive, alpha2 was induced and sustained, and beta2 was only transiently induced. The study concerns retinoid signaling in differentiation rather than germ cell tumor patients.

pmid-1385460.summary_ja: 表面にデスモソームを欠くF9胎児性癌細胞を、胚性上皮の発生モデルとして用いた基礎研究。レチノイン酸による上皮分化の前後でデスモソーム構成タンパク質の局在を調べた。ケラチン線維がデスモソームタンパク質の細胞表面への輸送を助ける可能性が示唆された。GCT患者を対象としたものではない。
pmid-1385460.summary_en: F9 embryonal carcinoma cells, which lack surface desmosomes and keratin filaments, were used as a model of embryonic epithelial development. The study examined desmoplakins, desmoglein I and plakoglobin before and after retinoic acid-induced epithelial differentiation. Desmosomal proteins became organized into desmosome-like structures, suggesting that keratin filaments may help transport these proteins to the cell surface. The focus is desmosome assembly, not germ cell tumors.

pmid-1437064.summary_ja: 新生児の口腔底に生じた先天性類皮嚢腫の症例報告である。腸型上皮で裏装された微小囊胞形成と、ムチン組織化学所見を考察している。口腔底の類皮嚢腫は発生由来の病変であり、胚細胞腫瘍としての位置づけは明確ではない。組織学的特徴の記載が本論文の主な意義である。
pmid-1437064.summary_en: A case report describes a congenital dermoid cyst on the floor of the mouth in a newborn. The authors discuss microcyst formation lined by intestinal-type epithelium and mucin histochemistry findings. Because oral dermoid cysts are developmental lesions rather than germ cell tumors, relevance to this site is uncertain. The paper's significance lies in its histologic description of gastrointestinal-type epithelium within a dermoid cyst.

pmid-1446786.summary_ja: 本研究は、ヒト絨毛癌細胞株JARによる甲状腺ホルモンT3の膜輸送を解析した。取り込みは時間依存的で、非飽和成分と飽和性の単一機構（Km 586 nM）からなり、温度・細胞内エネルギー・膜電位に依存し、Na+勾配には依存しなかった。正常ヒト栄養膜細胞と類似した値であり、腫瘍細胞株は疾患そのものではなく生理学的モデルとして用いられている。
pmid-1446786.summary_en: This study characterizes the uptake of triiodothyronine (T3) by JAR, a human choriocarcinoma cell line. Uptake was time-dependent, with about 24% non-saturable and a single saturable mechanism (Km 586 nM). It depended on temperature and cellular energy and was independent of the sodium gradient but sensitive to membrane potential. The values resembled those in cultured normal human trophoblast cells, supporting JAR as a model of placental thyroid hormone transport. The tumor line is used as a physiological model rather than studied as a disease.

pmid-1449187.summary_ja: 14か月の女児に生じた広範な中耳皮様嚢腫の症例報告と文献レビューである。皮様嚢腫や奇形腫は頭頸部に多いが、中耳や側頭骨での発生はまれである。本稿は臨床像と治療の経過を詳述し、関連文献を整理している。胚細胞腫瘍としての位置づけは、病変の発生起源の解釈に依存する。
pmid-1449187.summary_en: This case report describes an extensive dermoid tumor of the middle ear in a 14-month-old girl. Dermoids and teratomas are common in the head and neck but rarely occur in the middle ear or temporal bone. The paper details the clinical presentation and management and reviews the literature on this entity. Its relevance to germ cell tumors depends on the interpretation of the lesion's origin, which is not established here.

pmid-1451960.summary_ja: マウス胚性癌細胞株（F9、PCC4、P19）と胚性幹細胞株BLC6における小型熱ショックタンパク質hsp25の発現を比較した。hsp25はP19・BLC6が分化すると、長期培養、レチノイン酸処理、胚様体形成によって増加する。著者らはこれを分化マーカーとして提案している。本研究は患者の腫瘍ではなく、胚性癌細胞株を分化モデルとして用いている。
pmid-1451960.summary_en: This paper examines the small heat shock protein hsp25 in murine embryonal carcinoma (EC) and embryonic stem cell lines. hsp25 is constitutively present in F9 cells and absent in PCC4 and in undifferentiated P19 and BLC6 cells, but it accumulates when P19 and BLC6 cells differentiate through prolonged culture, retinoic acid treatment, or embryoid body formation. The authors propose hsp25 as a differentiation marker. The study uses EC lines as differentiation models rather than investigating tumors in patients.

pmid-1451963.summary_ja: BeWo絨毛癌細胞の分化に対する細胞外基質の影響を検討した。コラーゲン、ラミニン、フィブロネクチン、Matrigelなどを平面コーティングではなく三次元構造で提示すると、細胞は円形コロニーを形成して増殖が低下し、絨毛性ゴナドトロピンの分泌は最大10倍に増加した。プロゲステロンとアルカリホスファターゼは不均一な反応を示し、接着には影響がなかった。基質の組成だけでなく三次元構造が分化を制御することが示された。
pmid-1451963.summary_en: This study examines how three-dimensional extracellular matrix structures influence differentiation of BeWo human choriocarcinoma cells. When matrix molecules such as collagen, laminin, fibronectin, Matrigel, or placental matrix were presented as 3D structures rather than flat coatings, cells formed rounded colonies, proliferation decreased, and chorionic gonadotropin secretion rose up to tenfold. Progesterone and alkaline phosphatase responses were variable, and adhesion was unaffected. The findings show that matrix architecture, not just composition, regulates differentiation in tumor-derived trophoblast cells.

pmid-1455234.summary_ja: 胚細胞腫瘍のモデルであるF9奇形癌細胞を用い、Gαi2が原始内胚葉への分化を制御することを示した基礎研究。レチノイン酸処理でGαi2が減少し、アンチセンスによる抑制で分化様の表現型と増殖時間の短縮が生じた。活性型変異体はレチノイン酸による分化を阻害した。
pmid-1455234.summary_en: This study examines how the G protein subunit Gαi2 regulates differentiation of F9 teratocarcinoma cells, a model of embryonal carcinoma, into primitive endoderm. Gαi2 protein decreases during retinoic acid-induced differentiation. Antisense reduction of Gαi2 induces an endoderm-like phenotype without retinoic acid, reduces receptor-mediated inhibition of adenylyl cyclase, shortens doubling time, and increases tissue-type plasminogen activator. A constitutively active mutant blocks retinoic acid-induced differentiation, suggesting that Gαi2 controls stem cell differentiation and growth.

pmid-1458477.summary_ja: シスプラチン耐性の小細胞肺がん株と胎児性癌株（Tera-CP）を用い、7種類の白金製剤に対する細胞内グルタチオンの関与を検討した基礎研究。グルタチオン量は感受性と相関したが、BSOによる修飾効果は細胞株や薬剤により予測困難であった。シスプラチン耐性の克服はシスプラチンとエンロプラチンに限られた。
pmid-1458477.summary_en: This study examines how cellular glutathione affects sensitivity to and resistance against seven platinum compounds. Experiments used a cisplatin-resistant small cell lung cancer line and a cisplatin-resistant embryonal carcinoma line (Tera-CP) with their parental lines. Glutathione levels correlated with drug sensitivity, but glutathione depletion by BSO modulated resistance unpredictably, varying by cell line and platinum compound. Reversal of cisplatin resistance was achieved only for cisplatin and enloplatin.

pmid-1461650.summary_ja: 温度感受性変異を持つF9奇形癌細胞の分化における、c-mycとp53遺伝子発現を検討した基礎研究。分化誘導可能な変異株では、温度シフト後にc-mycとp53のmRNAが一過性に減少し、c-junは急速に誘導された。p53 mRNAは分化可能な変異株でのみ特異的に増加し、増殖から分化への移行における両遺伝子の異なる役割が示唆された。
pmid-1461650.summary_en: This study examines c-myc and p53 gene expression during differentiation of temperature-sensitive mutants of F9 teratocarcinoma cells. In differentiation-inducible mutants, both c-myc and p53 mRNA transiently decreased after the temperature shift, while c-jun was rapidly induced. A non-inducible mutant did not show these changes. p53 mRNA specifically increased in the inducible mutants. The authors propose distinct roles for p53 and c-myc in the transition of teratocarcinoma stem cells from proliferation to differentiation.

pmid-1462780.summary_ja: 中耳および乳突蜂巣に生じた、きわめて稀な類皮腫（毛髪性ポリープ）の症例報告。画像、手術、組織所見を検討し、類皮嚢腫と奇形腫の鑑別について考察している。側頭骨領域でこれらの腫瘍が稀であることも述べられている。耳科医が鑑別診断を考えるうえで参考になる報告である。
pmid-1462780.summary_en: This report describes a rare dermoid tumour of the middle ear and mastoid cavity, termed a hairy polyp, in an unusual location. The radiological, surgical, and histological features are discussed. The authors comment on distinguishing dermoid cysts from teratomas and note how scarce both tumours are in the temporal bone area. Given the rarity of such lesions in the temporal bone, the report provides a useful reference for otologists considering this differential diagnosis.

pmid-1467987.summary_ja: マウス胎児性癌細胞株P19をレチノイン酸で神経細胞へ誘導し、微小管関連タンパク質(MAPs)の発現時間経過を解析した基礎研究。初期MAPは12時間後、後期MAPは3～5日後に出現し、生体内の神経細胞に類似した発現パターンを示した。P19は神経分化におけるMAPの研究に有用なモデル系であると結論づけている。
pmid-1467987.summary_en: This basic study examines the chronological expression of microtubule-associated proteins (MAPs) in murine embryonal carcinoma P19 cells induced into neural cells with retinoic acid. Early MAPs (pMAP1B, MAP2C) appeared at 12 hours and late MAPs (MAP1A, MAP2A/B) at 3 to 5 days, resembling in vivo neural development. The authors propose P19 as a good model for studying MAP expression during neuronal differentiation. The work uses a germ cell tumor-derived cell line as a model rather than studying the tumor itself.

pmid-1469254.summary_ja: 新生児の後頭部脳瘤(髄膜脳瘤)の修復術中に、脳瘤内に発生した類皮嚢腫が偶然発見された症例報告。この組み合わせの報告は初めてとされる。類皮嚢腫は奇形腫の亜型に分類されることがあるが、本例は先天性の神経管閉鎖障害に伴う病変である。
pmid-1469254.summary_en: The authors report a neonate with a dermoid cyst arising within an occipital encephalocele, discovered during routine repair of a meningoencephalocele. The lesion was an unexpected intraoperative finding. The authors state this is the first described association of an occipital encephalocele with a dermoid cyst. The report is a brief case description focused on the operative discovery, without follow-up or treatment detail. Its relevance to germ cell tumors is limited because the dermoid is a congenital inclusion lesion within a neural tube defect.

pmid-1472012.summary_ja: 培養ヒト絨毛癌細胞株BeWoと子宮頸癌細胞株HeLaを比較し、NBMPR感受性ヌクレオシド輸送を解析した生化学研究。BeWoは高い輸送能と多数の結合部位を有し、エリスロサイト型輸送体の高発現が示唆された。腫瘍の臨床的挙動ではなく、細胞株を輸送機構の実験モデルとして用いた研究である。
pmid-1472012.summary_en: The authors characterize nitrobenzylthioinosine (NBMPR)-sensitive nucleoside transport in cultured human choriocarcinoma BeWo cells, compared with HeLa cervical carcinoma cells. BeWo cells have about 27 million NBMPR-binding sites per cell in two affinity populations, and thymidine transport Vmax values 20 to 30 times higher than HeLa. The authors attribute this to high expression of erythrocyte-like transport elements. The work uses the choriocarcinoma cell line as a biochemical model of nucleoside transport rather than studying the tumor's clinical behavior.

pmid-1472059.summary_ja: 胎児性癌細胞株の分化過程における補体成分と補体受容体のmRNA発現を検討した基礎研究。C2、C3、C4、C5およびCR1、CR2の転写産物が検出され、C3、C4、CR1は恒常的に発現していた。発生過程の炎症を制御する分子機構としての補体系の関与を論じている。
pmid-1472059.summary_en: The authors examined mRNA expression of complement components and receptors during differentiation of embryonal carcinoma cell lines, motivated by constitutive TNF expression in early embryos. Transcripts for C2, C3, C4, C5, and the receptors CR1 and CR2 were detected, with C3, C4, and CR1 expressed constitutively. Scavenger receptors SR-I and SR-II were negative. The authors discuss complement-mediated ontogenic inflammation as a regulatory mechanism during embryonal development at the molecular level.

pmid-1479325.summary_ja: ロンドンの6病院で行った症例対照研究で、良性上皮性卵巣腫瘍、機能性嚢胞、類皮嚢腫の女性と対照132例の生殖・避妊・月経因子を比較した。未経産と不妊は上皮性腫瘍のリスクを高め、多産はリスクを下げた。直近の経口避妊薬使用は3種すべてのリスクを下げた。類皮嚢腫は良性の胚細胞腫瘍だが、本研究の主題は良性卵巣腫瘍全般である。
pmid-1479325.summary_en: This case-control study in six London hospitals compared reproductive, contraceptive and menstrual factors among women with benign epithelial ovarian neoplasms, functional cysts, and dermoid cysts, with 132 controls. Nulliparity and infertility increased risk of epithelial neoplasms, while multiparity reduced it. Infertility and pelvic inflammatory disease raised risk for functional and dermoid cysts. Recent oral contraceptive use lowered risk for all three tumor types. The authors conclude that the etiology of benign cysts and epithelial neoplasms may differ, though benign and malignant epithelial tumors may share risk factors.

pmid-1550961.summary_ja: F9胎児性癌細胞をレチノイン酸とcAMPで壁側内胚葉へ分化させ、BMP-2およびBMP-4の発現変化を検討した。BMP-2 mRNAは約11倍に増加し、BMP-4は約12倍に減少した。外因性BMP-2はレチノイン酸処理細胞にのみ増殖と形態の変化をもたらした。レチノイン酸がBMPを制御し、BMPは着床前胚発生にも関与する可能性が示唆された。
pmid-1550961.summary_en: F9 embryonal carcinoma cells were used to examine how retinoic acid and cAMP induce differentiation into parietal endoderm. BMP-2 mRNA rose about 11-fold and BMP-4 mRNA fell about 12-fold during this process. Exogenous recombinant BMP-2 altered growth and morphology only in retinoic acid-treated cells and changed the abundance of several transcripts, including BMP-2 and BMP-4 themselves. The authors suggest that retinoic acid may regulate these osteoinductive proteins and that BMPs may participate in preimplantation embryogenesis.

pmid-1562551.summary_ja: JEG-3絨毛癌をヌードマウスに移植したモデルで、非ステロイド性アロマターゼ阻害薬R 83 842およびR 76 713の効果を検討した。腫瘍を有するマウスでは子宮重量が増加し、腫瘍内アロマターゼがアンドロゲンをエストロゲンに変換することが示された。経口投与により子宮重量と腫瘍内アロマターゼ活性は用量依存的に低下した。絨毛癌は薬理評価の実験系として用いられており、臨床的な管理を扱う研究ではない。
pmid-1562551.summary_en: The authors tested the non-steroidal aromatase inhibitor R 83 842, the dextro isomer of R 76 713, in ovariectomized nude mice bearing JEG-3 choriocarcinoma xenografts. Tumor-bearing mice showed increased uterine weight, indicating that tumor aromatase converts androgens to estrogens. Oral R 76 713 and R 83 842 reduced uterine weight and suppressed tumor aromatase activity in a dose-dependent manner, with 94% inhibition at 5 mg/kg. The choriocarcinoma line serves mainly as an aromatase-expressing model; the study focuses on pharmacology rather than the tumor's clinical management.

pmid-1563935.summary_ja: 新生児に舌下の甲状舌管嚢胞と類皮嚢腫が同時に発生した稀な症例を報告している。正中部という非典型的な部位で両者が共存しており、両病変の胚発生学的な関連性を考察している。類皮嚢腫は成熟奇形腫の亜型とみなされることがあるが、本論文の主題は先天性頭頸部奇形であり、生殖細胞腫瘍の生物学や腫瘍学的管理は扱っていない。
pmid-1563935.summary_en: This case report describes a neonate with a sublingual thyroglossal duct cyst and a dermoid cyst occurring together in the midline, an unusual anatomic location. The authors present the clinical findings and discuss a possible embryologic association between these two congenital midline lesions, which have traditionally been explained by different developmental mechanisms. Dermoid cysts are often regarded as mature teratoma variants, so the paper touches the teratoma spectrum, though it focuses on congenital head and neck anomalies rather than germ cell tumor biology or oncologic management.

pmid-1569949.summary_ja: F9胎児性癌細胞が壁側内胚葉へ分化する過程で、PEA3結合蛋白の発現がどう変化するかを調べた分子生物学研究である。約91kDaの蛋白(PEA3-91)が分化に伴い減少することを示した。c-ets-1およびc-ets-2の産物とは一致せず、ショウジョウバエE74Aに対する抗血清と反応する約92kDa蛋白に類似する発現パターンを示した。PEA3-91はマウスE74相同分子の可能性がある。
pmid-1569949.summary_en: This molecular biology study examines PEA3-binding proteins during differentiation of F9 embryonal carcinoma cells. Using UV cross-linking and mobility shift assays, the authors identify a roughly 91-kDa protein (PEA3-91) whose expression falls when F9 cells differentiate into parietal endoderm. The protein does not correspond to c-ets-1 or c-ets-2 products, as neither mRNA nor antiserum matched. Instead, an antiserum against Drosophila E74A recognized a related 92-kDa protein with a similar expression pattern, suggesting PEA3-91 may be a murine homolog of the Drosophila E74 gene.

pmid-1570119.summary_ja: 25歳男性の正中舌下に生じた類皮嚢腫の症例報告である。頭頸部では稀であり、口腔底に生じることはさらにまれである。正中矢状切開から嚢腫を無傷で摘出し、経過は良好であった。病理組織学的に皮膚付属器、平滑筋、角化重層扁平上皮の裏打ちが確認され診断された。成熟奇形腫の亜型とみなされることもあるが、主題は良性先天性病変の口腔外科的治療である。
pmid-1570119.summary_en: This dental journal report describes a median sublingual dermoid cyst in a 25-year-old man. Such cysts are uncommon in the head and neck and rare in the floor of the mouth. The cyst was enucleated intact through a midline sagittal incision, with uneventful healing. Histological examination showed a wall containing skin appendages, smooth muscle, and a lining of keratinized stratified squamous epithelium, confirming the diagnosis. Because dermoid cysts are often classified as mature teratoma variants, the case touches the teratoma spectrum, though its focus is oral surgical management of a benign congenital lesion.

pmid-1601186.summary_ja: 胚性癌細胞株であるマウスF9細胞を卵黄嚢内胚葉様細胞へ分化させ、微絨毛を構成するビリン、フィンブリン、ミオシンIの発現と局在を調べた研究です。ビリンは4日目に出現し、6日目には側底面にも分布しました。先端部への集積は整った微絨毛の形成と相関し、ビリンの転写産物はαフェトプロテイン(AFP)の発現時期と一致しました。腸管と卵黄嚢上皮に共通する微絨毛形成の機構を示唆しています。
pmid-1601186.summary_en: This study examines expression and localization of villin, fimbrin, and myosin I in mouse F9 embryonal carcinoma cells induced to differentiate into visceral endoderm. Villin appeared at day 4 and moved from the apical to the basolateral surface by day 6, while fimbrin and myosin I were present in undifferentiated cells and became apical after villin. Apical accumulation correlated with organized microvilli, and villin transcripts coincided with the visceral endoderm marker alpha-fetoprotein. The authors propose that the ordered localization of these proteins directs microvillus assembly in gut and yolk sac epithelium.

pmid-1606039.summary_ja: アンドロゲン受容体とは別のアンドロゲン結合タンパクであるMTBPが、絨毛癌由来細胞株JEG-3とヒト胎盤の両方に存在することを示した研究です。どちらにおいてもMTBPは核内に局在し、DNase I抵抗性のクロマチンと強く結合していました。絨毛癌細胞は実験モデルとして使われており、腫瘍生物学や臨床管理は扱われていません。
pmid-1606039.summary_en: This study shows that the methyltrienolone binding protein (MTBP), an androgen-binding protein distinct from the androgen receptor, is present in the human choriocarcinoma cell line JEG-3 as well as in human placenta. In both sources, MTBP was located exclusively in the nucleus and was tightly associated with DNase I-resistant chromatin. The findings concern nuclear localization and chromatin binding of a steroid-binding protein. Choriocarcinoma cells serve as an experimental model rather than a clinical subject, and tumor biology or patient management is not addressed.

pmid-1623557.summary_ja: 非活性化マクロファージが胚由来奇形癌細胞(F9、P19、PCC4)を選択的に殺傷する機序を検討した研究です。標的細胞はマクロファージに生きたまま貪食され、リソソーム依存的に細胞内で殺傷されます。殺傷はH-2抗原の欠如では説明できず、臨床の精巣・性腺外胚細胞腫瘍のデータを含まない前臨床のマウス免疫学研究です。
pmid-1623557.summary_en: This study examines why nonactivated murine macrophages kill embryo-derived teratocarcinoma cells such as F9, P19, and PCC4 while sparing many other tumor cells. The authors found that these cells are phagocytosed alive and destroyed intracellularly through a lysosome-dependent process. Killing was not explained by absence of H-2 (MHC class I) antigen, since H-2-expressing differentiated F9 and P19 cells and fusion hybrids were still killed, whereas H-2-negative testicular 402AX teratocarcinoma and melanoma cells resisted. The work is preclinical murine immunology, with no clinical germ cell tumor data.

pmid-1633114.summary_ja: マウス胎児性癌細胞（主にP19細胞）をレチノイン酸で分化誘導した際の上皮成長因子受容体（EGF-R）遺伝子発現を解析した基礎研究。分化に伴いmRNAとタンパク質が増加し、その要因として転写物の安定性と転写活性の軽度な変化が示された。細胞表面のEGF-Rが分化状態の維持に関与する正のフィードバック機構が提唱されている。
pmid-1633114.summary_en: This study examines epidermal growth factor receptor (EGF-R) gene expression during retinoic acid-induced differentiation of murine embryonal carcinoma cells, mainly P19 cells. Receptor mRNA and protein rise sharply upon differentiation toward neural and glial lineages, with transcript levels increasing 35 to 70-fold. Analyses of mRNA and protein stability, along with nuclear run-on transcription assays, suggest that both post-transcriptional stability and modest transcriptional changes contribute. The authors propose a feedback loop in which surface EGF-R sustains differentiation.

pmid-1727699.summary_ja: ラットの絨毛癌細胞（Rcho）を腎被膜下に移植すると、夜間のプロラクチン分泌サージやセロトニン誘導性分泌が抑制されました。胎盤性ラクトゲンの分泌が、妊娠中期以降のプロラクチン分泌の消失に関わる可能性が示唆されています。
pmid-1727699.summary_en: This study examined how pregnancy and rat choriocarcinoma (Rcho) cells affect serotonin- and TRH-induced prolactin release in rats. Rcho cells, which secrete placental lactogen I, were implanted beneath the kidney capsule and suppressed nocturnal prolactin surges and serotonin-induced prolactin release. TRH-induced release was not affected. The authors suggest that placental lactogens may antagonize the stimuli that drive prolactin surges in early pregnancy.

pmid-1727811.summary_ja: 絨毛癌細胞株NUC1を胎盤モデルとして用い、TNFαがhCG分泌を抑制することを示しました。hCGβ mRNAの発現も低下し、細胞毒性によるものではありませんでした。TNFαが栄養膜細胞のhCG産生を直接調節することが示唆されます。
pmid-1727811.summary_en: This study showed that tumor necrosis factor-alpha (TNF-alpha) reduces hCG secretion in normal chorionic villi and in the NUC1 choriocarcinoma cell line, used as an in vitro placental model. TNF-alpha decreased hCG secretion and hCG beta mRNA expression, and the effect was not due to cytotoxicity. The findings suggest TNF-alpha directly modulates trophoblast hCG production.

pmid-37281561.summary_ja: レチノイン酸で誘導したF9マウス胚性癌細胞の内胚葉分化過程で、アルカリホスファターゼの活性と発現を検討した。活性は著明に上昇し、4日目にはII型が主要な型となった。αフェトプロテインなどの内胚葉マーカーも発現が誘導された。mRNAの増加は活性上昇に先行し、翻訳後調節の関与が示唆された。
pmid-37281561.summary_en: This study investigates alkaline phosphatase (ALPase) changes in F9 mouse embryonal carcinoma cells during endodermal differentiation induced by retinoic acid. ALPase specific activity rose markedly, and treated cells expressed both type I and type II isozymes, with type II becoming dominant by day 4. Endoderm-specific transcripts, including alpha-fetoprotein, type IV collagen, and laminin B1, were induced. Expression of L/B/K/P-type ALPase mRNA preceded the increase in enzyme activity, suggesting translational or post-translational regulation.

pmid-1645268.summary_ja: 本報告は、growing teratoma syndromeを発症した、転移性混合型胚細胞腫瘍の精巣症例4例の放射線学的所見を示す。腫瘍マーカーが正常であったにもかかわらず、化学療法中に転移巣が増大し、残存腫瘤は悪性細胞を含まない成熟奇形腫であった。1例では肺結節の空洞化が認められた。著者らは、診断およびフォローアップにはCTが最も優れた手法であると結論づけている。
pmid-1645268.summary_en: This report presents radiologic findings in four patients with metastatic mixed germ cell tumors of the testis who developed growing teratoma syndrome. Metastases enlarged during chemotherapy despite normal tumor markers, and residual masses showed mature teratoma without malignant cells. One patient had cavitation of a pulmonary nodule, a rarely described finding. The authors conclude that CT is the best modality for diagnosis and follow-up.

pmid-1645564.summary_ja: 1971年から1984年のイングランドおよびウェールズの全国がん登録データを用いて、卵巣の胚細胞腫瘍を年齢、経時的推移、地域分布の観点から解析しています。奇形腫とディスジャーミノーマはいずれも15〜19歳に発生ピークを示し、65〜69歳にも奇形腫を主体とする二次的ピークがあります。奇形腫の発生率は若年層で増加し高齢層で減少し、ディスジャーミノーマは変化がありませんでした。これらの傾向は精巣がんの疫学に類似し、性別ごとのゴナドトロピン値の推移と並行していると考察されています。
pmid-1645564.summary_en: Using England and Wales national cancer register data from 1971 to 1984, this study analyzes ovarian germ cell cancers by age, time trends, and geography. Teratomas and dysgerminomas both peak at ages 15-19, and a second peak at 65-69 is mainly teratomas. Teratoma incidence has risen at younger ages but fallen at older ages, while dysgerminoma incidence was stable. The age and trend patterns resemble testicular cancer epidemiology and parallel sex-specific gonadotropin profiles.

pmid-1645819.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍44例を抗神経特異エノラーゼ抗体で免疫染色し、9例では手術前後の血清NSE値を測定しました。NSEはほとんどのセミノーマや多くの胎児性癌、卵黄嚢腫瘍の一部、奇形腫成分で陽性でした。血清NSE値は多くのセミノーマ症例で術前に高く、術後に低下しました。NSE染色は組織診断の補助に、血清NSEは経過観察や診断に有用な可能性があるとしています。
pmid-1645819.summary_en: This study examined neuron-specific enolase (NSE) in 44 testicular germ cell tumors by immunohistochemistry and measured serum NSE in nine patients before and after tumor removal. NSE was detected in most seminomas, many embryonal carcinomas and yolk sac tumors, and teratomatous components. Serum NSE was elevated before surgery and fell afterward in most seminoma cases. The authors suggest NSE staining may aid histologic diagnosis and serum NSE may help monitor disease course and diagnose seminoma.

pmid-1646453.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍と精細管内悪性胚細胞に対し、抗胎盤型アルカリホスファターゼ抗体と抗セミノーマ単クローナル抗体M2Aを用いた免疫染色を比較しています。PLAPはセミノーマと胎児性癌の両方を染色しましたが、M2Aはセミノーマと精細管内悪性胚細胞を染色し、胎児性癌は染色しませんでした。セミノーマは胎児性癌よりも精細管内悪性胚細胞に近縁と考えられ、精巣胚細胞腫瘍の発生起源の理解に示唆を与えています。
pmid-1646453.summary_en: This study compares immunoperoxidase staining of testicular germ cell tumors and intratubular malignant germ cells using antibody to placental alkaline phosphatase (PLAP) and a monoclonal anti-seminoma antibody, M2A. PLAP stained seminomas and embryonal carcinomas, while M2A stained seminomas and intratubular malignant germ cells but not embryonal carcinomas. The authors suggest seminomas are more closely related to intratubular malignant germ cells than to embryonal carcinomas, offering insight into testicular germ cell tumor histogenesis.

pmid-1646683.summary_ja: 本研究はオーストラリア・ビクトリア州の精巣がん発生率を1950年から1985年まで検討した。組織学的に確認された症例と登録データを用い、発生率は約2.9倍に上昇した。セミノーマと非セミノーマの両方で増加が認められ、非セミノーマでは若年層への移行が顕著であった。他のオーストラリア州でも同様の上昇が報告された。
pmid-1646683.summary_en: This registry-based study examined testicular cancer incidence in Victoria, Australia, from 1950 to 1985 using 1116 histologically checked cases and later registry data. Incidence rose nearly threefold, from 1.44 to 4.16 per 100,000. Rises were seen for both seminoma and nonseminoma, with nonseminomas increasingly affecting younger age groups. Cohort analysis supported these trends, and comparable increases were found in other Australian states.

pmid-1647564.summary_ja: OTT6050奇形癌腫由来の胚様体を同系マウスの腹腔内に移植し、5、7、9日後の増殖とラミニン・フィブロネクチン発現を検討した。ラミニンは嚢胞型と単純型の両方で内胚葉細胞に強く発現したが、フィブロネクチンの発現はわずかであった。本モデルは細胞外基質タンパク質の研究に有用と結論された。
pmid-1647564.summary_en: Embryoid bodies derived from the OTT6050 teratocarcinoma were injected intraperitoneally into isogenic mice, and their growth and extracellular matrix expression were studied at 5, 7 and 9 days. Laminin was strongly expressed on endodermal cells in both cystic and simple embryoid bodies, while fibronectin expression was only slight. The authors conclude that this in vivo model is useful for studying extracellular matrix proteins in embryogenesis and tumorigenesis.

pmid-1648634.summary_ja: 急性骨髄単球性白血病の診断から約3年後に精巣の胎児性癌を発症した症例を報告した。患者は放射線療法もアルキル化剤も受けていなかったため、二次性悪性腫瘍と考えられた。考えられる寄与因子について考察している。血液悪性腫瘍と続発する胚細胞腫瘍との関連を示す症例である。
pmid-1648634.summary_en: The authors describe a patient who developed testicular embryonal carcinoma about three years after being diagnosed with acute myelomonocytic leukemia. The patient had received neither irradiation nor alkylating agents, which makes the tumor likely a secondary malignancy. The report discusses possible contributing factors for the development of this second cancer. This case highlights the potential link between hematologic malignancy and subsequent germ cell tumors.

pmid-1648998.summary_ja: 精巣の非セミノーマ性胚細胞癌の転移巣が治療後に成熟奇形腫へ変化し、その内部に平滑筋肉腫が生じた症例を報告した。肉腫の出現は治療から18年後で、放射線誘発性と考えられた。奇形腫由来病変は通常は良性経過をたどるが、悪性転化が起こり得ることを示す症例である。
pmid-1648998.summary_en: The authors describe a leiomyosarcoma arising within a mature teratoma that had been present as a metastasis from nonseminomatous germ cell carcinoma of the testis. Chemotherapy had converted the metastatic embryonal carcinoma into mature teratoma. The sarcomatous component appeared 18 years after therapy and was judged likely to be radiation-induced. Such lesions usually follow a benign course, but this case shows malignant transformation can occur.

pmid-1649776.summary_ja: 本症例報告は、遺伝子マーカー解析により母性染色体1組と父性染色体2組と確認された部分胞状奇胎に続いて絨毛性腫瘍を発症した症例を記述している。フォローアップ中、血清hCGは持続的に高値であった。化学療法前の採取標本は妊娠性絨毛癌が疑われる形態を示した。部分奇胎が非胞状流産よりも妊娠性絨毛癌のリスクを高めるかは不明であり、持続性疾患の検出のために連続的なhCG測定が重要であると強調している。
pmid-1649776.summary_en: This case report describes a partial hydatidiform mole, confirmed by genetic marker analysis as one maternal and two paternal chromosome sets, followed by a subsequent trophoblastic tumor. Serum hCG remained persistently elevated during follow-up. Curettage specimens obtained before chemotherapy were morphologically suspicious for gestational choriocarcinoma. The authors note that it remains uncertain whether partial mole carries a higher risk of gestational choriocarcinoma than non-molar abortion, and emphasize careful serial hCG monitoring to detect persistent disease.

pmid-1649880.summary_ja: 妊娠初期の正常栄養膜細胞と胞状奇胎由来栄養膜細胞を用い、増殖因子の効果を検討した研究である。正常栄養膜細胞はEGF・PDGF・インスリン・GM-CSFの併用で強く増殖し、奇胎由来細胞はEGFやインスリンで増殖が促進された。両細胞とも長期培養が可能となった。妊娠性絨毛癌細胞株GCH-1は増殖因子に反応しなかった。
pmid-1649880.summary_en: This study examined how growth factors affect long-term cultures of normal first-trimester trophoblasts and molar trophoblasts from hydatidiform moles. Normal trophoblasts responded strongly to a combination of EGF, PDGF, insulin and GM-CSF, while molar trophoblasts were stimulated by EGF or insulin. Both cell types were maintained for many months and were identified as trophoblasts by CAM 5.2 staining. The gestational choriocarcinoma line GCH-1 did not respond to any growth factor and served as a comparator.

pmid-1649925.summary_ja: 化学療法後の大きな転移を伴う非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍に対し、後腹膜リンパ節郭清時に下大静脈切除または腫瘍栓摘出を行った42例の報告である。適応は腫瘍の遺残除去、瘢痕閉塞、下大静脈腫瘍栓の3つであった。静脈壁の病理はリンパ節病理を反映し、合併症は概ね一過性であった。化学療法の選択肢を使い果たした患者での生存率は71%であり、侵襲的手術の妥当性を示した。
pmid-1649925.summary_en: This report analyzes 42 patients who underwent inferior vena cava resection or intraluminal tumor thrombectomy during retroperitoneal lymph node dissection for bulky metastatic nonseminomatous germ cell tumor after chemotherapy. Indications were tumor clearance, caval scar occlusion, and caval tumor thrombus. Pathology of the resected vena cava mirrored nodal pathology, and complications were generally transient. The 71% survival rate, achieved in patients who had exhausted chemotherapy options, is presented as justification for this intensive surgical approach.

pmid-1651526.summary_ja: 播種性非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の48例を後方視的に検討し、化学療法後の残存腫瘤における悪性所見や奇形腫の有無を、CT所見と初発病理所見で除外できるかを評価しました。腫瘤サイズや縮小率などのCT所見では予測できず、画像・病理所見のみで残存悪性腫瘍や奇形腫を確実に除外することはできないと結論づけています。
pmid-1651526.summary_en: This retrospective study of 48 patients with disseminated nonseminomatous germ cell tumors evaluated whether CT features and initial pathology can exclude malignancy or teratoma in residual masses resected after chemotherapy. Neither residual mass size, attenuation, shrinkage during treatment, nor primary tumor cell type reliably predicted residual histology. Among nine patients with both a teratoma-free primary and over 90 percent shrinkage, two had malignancy and two had teratoma. The authors conclude that radiographic and pathologic features cannot reliably exclude residual malignancy or teratoma after chemotherapy for nonseminomatous testicular cancer, underscoring the need for resection of residual masses.

pmid-1651828.summary_ja: 1972年から1985年にかけて治療された絨毛癌と侵入奇胎の209例を解析した報告です。主に5-FUおよびKSMを用いた化学療法が行われ、絨毛癌の死亡率は84.3%から32.7%に、侵入奇胎では32.4%から8.1%に低下しました。回復後に妊娠した患者の子どもはすべて正常に成長しています。
pmid-1651828.summary_en: This Chinese Medical Journal report reviews choriocarcinoma and invasive mole treated at one hospital from 1948 to 1985, focusing on 209 cases from 1972 to 1985. A 5-FU and/or KSM regimen was the main treatment. Metastases were present in over 90 percent of choriocarcinoma cases, and mortality fell from 84.3 to 32.7 percent for choriocarcinoma and from 32.4 to 8.1 percent for invasive mole. Many chemotherapy-treated survivors later conceived, and all their children were normal and healthy.

pmid-1651992.summary_ja: 一次治療でシスプラチンに失敗した転移性胚細胞腫瘍の30例に、PEI(シスプラチン、エトポシド、イホスファミド)によるサルベージ療法を行った研究です。約3分の1で完全寛解が得られ、先行治療への反応良好例で成績が良好でした。主な用量制限毒性は骨髄抑制でした。
pmid-1651992.summary_en: This 1991 Journal of Clinical Oncology study evaluated salvage therapy with cisplatin, etoposide, and ifosfamide (PEI) in 30 patients with metastatic germ cell carcinoma that progressed after first-line cisplatin. Ten patients (33 percent) became tumor-free, and response to prior cisplatin predicted outcome: 57 percent of previously responsive patients achieved a second complete response versus 9 percent of others. Median survival was 311 days overall and 400 days in the favorable group. Myelosuppression was dose-limiting. The authors conclude that PEI induces a second remission in about one third of patients, with cure mainly expected in those with prior favorable responses.

pmid-1652171.summary_ja: 病期I非セミノーマ性精巣胚細胞腫瘍の治療の変遷を概説した総説です。後腹膜リンパ節郭清や放射線療法から、経過観察、温存型リンパ節郭清へと変化してきました。再発リスクは、局所進行度、脈管侵襲、胎児性癌などの組織型で評価され、治療は患者ごとに個別化すべきとしています。
pmid-1652171.summary_en: This urology review traces the management of stage I nonseminomatous germ cell tumors of the testis over three decades, from retroperitoneal lymphadenectomy and radiotherapy to surveillance and modified or nerve-sparing lymphadenectomy. Key predictors of relapse include local tumor stage, vascular or lymphatic invasion, and histology such as embryonal carcinoma. Patients with unfavorable features should generally undergo lymphadenectomy, while favorable-risk patients may choose surveillance or lymphadenectomy. The authors emphasize individualized treatment, pathologic review, accurate imaging, and future research on fertility and risk-adapted chemotherapy.

pmid-1652567.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍107例を対象に、新規のモノクローナル抗体を用いてp53蛋白の発現を免疫組織化学で評価した研究です。84%の症例で核内陽性を示し、胎児性癌はセミノーマより陽性率が高くなっています。前浸潤性病変の59%でも陽性で、p53異常は発がんの比較的早期に起こると考えられます。
pmid-1652567.summary_en: This 1991 study examined p53 protein accumulation in a broad range of human testicular germ cell tumors using a newly developed monoclonal antibody and a polyclonal antiserum. Immunohistochemistry showed nuclear p53 positivity in 84 percent of 107 tumors, with higher rates in embryonal carcinoma than seminoma. Normal testes were negative, while 59 percent of preinvasive intratubular germ cell neoplasia lesions were positive. The authors conclude that p53 alteration is a common feature of invasive male germ cell tumors and likely an early event in testicular cancer pathogenesis.

pmid-1652995.summary_ja: まれな妊娠性トロホブラスト疾患である悪性胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍の致死的症例の報告です。腫瘍細胞は主にhPLを発現し、hCGは局所的にのみ陽性でした。経過中に絨毛癌類似の二相性パターンを呈しました。転移が生じると、治療にかかわらず予後は不良です。
pmid-1652995.summary_en: This report describes a fatal case of malignant placental site trophoblastic tumor, a rare gestational trophoblastic neoplasm. Immunohistochemistry showed that the tumor cells predominantly expressed human placental lactogen, with hCG present only focally. Over time, the tumor developed a biphasic pattern resembling choriocarcinoma. The authors review the clinical and pathological features of malignant PSTT and note that diagnosis and prediction of behavior can be difficult. Once metastases occur, prognosis is poor regardless of therapy.

pmid-1653575.summary_ja: 4歳女児の後腹膜奇形腫の症例報告です。主な成分はウィルムス腫瘍様で、未熟奇形腫や悪性奇形腫の典型像とは異なっていました。完全切除の3か月後に再発した腫瘍は奇形腫成分を含まず、ネフロブラストーマ様成分のみでした。まれな腫瘍の組織発生についても考察されています。
pmid-1653575.summary_en: This case report describes a 4-year-old girl with a retroperitoneal teratoma whose predominant component resembled Wilms tumor (nephroblastoma), unlike typical immature or malignant teratomas. The mature elements included adipose tissue, neural tissue, cartilage, muscle, and respiratory and gastrointestinal epithelium. Three months after complete excision, a recurrent tumor developed that contained only nephroblastomatous elements without teratomatous components. The authors discuss the possible histogenesis of this rare tumor.

pmid-1654130.summary_ja: 精巣がんの疫学と治療の進歩をまとめた総説です。精巣摘除術後の腫瘍マーカー上昇速度は、薬剤抵抗性疾患の予測因子となることが示されています。病期I非セミノーマでは補助化学療法で再発率が低下し、セミノーマでは補助療法としての放射線療法の役割が見直されつつあります。
pmid-1654130.summary_en: This 1991 review covers testicular cancer advances: germinal epithelial atrophy as a common pathway in tumor development, elevated FSH at diagnosis as a marker of second-tumor risk, and post-orchiectomy tumor marker kinetics as a predictor of drug-resistant disease. For stage I nonseminoma, two courses of adjuvant chemotherapy produced lower relapse rates than surgical staging. In seminoma, combination chemotherapy cures nearly all patients and carboplatin alone about 80 percent, prompting reconsideration of adjuvant radiotherapy. Two courses of adjuvant carboplatin gave equivalent results with possibly less toxicity.

pmid-1655215.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍の両側同時性発生で、組織型が異なる症例の6例目を報告する。既報は5例のみである。異時性の対側発生は約3%、同時性両側発生は約0.5%とされ、両側腫瘍は通常組織学的に同一であることを踏まえ、発生機序と臨床上の意義を考察している。
pmid-1655215.summary_en: This report describes the sixth published case of synchronous bilateral testicular germ cell tumors with different histologic types. Metachronous development in the contralateral testis occurs in about 3% of patients with a testicular GCT, and synchronous bilateral GCT in about 0.5%. Bilateral testicular tumors are usually histologically identical. The authors discuss the clinical and pathogenetic implications of this rare bilateral presentation.

pmid-1655226.summary_ja: 性腺外胚細胞腫瘍の40歳男性が、自家骨髄移植後にアスペルギルス感染症を発症した症例報告。Hickmanカテーテル出口部の皮膚感染から真菌血症を経て播種性に進展した。好中球減少がみられなかった点が特徴的で、大量化学療法後の感染リスクとカテーテル関連感染への注意を示す。
pmid-1655226.summary_en: A 40-year-old man with extragonadal germ cell tumor developed disseminated Aspergillus fumigatus infection after autologous bone marrow transplantation. The infection spread hematogenously after fungemia, originating from a skin infection at a Hickman catheter exit site. Notably, the patient had no neutropenia, which is atypical for invasive aspergillosis. The report highlights infection risk after high-dose therapy and catheter-related sources in patients with GCT.

pmid-1655464.summary_ja: 後腹膜のセミノーマ(未分化成分を伴う)に対しシスプラチン併用化学療法で完全寛解した44歳男性が、88か月後に右精巣摘除術で精巣混合型胚細胞腫瘍(胎児性癌とセミノーマ未分化成分)と診断された症例。第2の腫瘍の発生機序について考察している。
pmid-1655464.summary_en: A 44-year-old man with retroperitoneal classic seminoma containing anaplastic areas achieved complete remission after cisplatin-based chemotherapy. Eighty-eight months later, he was diagnosed with a testicular mixed germ cell tumor, consisting of embryonal carcinoma with anaplastic seminoma areas, after right orchiectomy. The authors discuss the potential mechanisms by which this second tumor developed.

pmid-1656057.summary_ja: デンマークの全国コホートで、1960〜1979年に初発の胚細胞腫瘍と診断された男性2,850例を対象に、対側精巣の二次性腫瘍リスクを評価した。73例(2.6%)が対側に腫瘍を発症し、25年累積リスクは5.2%であった。非セミノーマ(8.4%)はセミノーマ(3.6%)より高かった。相対リスクは24.8と高値で、残存精巣の上皮内がんのスクリーニングと治療を含む厳重な経過観察が推奨されている。
pmid-1656057.summary_en: This Danish nationwide cohort study assessed the risk of a second primary contralateral testicular germ cell cancer in 2,850 men first diagnosed with germ cell cancer from 1960 to 1979. Seventy-three men (2.6%) developed a contralateral tumor, with a 25-year cumulative risk of 5.2%. The risk was higher after nonseminoma (8.4%) than after seminoma (3.6%). The overall relative risk was 24.8 and was not affected by age, calendar period, or time since diagnosis. The authors recommend close surveillance of the remaining testicle, including screening for and treating carcinoma in situ.

pmid-1656346.summary_ja: ウェリントン病院で治療された精巣がん79例を対象に、腫瘍発見から手術までの期間と予後の関係を検討した。期間が短い群と長い群で生存に差はなかったが、期間が短い群では腫瘍が小さい傾向があった。腫瘍の発見が遅すぎるため期間短縮だけでは生存は改善しないが、患者自身による早期発見と精巣自己検査の啓発が重要だと結論づけている。
pmid-1656346.summary_en: This Wellington Hospital study of 79 patients with testicular cancer examined whether the interval from tumor recognition to surgery affected prognosis. No survival difference was found between patients with short and long intervals, but shorter intervals were associated with smaller tumors. The authors conclude that tumors are recognized too late for shortening the interval to improve survival. They suggest that earlier recognition by patients could allow diagnosis at an earlier stage and support public education on testicular self-examination.

pmid-1656435.summary_ja: ヒト奇形腫の神経組織マーカーとして、NCAMの長鎖ポリシアル酸に対するモノクローナル抗体を評価した。S-100、GFAP、ニューロフィラメント蛋白、NGFRと比較した結果、抗ポリシアル酸抗体は成熟・未熟の両方の神経組織を一貫して標識した。未熟な神経成分は奇形腫の予後に関わるため、その同定に最も感度が高く有用なマーカーであると結論づけている。
pmid-1656435.summary_en: This study evaluated a monoclonal antibody against polysialic acid, a long-chain form of NCAM, as a marker of neural tissue in human teratomas. Its staining was compared with S-100, GFAP, neurofilament protein, and NGFR. The anti-polysialic acid antibody consistently labeled both mature and immature neural elements, whereas the other markers were less reliable. Because immature neural components carry prognostic significance in teratomas, the authors conclude that this antibody is the most sensitive and useful marker for identifying them.

pmid-1656578.summary_ja: 転移性精巣腫瘍の予後リスク分類について総説的に論じ、良好群・不良群の非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍試験に焦点を当てている。予後因子として、αフェトプロテイン(AFP)、hCG、LDHなどの腫瘍マーカー、病変の広がり・腫瘤量、組織型、原発部位が挙げられる。腫瘍マーカーと病変量を組み合わせると、いずれか単独より反応性と生存をよく予測でき、毒性の強い不良群治療に割り付けられる患者を減らせると主張している。
pmid-1656578.summary_en: This review discusses risk stratification in metastatic testicular germ cell tumors, focusing on good- and poor-risk nonseminomatous germ cell tumor trials. Prognostic factors include serum AFP, hCG, and LDH, extent or bulk of disease, histology, and primary site. The authors argue that combining biologic markers with disease bulk predicts response and survival better than either alone, reducing the number of patients assigned to toxic poor-risk regimens. They also caution that trial eligibility criteria affect reported outcomes and that randomized comparisons are needed.

pmid-1657126.summary_ja: 1972〜1990年にハイデルベルク大学小児外科で治療された卵巣腫瘍の小児44例を検討した。61%は腫瘍様病変で、真の腫瘍は17例(39%)であり、うち8例は胚細胞腫瘍であった。悪性は2例のみで、悪性奇形腫と悪性顆粒膜細胞腫瘍であった。治療は腫瘍の大きさ、ホルモン活性、合併する症候群、腫瘍の状態によって決めるべきだと述べている。
pmid-1657126.summary_en: This Heidelberg pediatric surgery series reviewed 44 children treated for ovarian tumors between 1972 and 1990. Twenty-seven (61%) had tumor-like lesions, including neonatal and functional cysts and syndrome-associated cysts, while 17 (39%) were genuine tumors: eight germ cell tumors, seven cystadenomas, and two gonadal stromal tumors. Only two cases were malignant, a malignant teratoma and a malignant granulosa-theca cell tumor. The authors note that management depends on tumor size, hormonal activity, associated syndromes, and tumor status.

pmid-1658054.summary_ja: 毛髪を含む卵巣奇形腫の超音波マーカーを検討するため、経腟超音波の所見を模擬したin vitroモデルを作製した。モデル導入前の32例と導入後の25例を比較したところ、経腟超音波による陽性的中率は84%から100%に向上した。このモデルにより診断精度が高まり、術式や手術時期を前もって計画しやすくなったと結論づけている。
pmid-1658054.summary_en: This study evaluated hair echoes as a sonographic marker of hair-containing ovarian teratomas. An in vitro simulation model was developed to mimic the transvaginal appearance of these cystic tumors. Comparing 32 patients scanned before the model with 25 scanned after its introduction, the positive predictive value of transvaginal sonography rose from 84% to 100%. The authors conclude that the model improved diagnostic accuracy and allowed more precise planning of surgical type and timing.

pmid-1658924.summary_ja: スウェーデン・ノルウェーの多施設共同研究SWENOTECAによる非セミノーマ性精巣胚細胞腫瘍の早期病期の解析。臨床的病期診断の正確度は75%で、精巣摘除後の腫瘍マーカーは後腹膜転移の予測に有用だった。病理学的病期I患者の再発因子は、摘除からRPLNDまでの期間短縮、血管浸潤、原発巣の奇形腫成分欠如であった。適切な補助化学療法を行えば、RPLND後のCTや多くの血液検査は省略可能と結論された。
pmid-1658924.summary_en: This Swedish-Norwegian multicenter study (SWENOTECA) of 588 patients with nonseminomatous testicular germ cell cancer evaluated early-stage disease. Clinical staging was 75% accurate, and tumor markers after orchiectomy helped predict retroperitoneal metastasis. Among pathologically staged stage I patients, relapse predictors included a short orchiectomy-to-RPLND interval, vascular invasion, and absence of teratoma elements. Unilateral RPLND did not increase relapse. Routine CT and most blood tests could be omitted during follow-up after RPLND, provided stage II patients received adjuvant cisplatin-based chemotherapy.

pmid-1659016.summary_ja: 1986年以降に陰嚢病変205例を専用コイルを用いた1.5T MRIで検査した研究。精巣がんが疑われた88例では陽性的中率が100%で、セミノーマと非セミノーマ性腫瘍の鑑別は62%で正確だった。良性病変を含む全体として、MRIは不要な診断的外科的探索を減らせる可能性が示された。
pmid-1659016.summary_en: This 1991 study evaluated MRI in 205 patients with scrotal pathology, 88 suspected of testicular cancer and 117 with benign lesions, using 1.5-T imaging with dedicated external coils. MRI achieved a 100% predictive value for diagnosing testicular cancer and correctly distinguished seminoma from nonseminomatous tumors in 62% of cases. The authors concluded that MRI could reduce diagnostic surgical exploration of scrotal lesions, supporting its role in the initial evaluation of suspected testicular tumors.

pmid-1659355.summary_ja: 1,387例の卵巣腫瘍を解析した研究で、胚細胞起源の腫瘍は440例の類皮嚢腫のほか、未熟奇形腫、ディスジャーミノーマ、卵黄嚢腫瘍、絨毛癌などが含まれた。患者は若年女性が中心で、類皮嚢腫の悪性転化は40歳以上で4.3%と高率だった。境界悪性の胚細胞腫瘍の予後は良好と報告されている。
pmid-1659355.summary_en: This clinicostatistical study of 1,387 ovarian tumors identified 440 dermoid cysts and smaller numbers of germ cell tumors, including immature teratomas, dysgerminomas, yolk sac tumors, and one choriocarcinoma. Germ cell tumors occurred mainly in young women, with mean ages of 17 to 32 years, whereas carcinoids and dermoid cysts with malignant transformation occurred later. Malignant transformation of dermoid cysts occurred in 0.9% overall and 4.3% in women over 40. Borderline germ cell tumors had a good prognosis.

pmid-1660411.summary_ja: 1977〜1989年に精巣非セミノーマに対して152例の後腹膜リンパ節郭清を行った経験の報告。初回化学療法の前後で術前病期診断と術中所見の不一致率は35%と16%で、死亡率は約20%と同等だった。化学療法後に手術を受けた78例中41例で腫瘍組織が残存していた。術後化学療法の計画や予後判断には病理所見が重要とされた。
pmid-1660411.summary_en: This 12-year experience (1977 to 1989) with 152 retroperitoneal lymph node dissections (RPLND) for testicular nonseminomas compared procedures performed before and after initial chemotherapy. Staging discrepancies with intraoperative findings were 35% before and 16% after chemotherapy, with similar mortality of about 20%. Among post-chemotherapy cases, 41 of 78 had viable or partially damaged tumor tissue. The authors emphasize that RPLND pathology guides postoperative chemotherapy and prognosis.

pmid-1660868.summary_ja: 卵巣奇形腫由来のPA-1細胞株を用い、未分化細胞が無血清培地中でEGFおよびIGF-Iの代替となる増殖因子を分泌することを明らかにしました。抗EGF・抗IGF-I抗体と反応する低分子ポリペプチドが同定され、PA-1細胞上に各受容体の存在も確認されました。奇形癌における自己分泌性増殖機構を研究するモデル系として提案されています。
pmid-1660868.summary_en: Using the ovarian teratoma-derived PA-1 cell line, the authors found that undifferentiated cells secrete factors that substitute for EGF and IGF-I in stimulating growth of a responsive mammary tumor cell line under serum-free conditions. Immunoreactive low-molecular-weight polypeptides were identified, and corresponding receptors were localized on PA-1 cells. The work proposes this system as a model for autocrine growth stimulation in teratocarcinomas.

pmid-1661046.summary_ja: セミノーマ20例および混合型胚細胞腫瘍20例について、腫瘍のない精巣組織を形態計測しました。合胞体栄養膜巨細胞(STGC)が存在する場合、特にセミノーマや混合型でライディッヒ細胞の面積や精細管あたりの表面積が有意に増加していました。STGCを伴う胚細胞腫瘍では、ライディッヒ細胞の肥大・過形成が重要な所見と考えられ、精細管あたりの表面積で評価するのが有用です。
pmid-1661046.summary_en: The study examined tumor-free testicular tissue from 20 seminomas and 20 mixed germ cell tumors, with or without syncytiotrophoblastic giant cells (STGC), which drive elevated hCG. Leydig cell area and surface per tubule were significantly increased when STGC were present, particularly in seminomas and combined tumors. The authors conclude that Leydig cell hypertrophy and hyperplasia is a relevant finding in germ cell tumors with STGC, best recorded as surface area per tubule.

pmid-1661265.summary_ja: 乳房腫瘍として発症し、乳管内乳癌と併存していた転移性絨毛癌の症例を報告しています。乳房へ転移した絨毛癌が化学療法に反応した最初の文献報告とされています。乳房組織における絨毛癌は極めてまれであることが強調されています。
pmid-1661265.summary_en: The authors describe a patient presenting with a breast mass caused by metastatic choriocarcinoma that coexisted with an intraductal breast carcinoma. This is reported as the first documented case of choriocarcinoma metastatic to the breast that responded to chemotherapy. The report highlights the rarity of choriocarcinoma involving breast tissue and the therapeutic response achieved.

pmid-1661794.summary_ja: 胸腺腫、胸腺癌、胸腺の胚細胞腫瘍の治療を概説した総説です。胸腺腫は放射線療法を併用するかどうかにかかわらず外科療法が主で、CDDP、ADM、VCR、CPA、BLMなどの化学療法が検討されています。精巣胚細胞腫瘍に有効なPVB、VAB-6、PEBなどのレジメンは、セミノーマを含む胸腺の胚細胞腫瘍にも有効とされています。
pmid-1661794.summary_en: This Japanese review summarizes treatment of thymoma, thymic carcinoma, and thymic germ cell tumor. Surgery with or without radiation is the main therapy for thymoma, with chemotherapy regimens such as CDDP, ADM, VCR, CPA or BLM under investigation. Regimens effective for testicular germ cell tumors (PVB, VAB-6, PEB) are also effective for thymic germ cell tumor including seminoma, and chemotherapy may be used more often for seminoma in future.

pmid-1663468.summary_ja: 著者らは、129/Sv-ter雄マウスの自然発生精巣腫瘍から二倍体の精巣奇形癌株STT-3を樹立し、その発生能を検討した。STT-3幹細胞を胚盤胞に注入すると、高頻度でキメラを形成し、妊娠中期の胎仔と出生マウスの両方で広範なキメラ化が見られた。細胞は正常な組織へと分化した。著者らは、生存可能なキメラマウスを形成する能力を持つ精巣奇形癌由来の幹細胞株として、これが初めての報告であると述べている。
pmid-1663468.summary_en: The authors established STT-3, a euploid testicular teratocarcinoma line derived from a spontaneous tumor in a 129/Sv-ter mouse, and tested its developmental potential. Injected into blastocysts, STT-3 stem cells contributed to chimeras at high frequency, with extensive chimerism in mid-gestation fetuses and live-born mice. The cells differentiated into normal tissues, making this the first reported testicular teratocarcinoma-derived stem line capable of forming viable chimeric mice.

pmid-1663935.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍の病理診断報告書に含めるべき項目を概説した総説です。混合型では組織型と成分割合、腫瘍径、局所進展(精巣網、白膜、精巣上体、精索)、脈管侵襲、非腫瘍側精巣の所見(停留精巣、精子形成)を記載します。病理医による正確な局所病期分類と転移の分類が、治療選択に重要であると強調されています。
pmid-1663935.summary_en: This review outlines the pathology report elements needed for testicular germ cell tumors. These include histologic type with component percentages in mixed tumors, tumor size, local spread (rete testis, tunica albuginea, epididymis, spermatic cord, including the cord margin), vascular or lymphatic invasion, and the status of the uninvolved testis, including cryptorchidism and spermatogenesis. The pathologist's role in precise local staging and metastasis classification is emphasized for guiding therapy.

pmid-1663937.summary_ja: 本総説は、低病期精巣がんの外科的管理を論じている。化学療法により生存率がほぼ100%に達しているため、著者らは治療による罹患の低減が目標であると主張する。奇形腫を含む低リスク患者は、精巣摘除術後少なくとも2〜3年間、胸部X線撮影、腫瘍マーカー検査、CTによる能動的監視の対象となり得る。修正後腹膜リンパ節郭清により確定的な病期分類が可能となり、化学療法量を減らせる。大きな病変を有する病期II疾患には通常化学療法が必要であるが、病期IIAでは約半数が外科的治療のみで治療可能である。特に切除された残存奇形腫を有する患者では、長期フォローアップが必要であると結論づけている。
pmid-1663937.summary_en: This 1991 review discusses surgical management of low-stage testicular cancer. Because chemotherapy achieves near-complete survival, the authors argue the goal is to reduce treatment morbidity. Selected low-risk patients, including those with teratoma, may be observed under active surveillance for at least 2 to 3 years after orchiectomy, using chest radiography, tumor marker tests, and CT. Modified retroperitoneal lymph node dissection allows definitive staging with less chemotherapy. Bulky stage II disease generally requires chemotherapy, while stage IIA disease may be managed surgically in about half of patients. Long-term follow-up remains necessary, especially after resection of residual teratoma.

pmid-1663938.summary_ja: 本総説は精巣胚細胞腫瘍における放射線療法の役割を論じる。病期Iおよび小範囲の病期IIの精巣セミノーマには横隔膜下放射線療法が標準とされ、無病生存率は90～95%を超える。大きな病変を有する進行例では、まず多剤併用化学療法を行い、残存腫瘤に対して照射野限局放射線療法を行う。臨床病期Iの非セミノーマにも有効な選択肢だが、米国では用いられることは少ない。化学療法後の地固め療法としても有用であり、性腺外セミノーマにも適応がある。
pmid-1663938.summary_en: This review examines the role of radiotherapy in testicular germ cell tumors. Infradiaphragmatic radiotherapy is the treatment of choice for stage I and small-volume stage II testicular seminoma, with disease-free survival above 90% to 95%. Large-volume advanced disease is treated first with multiagent chemotherapy, followed by involved-field radiotherapy for residual masses. For clinical stage I nonseminoma, radiotherapy is a viable but less commonly used option with relapse-free survival of about 85% to 90%. Radiotherapy also serves as post-chemotherapy consolidation and is useful for extragonadal seminoma.

pmid-1663941.summary_ja: 本総説は原発不明癌と性腺外胚細胞腫瘍の関係を扱う。一部の患者は性腺外胚細胞腫瘍であり、シスプラチンを用いた治療成績の良さや、診断的な染色体異常により支持される。縦隔または後腹膜に低分化癌を認める若年男性では、胚細胞腫瘍を疑い染色体分析を行うべきとされる。一方、低分化神経内分泌腫瘍や非ホジキンリンパ腫の患者も治療に反応することがある。
pmid-1663941.summary_en: This 1991 review addresses carcinoma of unknown primary site and its overlap with extragonadal germ cell tumors. Some such patients have germ cell tumors, supported by superior outcomes with cisplatin-based treatment and by a diagnostic chromosomal abnormality found in some tumors. Young men with poorly differentiated carcinoma centered in the mediastinum or retroperitoneum should be suspected of having a germ cell tumor and evaluated by chromosomal analysis. Other responsive patients have poorly differentiated neuroendocrine tumors or were misdiagnosed lymphomas, and additional responsive subgroups are likely to exist.

pmid-1663943.summary_ja: 本総説は卵巣胚細胞腫瘍の化学療法を概説する。現代の外科的病期分類と有効な化学療法レジメンにより治療成績が改善した。ディスジャーミノーマ（未分化胚細胞腫）以外の組織型には補助化学療法が推奨される。病期IAのディスジャーミノーマ（未分化胚細胞腫）は経過観察が可能だが、進行例には化学療法を行う。シスプラチンを基盤とするレジメンはVAC型より有効であり、他の組織型の予後には改善の余地がある。
pmid-1663943.summary_en: This review summarizes chemotherapy for ovarian germ cell tumors. Modern surgical staging and effective regimens have markedly improved outcomes, and nearly all patients with completely resected tumors survive. Patients with non-dysgerminoma histology should receive adjuvant chemotherapy. Stage IA dysgerminoma can be observed, while higher-stage disease usually needs chemotherapy, with radiotherapy an option in selected older or frail patients. Cisplatin-based regimens, developed for testicular cancer, outperform VAC-type regimens. Most dysgerminoma patients are cured, while outcomes for other histologies have room for improvement.

pmid-1664471.summary_ja: 本症例報告は、67Gaクエン酸と99mTc-HIDAシンチグラフィーにより検出された、肝細胞癌と精巣セミノーマの重複癌の1例である。胸壁病変は肝癌転移が疑われたが、精巣にも別の癌が存在すると判断された。精巣摘除術と針生検により、精巣はセミノーマ、肝および胸壁は肝細胞癌と確認された。シンチグラフィーが多発癌の診断に有用であったことを示している。
pmid-1664471.summary_en: This 1991 case report describes a patient with two primary cancers, hepatocellular carcinoma and testicular seminoma, detected by gallium-67 citrate and technetium-99m HIDA scintigraphy. Gallium uptake was seen in the chest wall, liver lesion, and testis, while HIDA uptake appeared only in the chest wall. The chest wall lesion was initially suspected to be a metastasis from hepatocellular carcinoma, with a separate testicular cancer. Orchiectomy and needle biopsy confirmed seminoma in the testis and hepatocellular carcinoma in the liver and chest wall.

pmid-1664641.summary_ja: 成熟奇形腫と莢膜細胞腫が同一卵巣に共存した2症例の報告である。症例は36歳と48歳の女性で、性器出血や下腹部痛を主訴に来院した。いずれも皮膚組織を含む単房性嚢胞性の成熟奇形腫と、脂質に富む紡錘形細胞からなる充実性腫瘍が隣接していた。両成分は完全に分離し、移行像は認められなかった。卵巣における両者の共存は稀な所見である。
pmid-1664641.summary_en: This 1991 case report describes two women with coexisting mature ovarian teratoma and thecoma. A 36-year-old presented with genital bleeding and a 12 x 9 cm ovarian tumor, and a 48-year-old postmenopausal woman presented with lower abdominal pain and a 15 x 11 cm tumor. In both cases, a unilocular cystic skin-containing component lay adjacent to a solid spindle-cell component with lipid-rich cytoplasm. The two components were completely separate with no transitional features. The findings document the rare coexistence of these tumors in the same ovary.

pmid-1666273.summary_ja: 本研究は精巣胚細胞腫瘍36例の精巣摘除標本で、腫瘍細胞のDNA量を細胞測光法により測定した。セミノーマでは精母細胞性セミノーマのDNA量が最も低く、非セミノーマでは絨毛癌が最も高く、奇形腫が最も低かった。セミノーマと非セミノーマの間で平均DNA量に有意差はなかった。多くの腫瘍は二倍体範囲外であり、異数性の頻度の高さは診断に有用となりうる。
pmid-1666273.summary_en: This study measured DNA content by cytophotometry in orchiectomy specimens from 36 men with testicular germ cell tumors. Spermatocytic seminoma showed the lowest DNA content among seminomas, while choriocarcinoma had the highest and teratoma the lowest among non-seminomatous tumors. Overall DNA content did not differ significantly between seminomas and non-seminomas. Most tumors showed non-diploid modal values, suggesting frequent aneuploidy that may aid diagnosis.

pmid-1667098.summary_ja: 1962年から1990年にかけてブリュワー センターで治療された妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍の経験を報告しています。化学療法を受けた564例（絨毛癌および侵入奇胎）の治療成績がまとめられています。全体の治癒率は94%で、転移のない症例では100%、転移例では85%でした。治療効果に影響した因子は4つ示されています。
pmid-1667098.summary_en: This report summarizes experience at the John I. Brewer Trophoblastic Disease Center from 1962 to 1990, including 5063 referred patients and 564 treated with chemotherapy for gestational trophoblastic tumors (choriocarcinoma and invasive mole). The overall cure rate was 94 percent, reaching 100 percent in non-metastatic disease and 85 percent with metastases. Four factors significantly predicted response: choriocarcinoma histology, metastatic sites other than lung or vagina, number of metastases, and prior failed chemotherapy. These findings inform risk-adapted management.

pmid-1667240.summary_ja: 胞状奇胎と妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍（GTN）について、疫学、病理、内分泌、診断、治療の進歩をまとめた総説です。完全奇胎と部分奇胎は組織像と遺伝学的特徴が異なる別個の疾患とされます。非転移例ではほぼ100%、多くの転移例でも治癒が得られ、多くは妊孕性が温存できます。局所限局例では外科的切除で治癒可能な胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍も取り上げられています。
pmid-1667240.summary_en: This review traces advances over four decades in the epidemiology, pathology, endocrinology, diagnosis, and treatment of molar pregnancy and gestational trophoblastic neoplasia. Complete and partial moles are recognized as distinct entities with different histopathology and genetics. Early diagnosis and effective chemotherapy yield near 100 percent cure in non-metastatic disease and most metastatic cases, often preserving fertility. Placental site trophoblastic tumor is curable by surgery when localized but usually fatal when disseminated. Further progress is anticipated to improve survival in resistant cases.

pmid-1672521.summary_ja: プルーンベリー症候群の長期生存者に発生した精巣セミノーマの症例報告です。この症候群では停留精巣を高頻度に伴い、停留精巣は精巣胚細胞腫瘍の既知の危険因子です。著者らは、この症候群の患者における原発性精巣胚細胞腫瘍として2例目の報告としています。停留精巣を有する男性では、悪性腫瘍への注意が重要であると指摘しています。
pmid-1672521.summary_en: This case report describes a testicular seminoma in a long-term survivor of prune belly syndrome. Patients with this syndrome commonly have cryptorchidism, a known risk factor for testicular germ cell tumors. The authors present only the second documented case of a primary testicular germ cell tumor in a patient with prune belly syndrome. The report highlights the association between undescended testes and testicular malignancy and the need for vigilance in such patients.

pmid-1672910.summary_ja: 1935年から1974年にミネソタ州ロチェスターで停留精巣と診断された224例のフォローアップ研究です。年齢別の地域発生率と比較した結果、2例の悪性精巣腫瘍が確認され、標準化罹患比は11.4でした。鼠径ヘルニアや先天奇形などのリスク増加も認められました。停留精巣患者では悪性腫瘍のリスクが高いことを支持する結果です。
pmid-1672910.summary_en: This follow-up study of 224 men diagnosed with cryptorchidism in Rochester, Minnesota, between 1935 and 1974 assessed subsequent testicular neoplasms. Using age-specific community rates, the authors found two malignant testicular neoplasms, giving a standardized morbidity ratio of 11.4. The cohort also showed increased risks of inguinal hernia, hypospadias, Down syndrome, cleft lip or palate, clubfoot, and congenital heart disease. The findings support an elevated malignancy risk in cryptorchidism, consistent with earlier studies.

pmid-1674487.summary_ja: 胎盤に生じた稀な奇形腫の症例を報告し、発生起源について考察した論文です。胎盤奇形腫は、無形胎児と比較して構造的な組織化が乏しく、腫瘍に流入する大きな血管がない点が特徴とされています。本論文は、治療成績ではなく、この稀な病変の希少性と発生機序に焦点を当てた短報です。
pmid-1674487.summary_en: This report describes a case of placental teratoma, a rare tumor of the placenta. Compared with the fetus amorphus, placental teratomas lack structural organization and large vessels entering the tumor. The authors discuss the case alongside proposed theories of origin for this uncommon lesion. The paper is a brief clinical report focused on the rarity and pathogenesis of placental teratoma rather than on treatment outcomes.

pmid-1676904.summary_ja: 1977年から1989年にロイヤル・マースデン病院で治療した精巣胚細胞腫瘍1191例の後方視的検討です。鼠径リンパ節または腸骨リンパ節への転移が22例で認められました。停留精巣の既往や傍大動脈の大きな病変を有する例で転移が有意に多く見られました。これらの患者では骨盤部と鼠径部を病期分類やフォローアップのCTに含めるよう勧めています。
pmid-1676904.summary_en: This Royal Marsden Hospital review of 1191 patients with primary testicular germ cell tumours (1977-1989) identified inguinal or iliac node metastases in 22 cases. Involvement was significantly more common in patients with a history of maldescent and orchidopexy, or with bulky para-aortic disease. The authors recommend including the pelvis and inguinal regions in staging or follow-up CT scans for such patients. These factors should also guide the extent of radiation fields or surgical dissection.

pmid-1676906.summary_ja: 31歳男性の縦隔胚細胞腫瘍(奇形腫と胎児性横紋筋肉腫成分)と、2か月男児の肝芽腫を遺伝学的に解析した報告。両成分にi(12p)が認められ、奇形腫と横紋筋肉腫の克隆性関係が示された。横紋筋肉腫成分と肝芽腫の両方で2q異常を認め、2q異常が組織学的に異なる両腫瘍の共通の遺伝的関連である可能性を示唆している。
pmid-1676906.summary_en: Cytogenetic and RFLP analyses were performed on a mediastinal germ cell tumor with distinct teratoma and embryonal rhabdomyosarcoma components in a 31-year-old man, and on a hepatoblastoma in a 2-month-old boy. Both components shared i(12p), a marker of germ cell tumors, which established clonal relationship between teratoma and rhabdomyosarcoma. The rhabdomyosarcoma component and the hepatoblastoma both showed 2q rearrangements. The authors propose that malignant transformation of teratoma involves histology-specific chromosomal abnormalities, and that 2q abnormalities may be a shared genetic link between two histologically unrelated tumors.

pmid-1677257.summary_ja: ビクトリア州の集団ベース研究（1950〜1978年）では、精巣腫瘍1,116例を対象に臨床的危険因子を検討した。停留、特に腹腔内停留は高い相対危険度と関連していた。停留の既往がある男性や矯正された停留精巣の症例ではセミノーマが多く、より若年で診断された。患者の28%が外傷の既往を記録しており、非セミノーマで多かった。肉腫では左側が優勢であった。その他の悪性腫瘍の既往は、前立腺がんと悪性黒色腫が主であり、わずかに増加していた。
pmid-1677257.summary_en: A population-based study of 1,116 testicular neoplasms in Victoria, Australia (1950-1978) examined clinical risk factors. Maldescent conferred high relative risks, particularly abdominal maldescent, and seminomas were more frequent in men with a history of maldescent or corrected cryptorchidism, diagnosed at younger ages. Trauma was reported by 28 percent of patients and was more common among nonseminomas. Left-sided predominance was seen among sarcomas. Prior malignancies were slightly increased, mainly prostate cancer and melanoma.

pmid-1677333.summary_ja: 停留精巣に発生した精巣がん34例を検討し、先行する精巣固定術の有無で比較した。固定術群では非セミノーマが多く、病期の改善や予後の向上は認められなかった。固定術は症状出現までの期間をわずかに短縮し、セミノーマ発生リスクを下げる可能性が示唆された。
pmid-1677333.summary_en: Thirty-four cryptorchid testicular cancer patients were studied, nine of whom had prior orchiopexy. Stage distribution was similar between groups, and the orchiopexy group had more non-seminomas, with four deaths among seven patients. The uncorrected group was mostly seminomas, with six deaths. Orchiopexy modestly shortened the symptomatic interval to cancer diagnosis and may reduce seminoma risk, but it did not improve stage at presentation or prognosis, partly due to advanced non-seminomas in the orchiopexy group.

pmid-1677812.summary_ja: ヒト胎児性癌(EC)細胞をレチノイン酸で分化誘導し、38種のHOX遺伝子の発現を解析した。HOX遺伝子は染色体上の配置順に従って逐次活性化され、3'側の遺伝子が早期に反応した。タンパク質合成阻害では早期遺伝子の活性化は保持されたが、その時期と方向性は乱れた。
pmid-1677812.summary_en: The expression of 38 human HOX genes was studied in embryonal carcinoma (EC) cells induced to differentiate with retinoic acid. Genes at the 3' end of each HOX locus were activated early and sequentially, in order colinear with their chromosomal arrangement, while upstream genes responded later. One HOX3 gene and four HOX4 genes, weakly expressed in EC stem cells, were downregulated by retinoic acid. Protein synthesis inhibition did not block early gene activation but disrupted the timing and polarity of the response.

pmid-1678315.summary_ja: Tera-2胎児性癌細胞をDFMOで分化させ、インスリン様成長因子(IGF)の結合と反応性を解析した。分化後はIGF-II結合が2〜3倍に増加し、低親和性部位が出現した。IGF-IIによるDNA合成促進は分化後に低下した。IGF-II結合の変化は、ヒト胚細胞腫瘍の分化表現型と関連する可能性がある。
pmid-1678315.summary_en: Tera-2 human embryonal carcinoma cells were differentiated with alpha-difluoromethylornithine, and their binding of insulin-like growth factors was measured. IGF-I binding was largely unchanged, whereas IGF-II binding increased two- to three-fold and showed both high- and low-affinity sites after differentiation. IGF-II stimulated thymidine incorporation in both states, but this response was reduced after differentiation. Both type I and type II IGF receptors and IGF-binding proteins were present. The authors suggest these IGF-II changes may characterize differentiation in human germ cell tumors.

pmid-1679102.summary_ja: ヒト胎児性癌クローンNT2/D1をベルベリンで神経様細胞に分化させた。形態変化はレチノイン酸より速く出現した。分化に伴いc-Ki-ras2 mRNAは著明に低下し、がん遺伝子の発現低下と分化の関連が示された。
pmid-1679102.summary_en: The pluripotent human embryonal carcinoma clone NT2/D1 was differentiated into neuron-like cells by berberine, a Chinese herbal alkaloid. Morphologic changes appeared within a day, much faster than retinoic acid-induced differentiation. Berberine did not induce endodermal differentiation of murine F9 cells, unlike retinoic acid. Although c-Ki-ras2 was amplified and highly expressed in NT2/D1, its mRNA was markedly downregulated upon differentiation, while actin mRNA was unchanged. The findings link downregulation of this protooncogene to neuronal-like differentiation.

pmid-1679110.summary_ja: 妊娠性絨毛性疾患のhCGを化学療法経過中に解析した。胞状奇胎では正常妊娠に近い分子形態を示し、絨毛癌では大小さまざまな分子形態が認められた。大型hCGの出現は予後不良を示唆し、化学療法への反応例ではConA結合の増加が認められた。
pmid-1679110.summary_en: The physicochemical properties of hCG were studied in gestational trophoblastic disease (GTD) during chemotherapy. Hydatidiform mole hCG resembled normal pregnancy and standard hCG in molecular form, whereas choriocarcinoma hCG showed variable molecular sizes. In two fatal choriocarcinoma patients, large hCG and large hCG alpha were found in urine before death. Chromatofocusing patterns changed little during chemotherapy. High Con A binding emerged in chemotherapy-responsive patients. Smaller or larger hCG forms may indicate poor prognosis, while high Con A binding may be favorable.

pmid-1679374.summary_ja: 完全胞状奇胎22例を分子指紋法で解析し、起源を検討した。60%は完全にホモ接合のアンドロジェネティック型で、残りの40%のうち半数は両親由来であった。胞状奇胎の発生は従来考えられていたより多様であり、多くの遺伝子座で変異が頻発していた。
pmid-1679374.summary_en: Molecular fingerprinting was used to determine the origin of 22 consecutive complete hydatidiform moles, the most common form of gestational trophoblastic disease. Sixty percent were completely homozygous androgenic. Forty percent were heterozygous, half of which were androgenic and half biparental, containing maternal alleles. The findings show that complete mole pathogenesis is more heterogeneous than previously thought and can arise from biparental fertilization. Frequent mutations at many loci suggest genetic instability that may relate to malignant change.

pmid-1679964.summary_ja: 絨毛癌2例について、HLA-DQ遺伝子の制限断片長多型解析で原因となった妊娠を同定した。1例目は3回目の正常妊娠、2例目は完全胞状奇胎由来のアンドロジェネティック型であった。複数回妊娠後の絨毛癌の原因妊娠特定に有用な手法である。
pmid-1679964.summary_en: Restriction fragment length polymorphism analysis of HLA-DQ genes identified the pregnancies responsible for two choriocarcinomas. In the first case, after three normal pregnancies, the tumor carried parental genome and arose from the third normal pregnancy. In the second case, after two normal pregnancies and a complete hydatidiform mole, the tumor was androgenetic and derived from the mole. The method proved useful for identifying the pregnancy responsible for choriocarcinoma in women with multiple pregnancies.

pmid-1680081.summary_ja: XY性腺異形成の16歳表現型女性が、卵巣の混合型胚細胞腫瘍の手術と化学療法の直後に急性骨髄性白血病を発症した。核型から治療関連白血病ではなく新規発症と考えられた。胚細胞腫瘍と白血病の関係や、卵黄嚢起源の共通性、Y染色体の役割を考察している。
pmid-1680081.summary_en: A 16-year-old phenotypic female with XY gonadal dysgenesis developed acute myeloblastic leukemia shortly after surgery and chemotherapy for an ovarian mixed germ cell tumor. The karyotype 46,XY,+8 suggested de novo leukemia rather than therapy-related leukemia. The authors discuss the relationship between germ cell tumors and leukemia, their possible common yolk sac origin, the role of the Y chromosome, and the possibility of familial XY gonadal dysgenesis.

pmid-1680200.summary_ja: 化学療法後に残存・増大した成熟奇形腫29例33検体を解析した。DNA量は原発腫瘍と類似し、増殖抗原は増大病変の上皮成分に多く発現した。切除奇形腫6例では嚢胞液のαフェトプロテイン(AFP)、β-hCG、CEAが上昇し、血清値は正常範囲であった。組織学的に良性でも悪性形質を示すため完全切除が重要と結論づけている。
pmid-1680200.summary_en: This study analyzed 33 specimens from 29 patients with residual stable or growing mature teratoma after chemotherapy for testicular germ cell tumors. Flow cytometry showed DNA content similar to primary tumors, and proliferation antigen was expressed mainly in epithelial components of growing lesions. Cystic fluid from six excised teratomas had elevated AFP, beta-hCG, and CEA despite normal serum levels. The authors conclude that aneuploidy and elevated cystic markers confirm malignant potential, so complete surgical resection is essential even when histology appears benign.

pmid-1680961.summary_ja: 妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍146例の尿検体1178件を解析し、hCG低下パターンを3型に分類した。パターンDは死亡例がなく最も予後良好であったが、パターンPとRの死亡率は10%および14.3%であった。hCGの測定系と分子型の比較から、サブユニット分泌の不均衡が予後不良と関連し、臨床でのフォローアップに有用と結論づけている。
pmid-1680961.summary_en: This study analyzed 1178 urine samples from 146 patients with gestational trophoblastic tumors, including hydatidiform mole, choriocarcinoma, and persistent disease. Three hCG declining patterns were identified, with pattern D showing the most favorable outcome and no deaths. Patterns P and R had mortality rates of 10% and 14.3%. Comparing assays and molecular forms of hCG, the authors found that marked imbalance in hCG subunit secretion was associated with a fatal course, supporting use of ratio and molecular analyses in clinical practice.

pmid-1682695.summary_ja: 肺動脈内で増殖した絨毛癌により、肺塞栓症と肺動脈圧亢進をきたした若年女性3例を報告した。いずれも高リスク化学療法で寛解している。造影CTで主要な塞栓を同定し、換気血流スキャンと血清hCGで病勢を追跡した。適切な治療で予後は良好であり、本症候群の認識が重要と述べている。
pmid-1682695.summary_en: The authors describe three young women with choriocarcinoma growing within the pulmonary artery, causing pulmonary embolism and pulmonary hypertension. All three were treated with high-risk chemotherapy and are in remission. Contrast-enhanced CT identified major emboli, while serial ventilation/perfusion scans and serum hCG measurements monitored disease progression. Recognizing this rare syndrome is important because the prognosis is excellent with appropriate treatment.

pmid-1686508.summary_ja: 9歳男児の停留精巣内に発見された類皮嚢腫の症例報告である。本病変は成熟奇形腫の単層型と考えられると述べている。小児では稀で、停留精巣での発見はさらに例外的とされる。従来は去勢術が行われてきたが、小型で緻密な病変では隣接実質が保たれていれば単純摘出も考慮できると提案している。
pmid-1686508.summary_en: A case report of a dermoid cyst found within an undescended testis in a 9-year-old boy. The authors argue the lesion is best regarded as a monolayer form of mature teratoma, which is rare in children and is exceptionally discovered in an undescended testis. They note that traditional management is castration, but small compact lesions may be treated by simple enucleation if the adjacent parenchyma is preserved. The report highlights a conservative surgical option for selected pediatric cases.

pmid-1702268.summary_ja: 胚細胞腫瘍の患者で、精巣網に生じる硝子様小体を伴う上皮過形成が卵黄嚢腫瘍に類似することを報告した病理学的研究である。48例の精巣標本で胚細胞腫瘍の16/27例に小体を認め、非腫瘍例では認めなかった。精巣網への腫瘍浸潤に関連する偽腫瘍性反応と結論づけた。卵黄嚢腫瘍との誤診を避けるうえで重要な知見である。
pmid-1702268.summary_en: This pathology study describes rete testis hyperplasia with hyaline globules, which can mimic a yolk sac tumor component in patients with germ cell tumors. Review of 48 testicular specimens showed globules in 16 of 27 germ cell tumors versus none of 16 nonneoplastic cases. The lesion was associated with tumor invasion of the rete testis and was considered a pseudoneoplastic reaction. Immunostains supported its nonneoplastic nature, which is important for avoiding misdiagnosis of yolk sac tumor.

pmid-1702356.summary_ja: 非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍104例のうち、血清hCGが25,000超の16例を検討した臨床研究である。多くは絨毛癌症候群の特徴を示し、急速進行、肺・肝・中枢神経系の合併症が多く、標準化学療法への反応も不良であった。組織学的確認は診断に必須ではなく、閉鎖生検は出血の危険から避けるべき場合があるとしている。予後不良群の同定が治療改善に重要である。
pmid-1702356.summary_en: This clinical study examines 16 of 104 patients with nonseminomatous germ cell tumor who had serum hCG above 25,000 at the CRC Wessex unit. Most showed the choriocarcinoma syndrome with bulky, rapidly progressive disease, frequent pulmonary, hepatic, and CNS complications, and poorer response to standard chemotherapy. The authors note that histologic confirmation of trophoblastic tumor is not essential for diagnosis and that closed biopsy may be hazardous due to hemorrhage risk. Identifying these poor-prognosis patients is key to improving management.

pmid-1703917.summary_ja: プラチナ導入療法後に持続的完全奏効が得られなかった進行胚細胞腫瘍94例の救援化学療法を解析した臨床研究である。前治療で完全奏効、シスプラチン併用救援療法、精巣原発、hCG・LDH正常、転移部位1か所の場合に予後が良好であった。前治療で不完全奏効の患者は予後が極めて不良であった。新たな救援療法の開発と予後因子に基づく臨床試験の解釈の必要性を強調している。
pmid-1703917.summary_en: This clinical study from Memorial Sloan-Kettering analyzes 94 advanced germ cell tumor patients who received salvage chemotherapy after failing platinum-based induction. Survival and response were better with a prior complete response, a cisplatin-based salvage regimen, testis primary, normal hCG and LDH, and one metastatic site. Patients with a prior incomplete response had very poor survival (4 of 52 alive). The authors emphasize the need for new salvage therapies and use of prognostic factors to guide trials.

pmid-1704432.summary_ja: 早産児と正期産児の血清αフェトプロテイン(AFP)とそのConA結合分画の基準値を示した小児研究である。AFPは出生後に二相性に低下し、早産児では初期値が高い。ConA非反応分画は生後6か月までに85〜95%に達する。新生児仙尾部奇形腫の悪性再発ではAFPの上昇とConA非反応分画の低下を伴っていた。生理的なAFP低下と腫瘍関連変化をフォローアップ中に区別する助けとなる。
pmid-1704432.summary_en: This pediatric study establishes reference values for serum AFP and its concanavalin A binding subfractions in preterm and term infants. AFP declines biphasically after birth, with preterm infants showing higher initial levels, and the ConA nonreactive fraction rises to 85–95% by six months. Importantly, malignant recurrences of neonatal sacrococcygeal teratomas were associated with rising serum AFP and a falling ConA nonreactive proportion. The findings help distinguish physiologic AFP decline from tumor-related changes during follow-up.

pmid-1705669.summary_ja: 精巣セミノーマの頭蓋骨および頭蓋内転移を生じた44歳男性の症例報告である。41歳で精巣腫瘍に対する手術を受けた。外科的切除、放射線療法、PVB化学療法を行い、神経学的には10か月無病であったが、その後肝転移で死亡した。日本でのセミノーマの中枢神経系転移は0.7%と報告している。寛解後も予防的化学療法が重要と強調している。
pmid-1705669.summary_en: A case report of a 44-year-old man with skull and intracranial metastasis from testicular seminoma, diagnosed after orchiectomy at age 41. He received surgical excision, radiation, and PVB chemotherapy and was disease-free neurologically for ten months before dying of liver metastasis. The authors note CNS metastasis occurs in only 0.7% of seminomas in Japan and stress that prophylactic chemotherapy may be essential even after CNS remission.

pmid-1706218.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍70例で、c-kit、hst-1、int-2がん遺伝子の発現と遺伝子構造を解析した。c-kitはセミノーマで高頻度（80%）、非セミノーマで低頻度に発現し、hst-1はこれと逆のパターンを示した。非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍では、hst-1発現と病期に相関が認められた。DNAレベルの明らかな異常は認めなかった。
pmid-1706218.summary_en: This study analyzed 70 testicular germ cell tumors for c-kit, hst-1, and int-2 oncogene expression using Northern and Southern blotting. c-kit expression was common in seminomas (80%) but rare in nonseminomas (7%), whereas hst-1 expression was frequent in nonseminomas (63%) and rare in seminomas (4%), showing an inverse pattern. In nonseminomas, hst-1 expression was associated with tumor stage. No gross DNA alterations were found in these loci, and int-2 mRNA was not detected.

pmid-1706441.summary_ja: 精巣がん患者2例で、導入化学療法後かつ後腹膜リンパ節郭清前に血清腫瘍マーカーが高値を示したが、残存悪性腫瘍は認められなかった。原因は、αフェトプロテイン(AFP)やβ-hCGを高濃度に含む嚢胞性の分化成熟奇形腫であった。嚢胞内容物が血中へ漏出し、マーカー高値が持続したと考えられる。この病態を認識すれば、不要な救援化学療法を避けられる。
pmid-1706441.summary_en: Two patients with testicular cancer had elevated serum tumor markers after induction chemotherapy and before retroperitoneal lymph node dissection, but no residual malignancy was found. Instead, cystic differentiated mature teratomas containing high levels of alpha-fetoprotein or beta-hCG were identified. The authors propose that leakage of these cyst contents into the blood maintained the elevated markers. Recognizing this entity matters because unnecessary salvage chemotherapy can be avoided.

pmid-1706815.summary_ja: 停留精巣に発生した精巣腫瘍21例の治療成績を報告した。組織型はセミノーマ、非セミノーマ、混合型で、早期病期（病期Iおよび病期IIb）は放射線療法または後腹膜リンパ節郭清により良好な生存率を示した。進行例（病期IIcおよびIII）は導入化学療法を受けたが、5年生存率は33%であった。全体の5年生存率は69%だった。
pmid-1706815.summary_en: This report describes 21 patients with tumors arising in undescended testes, including abdominal and inguinal locations. Six had prior orchiopexy. Histology showed seminoma in 12, nonseminoma in six, and mixed tumors in three. Early-stage disease (stages I and IIb) treated with radiotherapy or retroperitoneal node dissection showed 100 percent survival at 3 and 5 years. Advanced disease (IIc and III) receiving VAB-6 induction chemotherapy had 45 percent complete response and 33 percent five-year survival. Overall 5-year survival was 69 percent.

pmid-1707715.summary_ja: 1977年から1988年に化学療法後の残存転移巣の外科的切除を受けた、播種性非セミノーマ性精巣胚細胞腫瘍（病期II B以上）の67人の患者を検討した。後腹膜リンパ節郭清が最も多く行われた術式であった。切除された転移巣の30%で未分化腫瘍、43%で成熟奇形腫が認められた。82%が寛解を維持し、周術期死亡率は4%であった。予後不良群でも寛解が得られた。
pmid-1707715.summary_en: This study reviewed 67 patients with disseminated nonseminomatous testicular germ cell tumors (stage IIB or higher) who underwent surgical removal of residual metastases after chemotherapy between 1977 and 1988. Retroperitoneal node dissection was the most common procedure. Undifferentiated tumor was found in 30 percent of resections and mature teratoma in 43 percent. Eighty-two percent remained in remission, and perioperative mortality was 4 percent. Remission was achieved even in poor-prognosis groups.

pmid-1708402.summary_ja: 1歳半の女児に生じた顎下部の内胚葉洞（卵黄嚢）腫瘍の症例報告である。Schiller-Duval体やコロイド体などの典型的組織像を示し、腫瘍細胞の多くがαフェトプロテイン(AFP)陽性であった。臨床的・画像的に他部位の病変は認められなかった。頭頸部に生じる胚細胞腫瘍の一例として重要である。
pmid-1708402.summary_en: A 1.5-year-old girl presented with a rapidly growing submandibular endodermal sinus (yolk sac) tumor, a rare extragonadal germ cell tumor. Histology showed typical features, including Schiller-Duval bodies and colloid bodies. Most tumor cells expressed alpha-fetoprotein. Clinical and radiological examinations found no evidence of disease elsewhere in the body. This case report shows that yolk sac tumors can arise in the head and neck region.

pmid-1709325.summary_ja: 子宮絨毛癌の既往がある患者の左乳房結節を穿刺吸引細胞診で評価した症例報告である。悪性単核細胞と多核巨細胞が認められ、切除組織の病理組織学的検査で乳腺への絨毛癌転移と確認された。既往歴がなければ診断は困難であった点や、乳腺穿刺標本における多核巨細胞の鑑別診断が考察されている。
pmid-1709325.summary_en: A case report describing a patient with prior uterine choriocarcinoma who developed nodules in the left breast. Fine needle aspiration smears showed malignant mononuclear cells and multinucleated giant cells, and the cytologic diagnosis of metastatic choriocarcinoma was confirmed by histologic examination of the excised tissue. The authors note that the diagnosis would have been difficult without the clinical history and discuss the differential diagnosis of multinucleated giant cells in breast aspirates. The report highlights the importance of clinical history in interpreting cytology.

pmid-1710406.summary_ja: 卵巣未分化胚細胞腫の1症例について、細胞診、組織学的および電子顕微鏡所見を報告している。腫瘍細胞は著明な核大小不同と大型で異型的な核小体を示し、リンパ球浸潤を伴っていた。電子顕微鏡では胚細胞腫瘍に特徴的な環状ラメラやグリコーゲン顆粒が確認された。術中迅速診断では確定できず、各種検査の併用により診断された。
pmid-1710406.summary_en: A case report of ovarian dysgerminoma describing cytologic, histologic, and electron microscopic findings. Cells showed marked anisokaryosis and large, sometimes bizarre nucleoli, with lymphocytic infiltration. Electron microscopy revealed convoluted nucleoli, annulated lamellae, and glycogen particles typical of germ cell tumors. The diagnosis was not certain on frozen section but was established by combined cytologic, histologic, and ultrastructural review. The case highlights the value of multimodal assessment in diagnosing ovarian germ cell tumors.

pmid-1710473.summary_ja: 非セミノーマ性精巣胚細胞腫瘍11例を対象に、血液型関連抗原の発現を分化マーカーとして検討した研究である。全例で2-3シアロシルラクトサミン構造が認められ、N-アセチルラクトサミンやLe(y)の発現は腫瘍ごとに異なった。これらの抗原陰性例は形態学的に分化度が低く、陽性例はより分化した像を示した。ただし症例数が少なく、今後の大規模検討が必要とされている。
pmid-1710473.summary_en: This study examines histo-blood group antigens as differentiation markers in eleven non-seminomatous testicular germ cell tumors. All tumors contained binary 2-3 sialosyllactosamine structures, while N-acetyllactosamine and Le(y) expression varied. Tumors negative for these antigens were morphologically least differentiated, whereas positive tumors showed more differentiated patterns. The authors suggest that type 2 chain antigens may serve as differentiation markers. Because the series is small, a larger study is needed to confirm whether their expression reflects differentiation potential.

pmid-1710481.summary_ja: 進行精巣がん48例に対し、シスプラチン、エトポシド、イホスファミド、ビンクリスチン、ブレオマイシンによる強化化学療法を施行した報告である。34例（71%）が無腫瘍状態に達し、うち20例は残存病変の外科的切除を要した。セミノーマは非セミノーマより良好な反応を示した。36か月生存率は76%であった。
pmid-1710481.summary_en: This 1991 study reports outcomes of an intensive five-drug alternating chemotherapy regimen in 48 patients with far advanced testicular cancer. Thirty-four patients (71%) achieved tumor-free status, 14 with chemotherapy alone and 20 after surgical resection of residual disease. Pure seminoma responded better than nonseminoma. Univariate analysis associated serum hCG level and number of involved organ sites with response. Three patients relapsed after a minimum follow-up of 24 months, and 36-month survival was 76%.

pmid-1710482.summary_ja: 予後不良の非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍91例に対する白金製剤強化化学療法BOP/VIPの成績を報告している。64例（70%）が完全寛解に達し、51例で残存腫瘤の外科的切除が施行された。2年無増悪生存率は66%であった。主な有害事象は骨髄抑制であり、末梢神経障害が22%に認められた。
pmid-1710482.summary_en: This study reports the BOP/VIP regimen, an initial platinum-intensive chemotherapy schedule, in 91 patients with poor-prognosis non-seminomatous germ cell tumors. Of these, 64 (70%) achieved complete remission, and 51 underwent surgical resection of residual masses, with teratoma or non-germ cell cancer found in 11. The overall response rate was 80%. With a median follow-up of 90 weeks, 2-year progression-free survival was 66%. Major toxicity was myelosuppression, and peripheral neuropathy occurred in 22% of patients.
