pmid-1964623.summary_en: This review proposes that testicular germ cell atrophy is a final common pathway for established and postulated risk factors for testicular tumours. Epidemiological data show that tumour incidence follows the curve of male sexual activity and that more than 75% of patients have atrophogenic events or low sperm counts. The authors also discuss mumps virus, HLA-linked immune response genes, radiation, carcinogens and clonal evolution. They highlight the need for more information on hormone sensitivity, especially in seminoma, and on DNA repair enzyme activity.

pmid-1964624.summary_ja: 精巣上皮内癌（CIS）は浸潤性胚細胞腫瘍へ進行する非浸潤性病変であることを概説する。CISは停留精巣、対側精巣、半陰陽、性腺外胚細胞腫瘍、不妊と関連する。無治療の患者の半数は5年以内に浸潤癌へ進行し、診断には生検が必要である。片側CISで妊孕性を温存できる場合は精巣摘除術、それ以外では局所照射を推奨する。著者らは、CIS細胞はゴノサイト由来であると提唱している。
pmid-1964624.summary_en: This review covers carcinoma in situ (CIS) of the testis, a preinvasive lesion that progresses to invasive germ cell tumours. CIS is linked to cryptorchidism, the contralateral testis after unilateral tumour, intersex conditions, assumed extragonadal germ cell tumours and possibly infertility. Half of untreated patients progress to invasive cancer within five years, and biopsy is needed for diagnosis. The authors recommend orchidectomy for unilateral CIS when fertility can be preserved, and localized testicular irradiation in other cases. They propose CIS cells derive from gonocytes.

pmid-1964625.summary_ja: 精巣、卵巣および性腺外胚細胞腫瘍の細胞遺伝学的所見をまとめたレビュー。セミノーマ、ディスジャーミノーマ（未分化胚細胞腫）、ジャーミノーマ（胚細胞腫）（ゴノサイトーマ）は等染色体12p（i(12p)）を共通して有する。非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍は、ゴノサイトーマ段階を経て染色体欠失により進展したと考えられる。
pmid-1964625.summary_en: This review summarizes cytogenetic data for testicular, ovarian and extragonadal germ cell tumours. Seminoma, dysgerminoma and germinoma, termed gonocytomas, are characterized by isochromosome 12p. Dysplastic gonocytes are prone to polyploidization, especially in the gonads. The authors propose that non-seminomatous germ cell tumours of the testis may evolve through a gonocytoma stage by chromosome loss. This would also explain i(12p) in non-seminomatous tumours of the adult testis, ovary and extragonadal sites.

pmid-1964626.summary_ja: 胚細胞腫瘍の単クローン起源とクローン進化を支持する臨床的根拠をまとめたレビュー。セミノーマは、上皮内癌と悪性奇形腫/非セミノーマの中間的なDNA含量や患者年齢を示し、中間段階と考えられる。一部の症例では異なる組織型の病巣が生じる多クローン性の発生も認められるとしている。
pmid-1964626.summary_en: This review presents clinical evidence for a monoclonal origin of germ cell tumours and for clonal evolution, in which seminoma is an intermediate stage toward malignant teratoma/non-seminoma. Supporting data include intermediate DNA content and patient ages, as well as spontaneous regression, responses to therapy and post-mortem histology. The authors acknowledge that polyclonal development occurs in some patients with multiple tumour foci of different histological types. These observations do not overturn the view that seminoma is an intermediate event in tumour evolution.

pmid-1964675.summary_ja: 精巣がん症例271例と対照259例を用いた症例対照研究で、職業と精巣がんリスクの関連を検討した。専門職はセミノーマのリスク増加（OR 2.8）、生産労働は他の胚細胞腫瘍のリスク増加（OR 1.8）と関連した。自己申告によるマイクロ波・電波曝露は両者と関連したが、職種に基づく評価では確認されなかった。職業要因は発生増加の大部分を説明しないと結論づけている。
pmid-1964675.summary_en: This case-control study of 271 testicular cancer cases and 259 controls examined the association between occupation and risk of testicular germ cell tumours. Professional employment was associated with seminoma risk (OR 2.8), and production work with other germ cell tumours (OR 1.8). Self-reported exposure to microwaves and radio waves was linked to both types, but this was not supported by an exposure assessment based on job title. The authors conclude that occupational factors do not account for a substantial share of the rising incidence.

pmid-1965310.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍患者51例と健常者40例で血清LDH、HBDHおよびHBDH/LDH比を測定しました。セミノーマと非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の両方でLDHとHBDHは上昇し、治療後に低下しました。HBDHは治療モニタリングにおいてLDHより特異性が高い腫瘍マーカーと考えられました。
pmid-1965310.summary_en: This study measured serum LDH, HBDH, and the HBDH/LDH ratio in 51 patients with histologically proven testicular germ cell tumors and 40 healthy controls. LDH and HBDH were elevated in both seminomatous and non-seminomatous tumors. The HBDH/LDH ratio was statistically significant in seminomas but not in non-seminomatous tumors. Both enzymes fell after treatment, indicating response to therapy. The authors propose LDH and HBDH as tumor markers for diagnosis and monitoring, with HBDH being more specific than LDH for monitoring therapy.

pmid-1966037.summary_ja: 生後10か月の女児に発生した後腹膜奇形腫の症例報告です。腫瘍は主に腎芽腫様の組織から成り、芽腫性の細胞巣内に糸球体様および尿細管様の構造が認められました。腎外性ウィルムス腫瘍との鑑別が重要であることが強調されています。乳児の後腹膜腫瘤の病理診断に役立つ症例です。
pmid-1966037.summary_en: This report describes a retroperitoneal teratoma in a 10-month-old girl that was composed predominantly of nephroblastic tissue. The tumor showed glomeruloid and tubular structures within blastemal nests, with minor hyaline cartilage, adipose tissue, glial tissue and mucin-secreting glands. The authors highlight the rarity of this variant and the need to distinguish it from extrarenal Wilms' tumor, since the two have different origins. The case is useful for pathologists evaluating retroperitoneal masses in infants.

pmid-1966319.summary_ja: 妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍(GTN)の総説です。胞状奇胎は悪性化の危険があり、ヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)の経時的測定が有用な腫瘍マーカーとされています。低リスク例では化学療法の治癒率が高い一方、統一された病期分類と予後評価、高リスク例に対する無作為化試験の必要性が指摘されています。
pmid-1966319.summary_en: This review discusses gestational trophoblastic neoplasia (GTN), noting that hydatidiform moles carry a risk of malignant GTN and that serial hCG monitoring is a sensitive, specific serum tumor marker model. Chemotherapy is usually successful, with high cure rates for nonmetastatic and low-risk metastatic disease. The authors call for a uniform staging and risk-assessment system, validation of the WHO prognostic score, and randomized trials of newer high-risk and salvage regimens. Choriocarcinoma arising from nonmolar gestations warrants further epidemiologic study.

pmid-1967025.summary_ja: 本研究では、正常妊娠尿、侵入奇胎、絨毛癌患者の尿から精製したhCGの糖鎖構造と生物活性を比較した。絨毛癌由来hCGはシアル酸化が低く、ホルモン活性は正常hCGより有意に低かった。脱シアル化によりいずれも活性は大きく低下したが差は残り、中性糖鎖も完全な活性発現に重要であることが示された。
pmid-1967025.summary_en: This study compared hCG from normal pregnancy urine with hCG from patients with invasive mole or choriocarcinoma, examining sugar chain structures and their effect on cAMP production in MA-10 Leydig tumor cells. Sialylation was lowest in choriocarcinoma hCG, whose hormonal activity was significantly reduced compared with normal hCG. Desialylation markedly reduced activity in all samples, but differences persisted. The authors conclude that neutral oligosaccharides also contribute to full hormonal activity.

pmid-1967548.summary_ja: 本研究は、ミニサテライトDNAプローブを用いた制限酵素断片長多型解析により、絨毛癌と全胞状奇胎の病因が共通かどうかを検討した。全胞状奇胎は父親由来の断片のみを持ち、アンドロゲネシス起源が分子レベルで確認された。絨毛癌の一部は奇胎と同じ遺伝パターンを示したが、他は宿主と同一であり、病因は症例により異なると結論づけられた。
pmid-1967548.summary_en: This study used restriction fragment length polymorphism analysis with a minisatellite probe to test whether choriocarcinoma and complete hydatidiform mole share a common pathogenesis. The complete mole's polymorphic fragments were all paternally derived, confirming androgenetic origin at the molecular level. In some choriocarcinomas the inheritance pattern matched the complete mole, whereas in others all fragments matched host DNA. The authors conclude that choriocarcinoma pathogenesis varies between cases and is in some cases entirely different from that of complete mole.

pmid-1968400.summary_ja: 本研究は精巣セミノーマ40例(うち停留精巣9例)を後ろ向きに検討し、精巣の位置で治療成績を比較した。正常下降精巣では病期Iの2年生存率は94%、病期IIでは86%であった。停留精巣由来のセミノーマでも、同程度の放射線療法と照射野の調整により同等の生存率が得られ、予後は精巣の位置より病期に依存していた。
pmid-1968400.summary_en: This review of 40 seminoma patients, nine with cryptorchidism, compared outcomes by testicular position. Two-year survival was 94% for Stage I and 86% for Stage II with normally descended testes. Cryptorchid seminoma achieved comparable survival when similar radiation doses were given and field sizes were tailored to disease extent, and prognosis depended more on stage than on testicular position. More than half of cryptorchid patients presented with groin mass or abdominal pain, which may delay diagnosis.

pmid-1969370.summary_ja: 本報告は、クウェート母子病院で2.5年間に管理した胎児仙尾部奇形腫4例を記述しており、発生頻度は出生1万件に1例とされた。3例は出生前に超音波で診断され、1例は分娩時の難産で発見された。子宮切開による部分切除後に2例が経腟分娩し、出生後48時間で切除した1例の新生児が生存した。全例で組織学的には良性であった。
pmid-1969370.summary_en: This report describes four fetal sacrococcygeal teratoma cases managed over 2.5 years at Kuwait Maternity Hospital, an incidence of about 1 in 10,000 deliveries. Three were diagnosed antenatally by ultrasound showing polyhydramnios and characteristic echogenicity, and one presented with dystocia during labor. Two were delivered vaginally after partial excision through hysterotomy, and one infant survived excision performed 48 hours after delivery. All tumors were histologically benign. The authors recommend routine antenatal ultrasound and delivery at experienced centers.

pmid-1970378.summary_ja: 初診で部分胞状奇胎と診断された11例を後方視的に検討した研究。病理組織学的検査とDNA倍数性測定で診断を再評価したところ、多くが別の診断に修正された。部分胞状奇胎後に化学療法を要する妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍の頻度は約200分の1で、完全胞状奇胎の12分の1より低い。それでも排出後のフォローアップから除外すべきではないと結論づけている。
pmid-1970378.summary_en: This retrospective review examined 11 patients initially diagnosed with partial hydatidiform mole who later needed chemotherapy for gestational trophoblastic tumour. Histopathological review and DNA ploidy measurement revised the diagnosis in many cases: 5 were confirmed as partial mole, 4 were revised to complete mole, and 2 showed no molar pregnancy. Two of the partial mole patients had choriocarcinoma. The risk of requiring chemotherapy after partial mole was about 1 in 200, versus 1 in 12 after complete mole, and the authors argue that patients should still be followed up after evacuation.

pmid-1970513.summary_ja: 46,XXの良性卵巣奇形腫について、6例の腫瘍と宿主のDNA多型マーカーを解析し、さらに21例で核型と着糸点マーカーを調べた。多くは減数分裂第二分裂の失敗により胚細胞から生じたと考えられ、一部は減数分裂第一分裂の失敗や分裂前の細胞に由来すると推定された。1例は47,XX,+8の異常核型を示した。卵巣奇形腫の発生機序を明らかにした研究である。
pmid-1970513.summary_en: Researchers analysed benign ovarian teratomas in 46,XX patients using DNA polymorphism markers in six tumours and their hosts, plus karyotyping and centromeric marker analysis of 21 cases. Most tumours appeared to arise from germ cells after failed meiosis II, while some arose from failed meiosis I or from premeiotic cells. One tumour had an abnormal 47,XX,+8 karyotype. The findings clarify the mechanisms by which these ovarian tumours form and how mature teratomas originate from germ cells.

pmid-1970695.summary_ja: 卵黄嚢腫瘍の細胞外基質について、大小2種類のプロテオグリカンを免疫組織化学的に3例で検討した。大型のプロテオグリカンは粘液腫状部や血管周囲に分布し、小型のものは多小胞性の卵黄嚢様構造の緻密な間質に認められた。未熟な間葉系細胞や上皮様細胞が大型を、成熟線維芽細胞が小型を産生すると考察している。ラミニンやコラーゲンなども併せて検討された。
pmid-1970695.summary_en: This study examined extracellular matrix components in yolk sac tumours. Proteoglycans were isolated from a yolk sac tumour, and monoclonal antibodies against large and small proteoglycans were used to immunostain three tumours. Large proteoglycan was concentrated in myxomatous, perivascular and perivesicular areas, while small proteoglycan characterised the compact stroma of polyvesicular vitelline areas. Staining for laminin, fibronectin and collagens was also compared. The authors suggest that large proteoglycans are made by immature mesenchymal and epithelial-like cells, and small ones by mature fibroblasts.

pmid-1971238.summary_ja: 胎児の仙尾部奇形腫の2症例を報告し、いずれも分娩停止と子宮内死亡に至った。出生前の超音波検査で診断可能で、分娩方法は腫瘍の大きさと胎児の状態により決める。外傷のない分娩の後、適切な時期に三次施設で手術を行えば予後は良好であるとし、出生前および分娩時の管理案を提案している。
pmid-1971238.summary_en: Two cases of fetal sacrococcygeal teratoma are reported, both causing obstructed labour and intrauterine death. The authors propose a scheme for antenatal and intrapartum management of these rare tumours. Diagnosis can be made antenatally by ultrasound examination, and the mode of delivery depends on tumour size and fetal condition. They conclude that fetal prognosis is excellent when atraumatic delivery is followed by timely surgery at a tertiary centre.

pmid-1972122.summary_ja: 未熟卵巣奇形腫、胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍、乳癌の3つの悪性腫瘍が短期間に出現した女性を報告。胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍が原発性卵巣胚細胞腫瘍に伴った初の報告であり、まれな婦人科腫瘍どうしの関連を示している。胚細胞腫瘍と栄養膜性腫瘍の両方の文献に位置づけられる症例である。抄録以外の臨床経過の詳細は示されていない。
pmid-1972122.summary_en: A woman developed three malignancies in a short period: immature ovarian teratoma, placental site trophoblastic tumour (PSTT), and breast carcinoma. The authors describe these rare gynaecological neoplasms and note that this is the first report of PSTT associated with a primary ovarian germ cell tumour. The case is therefore relevant to both the germ cell tumour and trophoblastic tumour literature. Clinical details beyond the abstract are not provided.

pmid-1972819.summary_ja: 免疫組織化学染色により、発生途上の性腺におけるプラセンタ型アルカリホスファターゼ（PLAP）を検討。PLAPは胚細胞が顆粒膜細胞やセルトリ細胞に囲まれる前の限られた期間に発現した。染色体異常を伴う異常な胎児や新生児の性腺では陽性が持続し、精巣の上皮内癌、性腺芽細胞腫の一部、セミノーマに類似していた。他の胚細胞腫瘍の染色パターンは多様であった。
pmid-1972819.summary_en: This study traced placental-like alkaline phosphatase (PLAP) in developing gonads using immunohistochemistry. PLAP was expressed in germ cells during a limited window before they were enclosed by granulosa or Sertoli cells. Abnormal fetal or neonatal gonads with chromosomal anomalies retained PLAP positivity, resembling testicular in situ carcinoma, gonadoblastoma in a 45,XO/46,XY mosaic, and seminoma. Positivity in other germ cell tumours varied widely. The authors suggest that retained embryonic properties may contribute to neoplastic induction.

pmid-1973631.summary_ja: 精巣腫瘍の男性14例について、14本の常染色体のRFLPプローブを用いたサザンブロット解析を行った。精巣胚細胞腫瘍の6例で5番、7番、12番染色体の対立遺伝子量に変化を認め、3例では3本すべてに変化があった。腫瘍DNAではY染色体の相対的減少とX染色体の増加も認められた。遺伝子量効果、がん遺伝子の活性化、がん抑制遺伝子の顕在化の関与を考察している。
pmid-1973631.summary_en: Fourteen men with testicular tumours were analysed by Southern blot hybridisation using RFLP probes across 14 autosomes. Six patients with testicular germ cell tumour showed altered allele dosage on chromosomes 5, 7 and 12, and three had changes on all three. Tumour DNA also showed a relative loss of Y-chromosome and gain of X-chromosome material. Other autosomes showed no consistent changes. The authors discuss how gene dosage effects, oncogene activation and unmasking of tumour suppressor genes may contribute.

pmid-1976039.summary_ja: 本論文は、妊娠性絨毛癌の遺伝的起源を解析した報告である。患者本人、配偶者、先行妊娠で生まれた息子を対象に、染色体多型およびDNA制限酵素断片長多型を比較した。その結果、絨毛癌は先行妊娠と同一の受精に由来する可能性が高いと結論づけられた。これまで細胞株の細胞遺伝学的解析に限られていた絨毛癌の遺伝学的知見を補う重要な研究である。
pmid-1976039.summary_en: This study investigated the genetic origin of a gestational choriocarcinoma in a woman. Using chromosomal heteromorphisms and DNA restriction fragment length polymorphisms, the authors compared the tumor with the host, her spouse, and her son from the antecedent pregnancy. The results indicated that the choriocarcinoma most likely arose from the same fertilization event that produced the earlier pregnancy. Prior genetic data on choriocarcinoma were limited to cytogenetic analysis of a few cell lines, so this single-case family analysis adds direct evidence on the origin of gestational trophoblastic tumors.

pmid-1977308.summary_ja: 本研究は、ヒト卵巣奇形腫の成因を分子レベルで解析したものである。遺伝情報のある61例の卵巣奇形腫を対象に、染色体多型とDNA多型を用いて非分離の起源を調べた。第1減数分裂の非分離由来は約21%、第2減数分裂由来は約39%であった。第1染色体上の多型マーカーで遺伝子–セントロメア地図を作成し、第1減数分裂由来の腫瘍で組換えパターンが異なることを示した。卵巣奇形腫が遺伝子マッピングの資源となりうることも提案している。
pmid-1977308.summary_en: This paper analyzes the molecular mechanisms behind the formation of human ovarian teratomas using chromosomal heteromorphisms and DNA polymorphisms in 61 genetically informative tumors. About 21% arose from meiosis I nondisjunction and 39% from meiosis II nondisjunction. Eight polymorphic markers on chromosome 1 were used to build a gene-centromere map, revealing altered recombination patterns in meiosis I-derived teratomas and evidence of chiasma interference. The authors propose that ovarian teratomas can serve as a rapid resource for gene mapping relative to the centromere.

pmid-1977467.summary_ja: 母体のエストロゲン曝露と停留精巣・精巣胚細胞癌との疫学的関連に着想を得て、妊娠11日目と12日目の129 Sv-S1マウスにエチニルエストラジオールを投与した。雄の子は生後15日目に検査された。処置群の子は対照群と比べて停留精巣の発生率が有意に高く、精巣奇形腫のリスクは増加したが有意ではなかった。本研究は、精巣胚細胞腫瘍の感受性に子宮内のホルモン的要因が関与することを支持し、生殖細胞移動の妊娠初期の時期が重要な期間であることを示唆している。
pmid-1977467.summary_en: Motivated by epidemiological links between maternal estrogen exposure and both cryptorchidism and testicular germ cell cancer, the authors gave ethinyl estradiol to pregnant 129 Sv-S1 mice on gestational days 11 and 12. Male offspring were examined at 15 days of age. Treated offspring had a significantly higher incidence of cryptorchid testis than controls, and an increased but nonsignificant risk of testicular teratoma. The study supports an in utero hormonal origin for testicular germ cell tumor susceptibility, with the early gestational window of germ cell migration as the critical period.

pmid-1977631.summary_ja: 本研究は、胞状奇胎患者165例を後方視的に検討し、奇胎除去後の妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍の発生と関連する因子を調べたものである。約18%が化学療法を必要とした。子宮の過大と卵巣黄胞嚢胞が治療の必要性と関連した一方、hCG値や年齢は関連しなかった。核異型、壊死、栄養膜細胞の成熟低下などの組織学的所見がリスクを高めた。これらの所見をもつ奇胎には予防的化学療法の検討が推奨されている。
pmid-1977631.summary_en: This retrospective study reviewed 165 patients with hydatidiform mole treated at a trophoblastic disease center to identify features linked to postmolar gestational trophoblastic tumor. About 18% required chemotherapy. Uterine enlargement beyond dates and theca-lutein cysts predicted treatment, while hCG level, age, and gravidity did not. Histologic features including nuclear atypia, necrosis, reduced trophoblast maturation, marked proliferation, and absence of Nitabuch's layer were associated with higher risk. The authors suggest that moles with these features should be considered for prophylactic chemotherapy.

pmid-1980172.summary_ja: 129/Sv-terマウスでは、三胚葉すべてへの分化を示す精巣奇形腫(胚細胞腫瘍)が自然発生する。本研究は生後4週の奇形腫内の筋組織を、組織化学および免疫組織化学で解析した。奇形腫の筋肉は酸化能が正常筋と同程度であったが、ミオシン関連の線維型分化は不完全であった。筋線維は神経終末と接する終板を有し、脊髄運動ニューロンに相当する神経細胞による支配が示唆された。
pmid-1980172.summary_en: In 129/Sv-ter mice, testicular teratomas arise spontaneously from germ cell tumors that show differentiation toward all three germ layers. The authors examined the muscle tissue within 4-week-old teratomas, using histochemical and immunohistochemical methods to define fiber types. Teratoma muscle had oxidative capacity comparable to normal muscle, but myosin-related fiber type differentiation was incomplete. Muscle fibers had endplates contacted by nerve terminals, and the findings suggest innervation by neurons resembling spinal motoneurons. Teratoma myogenesis and innervation largely resemble normal embryonic development.

pmid-1980272.summary_ja: 本報告は、停留精巣の成雄馬2頭に生じた精巣セミノーマの症例である。精索捻転と腹腔内に残存した腫瘍性精巣の絞扼により、疝痛を呈した。両例とも直腸検査で尾側腹腔の腫瘤を触知した。1例は精巣摘出により治癒し、もう1例は無治療で安楽死された。組織学的に精巣セミノーマと診断された。停留精巣の雄馬における腹痛の鑑別診断として、精索捻転を考慮すべきと結論づけている。
pmid-1980272.summary_en: Two adult cryptorchid stallions presented with colic caused by spermatic cord torsion and strangulation of abdominally retained neoplastic testes. Both had palpable caudal abdominal masses. One was cured by surgical removal of the testis, while the other was euthanized without treatment. Histopathology confirmed testicular seminoma in both. The authors recommend that spermatic cord torsion of an abdominally retained testis be included in the differential diagnosis of abdominal pain in cryptorchid stallions, particularly those with a palpable caudal abdominal mass.

pmid-1981959.summary_ja: 本論文は、ペプチドホルモンを産生したがカルチノイド症候群を呈さなかったストルーマ卵巣由来カルチノイドの症例を報告している。組織化学、免疫組織化学、超微細構造解析により、濾胞部のサイログロブリン陽性領域と、ACTHやSRIFを発現する索状部の神経内分泌領域が確認された。血中濃度は正常範囲内であった。ストルーマ・カルチノイドは卵巣奇形腫の特殊型であり、その神経内分泌成分の免疫表現型を示した点に意義がある。
pmid-1981959.summary_en: The authors report an ovarian strumal carcinoid that produced peptide hormones but did not cause carcinoid syndrome. Histochemical, immunohistochemical, dot-immunobinding, and electron microscopic analyses showed follicular thyroglobulin-positive areas and trabecular neuroendocrine areas expressing ACTH, SRIF, and neuroendocrine markers. Electron microscopy revealed dense-core granules in both components. Plasma levels of ACTH, SRIF, and thyroglobulin were within normal limits. Strumal carcinoids are a specialized ovarian teratoma subtype, and this case documents the immunophenotype of a neuroendocrine component arising within it.

pmid-19912770.summary_ja: 多能性胎児性癌細胞株PCC4uvaを神経様細胞へ分化させる系を検討した。レチノイン酸とジブチリルcAMPで処理すると、神経様細胞は培養3日目に出現し、10日目には全細胞の60〜80%を占めた。神経特異的タンパク質（Map2、Tau、ニューロフィラメント、III型βチューブリン）を発現していた。
pmid-19912770.summary_en: This study examined in vitro differentiation of the pluripotent embryonal carcinoma line PCC4uva into neuron-like cells. Standard culture produced neuron-like cells slowly, but treatment with retinoic acid and dibutyryl cAMP accelerated their appearance to day 3 and increased their proportion to 60-80% by day 10. These cells expressed neuron-specific proteins including Map2, Tau, neurofilaments, and type III beta-tubulin. The optimized system was then used to investigate how laminin substrates influence neural differentiation.

pmid-2074566.summary_ja: 本症例は早産の女児で、鼻咽腔奇形腫（「hairy polyp」）、Dandy-Walker奇形、横隔膜ヘルニア、先天性心疾患を含む多発奇形を有していた。このような奇形の組み合わせは過去に報告がないとされる。鼻咽腔奇形腫は稀で口腔外の奇形を伴うことは少なく、性腺外奇形腫と先天異常の関連を考える上で貴重な症例である。
pmid-2074566.summary_en: This case report describes a premature female infant with multiple congenital anomalies, including a nasopharyngeal teratoma (a 'hairy polyp'), Dandy-Walker malformation, diaphragmatic hernia, and a congenital heart defect. The authors note that this combination of malformations has not been previously reported. Nasopharyngeal teratomas are rare and only infrequently associated with extra-oral anomalies, so the case adds to the limited literature on extragonadal teratomas occurring alongside syndromic congenital malformations.

pmid-2075885.summary_ja: 生後6か月の男児が無痛性の左陰嚢内腫瘤を主訴に受診し、左高位精巣摘除術が施行された。病理診断は左精巣の未熟奇形腫であった。腫瘍組織と末梢血の染色体解析で47,XXYが確認され、Klinefelter症候群と診断された。耳介の過折れ以外に先天異常は認めなかった。精巣腫瘍との関連について考察している。
pmid-2075885.summary_en: This Japanese case report describes a 6-month-old boy with a painless left scrotal mass who underwent high orchiectomy. Pathology revealed an immature teratoma of the left testis. Chromosome analysis of both tumor tissue and peripheral blood showed 47,XXY, establishing a diagnosis of Klinefelter syndrome. Apart from an overfolded helix, no other congenital anomalies were found. The authors discuss the association between testicular tumors and Klinefelter syndrome, a rare combination in infancy.

pmid-2075886.summary_ja: 本邦の症例報告で、1年間血液透析を受けている43歳の男性が、左精巣の腫大と疼痛を主訴に来院した。高位精巣摘除術により、絨毛癌が疑われる部分を伴うセミノーマが認められた。コンピュータ断層撮影と胸部X線検査では転移はなく、腫瘍は臨床病期I と分類された。透析中であることおよび病期I であることを考慮し、放射線療法およびリンパ節郭清は行わず、慎重な経過観察が続けられている。
pmid-2075886.summary_en: This Japanese case report describes a 43-year-old man on hemodialysis for one year who presented with left testicular swelling and pain. High orchiectomy revealed a seminoma with a focus suspected to be choriocarcinoma. Computed tomography and chest radiography showed no metastasis, and the tumor was classified as stage I. Because of his dialysis status and stage I disease, the patient did not receive radiotherapy or lymph node dissection and is being followed with careful observation.

pmid-2076869.summary_ja: 精巣セミノーマ10例と頭蓋内胚腫10例を形態学的・免疫組織化学的に比較した。両部位の大多数で胎盤型アルカリホスファターゼが陽性であり、サイトケラチンとビメンチンは全例陰性であった。リンパ球浸潤は両部位で類似し、マクロファージや肉芽腫も認めた。共通の起源を持つ可能性が示唆された。
pmid-2076869.summary_en: This study compared 10 classical testicular seminomas with 10 intracranial germinomas using morphological and immunohistochemical methods. Most tumors at both sites stained positive for placental alkaline phosphatase, while cytokeratin and vimentin were negative in all cases. Lymphocytic infiltrates containing T and B cells were similar at both sites, and macrophages and granulomas were noted in both. The authors suggest that testicular and intracranial germinomas share a common origin, with no evidence of tumor cell differentiation at either site.

pmid-2078509.summary_ja: 放射線誘発性の胚細胞腫瘍から樹立された細胞株の染色体解析を報告している。株は1年以上培養され、継代13代で解析された。核型は偽二倍体で複数の均衡型転座を認めた。自然発生の胚細胞腫瘍で報告されるi(12p)は認めず、12pと7q22-q32のモノソミーを認めた。
pmid-2078509.summary_en: This report describes the cytogenetic analysis of a cell line established from a radiation-induced germ cell tumor, a rare occurrence. The cell line was grown for over a year and harvested at passage 13. Its karyotype was pseudodiploid with several balanced translocations. Spontaneously occurring germ cell tumors are associated with i(12p), but the authors did not detect i(12p) and instead found monosomy of 12p and 7q22-q32, suggesting that radiation-induced tumors may differ genetically from spontaneous ones.

pmid-2081460.summary_ja: 胎児性癌細胞株F9とPSA-1が、壁側・臓側内胚葉を含む胚様体へ分化する過程で、メタロプロテアーゼの分泌がどう変化するかを検討した。分化はレチノイン酸とジブチリルcAMP、あるいは細胞間接着の変化により誘導された。両株とも分化に伴いコラゲナーゼ活性と組織性メタロプロテアーゼ阻害因子（TIMP）の分泌が増加し、遺伝子発現も上昇した。
pmid-2081460.summary_en: This study examined how two embryonal carcinoma cell lines, F9 and PSA-1, change their secretion of metalloproteinases as they differentiate into embryoid bodies containing parietal and visceral endoderm. Differentiation was induced by retinoic acid and dibutyryl cAMP or by altering cell-cell adhesion. Both lines showed increased collagenase activity and secretion of tissue inhibitor of metalloproteinases during differentiation, and gene expression for collagenase, stromelysin, and TIMP rose. The findings suggest these enzymes are developmentally regulated during parietal endoderm spreading.

pmid-2081693.summary_ja: マウス胎児性癌細胞3株を用いて、エタノールおよび短鎖アルコールが細胞の基質接着に与える影響を検討した基礎研究である。エタノールはラミニンやコラーゲンI型への接着を用量依存的かつ可逆的に低下させたが、フィブロネクチンへの接着には影響しなかった。他の短鎖アルコールによる抑制効果は膜/緩衝液分配係数に比例した。胎児性癌細胞株間で基質接着能が異なること、胎児性アルコール症候群の解明に関連しうることが示された。
pmid-2081693.summary_en: This basic research study examined how ethanol and related short-chain alcohols affect the adhesion of three mouse embryonal carcinoma cell lines to extracellular matrix substrates (laminin, fibronectin, collagen type I). Ethanol reduced binding to laminin and collagen I in a dose-dependent, reversible manner, while fibronectin binding was unaffected. Other short-chain alcohols inhibited laminin adhesion in proportion to their membrane/buffer partition coefficients. The results show that embryonal carcinoma lines differ in matrix adhesion capacity and suggest possible relevance to fetal alcohol syndrome mechanisms.

pmid-2082747.summary_ja: 陰嚢切開による局所生検を受けた精巣腫瘍患者3例の報告と文献レビューである。うち2例は高位鼠径精巣摘除術と生検部位の広範囲局所切除を行い、化学療法と放射線療法の併用により良好な転帰が得られた。不適切な陰嚢切開は局所制御を損なうおそれがあることが指摘されている。精巣腫瘍に対する初回の適切な外科的管理の重要性を強調する論文である。
pmid-2082747.summary_en: This report describes three patients with testicular tumors who initially underwent local biopsy through an inadequate scrotal incision. Two were subsequently managed with high inguinal orchidectomy and wide local excision of the prior biopsy site, followed by combination chemotherapy and radiotherapy, with good outcomes. The authors review the literature on the risks of inadequate scrotal approaches, which may compromise local control and staging. The paper highlights the importance of proper primary surgical management of testicular neoplasms.

pmid-2083411.summary_ja: 人の奇形癌と混合型胚細胞腫瘍の幹細胞区画について総説した論文である。多能性の悪性幹細胞である胎児性癌細胞は、栄養膜様や卵黄嚢様の組織へ分化しうるほか、絨毛癌や卵黄嚢癌の細胞へ、さらには体細胞型の悪性腫瘍へ変化しうると述べられている。奇形腫内の良性体細胞組織の悪性転化からも体細胞型の幹細胞が生じうる。胚細胞腫瘍の生物学的特性、臨床像、化学療法への反応はこれらの幹細胞の性質に依存すると結論づけている。
pmid-2083411.summary_en: This review examines the stem cell compartment of human teratocarcinomas and mixed germ cell tumours. Embryonal carcinoma cells serve as pluripotent malignant stem cells that can differentiate into trophoblastic and yolk sac-like tissues, or give rise to more restricted choriocarcinoma and yolk sac carcinoma cells. Somatic malignancies may also arise from embryonal carcinoma, and malignant transformation of benign somatic components in teratomas can produce somatic-type malignant stem cells. The authors argue that the biology, clinical presentation, and chemotherapy response of germ cell tumours depend on the nature of these stem cells.

pmid-2090793.summary_ja: 本研究では、インジウム111またはヨウ素123で標識した胎盤性アルカリホスファターゼに対するモノクローナル抗体(H17E2)を、原発性または転移性精巣腫瘍の患者33例と完全寛解の患者8例で評価した。抗体シンチグラフィは従来の画像診断とよく一致し、従来法が陰性で血清マーカーが上昇した2例の活動性疾患を検出した。1例ではCTが偽陽性であったが、抗体シンチグラフィでは陰性であった。4か月の追跡期間中、ヒト抗マウス抗体や毒性は検出されず、新たな画像診断の補助法としての臨床的有用性が示唆された。
pmid-2090793.summary_en: This study evaluated a radiolabelled monoclonal antibody (H17E2) against placental alkaline phosphatase, labelled with Indium-111 or Iodine-123, in 33 patients with primary or metastatic testicular tumours and 8 patients in complete remission. The antibody scan confirmed tumours that correlated well with conventional imaging, and it detected active disease in two patients with negative conventional imaging and elevated serum markers. In one patient, CT gave a false-positive result that the antibody scan did not show. No human anti-mouse antibodies or toxicity were detected during four months of follow-up, suggesting clinical value as a new imaging adjunct.

pmid-2092655.summary_ja: 精巣セミノーマ患者73例を対象に、腹腔内進展の検出におけるコンピュータ断層撮影(CT)と両足式リンパ管造影を後方視的に比較した。両検査の一致率は88%であった。病期の上方修正はCTで10%、リンパ管造影で14%、両者併用で16%にみられた。血清β-hCGは残存病変の信頼できるスクリーニングとはならなかった。腹部CTが不確実または正常の場合、臨床病期Iのセミノーマではリンパ管造影に役割があると結論づけている。
pmid-2092655.summary_en: This retrospective study of 73 patients with testicular seminoma compared CT scanning and bipedal lymphangiography for detecting intra-abdominal spread. Concordance between the two techniques was 88%. Upstaging occurred in 10% of patients by CT, 14% by lymphangiography, and 16% when both were used. Serum beta-HCG was not a reliable screen for residual disease, though CT readily detected residual disease in patients with elevated levels. The authors conclude that lymphangiography retains a role in clinical stage I seminoma when abdominal CT is equivocal or normal.

pmid-2098280.summary_ja: マウス奇形癌に由来する3つの細胞株（NE、ME、LRD）を、胎児性癌および卵黄嚢癌のモデルとして特徴づけた。ラミニン、エンタクチン、フィブロネクチン、オステオネクチンなどの基底膜成分の分泌と集積を比較した。多能性を持たない胎児性癌細胞はラミニンとフィブロネクチンを分泌したが、目に見える細胞周囲基質は形成しなかった。壁側卵黄嚢癌の基質にはフィブロネクチンが含まれていなかった。胚細胞腫瘍の細胞株間で基質産生は異なり、in vitro での基底膜研究への利用が支持される。
pmid-2098280.summary_en: Three mouse cell lines (NE, ME, LRD) derived from teratocarcinomas were characterized as embryonal carcinoma or yolk sac carcinoma models. Their secretion and assembly of basement membrane components, including laminin, entactin, fibronectin and osteonectin, were compared. Nullipotent embryonal carcinoma cells secreted laminin and fibronectin but did not assemble a visible pericellular matrix, while parietal yolk sac carcinoma matrix lacked fibronectin. Matrix production differs among germ cell tumor cell lines, supporting their use for in vitro basement membrane studies.

pmid-2099732.summary_ja: 子宮頸部に原発した、極めてまれな性腺外の成熟嚢胞性奇形腫の症例を報告している。ポリープ状を呈した腫瘍は外胚葉、中胚葉、内胚葉に由来する成分から構成されていた。世界文献で14例目とされ、文献レビューと組織発生の可能性について簡潔に論じている。
pmid-2099732.summary_en: A rare extragonadal mature cystic teratoma arising primarily in the uterine cervix is reported. The polypoid tumor consisted of ectodermal, mesodermal and endodermal derivatives. The authors note it is the 14th such tumor recorded in the world literature. The case highlights that teratomas can rarely develop outside the gonads. The authors briefly review prior reports and discuss how such lesions may arise.

pmid-2104698.summary_ja: 17例の小児患者に生じた18個の良性嚢胞性卵巣奇形腫の超音波所見を、思春期前と思春期後で比較した。壁在結節は思春期前で38%、思春期後で70%に認められ、音響陰影も思春期後に多かった。典型的所見は思春期後により頻繁にみられ、年齢により画像所見が異なることを示した。
pmid-2104698.summary_en: Sonographic features of 18 benign cystic ovarian teratomas in 17 pediatric patients were compared between prepubertal and postpubertal girls. Mural nodules were seen in 38 percent of prepubertal and 70 percent of postpubertal lesions, and acoustic shadowing in 13 percent and 70 percent respectively. Typical features occurred more often after puberty. Prepubertal lesions were more often complex or cystic without characteristic signs. The study suggests age-related differences in imaging appearance that may affect diagnosis.

pmid-2104910.summary_ja: 胎児性癌株Tera-2と絨毛癌株Jeg-3のHLAクラスI発現を比較した。Tera-2では古典的HLA-A、-B、-Cの抗原がわずかに発現し、Jeg-3では正常量のβ2ミクログロブリン結合型クラスI分子が発現していた。HLA-6.0転写産物はJeg-3で恒常的に発現したが、Tera-2では認められなかった。IFN-γはTera-2のクラスI遺伝子を誘導したがJeg-3では反応しなかった。栄養膜のクラスI分子が母体による胎児同種移植の受容に果たす役割を論じている。
pmid-2104910.summary_en: HLA class I expression was compared in two serologically untypeable developmental tumor lines: the embryonal carcinoma line Tera-2 and the choriocarcinoma line Jeg-3. Tera-2 expressed trace classical HLA-A, -B and -C antigens, whereas Jeg-3 expressed normal beta2-microglobulin-associated class I molecules. HLA-6.0 transcripts were constitutively expressed in Jeg-3 but not Tera-2, and HLA-E was largely untranscribed. IFN-gamma upregulated class I genes in Tera-2 but not Jeg-3. The authors discuss trophoblast class I molecules in maternal acceptance of the fetal allograft.

pmid-2106218.summary_ja: 精巣腫瘍の術前MR画像で、セミノーマと非セミノーマを鑑別できるかを検討した。非セミノーマは不均一な信号を示し周囲に線維性被膜を伴い、セミノーマは被膜を欠き均一な低信号を呈した。判定可能であった14病変中13例で組織型を正しく予測した。誤診は出血を伴った純粋セミノーマの1例であった。治療方針が異なるため、MRによる鑑別は有用と結論している。
pmid-2106218.summary_en: MR imaging was evaluated for distinguishing seminomatous from nonseminomatous testicular tumors preoperatively in 15 patients. Nonseminomatous tumors showed heterogeneous signal with a peripheral dark band corresponding to a fibrous capsule. Seminomas were isointense on proton-density images and homogeneously hypointense on T2-weighted images, usually without a capsule. Histologic type was correctly predicted in 13 of 14 characterizable lesions. The single error was a pure seminoma with hemorrhage. MR may help differentiate these tumor types, which require different treatment.

pmid-2108920.summary_ja: 転移性精巣がん患者16例と年齢を合わせた健常男性10例で、GHRHおよびTRHに対する成長ホルモン反応を測定した。患者では基礎値も刺激後値も有意に高値であった。完全寛解後に再検査した9例では、GHRH反応が低下傾向を示したが有意差はなかった。転移性精巣がんが視床下部または下垂体のGH分泌調節を変化させている可能性を示唆している。
pmid-2108920.summary_en: Growth hormone responses to GHRH and TRH were measured in 16 patients with metastatic testicular cancer and 10 age-matched healthy men. Basal and stimulated GH levels were significantly higher in cancer patients. In 9 patients studied again after complete remission, GH responses to GHRH tended to decrease, though not significantly. The authors suggest that metastatic testicular cancer alters hypothalamic or pituitary regulation of GH secretion.

pmid-2109649.summary_ja: F9奇形癌幹細胞をDFMOで処理すると、大部分は終末分化して増殖能を失う。しかし約20万個に1個の細胞は増殖能を保持していた。これらの細胞は薬剤耐性を示さず、DFMO除去後は対照細胞と同程度の倍加時間で増殖した。DFMOを用いた治療プロトコルを設計する際には、この静止期の細胞集団を考慮する必要があると結論している。
pmid-2109649.summary_en: This study examined F9 teratocarcinoma stem cells treated with alpha-difluoromethylornithine (DFMO), a polyamine synthesis inhibitor that induces parietal endoderm-like differentiation. Most treated cells become terminally differentiated and lose proliferative capacity. However, about 1 in 200,000 cells retained the ability to proliferate after 6 to 10 days of treatment. These cells showed no drug resistance, and their doubling time resembled that of control cells after DFMO withdrawal. The authors conclude that this quiescent population must be considered when designing DFMO-based therapeutic protocols.

pmid-2114939.summary_ja: 精巣セミノーマ197例に対する放射線療法の成績を後方視的に検討した。病期I・IIには40Gyを照射され、5年生存率は病期I・IIで100%、病期III・IVで87%であった。急性毒性は軽度から中等度で、縦隔照射後の肺線維症による死亡が1例あった。30Gyの個別化照射や、病期Iでの照射省略と綿密なフォローアップが有用と結論している。
pmid-2114939.summary_en: This retrospective review analyzed 197 patients with testicular seminoma treated with radiation therapy at a German university hospital. Stage I and II patients received 40 Gy to paraaortic and parailiac fields, while stage III and IV patients also received mediastinal and supraclavicular irradiation. Five-year survival was 100% for stages I and II and 87% for stages III and IV. Acute toxicity was mild to moderate, with one death from pulmonary fibrosis after mediastinal irradiation. The authors suggest reduced 30 Gy doses and individualized planning, or surveillance alone for early stages.

pmid-2115033.summary_ja: 1951〜1986年に精巣摘除術と放射線療法を受けた純粋型精巣セミノーマ116例で、二次がんの発生リスクを検討した。12例の二次がんが発生し、累積リスクは15年および20年で16%だった。対側のセミノーマや膀胱移行上皮癌の増加が、全体のリスク上昇を主に説明した。セミノーマを除くと有意な増加は認められず、予後は依然として良好である。
pmid-2115033.summary_en: This study assessed second cancer risk in 116 patients with pure testicular seminoma treated with orchiectomy and radiation therapy from 1951 to 1986. Eleven patients developed 12 second cancers, with cumulative risk reaching 16% at 15 and 20 years. Overall risk was increased (O/E 1.97), driven mainly by contralateral seminoma and bladder transitional cell carcinoma. Excluding second seminomas, the excess risk was not significant. The overall prognosis remains excellent, with a 5-year survival of 95%.

pmid-2115259.summary_ja: 女性の骨盤内で脂肪を含む腫瘍の画像所見を概説する。大半は良性の嚢胞性卵巣奇形腫である。奇形腫の悪性転化や非奇形腫性の脂肪性卵巣腫瘍、子宮脂肪性腫瘍などを鑑別診断に挙げる。悪性病変の正確な同定は予後と手術計画に影響するため重要である。
pmid-2115259.summary_en: This essay illustrates imaging findings of fat-containing pelvic tumors in women. Most are benign cystic ovarian teratomas, but the differential diagnosis includes malignant degeneration of teratoma, nonteratomatous lipomatous ovarian tumors, lipomatous uterine tumors, benign pelvic lipomas, and liposarcomas. Asymptomatic uterine lipomatous tumors and pelvic lipomas may need no therapy. Correct identification of malignant lipomatous tumors affects prognosis and surgical planning. The rare entities still require accurate differentiation because it can be clinically significant.

pmid-2120460.summary_ja: 1969年から1984年に当施設で治療された精巣セミノーマ58例の後方視的検討である。病期I(34例)が最多で、放射線療法を受けた患者が多かった。無病生存率は病期Iの91%から病期IVの50%まで低下した。未分化型組織やヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)βサブユニット高値は生存に有意差を与えず、晩期合併症も認められなかった。
pmid-2120460.summary_en: This retrospective review covers 58 patients with testicular seminoma treated at the University of Kansas Medical Center from 1969 to 1984. Most had stage I disease (34 patients), and 42 had typical histology while 16 had anaplastic histology. Most patients received radiation, and seven received chemotherapy with or without radiation. Median follow-up was 7 years. Disease-free survival declined with stage, from 91% in stage I to 50% in stage IV. Anaplastic histology and elevated hCG B subunit did not significantly change survival, and no late complications were seen.

pmid-2125127.summary_ja: 末梢性神経線維腫症(Recklinghausen病)に加え、中脳水道狭窄と精巣奇形腫を合併した症例を報告している。神経線維腫症に中脳水道狭窄が合併する報告はあるが、この文脈で精巣奇形腫が合併した報告は初めてとされる。胚細胞腫瘍と神経線維腫症の稀な合併を示す症例報告である。
pmid-2125127.summary_en: This case report describes a patient with peripheral neurofibromatosis (von Recklinghausen disease) who also had aqueductal stenosis and a testicular teratoma. The authors note that aqueductal stenosis has been reported in neurofibromatosis, but a testicular teratoma in this setting has not been described before. The report highlights a rare co-occurrence of a germ cell tumor with neurofibromatosis. Further clinical details are not provided in the available abstract.

pmid-2129227.summary_ja: ホジキン病の化学療法、または精巣セミノーマに対する片側精巣摘除後の放射線療法を受けた男性で、インヒビン、FSH、LH、テストステロンを測定した。化学療法群ではインヒビンとテストステロンは正常だが、I/FSH比とT/LH比が低下していた。放射線療法群ではインヒビンとテストステロンが低下し、ゴナドトロピンが著明に上昇していた。GCT治療の晩期影響を考えるうえで重要な知見である。
pmid-2129227.summary_en: This study measured serum inhibin, FSH, LH and testosterone in men with testicular damage from chemotherapy for Hodgkin's disease or from radiotherapy after orchidectomy for testicular seminoma. Chemotherapy-treated men had normal inhibin and testosterone but raised FSH and LH, with reduced inhibin/FSH and testosterone/LH ratios. Radiotherapy-treated men had lower inhibin and testosterone with markedly elevated gonadotropins. The authors conclude that subtle Sertoli and Leydig cell dysfunction persists after chemotherapy, which the ratios can reveal. This is relevant to the late effects of GCT treatment.

pmid-2137105.summary_ja: ハムスターの頬袋に移植したヒト絨毛癌（JEG-3）細胞に対し、光感受性物質DHEと630nmのレーザー光による光線力学療法を行った研究です。単独では効果が乏しく、併用では1回治療で55%、2回目で100%が完全退縮しました。全体では90%の腫瘍が破壊され、対照群は増大を続けました。
pmid-2137105.summary_en: In a hamster cheek pouch model, transplanted human choriocarcinoma (JEG-3) cells were treated with photodynamic therapy using dihematoporphyrin ether and 630-nm laser light. Light alone or photosensitizer alone had little effect. Combined treatment produced complete regression in 55% of tumors after one session and in 100% after a second, with 90% grossly destroyed overall, while control tumors kept growing. The authors conclude that choriocarcinoma is highly responsive to photodynamic therapy in this model.

pmid-2141485.summary_ja: シスプラチン併用化学療法で治癒した精巣がん患者28例と、放射線療法で治癒した年齢・社会階層・治療後期間をマッチさせた34例を比較しました。化学療法群では身体的副作用が多く、放射線療法群では不安と抑うつが多く報告されました。化学療法群の多くは、病気が家族や友人との関係に良い影響を与えたと感じていました。
pmid-2141485.summary_en: This study compared patient-reported long-term outcomes in 28 men cured of testicular cancer with cisplatin-based chemotherapy against 34 matched men cured with radiotherapy. A category-rating questionnaire covered health, side effects, employment, relationships, reproduction, and mood. The chemotherapy group reported more physical side effects, while the radiotherapy group reported more anxiety and depression. Many chemotherapy patients felt their illness had improved relationships with family and friends.

pmid-2144165.summary_ja: 膀胱がん細胞株RT112と精巣腫瘍細胞株SuSaから、シスプラチンを段階的に高濃度で曝露させて耐性株を作製しました。両耐性株は約4倍の耐性を示し、薬剤非存在下でも少なくとも3か月維持されました。カルボプラチンとメトトレキサートにも交差耐性を示しましたが、ドキソルビシンには耐性を示しませんでした。
pmid-2144165.summary_en: Cisplatin-resistant cell lines were generated in vitro from a bladder carcinoma line (RT112) and a human testicular tumour line (SuSa) by long-term exposure to escalating cisplatin. Both resistant lines showed about four-fold resistance, which persisted without drug for at least three months, and produced fewer micronuclei. Cross-resistance to carboplatin and methotrexate was seen in both, but not to doxorubicin. Karyotypic changes differed between the two lines.

pmid-2148879.summary_ja: セミノーマ患者236例、計1578検体の血清PLAPを解析した研究である。喫煙者や活動性疾患では値が高いが、群間の重なりが大きい。監視療法中に再発した11例のうち、臨床的再発時に上昇していたのは2例のみであった。PLAP単独ではマーカーとして不十分で、フォローアップへの寄与は小さいと結論づけられている。
pmid-2148879.summary_en: This study assessed serum placental alkaline phosphatase (PLAP) in 236 patients with seminoma, using 1578 samples. PLAP levels were higher in smokers and in patients with active disease, but overlap between groups was considerable. In 97 patients on surveillance, only 2 of 11 who relapsed had elevated PLAP at clinical relapse. Using a 35 U/l cutoff, sensitivity was low (45% overall, 47% in non-smokers), and the authors conclude that PLAP cannot stand alone as a seminoma marker and adds little to follow-up.

pmid-2149420.summary_ja: 著者らは、卵巣甲状腺腫とカルチノイドが併存した単一症例の病理組織像を記述し、5年間の臨床経過を報告している。本論文は、卵巣甲状腺腫の内部に生じた甲状腺癌と、さまざまなパターンのカルチノイドを鑑別することの診断上の困難さを強調している。卵巣甲状腺腫は卵巣奇形腫の単胚葉型亜型であるため、本症例は診断に焦点を当てた胚細胞腫瘍の症例報告である。
pmid-2149420.summary_en: The authors describe the histopathology of a single case of strumal carcinoid, in which struma ovarii coexists with carcinoid, and report five years of clinical follow-up. The paper emphasizes the diagnostic difficulty of distinguishing a thyroid carcinoma arising within a struma ovarii from various carcinoid patterns. Struma ovarii is a monodermal subtype of ovarian teratoma, so this is a germ cell tumor case report with a diagnostic focus.

pmid-2153192.summary_ja: オーストラレーシア胚細胞腫瘍試験グループによる研究で、シスプラチン、ビンブラスチン、ブレオマイシンによる治療に抵抗性の進行胚細胞腫瘍患者51例にEAM療法（エトポシド、ダクチノマイシン、メトトレキサート）を施行した。完全寛解は25%、完全寛解と無病状態を合わせた奏効率は29%で、奏効に影響した因子は腫瘍容積のみであった。完全寛解例は5年以上再発がなく、シスプラチンを含まない本レジメンの有用性が示唆される。
pmid-2153192.summary_en: This Australasian Germ Cell Trial Group study evaluated salvage therapy with etoposide, dactinomycin, and methotrexate (EAM) in 51 patients with refractory advanced germ cell malignancy, all of whom had failed cisplatin, vinblastine, and bleomycin. Complete remission was achieved in 25%, and the combined complete remission plus no evidence of disease rate was 29%. Tumor volume was the only significant predictor of response. Patients achieving remission had no relapses after at least five years, and the authors suggest that this non-cisplatin regimen may improve cure rates.

pmid-2153431.summary_ja: 本研究は特異的モノクローナル抗体を用い、ヒト胚細胞腫瘍107例におけるガングリオシドGM2のN-アセチル型およびN-グリコリル型を検討した。セミノーマはN-アセチル型GM2陽性率が89.4%と最も高く、N-グリコリル型は全例で陰性であった。非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍はN-グリコリル型を発現し、その陽性率は分化度と相関した。セミノーマのマーカー候補としてN-アセチル型GM2の有用性が示唆された。
pmid-2153431.summary_en: This study used three monoclonal antibodies to assess N-acetyl and N-glycolyl forms of ganglioside GM2 in 107 human germ cell tumors. Seminoma showed the highest N-acetyl GM2 positivity (89.4%) and lacked N-glycolyl GM2 entirely. Non-seminomatous tumors expressed N-glycolyl GM2, with positivity correlating with differentiation, higher in yolk sac tumor, choriocarcinoma, and teratocarcinoma than in embryonal carcinoma. Thin-layer chromatography confirmed these findings chemically. The authors propose N-acetyl GM2 as a potential marker for seminoma.

pmid-2153877.summary_ja: 1976年から1988年に多角的治療を受けた原発性縦隔非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の48例を後方視的に検討した。診断時の血清腫瘍マーカーは92%で上昇していた。初回治療施設の28例中22例が完全奏効し、17例が生存、5年生存率は57%であった。他施設で初回治療が奏効しなかった20例の予後は不良であった。シスプラチン併用化学療法と残存腫瘍の切除が有効であることが示された。
pmid-2153877.summary_en: This retrospective study reviews 48 patients treated between 1976 and 1988 for primary mediastinal nonseminomatous germ cell tumor with a multimodality approach. Serum tumor markers were elevated in 92% at diagnosis. Among 28 patients treated initially at the institution, 22 achieved complete response, and 17 survived with a 57% five-year Kaplan-Meier survival rate. Survival was poor among 20 patients referred after failed initial therapy. The authors conclude that intensive cisplatin-based chemotherapy, normalization of tumor markers, and aggressive resection of residual disease offer survival to many patients.

pmid-2154316.summary_ja: 本論文は、胚細胞腫瘍の病期分類は予後予測だけでなく、手術、化学療法、またはその併用という治療選択を導くものでなければならないと論じる。組織型と原発部位が治療方針を大きく左右する。純粋セミノーマは化学療法に対して独自の感受性を示すため専用の病期分類が必要である。非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍では腫瘍容積、組織型、原発部位、腫瘍マーカーを評価すべきである。
pmid-2154316.summary_en: This review argues that germ cell tumor staging systems must go beyond prognosis and guide the choice among surgery, chemotherapy, or both. Histologic type and primary site strongly shape management. Pure seminoma responds uniquely to chemotherapy and needs its own staging scheme. For nonseminomatous tumors, tumor volume, histology, site of origin, and serum biomarkers should be systematically evaluated. Results from the M.D. Anderson Cancer Center support clinically relevant staging, which the authors propose as a basis for future trials that tailor treatment intensity to risk.

pmid-2154858.summary_ja: 難治性胚細胞腫瘍22例に対し、エトポシド50 mg/m2/日の経口連日投与を行った第II相試験。21例の評価可能例中3例で測定可能病変が50%以上縮小し、さらに3例で腫瘍マーカーが90%以上低下した。主な毒性は顆粒球減少症で、ニューモシスチス肺炎による死亡が2例あった。難治例に対する有効性が示され、さらなる検討が妥当と結論づけられている。
pmid-2154858.summary_en: This phase II study evaluated daily oral etoposide at 50 mg/m2 in 22 patients with refractory germ cell tumors, nearly all previously treated with cisplatin/etoposide regimens. Among 21 evaluable patients, three achieved major responses with over 50% reduction in measurable disease, and three more had marker decreases over 90% with stable imaging. Granulocytopenia was the main toxicity, and two patients died of Pneumocystis pneumonia. The authors conclude that daily oral etoposide has definite activity in refractory germ cell tumors and merits further evaluation.

pmid-2156245.summary_ja: 1941年から1986年に小児病院で治療された胚細胞腫瘍188例を後方視的に検討した。卵巣、仙尾部、精巣、松果体部、縦隔が主な発生部位であった。5年生存率は良性96%、未熟性83%、悪性42%だった。未熟奇形腫で診断時のαフェトプロテイン(AFP)が高値の症例は再発率が高く、再発腫瘍は胎児性癌であった。
pmid-2156245.summary_en: This retrospective review of 188 pediatric patients treated from 1941 to 1986 describes germ cell tumors by site and histology. Ovary, sacrococcygeal region, testis, pineal region, and mediastinum were the most common sites. Five-year survival was 96% for benign tumors, 83% for immature tumors, and 42% for malignant tumors. Elevated serum AFP at diagnosis in patients with immature tumors was associated with higher relapse, and the recurrent tumors were embryonal carcinoma.

pmid-2156331.summary_ja: ホルモン産生性の婦人科腫瘍を概説する総説。妊娠性絨毛性疾患はヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)を産生し、妊娠に似た症状が強調されることが多い。卵巣の性索間質性腫瘍は性ステロイドを分泌し、一部の卵巣胚細胞腫瘍は合胞体栄養膜細胞によりhCGを産生する。成熟奇形腫の特殊型である卵巣甲状腺腫は甲状腺ホルモンを、カルチノイドはセロトニンを産生する。
pmid-2156331.summary_en: This review covers hormonally active gynecologic tumors. Gestational trophoblastic disease produces hCG, and its symptoms resemble pregnancy but are often exaggerated. Sex-cord stromal ovarian tumors secrete sex steroids, while some ovarian germ cell tumors contain syncytiotrophoblastic cells that produce hCG. Struma ovarii, a specialized mature teratoma, produces thyroid hormones, and carcinoids produce serotonin.

pmid-2156412.summary_ja: 精巣・後腹膜・縦隔の胚細胞腫瘍299例を後方視的に検討し、神経画像検査の有用性を評価した。CNS画像検査を受けた66例中20例にCNS転移が認められ、うち11例は頭蓋内転移だった。腫瘍マーカー高値のみで神経症状のない25例には脳転移はなかった。限局性神経学的欠損や痙攣がある場合に有用性が高かった。
pmid-2156412.summary_en: This retrospective analysis of 299 patients with testicular, retroperitoneal, or mediastinal germ cell tumors assessed when neuroimaging is useful. Of 66 patients who underwent CNS imaging, 20 had CNS metastases, including 11 intracranial. None of 25 asymptomatic patients with elevated tumor markers had brain metastases. CNS imaging was most useful for focal neurologic deficits or seizures, where metastases were common, but was not useful for unexplained marker elevation alone.

pmid-2156765.summary_ja: 部分胞状奇胎に続発した持続性妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍を発症した16例(240例中)を検討した。全例が非転移性で、絨毛癌の組織像は認められなかった。15例はメトトレキサートとロイコボリン(シトロボルムファクター)により寛解し、1例は併用化学療法を要した。臨床・病理学的特徴は他の部分胞状奇胎例と差がなく、ヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)による追跡が推奨されている。
pmid-2156765.summary_en: This study examined 16 of 240 patients followed for partial hydatidiform mole who developed persistent gestational trophoblastic tumor. All had nonmetastatic disease with no choriocarcinoma histology. Fifteen achieved complete remission with methotrexate and citrovorum factor, and one required combination chemotherapy. Clinical and pathologic features did not differ from other partial mole patients. The authors recommend serial hCG monitoring in all patients with partial mole to confirm remission.

pmid-2158037.summary_ja: NT2/D1ヒト胎児性癌細胞株をレチノイン酸で処理すると、Hst-1/kFGF、TGF-α、bFGFの発現が低下し、Hox 2.1/2.2の発現が上昇した。これらの変化は時間的に逆相関していた。男性胚細胞腫瘍細胞株7株中5株でHst-1/kFGFとbFGFが共通して発現しており、精巣がんへの関与が示唆された。
pmid-2158037.summary_en: Study of the human embryonal carcinoma line NT2/D1 treated with retinoic acid, which induces neuronal-type differentiation. Three growth factors (Hst-1/kFGF, TGF-alpha, bFGF) were markedly down-regulated, while Hox 2.1 and Hox 2.2 increased, with the changes inversely correlated over time. Nuclear run-on assays suggested the changes were not primarily transcriptional. Hst-1/kFGF and bFGF were commonly expressed in five of seven male germ cell cancer lines, suggesting a possible role in human testicular cancer.

pmid-2158120.summary_ja: 化学療法後に血清腫瘍マーカーが陰性となった非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍患者185例を対象とした。化学療法後も増大した残存腫瘤17個（14例）の大部分は奇形腫で、成熟奇形腫が中心だった。後腹膜と縦隔の奇形腫性腫瘤はすべて、CTで部分的に嚢胞性であった。マーカー陰性で増大する腫瘤は成熟奇形腫であることが多く、完全な外科的切除で通常治癒が得られると結論づけている。
pmid-2158120.summary_en: Study of 185 men with negative serum tumor markers after first-line chemotherapy for nonseminomatous germ cell tumors who underwent resection of residual masses. Of 17 enlarging masses in 14 patients, most were teratomas, including mature and immature forms, while some were necrotic tissue. One mature teratoma showed sarcomatous transformation. All retroperitoneal and mediastinal teratomatous masses were partly cystic on CT. The authors conclude that enlarging masses with negative markers frequently represent mature teratomas, and complete surgical resection is usually curative.

pmid-2158625.summary_ja: 1983〜1988年に縦隔原発胚細胞腫瘍に伴う血液腫瘍16例を観察し、文献上の28例と合わせて検討した。非セミノーマ性で、特に卵黄嚢成分を有する症例に限られていた。急性巨核芽球性白血病と悪性組織球症が主な病型であった。シスプラチン併用化学療法による発症とは考えにくく、等染色体12p標識を指標に共通の前駆細胞由来と示唆されている。
pmid-2158625.summary_en: Sixteen cases of hematologic neoplasia associated with primary mediastinal germ cell tumors were observed between 1983 and 1988, and 28 further cases were identified in the literature. The syndrome occurred only in nonseminomatous mediastinal tumors, particularly those with yolk sac elements. The most common neoplasms were acute megakaryoblastic leukemia and malignant histiocytosis. The authors conclude the leukemia is unlikely to be caused by cisplatin-based chemotherapy. A shared progenitor cell origin is suggested by an isochromosome 12p marker.

pmid-2159690.summary_ja: 精巣、後腹膜、縦隔の胚細胞腫瘍患者299例を後方視的に検討した。中枢神経系の画像検査を受けた66例中20例に中枢神経系転移が認められた。腫瘍マーカー上昇のみで無症状の25例に脳転移はなく、局所神経症状や痙攣を有する症例では多くで転移が認められた。神経学的所見がない腫瘍マーカー上昇例では、中枢神経画像の有用性は低いと結論している。
pmid-2159690.summary_en: A retrospective review of 299 patients with testicular, retroperitoneal, or mediastinal germ cell tumors evaluated neuroimaging use. Of 66 patients who underwent CNS imaging, 20 had CNS metastases, including intracranial and spinal lesions. None of 25 asymptomatic patients with elevated tumor markers had brain metastases, while most patients with focal deficits or seizures did. The authors conclude that CNS imaging is most useful with neurologic deficits or seizures and is not indicated for unexplained marker elevation without neurologic signs.

pmid-2159868.summary_ja: 本研究は、セミノーマまたはディスジャーミノーマの8例の細針吸引生検を、組織学的および電子顕微鏡所見と対比して検討した。3種類の腫瘍細胞型が同定され、III型細胞は塗抹標本で大きな細胞質内空胞を生じるほど豊富なグリコーゲンを含んでいた。背景にはリンパ球、形質細胞、類上皮肉芽腫を含む混合した炎症細胞が認められた。著者らは、これらの細胞学的特徴の診断的意義と、他の胚細胞腫瘍および非胚細胞腫瘍との鑑別について考察している。
pmid-2159868.summary_en: This study reviewed fine-needle aspiration biopsies from eight patients with seminoma or dysgerminoma and correlated them with histologic and electron microscopic findings. Three tumor cell types were identified, with type III cells containing abundant glycogen that produced large cytoplasmic vacuoles on smears. The background contained mixed inflammatory cells, including lymphocytes, plasma cells, and epithelioid granulomas. The authors discuss the diagnostic significance of these cytologic features and their differentiation from other germ cell and non-germ cell tumors.

pmid-2160316.summary_ja: 1965〜1984年に性腺外胚細胞腫瘍と診断された54例を後方視的に解析した。原発部位は縦隔、中枢神経系、後腹膜、仙尾部が中心であった。大部分の症例でメガボルテージ照射が行われた。5年生存率は57.8%、照射例の局所制御率は59%であった。組織型、原発部位、4000cGy以上の照射線量が予後因子であった。放射線療法は性腺外セミノーマに有効だが、非セミノーマ性腫瘍では反応性が低いと結論している。
pmid-2160316.summary_en: A retrospective analysis of 54 patients with extragonadal germ cell tumors, mostly in the mediastinum, central nervous system, retroperitoneum, and sacrococcygeal region, treated between 1965 and 1984. Most patients received megavoltage irradiation at doses of 2400 to 5580 cGy. Five-year actuarial survival was 57.8 percent, and local control was achieved in 59 percent of irradiated patients. Histologic type, primary site, and radiation dose of 4000 cGy or more were prognostic. The authors conclude radiotherapy is effective for extragonadal seminomas but less so for nonseminomatous tumors.

pmid-2161928.summary_ja: 妊娠性絨毛性疾患に対する化学療法を受けた49例、計65回の妊娠を追跡しました。満期産が64.7%、早産が6.1%、死産が1.5%でした。反復性胞状奇胎は3例（4.6%）に認められました。先天奇形や産科的合併症は観察されず、化学療法は妊孕性の温存と両立し、先天性胎児奇形の増加とは関連しないと結論づけています。
pmid-2161928.summary_en: This study followed 49 women treated with chemotherapy for gestational trophoblastic disease who subsequently had 65 pregnancies. Of these, 64.7% ended in term births, 6.1% in preterm births, and 1.5% in stillbirth. Eight pregnancies ended in spontaneous abortion, seven in elective abortion, and three patients had repeat molar pregnancies. No congenital malformations or obstetric complications were observed. The authors conclude that chemotherapy for gestational trophoblastic disease is compatible with fertility preservation and does not increase congenital fetal malformations.

pmid-2162091.summary_ja: 後方視的検討として、進行精巣胚細胞腫瘍の15例で、化学療法後に切除された残存腫瘤の組織型の予測因子を検討しました。原発巣に奇形腫を有した症例の78%で、残存腫瘤に奇形腫または癌が認められました。残存セミノーマの2例は救援化学療法にもかかわらず進行しました。CT所見による密度や性状は組織型を一貫して予測しませんでした。
pmid-2162091.summary_en: This retrospective review of 15 patients with stage B3 or B2/C testicular germ cell tumors examined predictors of histology in residual masses resected after chemotherapy. Preoperative CT density, character, and volume change were compared with histology. Among patients with teratoma in the primary tumor, 78% had teratoma or carcinoma in the residual mass, with volume changes ranging from a 93% decrease to a 540% increase. Residual seminoma progressed in two patients despite salvage therapy, whereas pure seminoma residues showed only fibrosis. CT mass density and character did not consistently predict histology.

pmid-2162186.summary_ja: 病期I非セミノーマ性精巣胚細胞腫瘍の患者150例を対象に、術後後腹膜リンパ節照射と経過観察を比較した無作為化試験を解析しました。34例（23%）に再発を認めました。精巣摘除標本の組織学的検討では、純粋な胎児性癌と脈管浸潤が再発リスク増加と有意に関連していました。経過観察群では、純粋胎児性癌の50%、脈管浸潤を有する腫瘍の36%で再発が認められました。
pmid-2162186.summary_en: This Danish Testicular Cancer Study Group analysis evaluated 150 patients with stage I non-seminomatous testicular germ cell tumor enrolled in a randomized trial comparing postoperative retroperitoneal irradiation with surveillance. Thirty-four patients (23%) relapsed. Histopathological review of orchidectomy specimens identified risk factors. Pure embryonal carcinoma and vascular involvement were significantly associated with increased relapse risk. In the surveillance group, relapse occurred in 50% of patients with pure embryonal carcinoma and in 36% of those with vascular involvement.

pmid-2162249.summary_ja: 絨毛癌由来のBeWo細胞株が発現するアルカリホスファターゼ（AP）を解析しました。cDNA解析により、胎盤型遺伝子ではなく胚細胞型AP（Nagao型）遺伝子の産物であることが示されました。腫瘍由来のAPは胎盤型APと同様にC末端にホスファチジルイノシトールグリカンを持ち、PI特異的ホスホリパーゼCで遊離します。胎盤型遺伝子の抑制と胚細胞型遺伝子の脱抑制により、異所性に発現していると結論づけています。
pmid-2162249.summary_en: This study characterized the alkaline phosphatase expressed by the BeWo choriocarcinoma cell line. Complementary DNA analysis showed the enzyme derives from the germ cell AP (Nagao isozyme) gene rather than the placental gene. Like placental AP, the tumor enzyme carries a phosphatidylinositol-glycan anchor at its C terminus and is releasable by PI-specific phospholipase C. Precursor analysis suggested a precursor-product relationship. The authors conclude that BeWo AP reflects ectopic expression, with repression of the PLAP gene and derepression of the germ cell AP gene.

pmid-2162914.summary_ja: 精巣がんと性腺外胚細胞腫瘍の2症例で、転移による神経症状が診断に先行した経過を報告している。転移があっても両疾患は治癒可能であると述べている。若年男性で起源不明の転移を認めた場合は胚細胞腫瘍を考慮し、組織標本を見直すべきだと提言する。神経腫瘍学の臨床教訓を示す短報である。
pmid-2162914.summary_en: Two patients are described in whom neurological symptoms from distant metastases preceded diagnosis: one with testicular cancer and one with an extragonadal germ cell tumor. The authors note that both malignancies are curable even with metastases at presentation. They advise considering germ cell tumor when a young man has metastases of uncertain origin and recommend reviewing histological specimens with this diagnosis in mind. The report is a brief clinical case description with diagnostic lessons for neuro-oncology.

pmid-2162918.summary_ja: 胚細胞腫瘍の硬膜外転移による脊髄圧迫の3例に対し、ステロイド投与後にシスプラチン併用化学療法を行った報告である。3例とも神経症状は完全に回復した。放射線療法や手術による除圧に頼らず、全身化学療法を初期治療として検討すべきと主張する。症例数は少ないが、この緊急病態における化学療法の有用性を示唆する。
pmid-2162918.summary_en: Three patients with epidural spinal cord compression from germ cell tumor metastases were treated with cisplatin-based chemotherapy after initial corticosteroids. All three achieved complete neurologic recovery. The authors argue that systemic chemotherapy should be considered as initial therapy alongside corticosteroids, rather than relying mainly on radiotherapy or surgical decompression. The case series is small but suggests a role for chemotherapy in this emergency.

pmid-2163363.summary_ja: 原発性悪性縦隔胚細胞腫瘍19例のDNA倍数性を測定した研究である。6例が二倍体で、13例は異数性を示し、その多くは近四倍体であった。縦隔の胚細胞腫瘍は成人精巣の腫瘍よりも乳児精巣の腫瘍に類似し、発生機序の違いが示唆された。倍数性は性腺外原発と精巣由来の転移の鑑別に役立つ可能性がある。
pmid-2163363.summary_en: Flow cytometric DNA ploidy was measured in 19 primary malignant mediastinal germ cell tumors. Six were diploid, while most of the 13 aneuploid tumors were near tetraploid, with a median DNA index of 1.91. Seminomas and nonseminomatous tumors showed similar ploidy patterns. The authors find mediastinal GCTs resemble infantile testicular GCTs more than adult testicular GCTs, suggesting a different pathogenesis. Ploidy may help distinguish a primary extragonadal tumor from a testicular metastasis.

pmid-2163557.summary_ja: 触知可能な精巣腫瘍62例で、術前超音波検査と組織診断を比較した研究である。セミノーマと非セミノーマの区別は70%で正確だった。セミノーマは均一な低エコー腫瘤、非セミノーマは嚢胞や石灰化を伴う不均一な像を示した。病期の予測はセミノーマで44%、非セミノーマで8%にとどまった。超音波は鑑別に有用だが、手術と組織学的検査の代わりにはならない。
pmid-2163557.summary_en: This 1990 study compares preoperative ultrasonography with histology in 62 men with palpable testicular tumors. Radiologists correctly distinguished seminoma from nonseminomatous tumors in 70% of cases. Seminomas typically appeared as homogeneous hypoechoic, well-defined masses, while nonseminomatous tumors were heterogeneous with cysts and calcifications. Stage prediction was accurate in 44% of seminomas but only 8% of nonseminomas. Ultrasound aids differential diagnosis but cannot replace surgical and histological exploration.

pmid-2163601.summary_ja: 混合性性腺異形成症の15例を報告し、その約半数に性腺腫瘍が認められた。性腺芽腫が最も多く、ジャーミノーマ（胚細胞腫）を併存することが多かった。心血管奇形や、エストロゲン療法後の子宮内膜腺癌も記載された。腫瘍発生予防のため性腺索や精巣の摘出を推奨し、致死的になりうる疾患のため心血管検査も勧めている。
pmid-2163601.summary_en: This report presents 15 patients with mixed gonadal dysgenesis, nearly half of whom had gonadal tumors. Gonadoblastoma was most common, often coexisting with germinoma, and was found in testes and streak gonads. The series also documents cardiovascular anomalies and an endometrial adenocarcinoma after estrogen therapy. The authors recommend removing streak gonads or testes to prevent tumor development and suggest cardiovascular screening for potentially lethal disease.

pmid-2163845.summary_ja: 精巣腫瘍20例の超音波所見を組織像と比較した研究である。セミノーマと白血病・悪性リンパ腫・前立腺がんなどの転移性腫瘍は均一な低エコーを示し、非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍はすべて不均一な所見であった。超音波検査は化学療法の効果判定や再発の早期診断に役立ち、小さな腫瘍の検出や対側精巣のフォローアップにも有用と考えられる。
pmid-2163845.summary_en: This study reviewed ultrasonograms from 20 patients with testicular tumors and compared them with histology. Seminomas and metastatic tumors such as leukemia, lymphoma, and prostate cancer appeared homogeneous and hypoechoic, whereas all nonseminomatous germ cell tumors appeared heterogeneous. Ultrasonography may help assess chemotherapy response in leukemia or lymphoma and detect early recurrence. It is also useful for detecting small tumors and for follow-up of the contralateral testis after tumor removal.

pmid-2163931.summary_ja: F9胎児性癌細胞において、c-fos発現の増加がレチノイン酸による分化に必要かを検討した。レチノイン酸処理ではc-fos転写産物は時期を問わず誘導されず、c-myc mRNAのみが速やかに減少した。c-fosは血清刺激に対してのみ一過性に誘導され、分化よりも増殖との関連が示唆された。c-fosの増加はレチノイン酸による分化には必須でないと結論づけられた。
pmid-2163931.summary_en: This study examined whether c-fos expression is required for retinoic acid-induced differentiation of F9 embryonal carcinoma cells. Retinoic acid did not induce c-fos transcripts at early or late time points, though it rapidly decreased c-myc mRNA. c-fos was transiently induced only by serum stimulation, linking it to proliferation rather than differentiation. The authors conclude that increased c-fos expression is not necessary for retinoic acid-induced differentiation of these cells.

pmid-2163933.summary_ja: 胎児性癌細胞C44から形成された胚様体の嚢胞液が胞胚腔液に類似するかを検討した。胚様体には栄養外胚葉は認められず、胎児性癌と内胚葉が存在していた。嚢胞液には低分子の可溶性細胞傷害活性があり、栄養外胚葉様の分化能を持つ胎児性癌細胞を選択的に殺傷した。この活性の化学的性質を解析するのに十分な量の液が得られた。
pmid-2163933.summary_en: This study examined embryoid bodies formed by embryonal carcinoma C44 cells to determine whether their cyst fluid resembles blastocele fluid. The embryoid bodies lacked trophectoderm but contained embryonal carcinoma and endoderm, suggesting they resemble late inner cell mass. Their cyst fluid contained a soluble, low-molecular-weight cytotoxic activity that selectively killed embryonal carcinoma cells with trophectodermal potential while sparing those with embryonic potential. Enough fluid was obtained to analyze the chemical nature of this activity.

pmid-2163993.summary_ja: レチノイン酸で分化誘導したF-9胎児性癌細胞において、糖タンパク質のフコシル化を検討した。分化に伴い、高分子量糖タンパク質のフコシル化が増殖抑制やラミニンB1発現より早期に増加し、用量依存的な変化を示した。フコシル転移酵素活性も上昇した。この系において、フコシル化の早期変化は分化の指標として有用と考えられる。
pmid-2163993.summary_en: This study investigated protein fucosylation during retinoic acid-induced differentiation of F-9 embryonal carcinoma cells. Retinoic acid induced endoderm-like features, growth inhibition, and laminin B1 expression. Fucosylation of several high-molecular-weight glycoproteins increased early, before growth inhibition and laminin induction, in a dose-dependent manner. Fucosyltransferase activity also rose. The authors propose early fucosylation changes as a marker of differentiation in this system.

pmid-2164240.summary_ja: 本研究は、横隔膜下照射を受けた精巣腫瘍患者51例の性腺機能を評価し、そのうち非セミノーマの20例は補助化学療法も受けた。精子形成の回復は9年にわたり連続的に評価された。回復は放射線量に依存し、補助化学療法により延長され、治療前の精子数が少ない患者や25歳を超える患者では低かった。残存精巣に到達する散乱放射線が用量依存的な障害を引き起こした。著者らは、精子形成を温存するために有効な性腺遮蔽を提案している。
pmid-2164240.summary_en: This study evaluated gonadal function in 51 patients with testicular tumors treated with subdiaphragmatic irradiation, 20 nonseminoma patients also receiving adjuvant chemotherapy. Spermatogenesis recovery was assessed serially over 9 years. Recovery depended on radiation dose, was prolonged by adjuvant chemotherapy, and was lower in patients with low pretreatment sperm counts or age over 25. Radiation scatter reaching the remaining testis caused dose-dependent impairment. The authors suggest effective gonadal shielding to preserve spermatogenesis.

pmid-2164481.summary_ja: レトロウイルス挿入変異により得られた非腫瘍形成性の胎児性癌細胞株を解析した。この変異株は胎児性癌の典型的な分化経路をたどらず、内胚葉由来の細胞を形成しにくいと考えられた。一方、胎児性癌特有の表面マーカーの一部は保持し、レチノイン酸処理で消失した。同系マウスでは腫瘍を形成しないが、in vitroでは親株と同様に増殖した。単一のウイルス挿入から、一つの遺伝子が腫瘍形成能と分化能の両方を制御する可能性が示唆された。
pmid-2164481.summary_en: This study characterized a nontumorigenic embryonal carcinoma cell line derived by retroviral insertional mutagenesis. The variant lacked typical differentiation along EC lineages, likely losing the ability to form endodermal derivatives, yet retained some EC surface markers that were lost upon retinoic acid exposure. It failed to form tumors in syngeneic mice despite growing normally in vitro. Southern blotting suggested a single viral insertion, indicating that one gene may regulate both tumorigenicity and differentiation.

pmid-2164651.summary_ja: 17年間に治療された予後不良の転移性妊娠性絨毛性疾患28例を検討した。主にMAC化学療法（メトトレキサート、アクチノマイシンD、クロラムブシル）を行い、全体の寛解率は89%であった。WHOスコアが12未満の患者は全例寛解したが、12以上では27%にとどまった。WHOスコアは、より強力な初回治療を要する高リスク患者の選別に有用である。
pmid-2164651.summary_en: This study reviewed 28 patients with poor-prognosis metastatic gestational trophoblastic disease treated over 17 years, mainly with MAC chemotherapy (methotrexate, actinomycin D, chlorambucil). The overall remission rate was 89%. All patients with WHO scores below 12 achieved remission with MAC, whereas only 27% of those scoring 12 or higher did. Most non-responders to MAC achieved remission with second-line regimens. No deaths resulted from chemotherapy toxicity. The WHO scoring system helps identify high-risk patients who need more intensive primary therapy.

pmid-2165183.summary_ja: 後天性免疫不全症候群関連複合体の患者に生じた、組織型の異なる両側同時性精巣腫瘍の症例を報告する。一側はセミノーマ、他側は胎児性癌であった。両側精巣摘除術と後腹膜リンパ節郭清を行い、病理病期はB1であった。アジドチミジンによる持続的な好中球減少のため化学療法は実施できなかった。術後約1年で無病の状態であった。
pmid-2165183.summary_en: This report describes a patient with AIDS-related complex who developed bilateral synchronous testicular tumors with different histologies: seminoma on one side and embryonal carcinoma on the other. He underwent bilateral orchiectomy and retroperitoneal lymph node dissection, with pathological stage B1. Because he was taking azidothymidine, which causes persistent neutropenia, chemotherapy was withheld. About one year after surgery, he had no evidence of disease.

pmid-2165626.summary_ja: 仙尾部胚細胞腫瘍の画像診断をまとめた総説です。新生児で最も多い充実性腫瘍である仙尾部奇形腫を含みます。従来の画像検査の所見を概説し、診断、隣接構造との関係把握、転移の検出、病期分類におけるCTとMRの有用性を強調しています。小児の仙尾部腫瘤を扱う放射線科医にとって有用な内容です。
pmid-2165626.summary_en: This Radiographics review examines imaging of sacrococcygeal germ cell tumors, of which sacrococcygeal teratoma is the most common solid tumor in neonates. The authors summarize the clinical context, outline the spectrum of findings on conventional imaging, and emphasize the value of CT and MR imaging for diagnosis, defining relationships to adjacent structures, detecting metastases, and staging. Because CT and MR characteristics of these lesions had received little attention in radiologic literature, the paper addresses that gap for radiologists evaluating infants and children with a palpable sacrococcygeal mass.

pmid-2165627.summary_ja: 少女および若年女性に多い悪性卵巣胚細胞腫瘍を、画像と病理の対比から解説した総説です。ディスジャーミノーマ（未分化胚細胞腫）、未熟奇形腫、卵黄嚢腫瘍、混合型を取り上げ、成熟奇形腫の併存にも言及しています。断面画像では大きく充実性の腫瘤を呈することが多く、αフェトプロテイン(AFP)やヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)の上昇が診断の参考になります。石灰化を伴う嚢胞成分があっても悪性腫瘍の併存を除外できない点に注意を促しています。
pmid-2165627.summary_en: This AFIP radiologic-pathologic review addresses malignant ovarian germ cell tumors, the most common malignant ovarian neoplasms in girls and young women. It covers dysgerminoma, immature teratoma, endodermal sinus tumor, and mixed forms, and notes that malignant tumors can coexist with mature teratoma. Cross-sectional imaging typically shows large, predominantly solid masses. The authors emphasize that elevated serum alpha-fetoprotein and hCG levels help establish the diagnosis, and that cystic areas with calcification suggestive of mature teratoma do not exclude a coexisting malignancy.

pmid-2165774.summary_ja: 1976年から1988年に香港大学で治療された妊娠性絨毛性疾患（GTD）320例のうち、膣転移を有した18例を検討した報告です。臨床像と経過を解析し、予後は主に病変の広がりに依存することを示しました。膣転移を伴う低リスク症例は、化学療法に対して同様に良好な反応を示しました。
pmid-2165774.summary_en: This Asia Oceania Journal of Obstetrics and Gynaecology report analyzes 320 patients with gestational trophoblastic disease treated at the University of Hong Kong from 1976 to 1988. It focuses on the 18 patients who had vaginal metastases, examining their clinical features and disease behavior. The authors found that prognosis depended mainly on the extent of disease. Low-risk patients with vaginal metastases showed a similarly favorable response to chemotherapy, suggesting that vaginal involvement alone does not worsen outcome in this setting.

pmid-2166553.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍16例を対象に、131I標識H17E2モノクローナル抗体による免疫シンチグラフィーを、リンパ管造影およびCTと比較した研究です。免疫スキャン（IS）はリンパ管造影所見とよく一致し、静脈内投与例では真陽性率がCTを上回りました。非特異的抗体では偽陰性となりました。既存の画像検査を補完しうる手法と結論づけています。
pmid-2166553.summary_en: This 1990 British Journal of Cancer supplement reports a study of iodine-131-labelled H17E2 monoclonal antibody immunoscintigraphy in 16 patients with testicular germ cell tumours. The results were compared with lymphangiography and CT. The antibody was given subcutaneously in the toe webs or intravenously. Immunoscintigraphy correlated well with lymphangiography and, after intravenous injection, showed higher true positivity than CT. A non-specific antibody control produced false-negative scans, and the authors conclude the method may complement existing imaging.

pmid-2167282.summary_ja: 妊娠性絨毛性疾患（GTD）の脳転移19例を検討した報告です。210例のGTD患者の9.0%を占め、初発症状や化学療法中・治療後の発症など、発症パターンを整理しています。全例に全脳放射線療法が行われ、4〜15年後も生存しているのは19例中5例（26.3%）でした。MAC化学療法は脳転移の発生を防げなかったと結論づけています。
pmid-2167282.summary_en: This Gynecologic Oncology review examines 19 patients with gestational trophoblastic disease that metastasized to the brain, representing 9% of 210 GTD patients treated over two decades. Brain metastases presented as initial neurological symptoms in some patients and emerged during or after first-line therapy in others, most often after resistance to chemotherapy. All patients received whole-brain radiotherapy. Survival was limited, with 5 of 19 patients alive and well 4 to 15 years later. The authors conclude that methotrexate, actinomycin D, and chlorambucil therapy did not prevent CNS spread.

pmid-2167494.summary_ja: 精巣がんの長期生存者34例とその配偶者を、治療終了から約4年後に面接した心理社会的研究です。良好なコミュニケーションや配偶者の支援、夫婦の満足度が、心理的適応や夫婦関係の機能と関連していました。多くの夫婦はむしろ絆が強まった一方、一部では持続的な障害が認められました。長期的な適応における夫婦関係の重要性を示しています。
pmid-2167494.summary_en: This Psychosomatics study interviewed 34 long-term survivors of testicular cancer and their wives about four years after treatment ended. Using measures of psychological adjustment and family functioning, the authors found that good communication, spousal support, and marital satisfaction were associated with better functioning. Most couples emerged more tightly bonded, although some showed lasting impairment. The findings highlight the importance of relationship factors in long-term adjustment after testicular cancer.

pmid-2167821.summary_ja: 1963年から1988年に111例で施行された194回の子宮造影法を検討し、絨毛癌と侵入奇胎の診断における有用性を評価した研究です。充填欠損、子宮壁内への浸潤、骨盤静脈への流入の3種類の異常を分類しました。子宮造影法は動脈造影やBモード超音波より優れ、併用により診断精度が最も高くなりました。
pmid-2167821.summary_en: This Chinese Medical Journal study reviewed 194 hysterographies performed in 111 patients between 1963 and 1988 to diagnose choriocarcinoma and invasive mole. Three abnormalities were classified: filling defects, intramural invasion of the uterine wall by contrast medium, and intravasation of contrast into pelvic veins. The authors found that hysterography outperformed pelvic arteriography and B-scan for these conditions, and that combining it with B-scan or arteriography gave the greatest diagnostic accuracy.

pmid-2168303.summary_ja: 本報告（Clinical Radiology誌）は、化学療法を受けた胚細胞腫瘍の肺転移部位に生じる薄壁の空洞を「肺ラクナ」と命名し、記載したものである。精巣奇形腫による多発肺転移患者の約7%で認められた。フォローアップ画像でこの所見を新規または進行した転移と誤認しないために、認識することが重要であると述べている。
pmid-2168303.summary_en: This Clinical Radiology report describes thin-walled cavities, termed pulmonary lacunae, that develop at the sites of pulmonary metastases from germ cell tumours treated with chemotherapy. The authors found these lesions in approximately 7% of patients with multiple pulmonary metastases from testicular teratoma. Recognizing pulmonary lacunae is important so that they are not mistaken for new or progressive metastatic disease on follow-up imaging.

pmid-2168496.summary_ja: 性腺外胚細胞腫瘍の最多発生部位である縦隔の胚細胞腫瘍を概説する。大部分は良性の成熟奇形腫だが、悪性例はセミノーマと非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍に分類される。シスプラチン併用化学療法で非セミノーマ性例の予後が改善し、長期生存例の多くは外科的切除を受けていた。
pmid-2168496.summary_en: This 1990 Japanese review covers primary mediastinal germ cell tumors, the most common extragonadal germ cell tumor site. Most are benign mature teratomas, while about 20% are malignant and classified as seminoma or non-seminomatous germ cell tumor. Cisplatin-based chemotherapy improved outcomes for non-seminomatous tumors, and most long-term survivors underwent surgical resection. The authors compile 329 reported malignant cases and argue that earlier diagnosis and complete resection combined with effective chemotherapy are needed.

pmid-2168805.summary_ja: 成人精巣胚細胞腫瘍において、セミノーマと非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の発生関係を説明する2つの仮説を検討している。セミノーマ、混合型腫瘍、非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の細胞遺伝学的・倍数性データから、単一起源説を支持する。セミノーマはその中間段階であり、進行に伴い染色体量が減少すると論じている。
pmid-2168805.summary_en: This review examines two competing models of pathogenesis linking seminomas and non-seminomatous germ cell tumors (NSGCTs) in adult testicular germ cell tumors. Cytogenetic and ploidy data from seminomas, combined tumors and NSGCTs are presented. The authors favor a single-origin model in which seminoma represents an intermediate stage in NSGCT development. Progression is associated with a progressive net loss of chromosomal material through specific chromosome losses, gains, and structural abnormalities.

pmid-2169301.summary_ja: 侵入奇胎または絨毛癌の患者38例の子宮動脈と子宮筋層を、ドプラ超音波検査で非妊娠・妊娠のボランティアと比較した。妊娠性絨毛性疾患では脈波指数が有意に低値であった。持続例には特徴的な低抵抗のドプラ所見があり、化学療法前の初期評価に有用である可能性を示している。
pmid-2169301.summary_en: This study uses Doppler ultrasound to assess the uterine circulation in 38 patients with invasive mole or choriocarcinoma, compared with non-pregnant and pregnant volunteers. Pulsatility indices were significantly lower in patients with trophoblastic disease. Persistent disease showed a characteristic low-resistance Doppler profile suggesting large low-resistance vessels. The authors propose this finding may aid initial assessment before cytotoxic chemotherapy.

pmid-2169421.summary_ja: 後腹膜に発生した胚細胞腫瘍が前立腺へ浸潤した稀な症例の報告である。文献上の既報は3例のみであった。化学療法と機能温存的な外科手術の併用により良好に治療された。性腺外胚細胞腫瘍が骨盤臓器へ直接浸潤しうることを示している。
pmid-2169421.summary_en: This case report describes a retroperitoneal germ cell tumor that invaded the prostate, an extremely rare presentation since only three prior cases had been reported. The patient was treated successfully with a combination of chemotherapy and nonmutilating surgery. The report highlights that extragonadal germ cell tumors may directly invade pelvic organs and that organ-preserving surgery combined with systemic therapy can achieve good outcomes.

pmid-2170547.summary_ja: 千葉大学で治療された妊娠性絨毛性疾患の病理確定例125例を、高リスク・低リスク基準で分類して検討した。高リスク群の多くは絨毛癌、低リスク群の多くは侵入奇胎であった。独自基準と絨毛癌診断スコアを比較し、スコアは病理診断との一致度が高いが、複雑で高齢患者には不向きと結論づけている。
pmid-2170547.summary_en: This 1990 Japanese study reviews 125 pathologically confirmed gestational trophoblastic disease patients at Chiba University, stratified by high- and low-risk clinical criteria. Pathological diagnoses showed choriocarcinoma in most high-risk cases and invasive mole in most low-risk cases. The authors compare their criteria with a choriocarcinoma diagnostic score and conclude the score aligns more closely with pathology but is more complex and less suitable for older patients.

pmid-2170590.summary_ja: 1979～1988年に化学療法後に手術を受けた非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍185例を解析し、残存腫瘤の切除対象を検討した。残存腫瘤の大きさ、縮小率、治療前のLDHおよびAFP値は壊死性デブリの予測因子であった。生存性の悪性腫瘍や奇形腫を確実に除外できる因子は見出されなかった。マーカーが正常化すれば残存病変の切除を推奨する。
pmid-2170590.summary_en: This study of 185 patients who underwent surgery after chemotherapy for nonseminomatous germ cell tumors (NSGCT) at Memorial Hospital from 1979 to 1988 seeks to identify who needs residual-mass resection. Residual mass size, shrinkage, and pretreatment LDH and AFP levels predicted necrotic debris. No factor reliably excluded viable malignancy or teratoma. The authors recommend resecting residual abnormalities when markers normalize and RPLND for bulky retroperitoneal metastases regardless of postchemotherapy CT.

pmid-2171286.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍の患者13例に術前に穿刺吸引細胞診を行い、腫瘍の分類を検討した。セミノーマ、胎児性癌、卵黄嚢腫瘍、絨毛癌、奇形腫の成分に基づく細胞学的分類は組織学的所見と良好に一致した。多くは複数成分を含み、最大4種の成分が認められた。性腺外の転移性胚細胞腫瘍の同定にも有用である可能性がある。
pmid-2171286.summary_en: This study evaluates fine needle aspiration (FNA) cytology for classifying testicular germ cell tumors in 13 patients preoperatively. Cytologic typing based on seminoma, embryonal carcinoma, yolk sac tumor, choriocarcinoma, and teratoma components agreed well with histology. Most cases showed mixed components, with up to four tumor types. The authors conclude FNA cytology may also help identify metastatic germ cell tumors at extragonadal sites.

pmid-2171316.summary_ja: 本研究は、臨床病期I非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の患者24例を後方視的に検討した。精巣摘除術後に注意深く観察し、25%が再発したが全例が化学療法で寛解した。信頼できる患者と十分なフォローアップが可能な施設では、精巣摘除術後の注意深い観察が妥当な選択肢になると結論している。
pmid-2171316.summary_en: This retrospective Mayo Clinic series followed 24 patients with clinical stage I nonseminomatous germ cell tumor of the testis managed by orchiectomy alone and close observation. Median follow-up was 47 months. Six patients (25%) relapsed, typically within 3.5 months; all were successfully treated with chemotherapy and remained in remission. The remaining 18 patients stayed disease-free. The authors conclude that observation after orchiectomy is reasonable in reliable patients treated at well-equipped centers with dependable follow-up.

pmid-2171750.summary_ja: 精巣がんの患者2例で、画像上は縦隔や肺への転移に見える所見が、実際にはサルコイド反応であった。診断時と診断12か月後にそれぞれ認められた。セミノーマと非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍が混在する症例であった。組織学的確認を行わないと不要な化学療法につながるため、病理学的な確認が重要であると指摘している。
pmid-2171750.summary_en: This report describes two patients with testicular cancer combining seminomatous and nonseminomatous germ cell components. Both showed isolated sarcoid reactions in hilar and interlobular lymph nodes that mimicked intrathoracic dissemination on radiologic imaging. One reaction was present at diagnosis and the other 12 months later. Without histologic confirmation, these findings could lead to unnecessary chemotherapy, so tissue diagnosis is essential when intrathoracic lesions appear during surveillance.

pmid-2172569.summary_ja: 臨床病期Iの精巣非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍85例に修正後腹膜リンパ節郭清を施行した。病理病期Aの再発は6%、B1は15%だった。順行性射精は94%で温存または回復し、低病期の精巣がんでは監視療法に代わる選択肢になると結論している。追跡期間中央値は38か月であった。
pmid-2172569.summary_en: Eighty-five patients with clinical stage I nonseminomatous germ cell tumor of the testis underwent modified bilateral retroperitoneal lymph node dissection via a thoracoabdominal approach.
