Combining these with eight previously reported familial clusters and a literature review of 119 families, the authors found more haplotype sharing than expected. They interpret this as supporting a genetic influence, possibly anticipation, in germ cell tumors.

pmid-2550400.summary_ja: 1957年から1988年に当施設で治療された原発性縦隔胚細胞腫瘍11例を報告する。内訳はセミノーマ4例、混合型胚細胞腫瘍3例、胎児性癌2例、奇形癌2例。セミノーマは減量手術と術後照射で良好な局所制御が得られた。非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍は生存率が有意に低く、文献的考察も行われている。
pmid-2550400.summary_en: This report describes eleven cases of primary malignant mediastinal germ cell tumor treated at the Peter MacCallum Cancer Institute between 1957 and 1988. Four were seminomas, three mixed germ cell tumors, two embryonal carcinomas and two teratocarcinomas. Seminoma patients fared best with surgical debulking and postoperative irradiation, achieving local control. Non-seminomatous tumors had significantly poorer survival, and the authors review the literature on this anterior mediastinal disease.

pmid-2550950.summary_ja: 1981年から1988年に、第1・第2選択療法に抵抗性または再発した進行精巣がん49例を対象に、エトポシド、イホスファミド、±ドキソルビシンの第3選択化学療法の効果を評価した。完全奏効2例、部分奏効10例で奏効率は24.48%であった。主な有害事象は白血球減少で、腎機能障害は一過性かつ軽度であった。
pmid-2550950.summary_en: This study evaluates a third-line combination of etoposide (Vepesid), ifosfamide (Holoxan), with or without doxorubicin (Adriblastin), plus mesna (Uromitexan), in 49 evaluable patients with advanced testicular cancer refractory to or relapsing after first- and second-line therapy, treated 1981 to 1988. Two achieved complete response and ten partial response, a 24.48% response rate. Leukopenia was the most severe toxicity, and renal toxicity was transient and mild.

pmid-2551494.summary_ja: 精巣原発の非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍14例を短期組織培養後に細胞遺伝学的に解析した。モード染色体数は53〜113で、フローサイトメトリーによるDNA量と一致した。14例中12例でi(12p)が少なくとも1コピー認められ、2例では欠如していた。特定の染色体の過剰・欠失が見られ、セミノーマとの違いも一部確認された。
pmid-2551494.summary_en: This cytogenetic study analyzed 14 primary testicular nonseminomatous germ cell tumors after short-term tissue culture. Modal chromosome numbers ranged from 53 to 113, consistent with flow cytometric DNA content. At least one copy of i(12p) was present in 12 of 14 tumors, and two lacked this marker. Some chromosomes were overrepresented and others underrepresented, with some differences noted compared with seminomas.

pmid-2551691.summary_ja: キール小児腫瘍登録に基づき、生後6か月以下の腹部・後腹膜・仙尾部腫瘍226例を解析した。神経芽腫が最多で、次いで胚細胞腫瘍76例（未熟奇形腫37例、成熟奇形腫32例）であった。悪性胚細胞腫瘍の成分は年長児に比べて少なく、多くは仙尾部に発生していた。年齢による発生部位・組織型・予後の違いが示されている。
pmid-2551691.summary_en: This Kiel Paediatric Tumour Registry report analyzed 226 abdominal, retroperitoneal, and sacrococcygeal tumours in infants aged 6 months or younger. Neuroblastomas were most common, followed by 76 germ cell tumours, including 37 immature and 32 mature teratomas. Malignant germ cell components were far rarer than in older children, and most germ cell tumours were sacrococcygeal. The authors highlight age-related differences in location, histology, and favourable prognosis.

pmid-2552741.summary_ja: 1966〜1986年にスウェーデンのKarolinska病院で治療した妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍58例の20年間の経験を報告。メトトレキサートを中心とした化学療法で全体の寛解率は96.5%。高リスク群や後期再発例も含め、多くは化学療法で救済された。手術は選択的症例や化学療法不応例に限定された。
pmid-2552741.summary_en: This Swedish single-institution review covers 58 GTN patients treated at Karolinska Hospital from 1966 to 1986, roughly half of national cases. Most developed malignancy after molar pregnancy, and 25 had metastatic disease, six classified as high-risk. Methotrexate-folinic acid was the first-line regimen from 1978, with CHAMOMA or EMA/CA as second-line options; surgery was reserved for elective or failed-chemotherapy cases. Overall remission was 96.5% with at least two years of follow-up, and five patients relapsed late.

pmid-2554633.summary_ja: 精巣悪性腫瘍に対する傍大動脈リンパ節への放射線療法後に筋萎縮を来した3例の報告。神経生理学的検査で腰神経叢や末梢神経の病変は否定され、前角細胞病変を示す所見もなかった。感覚障害はないものの、体性感覚誘発電位の潜時延長と振幅低下がみられ、放射線による馬尾神経根障害が示唆された。
pmid-2554633.summary_en: Three patients developed muscle atrophy after para-aortal radiotherapy for malignant testicular tumor. Neurophysiological testing excluded lumbar plexus and peripheral nerve lesions, and EMG showed no giant motor unit potentials, arguing against anterior horn cell disease. Although sensory deficits were absent, lumbar dermatomal SSEPs and peripheral nerve SSEPs showed prolonged latencies and reduced amplitudes. The findings suggest radiation-induced injury to the caudal nerve roots as a late complication.

pmid-2554701.summary_ja: 右精巣摘除および後腹膜リンパ節郭清の5年後に、左精巣に腫瘍を生じた36歳男性の症例報告。左精巣摘除の病理はセミノーマと胎児性癌の混在であった。CTおよびガリウムシンチグラフィーで転移は認めず、PVB化学療法を施行した。過去の両側性精巣胚細胞腫瘍の報告をまとめ、年齢分布や発症間隔、組織型について考察している。
pmid-2554701.summary_en: A 36-year-old man with bilateral testicular germ cell tumor is described. Five years earlier he had undergone right orchiectomy and retroperitoneal lymph node dissection for embryonal carcinoma. In 1988 a left testicular mass prompted left orchiectomy, which showed seminoma with embryonal carcinoma. CT and gallium scintigraphy showed no metastasis, and he received PVB chemotherapy. The authors review previous bilateral cases and discuss age distribution, interval between tumors, and histology.

pmid-2555732.summary_ja: 精巣の非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍で多発性の大きな脳転移をきたした症例の報告。PVB化学療法は血液脳関門の通過が悪く、脳転移の予後は不良とされる。本例は外科的減量切除、PVB化学療法、全脳照射により治癒した。大きな脳転移に対する外科的減量の役割を論じ、全身療法との併用の有用性を示唆している。
pmid-2555732.summary_en: This case report describes a patient with disseminated nonseminomatous germ cell tumor of the testis who developed multiple large brain metastases. Because PVB chemotherapy (cisplatin, vinblastine, bleomycin) penetrates the blood-brain barrier poorly, brain involvement carries a poor prognosis. The patient was treated with surgical debulking, PVB chemotherapy, and whole-brain radiation therapy, and was cured. The authors review the limited role of surgery in brain metastases from testicular germ cell tumors and argue that debulking of large lesions can be beneficial when combined with systemic therapy.

pmid-2556485.summary_ja: 1977〜1988年に静岡県で実施された妊娠性絨毛性疾患（GTD）の登録・フォローアップ制度の成績報告。胞状奇胎1,925例、侵入奇胎68例、絨毛癌48例などが登録され、制度は早期発見・治療に寄与した。絨毛癌の先行妊娠は胞状奇胎後から正期産後へ変化しており、制度未登録の正期産後絨毛癌への注意を促している。
pmid-2556485.summary_en: This Japanese registry study reviews gestational trophoblastic disease (GTD) registered in Shizuoka Prefecture from 1977 to 1988 under a formal follow-up system. Among 1,925 hydatidiform moles, 68 invasive moles, 70 persistent trophoblastic disease cases, and 48 choriocarcinomas were recorded, with a 97.4% registration rate. Hydatidiform mole registrations declined, and choriocarcinoma registrations fell significantly. Notably, the antecedent pregnancy for choriocarcinoma shifted from molar to term gestation, suggesting that term-pregnancy-associated choriocarcinoma needs greater attention beyond the current registry.

pmid-2556586.summary_ja: 男性胚細胞腫瘍24例の腫瘍検体を解析し、12番染色体短腕のアイソクロモソームi(12p)の有無を検討した。i(12p)は16例の20検体に認められ、絨毛癌を含むすべての原発部位・組織型で見られた。12pの追加コピーが3本以上あると治療失敗の可能性が有意に高かった。i(12p)は初期に生じる異常と考えられ、診断・予後マーカーとしての有用性が示唆される。
pmid-2556586.summary_en: This study examined isochromosome 12p, i(12p), in tumor specimens from 24 males with germ cell tumors spanning all primary sites and histologies. i(12p) was detected in 20 specimens from 16 patients, including a choriocarcinoma. Seven specimens had a normal 46,XY karyotype, and one failed cytogenetic analysis. Having three or more additional copies of 12p was significantly associated with treatment failure. The authors suggest i(12p) arises as an early event in tumor development, making it a useful diagnostic marker and a potential prognostic indicator in male germ cell tumors.

pmid-2556605.summary_ja: 精巣絨毛癌細胞株JHTK-1を用い、分化誘導による新たな治療法の可能性を検討したin vitro研究。1 mMのジブチリルcAMPは48時間以内に形態変化、ヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)分泌の15倍以上の増加、50%超の増殖抑制をもたらした。テオフィリン、酪酸ナトリウム、ビタミンC、ビンブラスチン、アクチノマイシンDも分化誘導物質として同定された。化学物質による分化誘導療法の概念を提唱している。
pmid-2556605.summary_en: This in vitro study examined whether the testicular choriocarcinoma cell line JHTK-1 can be induced to differentiate, as a basis for a differentiation-induction approach to testicular germ cell tumor therapy. Dibutyryl cAMP (DBcAMP) at 1 mM produced morphological changes within 48 hours, increased hCG secretion more than 15-fold, and inhibited proliferation by over 50%, in a dose-dependent manner. Several other agents, including theophylline, sodium butyrate, vitamin C, vinblastine, and actinomycin D, also increased hCG secretion. The authors propose that chemical inducers may support a differentiation-induction therapy for testicular choriocarcinoma.

pmid-2556829.summary_ja: 転移性非セミノーマ性精巣がんの化学療法後に切除された残存組織を軟寒天で培養し、クローン原性増殖を評価した後方視的研究。12検体中10検体でコロニー形成が見られ、がん組織ではそれ以外より有意に多かった（p=0.019）。良性組織の患者は追跡期間中無病で、がん患者のうち3名は死亡した。組織学的所見を補完する予測因子となりうると結論している。
pmid-2556829.summary_en: This study evaluated whether colony-forming assays on residual tissue resected after chemotherapy for metastatic nonseminomatous testicular germ cell cancer could predict biological behavior. Eleven patients had 12 assays of resected tissue cultured in soft agar. Colony formation occurred in 10 of 12 assays, and was significantly greater in tissue containing cancer than in benign tissue (p = 0.019). Patients with benign tissue remained disease-free over three to six years of follow-up, whereas three patients with cancer died. The authors conclude that clonogenic growth may complement histology in predicting disease behavior.

pmid-2557596.summary_ja: 27歳男性に生じた縦隔原発の混合型胚細胞腫瘍の症例報告である。CT下穿刺吸引細胞診の材料を光顕と電顕で検討し、光顕ではセミノーマのみが同定された。電顕と標本の再検討により絨毛癌と奇形腫の成分が確認され、手術・剖検組織でも裏付けられた。混合組織型の診断には超微細構造の細胞学的検討が有用で、予後と治療の決定に重要であると結論している。
pmid-2557596.summary_en: This report describes a 27-year-old man with a mediastinal mixed germ cell tumor containing seminoma, embryonal carcinoma, choriocarcinoma, and teratoma components. Material obtained by CT-guided fine needle aspiration was examined by light and electron microscopy. Light microscopy identified only seminoma, whereas electron microscopy, reexamination of slides, and later surgical and autopsy histology revealed choriocarcinoma and teratoma elements. The authors emphasize that ultrastructural cytology was needed to recognize the mixed histology, which is critical for prognosis and therapy.

pmid-2557695.summary_ja: 未治療の精巣胚細胞腫瘍患者12例（セミノーマ5例、非セミノーマ7例）と健常男性14例で、GnRH負荷に対する性腺刺激ホルモン応答を比較した。基礎ホルモン値は対照と差がなかったが、患者では下垂体反応が低下し、非セミノーマではFSH応答が欠如していた。治療前から視床下部-下垂体-性腺系の機能異常が存在すると結論され、妊孕性への影響の検討も必要とされた。
pmid-2557695.summary_en: This study assessed the hypothalamic-hypophyseal-gonadal axis in 12 untreated men with testicular germ cell tumors (5 seminomas, 7 non-seminomas) and 14 healthy controls using a 100-microgram GnRH bolus. Basal testosterone, estradiol, and prolactin did not differ from controls. Gonadotropin peaks were lower in patients, and non-seminoma patients lacked an FSH response and had lower FSH and LH peaks than controls. The authors conclude that this endocrine alteration, particularly in non-seminomas, is present before therapy and suggest further study of its effect on fertility.

pmid-2558693.summary_ja: 1972～1983年にフィンランドで診断された精巣胚細胞腫瘍422例を解析した。罹患率は過去より上昇し、3年生存率は病期I～IIBで大きく改善した一方、進行病期は依然不良であった。シスプラチン併用化学療法が予後改善に大きく寄与した。臨床的病期分類の精度は向上したと示唆されている。
pmid-2558693.summary_en: This nationwide Finnish study analyzed 422 patients with testicular germ cell cancer diagnosed in 1972 to 1983. Incidence rose compared with previous decades, and three-year survival improved markedly, reaching nearly 100% for seminoma and over 90% for non-seminoma in stages I to IIB, while advanced-stage survival remained poor. Cisplatin-based chemotherapy contributed substantially to improved prognosis in both histologies. The authors also suggest that clinical staging accuracy improved, based on relapse rates in stage I patients staged surgically versus clinically.

pmid-2558941.summary_ja: ヒト胎児性癌細胞株Tera-2およびNTera-2において、TGF-βの産生と受容体発現の調節を解析した。レチノイン酸による神経外胚葉系への分化に伴い、TGF-β1とβ2のmRNAと活性が増加し、増殖は低下した。ヒト株はIII型受容体を介してTGF-β1に高親和性で結合し、レチノイン酸処理によりこの結合はほぼ失われた。マウス株との違いが考察された。
pmid-2558941.summary_en: This study examined transforming growth factor-beta (TGF-beta) signaling in two human embryonal carcinoma cell lines, Tera-2 clone 13 and NTera-2 clone D1. Retinoic acid induced neuroectodermal differentiation with reduced proliferation, accompanied by increased TGF-beta1 and TGF-beta2 mRNA and activity. Unlike murine EC cells, these human lines bound TGF-beta1 with high affinity through type III receptors, and retinoic acid nearly abolished this binding. The authors discuss similarities and differences between human and murine EC cell regulation of growth and differentiation.

pmid-2559069.summary_ja: 絨毛外栄養膜細胞のマーカーとして、PP19、SP1、ヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)を免疫組織化学的に比較した研究である。対象には子宮外妊娠、子宮内妊娠、侵入胞状奇胎、原発性および転移性の妊娠性絨毛癌を含む。PP19は絨毛外合胞体性栄養膜細胞と間質性細胞様の栄養膜細胞に陽性であった。抄録は途中で打ち切られており、絨毛性疾患での所見は一部のみ確認できる。
pmid-2559069.summary_en: This immunohistochemical study compared placental protein 19 (PP19), pregnancy-specific beta1-glycoprotein (SP1), and human chorionic gonadotropin (hCG) as markers of extravillous trophoblast. Specimens included tubal and intrauterine pregnancies, late pregnancies with placental abnormalities, invasive complete moles, and primary and metastatic gestational choriocarcinomas. PP19 was expressed in extravillous syncytiotrophoblast and interstitial cytotrophoblast-like cells, while hCG and SP1 were limited to certain populations. The source abstract is truncated, so trophoblastic disease findings are only partly available.

pmid-2559868.summary_ja: ヒト奇形腫由来細胞株GCT 27から多能性の胎児性癌幹細胞クローンGCT 27 X-1を単離し、非多能性クローンと比較した。多能性クローンはフィーダー細胞層に依存し、除去すると内胚葉系や神経系へ分化した。ヌードマウスでは卵黄嚢癌やAFP・hCG産生細胞を含む奇形癌を形成した。卵黄嚢癌細胞株の培養上清がフィーダー依存性を部分的に代替し、傍分泌制御の可能性が示唆された。
pmid-2559868.summary_en: The authors isolated a multipotent human embryonal carcinoma stem cell clone, GCT 27 X-1, from the human teratoma cell line GCT 27 and compared it with a nullipotent clone, GCT 27 C-1. Both shared similar surface, cytostructural, and extracellular matrix marker profiles and chromosome features. Multipotent cells required feeder layers and differentiated into extraembryonic endoderm and neuronal types when feeders were removed. Xenografts formed teratocarcinomas with diverse lineages, including yolk sac carcinoma and AFP- and hCG-producing cells. Yolk sac carcinoma supernatant partly replaced the feeder requirement, suggesting paracrine regulation.

pmid-2560279.summary_ja: 精巣がん151例（非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍86例、純粋セミノーマ65例）のHLA抗原（A、B、C、DR）を解析した研究である。術前の血清ヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)が高値を示した症例は、セミノーマ群24例、非セミノーマ群50例であった。DR-5はセミノーマ群で、B-13は非セミノーマ群で増加しており、hCG陽性セミノーマはHLA分布においてNSGCTよりもセミノーマ様であった。HLA抗原が組織型に関連する可能性が示唆された。
pmid-2560279.summary_en: This study typed 151 patients with testicular cancer (86 non-seminomatous germ cell tumors and 65 pure seminomas) for HLA-A, B, C and DR antigens. Pre-operative serum hCG was elevated in 24 seminoma and 50 NSGCT patients. DR-5 was increased in pure seminoma, while B-13 was increased in NSGCT. hCG-positive seminomas resembled seminomatous tumors rather than NSGCT in HLA distribution, suggesting that histocompatibility antigens may be related to testicular tumor histology.

pmid-2560369.summary_ja: 胎盤、胞状奇胎、侵入奇胎、絨毛癌の組織におけるレクチン結合性を光学顕微鏡で検討した研究である。Con-AとWGAの結合は正常胎盤に比べ増加し、悪性転化よりも栄養膜細胞の増殖を反映していた。侵入奇胎と絨毛癌の多くではPNA結合が乏しく、一部の悪性栄養膜細胞で末端シアル酸が欠失している可能性が示唆された。
pmid-2560369.summary_en: This light-microscopic study examined lectin binding (Con-A, WGA, PNA) in normal placenta and gestational trophoblastic disease, including hydatidiform mole, invasive mole and choriocarcinoma. Con-A and WGA binding increased in all trophoblastic lesions compared with normal placenta, reflecting trophoblast proliferation rather than malignant transformation. PNA binding was minimal or absent in invasive mole and most choriocarcinomas, suggesting loss of terminal sialic acid in some malignant trophoblasts, which may serve as a diagnostic or biological marker.

pmid-2560376.summary_ja: 妊娠性絨毛性疾患の患者9例で、夫のHLAアロタイプに対するリンパ球細胞傷害を抑制する血清中物質を検討した研究である。絨毛癌3/3例、侵入奇胎3/4例、胞状奇胎1/2例で阻害物質が検出され、その力価は腫瘍の増殖とともに変化する様子がみられた。この物質は腫瘍に対する免疫応答を反映し、栄養膜腫瘍細胞に対する拒絶反応が起こらない理由を説明する可能性がある。
pmid-2560376.summary_en: Nine patients with gestational trophoblastic disease were tested for a serum substance that inhibits lymphocytotoxicity against their husbands' HLA allotypes. The inhibitory substance was found in all three choriocarcinoma patients, three of four invasive mole patients, and one of two hydatidiform mole patients, with titers appearing to follow tumor growth. The authors suggest the substance may reflect the immune response to trophoblastic tumor and may explain the absence of graft rejection against tumor cells.

pmid-2560719.summary_ja: 良性卵巣嚢胞性奇形腫(類皮嚢腫)の内部に生じた膠芽腫の症例報告である。神経成分の悪性化は稀で、先行報告は1例のみとされている。GFAP免疫組織化学染色により神経由来が裏付けられた。補助療法を行わない保存的手術にもかかわらず、3年以上無症状で生存している。
pmid-2560719.summary_en: This case report describes glioblastoma multiforme arising within a benign cystic ovarian teratoma (dermoid cyst). Neural malignancy within a teratoma is rare, with the authors noting only one prior report. Glial origin was confirmed by GFAP immunohistochemistry. Despite very conservative surgery without adjuvant therapy, the patient remained alive and symptom-free for more than three years, illustrating rare malignant transformation of a teratoma with a favorable outcome.

pmid-2561098.summary_ja: 進行非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍で白金併用化学療法後にCTで残存腫瘤を認めた42例の残存腫瘤切除を検討した。残存悪性腫瘍は21%、分化奇形腫は33%、線維化・壊死は36%であった。組織所見は再発を予測しなかった。中央値36か月で86%が無病であり、不完全切除では再発傾向があったが有意差はなかった。
pmid-2561098.summary_en: This study reviewed 42 patients who underwent resection of residual masses detected by CT after platinum-based chemotherapy for advanced non-seminomatous germ cell tumors, despite negative tumor markers. Specimens showed residual malignancy in 21%, differentiated teratoma in 33%, and fibrosis or necrosis in 36%. Histology did not predict relapse. With a median follow-up of 36 months, 86% remained disease-free, and incomplete excision showed a non-significant trend toward relapse.

pmid-2562098.summary_ja: 精巣の混合型胎児性癌から3種のヒト胎児性癌細胞株（NCR-G2、G3、G4）を新たに樹立した研究である。G3とG4は体細胞への分化能を示し、G3はレチノイン酸処理で最も顕著な抗原変化を示した。G3ではヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)、ケラチンおよび細胞外基質が誘導可能であり、最も多能性の高いヒト胎児性癌細胞の一つと考えられ、胚細胞腫瘍の分化機構研究に有用である。
pmid-2562098.summary_en: Three human embryonal carcinoma cell lines (NCR-G2, G3, G4) were newly established from testicular mixed embryonal carcinomas. G3 and G4 showed somatic differentiation capacity, and G3 showed the most pronounced antigenic changes after retinoic acid treatment. The authors describe immature EC-specific surface antigens defined with mouse monoclonal antibodies, and inducible hCG, cytokeratin and extracellular matrix components in G3 cells. G3 was considered one of the most pluripotent human EC lines, offering a model for germ cell tumor differentiation.

pmid-2562115.summary_ja: 縦隔卵黄嚢腫瘍と未熟奇形腫の患者で、診断から11か月後に急性非リンパ球性白血病を発症した症例の連続的な細胞遺伝学的解析を報告する。治療前後の腫瘍組織と2回の白血病骨髄検体に共通してi(12p)が認められ、一部の腫瘍クローンと全白血病クローンに21番染色体トリソミーが出現した。白血病は悪性胚細胞クローンに由来することが示され、縦隔胚細胞腫瘍と白血病の関連を遺伝学的に裏付けた。
pmid-2562115.summary_en: This case report presents serial cytogenetic analyses of a patient with a mediastinal yolk sac tumor and immature teratoma who developed acute nonlymphocytic leukemia 11 months after diagnosis. Pre- and post-treatment tumor biopsies and two leukemic marrow samples shared an i(12p) abnormality, and trisomy 21 appeared in one tumor clone and all leukemic clones. These findings establish a common origin and indicate that the leukemia arose from the malignant germ cell clone, providing genetic evidence for an association between mediastinal germ cell tumors and leukemia.

pmid-2564001.summary_ja: セミノーマの組織切片に複数のレクチンを反応させ、臨床パラメータとの相関を検討した研究である。コンカナバリンAとWGAは全例を染色した。停留精巣由来のセミノーマではダイズ凝集素陽性例が多く、腹腔内の位置が糖鎖発現に影響する可能性が示された。一方、予後、病期、転移との相関は認められなかった。
pmid-2564001.summary_en: This study applied a panel of lectins to histological sections of seminomas and compared staining patterns with clinical parameters. Concanavalin A and wheat germ agglutinin stained all tumors, while horse gram and peanut agglutinin did not stain tumor cells. Lectins from castor bean, soy bean, and gorse showed heterogeneous patterns, indicating variation within the tumor cell population. Seminomas arising from undescended testes more often stained with soy bean agglutinin, suggesting that intra-abdominal location may alter glycoconjugate expression. No correlation was found with prognosis, stage, or metastasis.

pmid-2564340.summary_ja: 多能性を持つ胎児性癌細胞の分化誘導を、レチノイン酸を中心に概説した総説である。分化に伴う遺伝子発現の変化が原因か結果かを検討している。分化した細胞と異なり、胎児性癌細胞がウイルスゲノムの発現を受け付けにくい理由も考察された。抑制因子配列の消失や中和が、これらの変化の基盤と提案されている。
pmid-2564340.summary_en: This review examines how embryonal carcinoma (EC) cells, which are pluripotent and resemble germ cells and embryonic stem cells, can be triggered to differentiate, with emphasis on retinoic acid. It summarizes changes in gene expression during EC differentiation and asks whether these changes cause or result from the differentiation event. The authors also consider why EC cells, unlike their differentiated derivatives, resist expression of many infecting viral genomes. They propose that loss or neutralization of strong repressor elements underlies many of the observed changes in gene expression.

pmid-2565826.summary_ja: 卵巣腫瘍の捻転を臨床病理学的に検討した1989年の報告である。妊娠中の発生率は非妊娠例より高く、疼痛が主症状であった。腫瘍の大半は良性嚢胞性奇形腫で、悪性は8.7%に留まった。若年女性の卵巣腫瘍では捻転が緊急手術の対象となりうることを示している。
pmid-2565826.summary_en: This clinicopathological study reviewed ovarian tumor torsion, which occurred mainly in women of reproductive age and was more frequent during pregnancy (22.7%) than in non-pregnant women (6.1%). Pain was the main symptom, and an abdominal mass was palpable in 79.4% of cases. Torsion involved the right ovary more often, and half of the cases were gangrenous at laparotomy. Most lesions were benign cystic teratomas, while only 8.7% were malignant. The findings highlight torsion as a surgical emergency in young women with ovarian masses.

pmid-2567209.summary_ja: マウス奇形癌MH-15を担がんさせたマウスで、SSEA-1抗体とメトトレキサートの複合体の抗腫瘍効果を検討した前臨床研究である。15 mg/kg投与で有意な抗腫瘍効果が得られ、全身毒性は目立たなかった。対照薬や遊離メトトレキサートでは効果が認められなかった。IgMが薬剤担体として有効である可能性を示した。
pmid-2567209.summary_en: This preclinical study conjugated methotrexate to an IgM monoclonal antibody against stage-specific embryonic antigen-1 (SSEA-1) and tested it in mice bearing MH-15 teratocarcinoma. Conjugates with about 65 mol MTX per mol antibody retained full antigen-binding capacity. At 15 mg/kg of drug, the immunoconjugate produced significant antitumor activity without marked systemic toxicity, whereas control conjugates and free methotrexate had no significant effect. The authors conclude that IgM can serve as an effective drug carrier and that antigens accessible in tumors, even if present on normal tissue, can be suitable targets for chemoimmunotherapy.

pmid-2568087.summary_ja: ニューヨーク州北部で1977〜1980年に精巣がん患者250例と、年齢・近隣をマッチさせた対照者を比較した症例対照研究である。精巣の加熱曝露、肥料・フェノール・煙霧などへの職業的曝露、精巣外傷、停留精巣や低精子数などの精巣関連異常がリスク上昇と関連していた。多変量解析でも、これらのいくつかの因子が統計学的に有意であった。
pmid-2568087.summary_en: This case-control study compared 250 testicular cancer patients in upstate New York (1977-1980) with age- and neighborhood-matched controls. Risk was increased by testicular heat exposure, occupational exposure to fertilizers, phenols, fumes or smoke, and testicular trauma. Congenital and testis-related abnormalities, including low sperm count, infertility, atrophic testis, and cryptorchidism, also increased risk. Several factors remained statistically significant in a multiple regression model adjusting for other significant traits, age, and education.

pmid-2569246.summary_ja: 停留精巣に生じた悪性胚細胞腫瘍（悪性転化）の2例について、CTとMRIの所見を報告している。CTでは低吸収域と限局性の石灰化、MRIでは低〜中等度信号と高信号域が認められた。両例とも化学療法後に残存腫瘍を切除し、正常精巣は残存しなかった。CTは石灰化、MRIは出血の描出に優れ、両者はほぼ同等の有用性を持つと結論づけている。
pmid-2569246.summary_en: This report describes CT and MR imaging findings in two patients with malignant germ cell tumors arising in an intraabdominal undescended testis. CT showed low-density lesions, one with focal calcification, while MR showed predominantly low or intermediate signal with areas of high signal. Both patients received initial chemotherapy, followed by surgical resection of residual tumor, and no residual normal testis was found. The authors conclude that CT is superior for detecting calcification and MR for detecting hemorrhage, with both being of nearly equal value.

pmid-2569358.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍に特徴的なi(12p)マーカー染色体を持つ腫瘍細胞を、制限断片長多型解析により検討した研究である。i(12p)の形成によって12番染色体長腕上の複数の遺伝子座でヘテロ接合性が失われることはなかった。この結果から、腫瘍発生の過程では異数性化がi(12p)の形成に先行すると考えられている。
pmid-2569358.summary_en: This study used restriction fragment length polymorphism analysis to examine testicular germ cell tumor cells carrying the i(12p) marker chromosome. The formation of i(12p), a characteristic abnormality of these tumors, did not cause loss of heterozygosity at loci on the long arm of chromosome 12. The authors suggest that aneuploidization occurs before i(12p) formation during tumor development. The findings provide insight into the sequence of genetic events in the etiology of testicular germ cell tumors.

pmid-2569418.summary_ja: ナイジェリアの大学病院で10年間に治療された胞状奇胎41例を後方視的に解析した研究である。胞状奇胎の発生率は妊娠1000件あたり0.82で、高齢ほど増加した。胞状奇胎後の妊娠性絨毛性疾患は17％、絨毛癌は7％に認められた。早期の認識と治療により合併症が減少する可能性を強調している。
pmid-2569418.summary_en: This retrospective analysis reviews 41 molar pregnancies treated at a Nigerian teaching hospital over ten years. The hydatidiform mole incidence was 0.82 per 1000 pregnancies, and the risk rose with advancing maternal age. Hyperemesis gravidarum was a prominent feature. Postmolar gestational trophoblastic disease developed in 17% of patients, and choriocarcinoma in 7%. The authors note that the incidence differed between ethnic groups and emphasize that earlier recognition and treatment of molar pregnancy may reduce complications.

pmid-2569902.summary_ja: 停留精巣の治療を受けた群と受けていない群の精巣胚細胞腫瘍75例の組織像を、503例の精巣胚細胞腫瘍と比較した研究である。純粋セミノーマの割合は腹腔内精巣で最も高かった。小児期（特に16歳以前）に精巣固定術が成功すると、セミノーマの割合が低くなった。早期の精巣固定術は、特にセミノーマのリスクを低下させると結論づけている。
pmid-2569902.summary_en: This study compared the histology of 75 testicular germ cell tumors in 73 patients with treated or untreated cryptorchidism against 503 patients with testicular germ cell tumors. The proportion of pure seminoma was highest in abdominal testes and lower in normally positioned testes. Successful orchiopexy in childhood, particularly before age 16, was associated with a lower proportion of seminoma. The authors conclude that early successful orchiopexy especially reduces the risk of seminoma.

pmid-2572163.summary_ja: 左下腹部の腫瘤と腰痛を主訴に来院した28歳男性の、セミノーマを伴う持続性ミュラー管症候群の症例を報告している。左精巣は陰嚢内になく、開腹術で恥骨結合後方に異所性の精巣が見つかり、大きな腫瘍に置換されていた。病理組織学的に純粋セミノーマと、未熟な子宮、卵管、精嚢様構造が確認された。稀な発生異常とセミノーマの合併例である。
pmid-2572163.summary_en: This case report describes a 28-year-old man with persistent Müllerian duct syndrome associated with seminoma. He presented with a left lower abdominal mass and lumbago, and a left testis was not found in the scrotum. Laparotomy revealed a cross-ectopic left testis replaced by a large tumor behind the pubic symphysis. Histology showed pure seminoma, along with an immature uterus, Fallopian tubes, and a seminal vesicle-like structure. The case illustrates the coexistence of seminoma with a rare developmental anomaly.

pmid-2573258.summary_ja: 精巣固定術を受けた9年後に、固定された精巣にセミノーマが生じた26歳男性の症例を報告する。日本の文献で報告された同様の症例35例をレビューしている。固定された精巣における腫瘍発生リスクと、長期の経過観察の重要性を示す報告である。
pmid-2573258.summary_en: A 26-year-old man developed seminoma in a testis that had been surgically fixed (orchiopexy) nine years earlier, illustrating a rare malignancy arising after orchiopexy. The authors also reviewed 35 previously reported Japanese cases of testicular tumors occurring after orchiopexy. The report highlights the increased risk of testicular neoplasia in undescended or surgically repositioned testes, and the importance of long-term follow-up and surveillance of fixed testes in affected patients.

pmid-2575353.summary_ja: 停留精巣に発生した精巣腫瘍の2症例を報告。いずれも組織学的にセミノーマであった。停留精巣の患者では、精巣摘除術と精巣固定術が行われた。また、日本の文献から報告された停留精巣由来の精巣腫瘍179例を集計し、この稀な関連について背景を検討している。
pmid-2575353.summary_en: The authors report two patients with testicular tumors arising in undescended testes. A 35-year-old man with a right undescended testis underwent orchiectomy, and a 45-year-old man with bilateral cryptorchidism underwent right orchiectomy and left orchiopexy. Both tumors were histologically seminoma. The authors also reviewed 179 previously reported cases from the Japanese literature of testicular tumors arising in undescended testes, providing a broader context for this rare association.

pmid-2575487.summary_ja: 後腹膜リンパ節と停留精巣から穿刺吸引細胞診を行った2症例を用い、セミノーマの細胞学的診断基準を検討した。細胞は均一で円形核と核小体を持ち、グリコーゲンを含む空胞を有する細胞質が特徴である。アルカリホスファターゼ活性は細胞質の一部に局在し、腺癌や悪性リンパ腫、胎児性癌と鑑別可能である。
pmid-2575487.summary_en: The authors evaluate fine-needle aspiration cytology criteria for diagnosing seminoma, using two cases: a retroperitoneal lymph node mass and a cryptorchid testis. Both were cytologically consistent with seminoma. Key features include uniform malignant cells with round nuclei and nucleoli, and cytoplasm containing glycogen-filled vacuoles. Alkaline phosphatase activity is localized to one cytoplasmic region. These features distinguish seminoma from adenocarcinoma, large-cell lymphoma and embryonal carcinoma.

pmid-2576549.summary_ja: 26歳女性の成熟卵巣奇形腫(類皮嚢腫)に生じた悪性転化の症例を報告し、患者は死亡した。悪性転化は成熟奇形腫の1〜2%に起こり、扁平上皮癌が最多である。閉経後女性に多く、術前診断は稀である。手術アプローチ、予後因子、補助療法について考察している。
pmid-2576549.summary_en: The authors describe a 26-year-old woman with malignant transformation of a mature ovarian teratoma, a rare event occurring in 1 to 2 percent of such tumors. Squamous cell carcinoma is the most common malignancy in this setting, and the disease in this patient was fatal. The article notes that malignant mature cystic teratomas typically affect postmenopausal women and are rarely diagnosed preoperatively. It proposes a surgical approach and discusses prognostic factors and adjuvant therapy.

pmid-2584406.summary_ja: 進行精巣胚細胞腫瘍146例を対象に、化学療法後に切除した後腹膜リンパ節の所見と予後の関係を10年間にわたり検討した。成熟奇形腫や線維壊死組織は予後良好と関連し、中分化型悪性奇形腫では生存腫瘍が多かった。完全切除は薬剤抵抗例の予後を改善しうるため、後腹膜リンパ節郭清の考慮と完全切除が推奨されている。
pmid-2584406.summary_en: This 10-year study of 146 patients with advanced testicular germ cell tumours (38 seminomas, 108 malignant teratomas) treated with combination chemotherapy examined findings in retroperitoneal lymph nodes resected after chemotherapy and their relation to prognosis. Mature teratoma or fibronecrotic tissue in resected specimens predicted good outcome, while viable malignancy was more frequent in intermediate-type malignant teratoma. Complete resection improved outcome in drug-resistant cases. The authors recommend considering retroperitoneal node dissection and attempting complete resection to avoid missing residual disease.

pmid-2584492.summary_ja: 後腹膜奇形腫の1例について、コンピュータ断層撮影(CT)とMR画像を病理所見と対比して検討した。両画像法は嚢胞成分と充実成分を持つ境界明瞭な腫瘤と、腫瘍の組織成分をすべて描出した。血管と腫瘍の関係の描出はMRがCTより優れており、術前評価における画像診断の有用性を示す報告である。
pmid-2584492.summary_en: A retroperitoneal teratoma was evaluated with CT and MR imaging and correlated with pathology. The tumor contained five tissue components: adipose tissue, bone, hair, sebum, and edematous fibrofatty tissue with skin. Both modalities showed a well-defined mass with separate cystic and solid parts and depicted all tissue elements. MR was superior to CT in delineating the relationship between the tumor and blood vessels, suggesting its value in preoperative assessment.

pmid-2584814.summary_ja: hCGを分泌する卵巣純粋ディスジャーミノーマから細胞株KURATOUを樹立し、特性を解析した。細胞は倍加時間約10日、hCG産生、三倍体の核型を示し、ヌードマウスへの移植で原腫瘍を再現した。本細胞株は卵巣胚細胞腫瘍の研究モデルとして有用である。
pmid-2584814.summary_en: A hCG-secreting pure ovarian dysgerminoma was established as the KURATOU cell line and characterized. The cells included small and large forms, had a doubling time of about 10 days, produced hCG at measurable levels, and showed a triploid karyotype. Nude mouse transplantation reproduced the original tumour without other elements. The line provides a model for ovarian germ cell tumour research.

pmid-2585622.summary_ja: 精巣がん治療を受けた31例を前向きに追跡し、心理社会的影響を検討した。治療内容にかかわらず適応は時間とともに改善し、問題は少なかった。後腹膜リンパ節郭清を受けた患者の多くで射精消失が認められたが、重篤な性機能障害は稀であった。そのため心因的な側面の評価が重要と結論づけている。
pmid-2585622.summary_en: This prospective study of 31 men aged 18 to 51 treated for testis cancer after orchiectomy assessed effects on life outlook, work, partner relationship and sexual function at 3, 6 and 18 months. Psychosocial adjustment improved over time regardless of treatment, with few problems. Most notable was loss of ejaculation in 11 of 13 patients after retroperitoneal lymph node dissection, though serious sexual dysfunction was rare, and the authors advise clinicians to assess psychogenic factors.

pmid-2587573.summary_ja: 成熟嚢胞性奇形腫と同一卵巣に生じたセルトリ・ライディッヒ細胞腫瘍の症例を報告している。若年女性にまれで、男性化徴候を呈することが多い本腫瘍は、他の卵巣腫瘍と合併することがまれである。多彩な組織像が診断を困難にすることも併せて文献的に考察されている。
pmid-2587573.summary_en: This report describes a Sertoli-Leydig cell tumor arising in the same ovary as a mature cystic teratoma. Sertoli-Leydig tumors are rare in young women and often cause virilization, but they are rarely associated with other ovarian neoplasms. The authors present their case and review the broad range of histologic patterns that can make diagnosis difficult.

pmid-2589932.summary_ja: 生後6〜7日目のマウス胚の卵筒を成体マウスの腎被膜下に移植し、奇形腫および奇形癌を誘導した。移植した115個の胚のうち32個が奇形腫様腫瘍を形成した。移植可能な奇形癌株DTC-4とDTC-8を樹立し、多分化能を保持していることから、今後の研究に有用なモデルとなる。
pmid-2589932.summary_en: Egg cylinders from 6- to 7-day-old mouse embryos were transplanted under the kidney capsule of adult mice to induce teratomas and teratocarcinomas. Of 115 grafted embryos, 32 formed teratoid tumors, with similar incidence in two strains. Two transplantable teratocarcinoma lines, DTC-4 and DTC-8, were established and retain pluripotent differentiation, making them useful experimental models.

pmid-2592807.summary_ja: 46,XYの核型を持つ表現型女性で、片側の索状性腺に性腺芽腫を認めた症例を報告している。性腺芽腫と環状小管を伴う性索腫瘍の組織学的類似性を検討した。ヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)投与と無関係な血清テストステロン高値が診断に有用であった。性腺摘出後のホルモン補充についても論じている。
pmid-2592807.summary_en: A phenotypic female with a 46,XY karyotype and streak gonads is described, with gonadoblastoma on one side. The authors compare gonadoblastoma with sex cord tumors with annular tubules. Elevated serum testosterone unrelated to hCG administration aided diagnosis. Because gonadoblastoma is small and ectopic, they stress laparotomy with biopsy and discuss hormone replacement after gonadectomy.

pmid-2593044.summary_ja: 不妊男性723例中5例で精巣に上皮内癌(CIS)が認められた。単一の生検ではCISを見逃す例があり、精子形成が残る尿細管とセルトリ細胞のみの尿細管の両方にCISが存在した。CIS細胞の核DNA含量は平均約4cであった。
pmid-2593044.summary_en: Carcinoma in situ (CIS) of the testis was found in five of 723 infertile men. Single biopsies missed CIS in some testes, and CIS was present in tubules with both complete and Sertoli-only patterns of spermatogenesis. Two of the five men had prior orchiopexy for cryptorchidism. CIS cells averaged about 4c DNA content, supporting its role as a precursor lesion of testicular germ cell tumors.

pmid-2593435.summary_ja: 難治性精巣がん13例に、VM-26またはVP-16とシスプラチンによる救援化学療法を施行し、3例には放射線療法を併用した。完全奏効は46%、部分奏効は31%であった。9例(69%)が18〜84か月にわたり無病生存した。血液毒性は強かったが、敗血症による死亡はなかった。
pmid-2593435.summary_en: Thirteen patients with refractory germinal testicular cancer received salvage chemotherapy with VM-26 or VP-16 plus cisplatin, with three also receiving radiation therapy. Complete response was achieved in 46% and partial response in 31%. Nine patients (69%) remained alive and disease-free at 18 to 84 months. Hematologic toxicity was severe, but no sepsis-related deaths occurred.

pmid-2597776.summary_ja: 精巣セミノーマに対し精巣摘除術と放射線療法を受けた43歳男性が、4年後にフィラデルフィア染色体陽性の慢性骨髄性白血病を発症した症例報告である。骨髄移植の適応がなくブスルファンで治療された。精巣セミノーマへの放射線療法後は、二次性腫瘍を検出するため長期フォローアップが必要であると述べている。
pmid-2597776.summary_en: A 43-year-old man with testicular seminoma treated with orchiectomy and radiotherapy developed Philadelphia chromosome-positive chronic myelogenous leukemia four years later. As he was ineligible for bone marrow transplantation, busulfan was used for treatment. The authors conclude that patients treated with radiotherapy for testicular seminoma require long-term follow-up to detect possible secondary malignancies, including leukemia. This case highlights the importance of surveillance after treatment.

pmid-2598586.summary_ja: 精巣腫瘍患者6例で、診断時1例・再発時5例において、大動脈分岐部以下の腰筋上に転移がCTで確認された。腰筋の低位に後腹膜リンパ節が存在するという根拠を示し、精巣腫瘍の転移部位として認識する重要性を論じている。正確な病期診断と経過観察のために重要な知見である。
pmid-2598586.summary_en: Six patients with testicular tumours had CT-detected metastases on the psoas muscle at or below the aortic bifurcation, either at presentation (one) or relapse (five). The authors provide evidence that low psoas retroperitoneal lymph nodes exist and argue that radiologists and clinicians should recognise the psoas as a possible metastatic site. Recognising this pattern matters for accurate staging and surveillance of testicular cancer patients.

pmid-2601223.summary_ja: 原発性ヒト精巣がん（セミノーマ、胎児性癌、奇形癌腫）と正常精巣におけるmyc遺伝子ファミリーの発現をノーザンブロットで解析した研究である。通常は神経外胚葉腫瘍に限られるN-mycは、セミノーマの多くと胎児性癌で検出され、遺伝子増幅は認められなかった。未分化な精巣腫瘍の発生・進展にN-mycの発現が関与する可能性が示唆された。
pmid-2601223.summary_en: This study analyzed expression of the myc family genes c-myc, N-myc, and L-myc in primary human testicular cancers (seminoma, embryonal carcinoma, teratocarcinoma) and normal testis by Northern blot. N-myc, normally restricted to neuroectodermal tumors, was detected in most seminomas and in embryonal carcinomas but not in teratocarcinomas or normal testis, without gene amplification. The authors suggest N-myc expression may relate to the development and progression of undifferentiated testicular neoplasms.

pmid-2602003.summary_ja: 13か月の男児で、左後部の大きな嚢胞性腫瘤が当初は肺と考えられた。MRIで嚢胞性腫瘤が脂肪に囲まれていることが示され、病変の性状評価に有用であった。切除により良性の後縦隔奇形腫と判明した。乳児における脂肪を含む縦隔奇形腫の診断にMRIが有用であることを示す症例報告である。
pmid-2602003.summary_en: A 13-month-old boy presented with a large left posterior cystic mass initially suspected to be lung. MRI demonstrated that the cyst was surrounded by fat, which helped characterize the lesion. The mass was resected and proved to be a benign posterior mediastinal teratoma. The report highlights the value of MRI in identifying fat-containing mediastinal teratomas in infants, an extragonadal germ cell tumor presentation.

pmid-2602244.summary_ja: 精巣腫瘍に対する腹部照射後に膵頭部付近に腫瘍が生じた2症例の報告。文献上3例目・4例目にあたり、悪性疾患に対する腹部照射が二次がんを誘発しうることを示唆する。精巣腫瘍の長期生存者では二次がんへの注意が必要である。
pmid-2602244.summary_en: This brief report describes two patients who developed tumours in or near the pancreatic head after abdominal irradiation for testicular tumours, which are germ cell tumours. Only the third and fourth such cases in the literature, they indicate that radiation therapy used to treat malignancy can induce second cancers in the pancreas. The findings highlight the long-term risk of secondary malignancy in survivors of testicular cancer treated with abdominal radiotherapy and the need for long-term surveillance.

pmid-2608605.summary_ja: 同胞3名が20代で精巣腫瘍を発症した家族内集積例の報告。全員が中間悪性度の悪性奇形腫で、うち1名は同側にセミノーマを合併していた。家族歴や停留精巣はなく、染色体解析とHLA型検査でも原因は特定できなかった。
pmid-2608605.summary_en: This report describes three of four brothers who were all diagnosed with testicular tumours in their twenties. All had intermediate-grade malignant teratoma, and one also had a seminoma on the same side. There was no family history of cancer and no congenital abnormalities such as cryptorchidism. Chromosomal analysis and HLA typing did not clarify the cause, highlighting an unusual familial clustering of germ cell tumours.

pmid-2611626.summary_ja: 進行セミノーマ46例で、化学療法後の残存腫瘤の画像所見と治療不成功の関係を検討した。後腹膜腫瘤が10 cm²を超える例では、シスプラチン併用化学療法後の再発リスクが約25%であった。縦隔病変は完全寛解でも再発例があり、長期的な定期フォローアップの必要性を示した。
pmid-2611626.summary_en: This study of 46 patients with advanced seminoma examined whether masses remaining after chemotherapy predict treatment failure. Retroperitoneal masses larger than 10 cm² were associated with higher failure rates, with about a 25% relapse risk after cisplatin-based chemotherapy. Mediastinal tumours achieving complete remission still relapsed in some patients, and original tumour size was not significantly related to failure. Some irradiated, relapse-free patients showed mildly enlarged masses on CT years later. The authors recommend long-term regular follow-up.

pmid-2612217.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍14例のヘテロ接合性の消失を解析し、4例で染色体11の非ランダムな欠失を認めた。卵巣奇形腫では減数分裂後起源を示唆する所見が得られた。染色体欠失や減数分裂時の分離が、劣性変異を顕在化させて胚細胞腫瘍の発生に関与することを示唆する。
pmid-2612217.summary_en: The authors examined loss of heterozygosity in 14 testicular germ cell tumours. Four cases showed nonrandom deletion of all or part of chromosome 11. One ovarian teratoma showed loss of heterozygosity at all informative loci, indicating a post-meiotic origin. The findings suggest that distinct mechanisms, including chromosomal deletion and meiotic segregation, unmask recessive mutations in the development of germ cell tumours. This early genetic study offers insight into germ cell tumour pathogenesis.

pmid-2612408.summary_ja: 1973年から1986年にラゴス大学教育病院で治療された仙尾部奇形腫30例の検討。良性67%、悪性33%で女児が多かった。良性例の多くは生後3か月以前に手術され、I型・II型病変であった。悪性例は骨盤内に広範な進展を伴い、排尿障害や便秘、歩行障害、神経症状を呈した。年齢、性別、臨床病型、病理組織学との予後の関係を検討し、他施設の報告と比較している。
pmid-2612408.summary_en: This 1989 Nigerian series reviewed 30 sacrococcygeal teratomas treated at Lagos University Teaching Hospital between 1973 and 1986. Two-thirds were benign and one-third malignant, with girls predominating. Most benign cases were operated on before age three months and had type I or II lesions. All malignant cases had significant presacral and endopelvic extension, often causing urinary retention, constipation, gait difficulty, or neurologic deficits. The authors relate age, sex, clinical type, and histopathology to prognosis and compare outcomes with other African and international centres.

pmid-2617306.summary_ja: 3か月の乳児が腹部膨満で受診し、右腹部に大きな腫瘤を認めた。手術で後腹膜腔に胎児様の腫瘤が見つかり、胎児内胎児と診断された。後腹膜奇形腫との鑑別診断を考察し、確定例と比較している。乳児の大きな腹部腫瘤では本疾患を念頭に置く必要性を示す症例である。
pmid-2617306.summary_en: A three-month-old infant presented with abdominal distension and a large right abdominal mass suggestive of a teratomatous lesion. Surgery revealed a foetus-like tumour in the retroperitoneal space, leading to a diagnosis of foetus in foetu. The authors discuss the differential diagnosis of retroperitoneal teratoma and compare the case with previously confirmed reports. The case highlights the need to consider this entity in infants with large abdominal masses.

pmid-2618610.summary_ja: 妊娠を除外できた女性で、血清hCG高値が1年半にわたり持続した症例。放射標識抗hCG抗体によりhCG産生源が絨毛癌と判明した。多剤併用化学療法により治癒した。非妊娠女性で持続するhCG上昇は腫瘍精査の対象となること、抗体を用いた局在診断が有用であることを示している。
pmid-2618610.summary_en: A woman with persistently elevated serum hCG for 1.5 years, in whom pregnancy had been excluded, underwent tumour investigation. Radiolabelled anti-hCG antibody localized the source of hCG production to a choriocarcinoma. Multiagent chemotherapy cured the patient. The report emphasizes that persistently elevated hCG in non-pregnant women warrants tumour evaluation, and that antibody-based localization can help identify the producing tumour.

pmid-2618614.summary_ja: 腹痛の増強を訴えた21歳女性に開腹術を施行し、両側の子宮傍組織に2つの腫瘍を認めた。顕微鏡検査で両者とも成熟奇形腫と判明した。子宮傍組織に発生する奇形腫は文献上の報告がないとされる。若年女性における成熟奇形腫の珍しい発生部位を示した症例である。
pmid-2618614.summary_en: A 21-year-old woman with no sexual experience and increasing abdominal pain underwent laparotomy, which revealed two tumours arising from the parametria. Microscopy confirmed both as mature teratomas. The authors note that teratomas located in the parametria had not previously been described in the literature, making this an unusual anatomic site for mature teratoma in a young woman.

pmid-2618979.summary_ja: 縦隔悪性胚細胞腫瘍の小児2例を報告する。20か月女児は卵黄嚢腫瘍、15歳男児は低分化扁平上皮癌を伴う悪性奇形腫であった。両者とも一次的併用化学療法、完全切除、腫瘍床への放射線照射、地固め化学療法を受け、4年以上にわたり再発を認めず、縦隔腫瘍の予後は不良であるという見解に疑問を投げかけている。
pmid-2618979.summary_en: Two children with malignant mediastinal germ cell tumours are described: a 20-month-old girl with endodermal sinus tumour and a 15-year-old boy with malignant teratoma containing poorly differentiated squamous cell carcinoma. Both received primary combination chemotherapy, followed by complete resection, tumour-bed radiation and consolidation chemotherapy. Both remained free of recurrence for more than four years, challenging the view that mediastinal tumours have a poor prognosis.

pmid-2621736.summary_ja: 卵巣4例と精巣2例の卵黄嚢腫瘍の凍結組織を用い、エストロゲン受容体(ER)とプロゲステロン受容体(PR)を生化学的方法と免疫組織化学染色で検討した。生化学的測定で卵巣腫瘍1例に低レベルのERが検出されたが、非特異的結合によるものと考えられた。免疫染色では特異的な核染色はなく、卵黄嚢腫瘍はERもPRも発現しないと結論づけている。
pmid-2621736.summary_en: Frozen tissue from four ovarian and two testicular endodermal sinus (yolk sac) tumors was examined for estrogen and progesterone receptors using biochemical assays and immunostaining. The biochemical assay detected low estrogen receptor levels in one ovarian tumor, which the authors attribute to nonspecific binding. Immunostaining showed no specific nuclear staining in any of the six tumors, and progesterone receptors were undetectable in all of them. The authors conclude that endodermal sinus tumors express neither estrogen nor progesterone receptors.

pmid-2624425.summary_ja: 経産婦が産後出血と自然子宮穿孔で受診し、絨毛癌による穿孔のため緊急開腹術を要した症例報告。正期産後の絨毛癌は妊娠性絨毛性疾患の稀な型で、転移が広範で化学療法への反応が悪く予後不良とされる。早期診断の重要性を強調し、積極的な化学療法により全生存期間が改善したと述べている。
pmid-2624425.summary_en: A woman with two previous term deliveries presented with postpartum hemorrhage and spontaneous uterine perforation caused by choriocarcinoma, requiring emergency laparotomy. The authors note that choriocarcinoma after term pregnancy is a rare form of gestational trophoblastic disease. It tends to be more aggressive, metastasizes more widely, responds less well to chemotherapy, and carries a poorer prognosis. Early diagnosis and a high index of suspicion are emphasized, and an aggressive chemotherapy regimen improved overall survival.

pmid-2624580.summary_ja: 無機能性卵巣腫瘍(類皮嚢腫を含む)の閉経後女性28例で、血漿と腫瘍組織のエストラジオール(E2)を測定した。術前の血漿E2は良性・悪性いずれも正常閉経後女性より有意に高く、術後に低下した。E2とその前駆体は腫瘍組織内に存在し、3β-HSDは間質に局在していた。腫瘍自体がE2を産生すると結論づけている。
pmid-2624580.summary_en: Estradiol levels were measured in plasma and tumor tissue from 28 postmenopausal women with nonfunctioning ovarian tumors, including dermoid cysts. Preoperative plasma estradiol was markedly higher in both benign and malignant tumor cases than in normal postmenopausal women. It declined substantially after surgery. Estradiol and its precursors were found within the tumor tissue, and 3beta-hydroxysteroid dehydrogenase activity localized to the stroma, suggesting that the tumors produce estradiol themselves.

pmid-2627129.summary_ja: 絨毛癌細胞の浸潤能を検討するため、コラーゲンゲル上で増殖させた脱落膜細胞または平滑筋細胞の単層を用いたin vitroモデルを作製した。超微細構造解析により腫瘍細胞と間質細胞の相互作用を観察した。浸潤の過程で、腫瘍細胞が間質細胞の収縮を誘導することが明らかになった。
pmid-2627129.summary_en: The authors established an in vitro model in which choriocarcinoma cells invade a monolayer of decidual or smooth muscle cells grown on collagen gels. Ultrastructural examination was used to study the interactions between tumor cells and stromal cells during invasion. The tumor cells were found to induce retraction of the stromal cells as they invaded. Choriocarcinoma is noted as a common cancer in Taiwan, Hong Kong, and Japan.

pmid-2629034.summary_ja: 58歳の閉経後女性が消化管出血で受診した症例報告。血管造影で胃の大きな過血管性腫瘤と多発肝腫瘤を認め、海綿状血管腫に類似していた。造影CTと血管像の所見は子宮絨毛癌に特徴的であった。hCG値は著明に上昇し、剖検により胃原発の性器外絨毛癌と確認された。
pmid-2629034.summary_en: A 58-year-old postmenopausal woman presented with gastrointestinal hemorrhage. Arteriography showed a large hypervascular gastric mass and multiple liver masses, mimicking cavernous hemangioma. Contrast-enhanced CT revealed a central nonenhancing area with peripheral enhancement, and angiographic features were characteristic of uterine choriocarcinoma. Serum hCG was markedly elevated. Autopsy confirmed primary extragenital choriocarcinoma of the stomach.

pmid-2629889.summary_ja: 腹部腫瘤のある12歳女児が、46XYと46XXの2系統の細胞を持つ二精子性(全身性)キメラと判明した。切除された右子宮付属器腫瘍は悪性転化を伴うディスジャーミノーマと診断された。血液型抗原と遺伝子マーカーの解析から、腫瘍に関連する細胞系統はA1遺伝子を持つ46XY系統であった。著者らは、Y染色体の存在下でこの系統由来の性腺が悪性化したと結論づけている。
pmid-2629889.summary_en: A 12-year-old girl with an abdominal tumor was found to be a dispermic or generalized chimera with two distinct cell lines, 46,XY and 46,XX. The resected right uterine adnexal tumor was diagnosed as dysgerminoma with malignant transformation. Blood group antigen and genetic marker analyses showed that the tumor-associated cell line carried the A1 gene. The authors conclude that the gonad derived from the 46,XY line developed malignancy in the presence of the Y chromosome.

pmid-2632415.summary_ja: インド・パンジャブ州の医科大学で15年間に検討された636例の卵巣腫瘍を後方視的に解析した報告である。漿液性腫瘍が最も多く、次いで粘液性腫瘍、奇形腫が142例で3番目に多かった。良性420例、悪性201例、境界悪性15例であった。地域の卵巣腫瘍の組織学的分布を示す疫学データである。
pmid-2632415.summary_en: A 15-year retrospective review of 636 ovarian tumours at a medical college in Punjab, India. Serous tumours were most common, followed by mucinous tumours, and teratoma was third most common with 142 cases. Of the tumours, 420 were benign, 201 malignant and 15 borderline. The paper provides regional epidemiologic data on ovarian tumour histology, including teratoma.

pmid-2642244.summary_ja: 2歳児に発生した巨大な仙尾部奇形腫の症例報告である。コンピュータ断層撮影(CT)ガイド下に1か月の間隔をあけて2段階で手術を行い、完全切除を達成した。仙骨前領域への大きな進展が特徴であり、完全切除の重要性が強調されている。術後8か月の経過は良好で、術後の画像フォローアップにCTが有用とされている。
pmid-2642244.summary_en: Case report of a giant sacrococcygeal teratoma in a two-year-old child, resected in two stages one month apart under CT guidance. Complete excision was achieved. The authors emphasize the tumour's large pre-sacral extension and the need for complete resection. Eight months after surgery the postoperative course was satisfactory, underlining the value of CT follow-up.

pmid-2649396.summary_ja: 67歳女性の膀胱腫瘍例で、低分化移行上皮癌と絨毛癌成分が併存していた。開腹時に膀胱内に限局していたが、化学療法後に再発し死亡。剖検で多発性の転移性絨毛癌が確認され、移行上皮癌は消失していた。既報例の検討から、移行上皮癌が逆分化により絨毛癌を生じる起源細胞と考察している。
pmid-2649396.summary_en: This case report describes a 67-year-old woman with a bladder tumor containing both poorly differentiated transitional cell carcinoma and trophoblastic (choriocarcinoma) components. Confined to the bladder at laparotomy, she received combination chemotherapy, responded initially, then relapsed and died. Autopsy revealed multiple metastatic choriocarcinoma without residual transitional cell carcinoma. The authors review reported cases and suggest transitional cell carcinoma is the cell of origin, acting through progressive retrodifferentiation.

pmid-2649987.summary_ja: 精巣がんに対するイホスファミドの有効性をまとめた総説。未治療例の奏効率は66%、シスプラチン前治療例では21%。再発例ではシスプラチン・エトポシド・イホスファミド併用で約30%が完全奏効し、15～20%が長期無病生存を得た。15年の追跡で晩期臓器毒性は認めず、予後不良例への初回治療としての使用が提案された。
pmid-2649987.summary_en: This review summarizes the role of ifosfamide in testicular cancer. Single-agent response was 66% in untreated and 21% in cisplatin-pretreated patients, with similar activity in nonseminoma and seminoma. In relapsing patients after cisplatin-based chemotherapy, cisplatin-etoposide-ifosfamide achieved about 30% complete responses and 15-20% long-term disease-free survival. A 15-year follow-up showed no late organ toxicity and only one secondary malignancy among 331 patients. The authors propose this combination for first-line treatment of poor-risk patients.

pmid-2653339.summary_ja: アイカルディ症候群の日本人女児例で、生後約4週から難治性の点頭てんかんを発症した。22か月時に左頬部の腫脹が出現し、血清αフェトプロテイン(AFP)が著明に上昇した。経口生検で胎児性癌と診断された。アイカルディ症候群と胎児性癌の合併は初めての報告で、先天奇形と腫瘍の関連が考察されている。
pmid-2653339.summary_en: This case report describes a Japanese girl with Aicardi syndrome who developed infantile spasms at about 4 weeks of age, refractory to multiple antiepileptic drugs and ACTH. At 22 months, her left cheek swelled, and serum alpha-fetoprotein was markedly elevated. Transoral biopsy revealed an embryonal carcinoma. The authors describe this as the first reported association of Aicardi syndrome with embryonal carcinoma and discuss the relationship between congenital malformations and neoplasms.

pmid-2653557.summary_ja: 純粋型セミノーマ105例の血清LDHとhCGを解析した研究。hCGは特異度100%・感度32%、LDHは特異度93%・感度47%であった。再発の70%でいずれかまたは両方の上昇がみられた。治療前のhCG上昇は再発リスクの高さと関連した。hCGは初期診断と化学療法のモニタリングに有用で、両マーカーをフォローアップで測定すべきとされる。
pmid-2653557.summary_en: This study analyzed serum LDH and hCG as tumor markers in 105 patients with pure seminoma, using 981 blood samples. hCG was highly specific (100%) but less sensitive (32%), while LDH showed 93% specificity and 47% sensitivity. Most relapses (70%) were associated with elevated LDH and/or hCG. Elevated pretreatment hCG, rather than LDH, indicated higher relapse risk. The authors conclude hCG is useful for primary diagnosis and chemotherapy monitoring, and both markers should be measured during follow-up.

pmid-2655097.summary_ja: 精巣がんに対するカルボプラチンの有用性を検討した総説。未治療の播種性セミノーマでは高い有効性と良好な忍容性が示された。一方、通常用量では難治性非セミノーマに無効であった。大量カルボプラチン・エトポシドと自家骨髄救援を併用すると、前治療の多い胚細胞腫瘍患者で一部に完全寛解が得られた。
pmid-2655097.summary_en: This review assesses carboplatin in testicular cancer. In previously untreated disseminated seminoma, carboplatin was highly effective and well tolerated. Conventional doses appeared inactive in refractory nonseminoma. An intensive carboplatin-etoposide regimen with autologous bone marrow rescue induced a few complete remissions in heavily pretreated germ cell tumor patients. The findings suggest carboplatin may be useful in certain testicular cancer settings, although its role in refractory nonseminoma appears limited.

pmid-2656147.summary_ja: 30歳男性の性腺外絨毛癌の症例。穿刺吸引細胞診(FNA)と免疫ペルオキシダーゼ染色により診断された。侵襲的な診断手技を要さず、急速に増大する転移病変を確認でき、速やかな治療開始につながった。低侵襲な診断法として、免疫染色を併用したFNAの有用性を示した症例報告。
pmid-2656147.summary_en: A 30-year-old man with extragonadal choriocarcinoma was diagnosed by fine-needle aspiration cytology supported by immunoperoxidase staining. The rapidly growing metastatic lesions were identified without an invasive diagnostic procedure, allowing prompt treatment. The report highlights the diagnostic utility of fine-needle aspiration combined with immunohistochemistry for germ cell tumor metastases when a minimally invasive approach is preferred.

pmid-2656957.summary_ja: 大きな仙尾部奇形腫を有する胎児3例を、心エコーとドプラ超音波で評価した。全例で胎児水腫を伴う高拍出性心不全がみられ、心室・胎盤血流が増加していた。腫瘍は大きな動静脈瘻として作用すると考えられた。手術摘出後に血行動態は改善し、非生存可能期の胎児では出生前の摘出が有効な治療になりうると示唆された。
pmid-2656957.summary_en: Three fetuses with large sacrococcygeal teratomas were evaluated using echocardiography and Doppler ultrasound. All showed high-output cardiac failure with fetal hydrops, increased ventricular and placental flow, and high-velocity flow within the tumor. The authors concluded that the tumor acts as a large arteriovenous fistula. Hemodynamic abnormalities reversed after surgical removal, suggesting that resection of the teratoma in previable fetuses with these findings may be the most effective treatment.

pmid-2657222.summary_ja: 原発性肺絨毛癌の症例。術前に5-FU、エトポシド、シスプラチンを投与して部分奏効を得て、右上葉の巨大腫瘍を完全切除した。その後、脳転移で再発して切除されたが、対側肺転移と新たな脳転移で死亡した。集学的治療は一部の患者に有益かもしれないと考察している。
pmid-2657222.summary_en: A primary choriocarcinoma of the lung was treated with neoadjuvant 5-FU, etoposide, and cisplatin, achieving a partial response that permitted complete resection of a massive right upper lobe tumor. The patient relapsed with a brain metastasis, which was excised, followed by contralateral lung metastases responsive to systemic chemotherapy. The patient ultimately died of a new brain metastasis. The authors suggest that intensive multimodality therapy may benefit selected patients and review the literature.

pmid-2657586.summary_ja: 頭頸部奇形腫は、三胚葉すべての組織に分化しうる細胞から構成される発生奇形または腫瘍である。ほぼ新生児と乳児に限って発症する。治療は正常な解剖学的構造を温存しつつ、完全な外科的切除を目指すことが基本となる。
pmid-2657586.summary_en: Head and neck teratomas are developmental malformations or tumors composed of cells with a full range of histogenic potential. They occur almost exclusively in newborns and infants. This review emphasizes that treatment centers on complete surgical excision while preserving normal anatomic structures.

pmid-2657712.summary_ja: 縦隔奇形腫が原因で胎児に非免疫性水腫を生じた稀な症例。超音波で前上縦隔に嚢胞性と充実性の混合した腫瘤を認めた。剖検では腫瘍が甲状腺上部まで進展し、気管・食道・大動脈弓を圧排していた。腫瘍による静脈還流障害が水腫の成因と考えられた。
pmid-2657712.summary_en: A rare case of non-immune hydrops fetalis caused by an intrauterine mediastinal teratoma is described. Sonography showed a mixed cystic and solid mass in the anterosuperior mediastinum. Postmortem examination revealed that the tumor extended cranially to the upper thyroid, compressing the trachea, esophagus, and aortic arch. The authors suggest that obstruction of venous return by the tumor underlies the hydrops.

pmid-2658603.summary_ja: 妊娠早期の大きな仙尾部奇形腫は、高拍出性心不全を介して胎盤肥大、胎児水腫、胎児死亡、母体の子癇前症様症候群を引き起こしうる。妊娠21週で胎児手術を行い水腫は改善したが、術後の子宮収縮で非生存児が娩出された。ドプラ心エコーによる高リスク症例の選択が有用と考察している。
pmid-2658603.summary_en: Large sacrococcygeal teratomas early in gestation can cause placentomegaly, fetal hydrops, fetal death, and a preeclampsia-like syndrome in the mother through high-output cardiac failure. The authors report fetal surgery at 21 weeks, which reversed hydrops and reduced aortic flow and placental thickness. Postoperative uterine irritability led to delivery of a nonviable infant. They suggest Doppler echocardiography may help select high-risk fetuses for intervention.

pmid-2659872.summary_ja: 精巣腫瘍31例を対象に、グルタチオンS-転移酵素(GST)を免疫染色で検討した。腫瘍細胞は卵黄嚢腫瘍の1例を除きGST陰性だった。乳児の精細管やライディッヒ細胞は陽性で、高β-hCG血症例ではライディッヒ細胞の広範な過形成がみられた。患者にみられる低受精能の説明に寄与する可能性がある。
pmid-2659872.summary_en: This immunohistochemical study examined glutathione S-transferase (GST) in 31 patients with testicular tumors, including seminoma and nonseminoma. Tumor cells were GST-negative except for one yolk sac tumor. GST was expressed in seminiferous tubules of infants and in Leydig cells, and diffuse Leydig cell hyperplasia was seen in a patient with high serum beta-hCG. The findings may help explain the hypofertility observed in these patients.

pmid-2660526.summary_ja: 60歳男性の左精巣に生じた純粋セミノーマの症例報告。超音波で拳大の充実性腫瘤を認め、鼠径切開で精巣を摘除した。病期はIで、術後に縦隔リンパ節へ放射線療法を行い、再発は認めなかった。高齢者の非バルキー性セミノーマの予後と従来の治療を文献的に概説している。
pmid-2660526.summary_en: Case report of a 60-year-old man with a left testicular tumor composed purely of seminoma. Scrotal ultrasound showed a solid, fist-sized mass, and surgical orchiectomy via inguinal incision was performed. Chest X-ray, CT, retroperitoneal ultrasound, and tumor markers were negative, indicating stage I disease. He received adjuvant irradiation to the mediastinal nodes and had no recurrence. The authors briefly review the prognosis of non-bulky pure seminoma in elderly patients and conventional treatment approaches reported in the literature.

pmid-2661088.summary_ja: 卵巣腫瘍105例に後腹膜リンパ節郭清を行い、リンパ節転移の頻度を検討した研究。胚細胞腫瘍は28例(26.7%)含まれた。後腹膜転移は54.3%に認め、術前化学療法の効果は未熟奇形腫では無効、卵黄嚢腫瘍では壊死を伴う変性を認めた。リンパ節陰性例の完全寛解率はやや高かったが、有意差はなかった。
pmid-2661088.summary_en: A prospective study at Peking Union Medical College Hospital evaluating lymph node metastasis in 105 ovarian cancer patients undergoing retroperitoneal lymphadenectomy, 28 of whom had germ cell tumors. Retroperitoneal nodal involvement was 54.3%, and pelvic and para-aortic patterns were analyzed by ovarian laterality. Lymphography correlated well with pathology (83.3%). Preoperative chemotherapy showed no response in immature teratoma and extensive necrosis in endodermal sinus tumor. Complete remission was 46.7% in node-negative versus 33.3% in node-positive patients, a difference that was not statistically significant.

pmid-2663131.summary_ja: 乳児の精巣奇形腫、成人の精巣類上皮嚢腫、成人の純粋奇形腫を比較した研究。成人の奇形腫の88%で精細管内胚細胞腫瘍(ITGCN)が見られ、転移は63%、死亡は37%だった。ITGCNは悪性の可能性と有意に関連し、乳児例や類上皮嚢腫では認められず良性経過を示した。病態の違いを反映する一連のスペクトラムと結論づけている。
pmid-2663131.summary_en: This study compares clinicopathologic features of testicular teratomas in infants, epidermoid cysts in adults, and pure teratomas in adults. Intratubular germ cell neoplasia (ITGCN) was found in 88% of adult teratomas, and 63% of these patients had metastases, with 37% dying. ITGCN was absent in infant teratomas and adult epidermoid cysts, which all behaved benignly. ITGCN correlated significantly with malignant potential (P = 0.0004). The authors conclude these lesions form a spectrum of entities likely reflecting differences in pathogenesis.

pmid-2664866.summary_ja: 腎周囲・腎傍腔に発生した成熟奇形腫23例の画像・臨床・病理所見を後方視的に評価した。多くは6か月未満の女児で無症状だった。特徴的所見は、液体成分を伴う複雑な腫瘤、脂肪-液体ニボー、凝固状・線状の石灰化であり、CTは超音波検査より明瞭に描出できた。
pmid-2664866.summary_en: This retrospective study evaluated imaging, clinical, and pathologic findings in 23 cases of mature teratoma arising in the peri- or pararenal spaces. Most patients were female, and half were under six months old, usually asymptomatic. Abdominal radiography, sonography, and CT were compared. The characteristic features were a complex mass with a fluid component, fat-fluid level, and calcification in congealed or linear strand patterns. CT demonstrated these components better than sonography, which could not reliably distinguish fat from other soft tissue.

pmid-2666591.summary_ja: 進行転移性セミノーマ34例に単剤カルボプラチン（400 mg/m²、4週ごと4〜6コース）を投与した。毒性は軽微で、2年生存率は94%、2年無増悪生存率は80%だった。再発6例中5例は救済治療後に寛解した。毒性を抑えたい場合の進行期セミノーマに対する選択肢として有用と結論づけている。
pmid-2666591.summary_en: Thirty-four patients with advanced metastatic seminoma received four to six courses of single-agent carboplatin 400 mg/m2 every four weeks. Patients with raised AFP or more than three lung metastases were excluded. Treatment was well tolerated without renal, neurologic, ototoxic, or hematologic serious toxicity. Two-year survival was 94%, and progression-free survival 80%. Five of six relapsed patients achieved remission after salvage therapy. The authors conclude single-agent carboplatin is a reasonable choice for advanced seminoma when limiting toxicity matters, while noting extranodal metastases are rare and need further study.

pmid-2669216.summary_ja: 胎児無形体と胎盤奇形腫を鑑別する従来の基準（臍帯の有無や骨格形成）を再検討した研究。新症例の報告と文献96例の再評価を行い、臍帯の有無は発育段階と無関係で、両者の内部構造は連続しているため従来の鑑別は意味をなさないと結論づけている。
pmid-2669216.summary_en: This 1989 Teratology paper revisits the proposed criteria for distinguishing fetus amorphus from placental teratoma, which relied on umbilical cord presence and skeletal organization. The authors describe a new case and reexamine 96 published cases. They find that umbilical cord presence is unrelated to developmental state, and that the internal organization of fetus amorphus forms a continuum with placental teratoma, making the proposed differential diagnosis meaningless. They suggest skeletal development may be a more valid criterion and call for further research.

pmid-2669822.summary_ja: 絨毛癌細胞株から放出される免疫抑制因子の性状を解析した研究。本因子はT細胞の増殖とアロ反応性細胞傷害性T細胞の誘導を抑制し、細胞内シグナル伝達や増殖経路に作用する。正常栄養膜由来因子との同一性の可能性や妊娠における意義が議論されている。
pmid-2669822.summary_en: This 1989 study characterizes an immunosuppressive factor released by choriocarcinoma cell lines. The factor inhibits proliferation of human T cells stimulated by lectins or alloantigens and blocks generation of alloreactive cytotoxic T cells. Its suppressive effect appears to act on intracellular signal transduction and proliferation pathways rather than early T cell receptor signaling or suppressor cell activation. The authors examine its physicochemical properties and propose it may be identical to a factor from normal trophoblasts, discussing its significance during pregnancy.

pmid-2671899.summary_ja: 5歳女児の腸間膜に発生した嚢胞性奇形腫の症例報告。腸間膜・大網嚢胞の稀な原因であり、小児の腹部嚢胞性腫瘤の鑑別診断において奇形腫を考慮すべきであることを示す。報告は簡潔で詳細な記述は限られている。
pmid-2671899.summary_en: This 1989 Pediatric Radiology report describes a cystic teratoma arising in the mesentery of a 5-year-old girl. Cystic teratoma is presented as an unusual cause of mesenteric or omental cysts. The case highlights the need to consider teratoma in the differential diagnosis of pediatric abdominal cystic masses. It is a brief case report with limited details.

pmid-2675515.summary_ja: 56歳男性の精子細胞性セミノーマの症例を報告する。穿刺吸引細胞診(FNA)では大・中・小の3種類の細胞、清明な背景、リンパ球成分の欠如、tigroid物質などが認められ、後の組織学的検査で確定診断された。FNA細胞診により、本腫瘍を他のセミノーマや胚細胞腫瘍から鑑別できる可能性が示唆された。
pmid-2675515.summary_en: This case report describes a 56-year-old man with spermatocytic seminoma. Fine needle aspiration cytology showed three cell types (large, medium, and small), a clean background, absence of lymphoid cells, and tigroid material, supporting the cytodiagnosis later confirmed histologically. The authors suggest that FNA cytology can distinguish spermatocytic seminoma from other seminoma types and germ cell neoplasms.

pmid-2677411.summary_ja: 新生児2例が仙骨前奇形腫により膀胱出口部閉塞を来した症例を報告する。いずれも診断が遅れており、経過と検査の経緯を示して、見逃しを招いた誤りや困難点を検討した。下部尿路閉塞を呈するすべての新生児に対し、日常的な直腸診を行うことが重要であると強調している。
pmid-2677411.summary_en: The authors describe two neonates who presented with bladder outlet obstruction caused by a presacral teratoma. Both diagnoses were delayed, and the clinical course and investigations are reviewed to show the pitfalls encountered. The report emphasizes that routine rectal examination should be performed in all neonates presenting with lower urinary tract obstruction, since this can reveal presacral masses that might otherwise be missed.

pmid-2677466.summary_ja: 70歳男性の原発性膀胱絨毛癌の剖検例を報告する。肉眼的血尿で受診し、初回生検では未分化癌と診断された。その後、ヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)-βが101ng/mlと著明に上昇し、膀胱腫瘤を認めた。剖検で骨盤内および大動脈傍リンパ節への転移が確認され、免疫染色で絨毛癌と確定された。国内で8例目の報告とされる。
pmid-2677466.summary_en: A 70-year-old man with primary choriocarcinoma of the bladder is reported. He presented with macrohematuria, an initial biopsy was diagnosed as undifferentiated carcinoma, and later serum hCG-beta rose to 101 ng/ml with a large bladder mass. Autopsy revealed metastases to pelvic and paraaortic lymph nodes, and immunohistochemistry confirmed choriocarcinoma with hCG-beta-positive syncytiotrophoblastic giant cells. The authors note this is the eighth such case reported in Japan.

pmid-2678683.summary_ja: 触診で正常な精巣を有していたセミノーマ患者の症例を報告する。著者らは、触知しない潜在性の精巣病変を発見するには精巣超音波検査が第一選択であると強調している。原因不明の後腹膜腫瘤を認めた場合には、原発巣が精巣に隠れている可能性があるため、本検査の実施を推奨している。
pmid-2678683.summary_en: This case report describes a patient with seminoma whose testes were normal on palpation. The authors emphasize that testicular ultrasound is the technique of choice for locating occult, nonpalpable testicular lesions. They recommend its use in evaluating any retroperitoneal mass of undetermined origin, since the primary tumor may be hidden within the testis.

pmid-2678987.summary_ja: 左側のセミノーマに対し精巣摘除術を受けた18か月後、右側にセミノーマを発症した29歳男性の症例を報告する。著者らの施設では1965〜1987年に精巣胚細胞腫瘍55例を治療し、そのうち2例に二次性の胚細胞腫瘍を認めた。このうち1例は左側が奇形癌、右側がセミノーマであった。稀な異時性両側発症について文献的考察を行っている。
pmid-2678987.summary_en: The authors report a 29-year-old man who developed a second testicular germ cell tumor, a seminoma on the right side, 18 months after left orchiectomy for seminoma. Among 55 patients treated at their institution between 1965 and 1987, two developed a second germ cell tumor, and one had teratocarcinoma on one side and seminoma on the other. The authors review the literature on this rare metachronous bilateral presentation.

pmid-2678988.summary_ja: 25歳男性が外傷なく自然発症した右精巣の出血で受診した。陰嚢痛と腫瘤様エコー所見から急性陰嚢症が鑑別に挙がった。高位精巣摘除術の結果、被膜下血腫を伴う成熟奇形腫(pT1N0M0)と診断された。シスプラチン、ビンブラスチン、ペプロマイシンによる化学療法後、術後15か月間転移はみられなかった。
pmid-2678988.summary_en: A 25-year-old man presented with sudden spontaneous hemorrhage of the right testis, mimicking acute scrotum, with a tumor-like finding on echography. High orchiectomy revealed a testicular mature teratoma with subcapsular hematoma (pT1 N0 M0). After adjuvant combination chemotherapy with cisplatin, vinblastine and peplomycin, he remained free of metastases for 15 months.

pmid-2679487.summary_ja: 29歳男性がB型肝炎表面抗原陽性の肝炎から回復して3か月後に精巣胎児性癌を発症した。抗HBs抗体を用いた蛍光染色で腫瘍細胞内にHBs抗原が検出された。正常精巣および他の精巣腫瘍3例では陰性であった。B型肝炎ウイルスが腫瘍細胞内に局在していたことが示された。精巣摘除術と化学療法の後、4年間生存し健康であった。
pmid-2679487.summary_en: A 29-year-old man developed testicular embryonal carcinoma three months after recovering from HBsAg-positive hepatitis. Immunofluorescence with anti-HBs antibody showed hepatitis B surface antigen within the tumor cells, while normal testis and three other testicular tumors were negative. This indicates that HBV was localized in the malignant cells. He remained alive and well four years after orchiectomy and chemotherapy.

pmid-2680053.summary_ja: 14歳女児の左卵巣腫瘤を切除したところ、ディスジャーミノーマに横紋筋肉腫成分が混在していた。病期分類のための開腹術で、骨盤壁に1cmの横紋筋肉腫結節が認められた。混合型胚細胞腫瘍や精母細胞性セミノーマに肉腫が合併する報告はあるが、純粋なディスジャーミノーマ由来の肉腫は文献上報告がないと考察された。
pmid-2680053.summary_en: A 14-year-old girl had a large left ovarian mass; histology showed dysgerminoma mixed with rhabdomyosarcoma. Staging laparotomy revealed a 1-cm rhabdomyosarcomatous nodule on the pelvic wall. The authors reviewed the literature, noting that sarcomas may accompany mixed germ cell tumors or spermatocytic seminoma, but found no prior report of sarcoma arising in a pure dysgerminoma.

pmid-2680804.summary_ja: 28歳女性は女性二次性徴、無月経、低身長などを呈し、45,X核型の両側性の燃え尽きた性腺芽腫を伴う性腺線条症候群と診断された。腫瘍は過去にステロイドホルモンを分泌していたと考えられたが、診断時にはホルモン活性は認められなかった。Y染色体を欠く性腺芽腫の症例を文献的に検討し、診断上の困難を論じた。
pmid-2680804.summary_en: A 28-year-old woman with female secondary sexual characteristics, amenorrhea, short stature and somatic anomalies of streak gonad syndrome had bilateral burnt-out gonadoblastoma with a 45,X karyotype. The tumor had probably secreted steroids earlier, though no hormonal activity was evident at diagnosis. The authors review gonadoblastoma cases without a Y chromosome and discuss diagnostic difficulties.

pmid-2681670.summary_ja: 妊娠36週の超音波検査で大きな先天性仙尾部奇形腫を出生前に診断し、外傷を避けるため帝王切開で分娩した。女児は体重4,050gで出生した。生後5日目に620gの成熟奇形腫を切除し、経過は順調であった。正確な出生前診断により無外傷分娩と速やかな手術が可能になると強調されている。
pmid-2681670.summary_en: Antenatal ultrasound at 36 weeks identified a large congenital sacrococcygeal teratoma, allowing cesarean delivery to avoid traumatic vaginal birth. The female infant weighed 4,050 g. A 620-g mature sacrococcygeal teratoma was resected on day 5, with an uneventful recovery. The authors stress that accurate prenatal sonographic diagnosis enables atraumatic delivery and prompt surgery.

pmid-2681672.summary_ja: 15年間に出生前に検出された57例の胎児腫瘍を、高分解能超音波検査の所見を中心に概説した報告。頸部リンパ管腫が最多で予後は一般に不良だが、外科的切除を受けた4例は良好な発育を示した。胎児卵巣嚢胞の子宮内穿刺の是非や、仙尾部奇形腫の出生前診断と分娩管理にも言及している。
pmid-2681672.summary_en: This review of fetal tumors summarizes 57 cases detected prenatally over 15 years using high-resolution ultrasonography. Hygroma colli was the most frequent tumor and generally had a poor prognosis, though four treated cases had normal outcomes after surgical resection. Fetal ovarian cysts and the value of in utero puncture are discussed. Sacrococcygeal teratoma is described as the most common fetal and neonatal tumor, with prenatal diagnosis based on size, internal structure, and calcification, guiding delivery timing and obstetric management.

pmid-2681880.summary_ja: 66歳男性の原発性胃絨毛癌の症例報告。術前は胃前庭部癌と考えられたが、開腹時に腫瘍浸潤による膿瘍を認め胃全摘術を施行した。組織学的に合胞体栄養膜細胞を伴う絨毛癌で、ヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)免疫染色が陽性であった。術後に肺転移が出現し、術後22日目に死亡した。精巣腫瘍は認められなかった。
pmid-2681880.summary_en: A 66-year-old man presented with primary gastric choriocarcinoma, initially suspected to be an antral gastric carcinoma on barium study and endoscopy. Laparotomy revealed a lesser sac abscess caused by tumor penetration, and total gastrectomy with lymphadenectomy was performed. Histology showed choriocarcinoma with syncytiotrophoblasts that were positive for hCG immunostaining. No testicular tumor was found. Serum hCG rose to 1,380 IU/L postoperatively, pulmonary metastases developed, and the patient died on postoperative day 22.

pmid-2682461.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍であるセミノーマを対象に、フローソーティングで分離した異数性腫瘍細胞核を用いてras遺伝子変異を検討した。Ki-rasまたはN-rasのコドン12または61に40%で変異を認めた。変異は臨床病理学的所見と相関せず、一部の腫瘍では変異が腫瘍細胞の一部にのみ存在し、不均一性が示唆された。ras変異はセミノーマ発生の初発の遺伝学的事象ではないと結論づけている。
pmid-2682461.summary_en: Ras oncogene mutations were examined in human seminomas, a testicular germ cell tumor, using oligonucleotide probe hybridization on flow-sorted aneuploid tumor nuclei. Mutations at codons 12 or 61 of Ki-ras or N-ras were found in 40% of cases, without correlation to histopathology or clinical features. In some tumors, mutations were present in only a subset of tumor cells, suggesting heterogeneity. Flow cytometry and histology did not reveal distinct tumor populations. The authors conclude that ras mutation is probably not the initial genetic event in seminoma development.

pmid-2685680.summary_ja: 10年間の後方視的レビューで、術後診断で卵巣腫瘍と判明した女性861例の年齢別分布を検討した。良性嚢胞性奇形腫が44%で最多であった。良性卵巣腫瘍では胚細胞腫瘍が最多の群であった。悪性率は20〜29歳から60〜69歳にかけて12倍に上昇し、閉経前は13%、閉経後は45%であった。
pmid-2685680.summary_en: This 10-year retrospective review analyzed 861 women with postoperative diagnoses of ovarian neoplasms to clarify their age-specific distribution. Benign cystic teratoma was the most common neoplasm at 44%, exceeding benign serous tumors by 57%. Germ cell neoplasms were the most common benign ovarian group, while epithelial neoplasms predominated among malignancies. The malignancy risk rose twelvefold from ages 20 to 29 to 60 to 69, and was 13% in premenopausal and 45% in postmenopausal women.

pmid-2690050.summary_ja: 腫瘍マーカー、超音波検査、コンピュータ断層撮影(CT)、新しい細胞傷害性化学療法が精巣がんの診療を大きく変えたことを概説する。早期に外来受診することで、多くの症例で治癒が得られるとしている。詳細な臨床データや治療プロトコルは示されていない。
pmid-2690050.summary_en: This short review describes how tumour markers, ultrasound, CT scanning, and newer cytotoxic therapy have transformed the management of testicular cancer. The author emphasizes that early outpatient referral can often lead to cure. The abstract is brief and provides no detailed clinical data, patient numbers, or specific treatment protocols.

pmid-2690804.summary_ja: 出生前の超音波検査で診断され、出産後に確定した胎児仙尾部奇形腫と水腫(hydrops)の1例を報告。まれな先天性胚細胞腫瘍の発見における出生前超音波検査の役割を示す。単一症例のため、治療成績に関する情報は含まれない。
pmid-2690804.summary_en: The authors present a case of fetal sacrococcygeal teratoma complicated by hydrops, detected on prenatal ultrasonography and confirmed after delivery. The report highlights the role of antenatal ultrasound in identifying this rare congenital germ cell tumor and its fetal complications. As a single case, it provides no treatment outcome data.

pmid-2691592.summary_ja: 4例の小児仙尾部奇形腫を報告し、うち2例は子宮内で超音波検査により診断された。3例でX線写真上に石灰化を認めた。多くは良性組織からなり、未熟組織を3例に認めた。全例で早期に切除し、尾骨切除により再発と悪性化を予防した。転移がなかったため悪性組織を伴う1例では化学療法と放射線療法は行わなかった。
pmid-2691592.summary_en: This report describes four children with sacrococcygeal teratoma, two diagnosed in utero by ultrasonography. Radiographs showed calcifications in three cases. Most tumours were benign, while immature neural tissue was present in three. All were excised early with coccygectomy to reduce recurrence and malignant change. One patient with malignant tissue received no chemotherapy or radiotherapy because metastases were absent.

pmid-2692444.summary_ja: 混合性性腺異形成を伴う38歳男性の未分化セミノーマ症例を報告。小児期に開腹歴があり、腹部の巨大腫瘤と乳酸脱水素酵素(LDH)、hCGの上昇を認めた。シスプラチン、ビンブラスチン、ブレオマイシンによる化学療法2コース後に腫瘍とミュラー管構造を広範に切除した。国内既報の混合性性腺異形成40例と性腺腫瘍8例を併せて検討した。
pmid-2692444.summary_en: A 38-year-old man with mixed gonadal dysgenesis and an anaplastic seminoma arising from an abdominal testis is described. He had undergone childhood laparotomies and presented with a large abdominal mass, elevated lactate dehydrogenase, and elevated hCG. Two cycles of cisplatin, vinblastine and bleomycin chemotherapy were given before extensive tumour and Müllerian structure resection. The authors also review 40 previously reported Japanese cases of mixed gonadal dysgenesis and eight with gonadal tumour.

pmid-2693977.summary_ja: 縦隔奇形腫と急性巨核芽球性白血病(AMKL)を合併した15歳男児の症例を報告。経過を小児AMKLの既報20例と比較した。白血病診断時の染色体検査で、数的・構造的異常を伴う複数の白血病幹細胞系統が認められた。
pmid-2693977.summary_en: A 15-year-old boy with mediastinal teratoma and concurrent acute megakaryoblastic leukemia (AMKL) is reported. The clinical course is compared with 20 previously published pediatric AMKL cases. Chromosome analysis at leukemia diagnosis revealed multiple leukemic stem cell lines with numerical and structural abnormalities. The report is limited to a single patient.

pmid-2694375.summary_ja: 胞状奇胎から絨毛癌、胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍に至る妊娠性絨毛性疾患の分類と管理を概説した総説である。部分奇胎の認識やWHO分類、排出後のβ-hCGによる継続的フォローアップの重要性を述べる。悪性化併存例では速やかな化学療法が不可欠で、転移例では適切な外科的切除が化学療法期間を短縮しうるとする。
pmid-2694375.summary_en: This review updates the classification and management of gestational trophoblastic disease, spanning hydatidiform mole to choriocarcinoma and placental site trophoblastic tumor. It highlights recognition of partial mole, WHO classification revisions, and the central role of serial beta-hCG follow-up after evacuation. Prompt chemotherapy remains essential for malignant sequelae, with newer regimens salvaging drug-resistant cases. The authors also note that judicious surgery for metastatic disease can shorten chemotherapy duration, and advise management in tertiary centers.

pmid-2695649.summary_ja: 胎児口蓋から生じた稀な奇形腫であるエピグナサス（双葉状）を出生前に診断し、胎児が生存した症例を報告している。著者らは、出生前に本奇形を認識することで新生児チームや外科チームが適切に準備でき、胎児の生存率向上につながると強調する。極めて稀な病態であるため、良好な転帰を示した症例報告は限られた臨床文献を補う意義がある。
pmid-2695649.summary_en: This case report describes the antenatal diagnosis of a bilobed epignathus, a rare teratoma arising from the fetal palate, and the subsequent survival of the fetus. The authors note that recognizing this congenital malformation before birth allows neonatal and surgical teams to plan appropriate management in advance. Early prenatal identification is therefore presented as key to optimizing fetal and neonatal outcomes in such cases. Epignathus remains exceptionally uncommon, and reports documenting successful outcomes add to the limited clinical literature.

pmid-2700185.summary_ja: 精細管上皮の異常で、異数性細胞を特徴とする精巣の上皮内癌を扱う。形態学的、細胞遺伝学的、組織化学的特徴を示し、正確な診断には精巣組織の適切な固定が必要だと強調する。上皮内癌の約半数が5年以内に悪性胚細胞腫瘍へ進展するとし、その浸潤能を支持する。リスクのある集団における発生頻度も概観している。
pmid-2700185.summary_en: This paper examines carcinoma in situ (CIS) of the testis, an abnormality of seminiferous epithelium with aneuploid cells. It describes morphological, cytogenetic, and histochemical features and stresses that adequate fixation of testicular tissue is necessary for accurate diagnosis. The authors note that roughly half of CIS lesions progress to malignant germ cell tumours within five years, supporting its invasive potential. The incidence of CIS among at-risk individuals is also reviewed.

pmid-2702589.summary_ja: 17歳女性に生じた進行性の前縦隔原発悪性奇形腫の症例である。初期治療として動注ヨードデオキシウリジンと放射線照射を行い、多剤化学療法の不奏効後に外科的切除を実施した。治療後23年にわたり無病生存しており、本腫瘍型では稀な長期生存例である。多モダリティ治療による持続的治癒の可能性を示す。
pmid-2702589.summary_en: This case report describes a 17-year-old girl with an advanced primary anterior mediastinal malignant teratoma extending parasternally. Initial treatment included intraarterial iododeoxyuridine and irradiation, followed by surgical resection after multidrug therapy failed. The patient remained free of disease 23 years after therapy, representing rare long-term survival in this uncommon tumor type. The case highlights the potential for durable cure with multimodal management.

pmid-2704010.summary_ja: 卵管結紮術を希望した30歳の経産婦において、左卵管の未熟嚢胞性奇形腫が偶然発見された症例報告である。著者らは、これまで同様の未熟卵管奇形腫は1例しか報告されていないと指摘する。胚細胞由来の奇形腫が卵管のような稀な部位に生じうることを示す。
pmid-2704010.summary_en: This case report describes an immature cystic teratoma of the left fallopian tube, found incidentally in a 30-year-old multiparous woman undergoing tubal ligation. The authors note that only one prior case of immature tubal teratoma had been reported. The finding illustrates that germ cell-derived teratomas may arise in unusual sites such as the fallopian tube and may be identified unexpectedly during routine gynecologic procedures.

pmid-2704139.summary_ja: 日本からの後方視的検討で、術後放射線療法を受けた精巣純粋セミノーマ患者26例を対象とした。5年全生存率は92.3%で、不妊を含む重篤な有害事象は報告されなかった。横隔膜上リンパ節への進展は1例のみであったことから、縦隔への予防的照射は不要と結論された。骨病変2例を含む節外転移は首尾よく治療された。病期Iセミノーマは16年の無病期間後に播種しうるため、長期フォローアップが不可欠であると強調されている。
pmid-2704139.summary_en: This Japanese retrospective review evaluated 26 patients with pure testicular seminoma treated with postoperative radiotherapy. The overall five-year survival was 92.3%, and no severe adverse effects, including sterility, were reported. The authors concluded that prophylactic mediastinal irradiation is unnecessary, since supradiaphragmatic nodal spread occurred in only one patient. Extranodal metastases, including two bone lesions, were successfully treated. The study emphasizes that long-term follow-up is essential because stage I seminoma can disseminate after a 16-year disease-free interval.

pmid-2704337.summary_ja: 23歳女性に生じた原発性縦隔セミノーマの症例報告。原発性縦隔胚細胞悪性腫瘍は若年男性に多いため、女性例は稀である。前縦隔腫瘤の鑑別診断、精査、治療を論じ、評価における磁気共鳴画像法(MRI)の役割を強調している。
pmid-2704337.summary_en: This case report describes a primary mediastinal seminoma in a 23-year-old woman, an unusual presentation since primary mediastinal germ cell malignancies usually affect young men.
