The authors review the differential diagnosis, diagnostic workup, and therapy of anterior mediastinal masses. They emphasize the role of magnetic resonance imaging in evaluating these lesions. The report highlights that such tumors, though uncommon, should be considered in young women presenting with anterior mediastinal masses.

pmid-2704518.summary_ja: 24歳女性の進行期(ステージIII)卵巣未熟奇形腫例。片側卵管卵巣摘出後、化学療法を9コース実施した。セカンドルック手術は陰性で、術後30か月に妊娠し、正期産で健常児を出産した。進行期未熟奇形腫の保存治療後の妊娠成功例は初めての報告とされる。
pmid-2704518.summary_en: This case report describes a 24-year-old woman with stage III grade 3 immature ovarian teratoma treated with unilateral salpingo-oophorectomy followed by nine courses of vincristine, actinomycin D, and cyclophosphamide chemotherapy. A second-look exploration was negative. Thirty months after surgery she conceived and delivered a healthy term infant. The authors state this is the first report of a successful pregnancy after conservative surgery and chemotherapy for advanced-stage immature teratoma, offering fertility-relevant information for young patients.

pmid-2705079.summary_ja: 右副腎領域の腫瘤をコンピュータ断層撮影(CT)で検出し、副腎傍部に生じた典型的な嚢胞性奇形腫と判定した1例の報告。性腺外に発生した稀な部位であり、治療や転帰より画像所見を中心とした短報である。
pmid-2705079.summary_en: This short report describes a para-adrenal teratoma in which computed tomography identified a mass in the right adrenal region. The lesion was characterized as a typical cystic teratoma located in a para-adrenal position, an extragonadal site. The authors use this case to illustrate how CT can help recognize this uncommon tumor location and suggest a teratoma diagnosis preoperatively. The paper is brief and focuses on imaging presentation rather than treatment or outcomes.

pmid-2705742.summary_ja: 絨毛癌細胞と培養血管を用いたin vitro研究。腫瘍細胞を血管壁に播種すると内皮細胞が収縮して下層組織が露出し、その後、腫瘍細胞は内皮下結合組織と内弾性板を貫通した。腫瘍と内皮細胞の相互作用による転移の初期過程を示す。
pmid-2705742.summary_en: This in vitro study examines how choriocarcinoma cells invade blood vessel walls, using cultured blood vessels and tumour cells. Seeding tumour cells onto vessel walls caused endothelial cells to retract, exposing underlying tissue. The tumour cells then penetrated the subendothelial connective tissue and the internal elastic lamina. The findings provide a model of tumour-endothelial interaction relevant to metastasis, which the authors note is the lethal event in most neoplastic diseases.

pmid-2705872.summary_ja: 34歳男性の右精巣に生じた1.5cmの充実性腫瘍の症例報告。組織学的に管状構造が主体で、セミノーマに特徴的な細胞から成る。構造はセルトリ細胞腫に類似し、鑑別診断上注意を要する稀な管状変異型と報告された。
pmid-2705872.summary_en: This case report describes a 34-year-old man with a 1.5-cm solid right testicular tumor. Microscopy showed predominantly solid tubular structures composed of cells with typical seminoma features, with sparse lymphocytic infiltrate. The authors classify it as a rare tubular variant of seminoma whose architecture closely resembles a Sertoli cell tumor, a pattern that could complicate differential diagnosis. The report is primarily a histopathological description of this uncommon morphological variant.

pmid-2707535.summary_ja: 食道壁に浸潤した後縦隔奇形腫の症例報告である。石灰化がなく非典型的な部位に存在する場合、胸部X線写真では診断が困難である。胸部コンピュータ断層撮影(CT)および食道バリウム検査の所見を提示し、病変の性状評価に役立ったことを示す。断面画像と造影検査が、食道浸潤を伴う胸郭内奇形腫の同定において単純X線写真を補完しうることを強調している。
pmid-2707535.summary_en: This case report describes a posterior mediastinal teratoma that invaded the esophageal wall, a presentation that is difficult to detect on chest radiographs when the mass is non-calcified and located in an atypical site. The authors present the computed tomography features of the chest and the barium esophagography findings that helped characterize the lesion. The paper highlights how cross-sectional imaging and contrast studies can complement plain films in identifying intrathoracic teratomas with esophageal involvement.

pmid-2707801.summary_ja: 側腹部痛を呈した30歳男性の後腹膜セミノーマ症例である。正常大の右精巣の超音波検査で不均一なエコーパターンを認め、精巣摘除術で広範な精細管内胚細胞腫瘍が確認された。後腹膜病変と精巣病変が重複原発か、精細管内腫瘍からの転移かを検討している。胚細胞腫瘍における原発巣の判定の難しさを示す症例である。
pmid-2707801.summary_en: A 30-year-old man presented with flank pain and a large retroperitoneal seminoma. Ultrasonography of the normal-sized right testis showed an inhomogeneous echo pattern, and orchiectomy revealed extensive intratubular germ cell neoplasia without extratubular extension. The authors consider whether the retroperitoneal and testicular lesions represent double primaries or whether the retroperitoneal tumor is a metastasis from the intratubular neoplasia. The case illustrates the diagnostic difficulty of assigning the primary site in germ cell tumors.

pmid-2707955.summary_ja: Y染色体を有する個体の索状性腺などに生じる混合性腫瘍、性腺芽腫の免疫組織化学的および超微細構造学的研究である。支持細胞の中間径フィラメントはサイトケラチンおよびビメンチンに反応し、硝子様物質はラミニン陽性で基底膜成分と示された。超微細構造上の棒状凝集は思春期後の精巣のセルトリ細胞に類似し、セルトリ様分化が支持された。
pmid-2707955.summary_en: This study characterizes gonadoblastoma, a mixed tumor of primitive germ cells and sex cord cells that typically arises in streak gonads or abnormal testes of individuals with a Y chromosome. Immunohistochemistry showed that the supporting cells' intermediate filaments react with cytokeratin and vimentin antibodies, and that the hyaline material reacts strongly with laminin, indicating basement membrane. Ultrastructural rodlike filament condensations resembled those of postpubertal Sertoli cells, supporting Sertoli-like differentiation of these cells.

pmid-2709296.summary_ja: 生後9か月時に発見された腹部嚢胞性腫瘍を7歳で外科的切除した台湾の女児の症例報告と文献的考察である。病理学的に線維性嚢内に2つの「胎児」様構造が認められ、胎児内胎児と診断された。後腹膜奇形腫との鑑別や発生機序について論じ、双胎過程から奇形腫への移行か、一卵性二羊膜双胎の取り込みかを検討している。
pmid-2709296.summary_en: This case report describes a Taiwanese girl with a cystic abdominal mass first noted at nine months of age, which was surgically removed at seven years. Pathology revealed two fetus-like structures within a fibrous sac, consistent with fetus in fetu. The review addresses the pathogenesis of this entity and its distinction from retroperitoneal teratoma, and considers whether it reflects a natural progression of twinning toward teratoma or inclusion of a monozygotic diamniotic twin.

pmid-2710951.summary_ja: Joint Center for Radiation Therapyで1968〜1984年に治療された病期Iおよび病期IIの精巣セミノーマ116例の後方視的解析である。10年無再発生存率は全体で94%、病期Iで97%、最大径5cmを超える病期IIcでは75%であった。現在、病期IIcにはシスプラチン併用化学療法の後に放射線療法を行い、縦隔照射は推奨されていない。
pmid-2710951.summary_en: This 17-year retrospective series from the Joint Center for Radiation Therapy treated 116 patients with stage I and II testicular seminoma using radiation therapy. Ten-year relapse-free survival was 94% overall, 97% for stage I, but only 75% for stage IIc, where bulky disease over 5 cm predicted worse survival. Stage IIc patients now receive cisplatin-based chemotherapy followed by radiation to bulk sites, and mediastinal irradiation is no longer recommended.

pmid-2711481.summary_ja: 卵巣成熟奇形腫10例由来の72本の歯と、8〜21歳の被験者由来の萌出前および萌出後の歯12本を走査型電子顕微鏡で比較した研究である。奇形腫内の歯の超微細構造は正所性の歯と類似していたが、形態の明瞭性は低かった。著者らは、口腔内で歯を取り囲む隣接組織の誘導作用が関与すると考察している。
pmid-2711481.summary_en: This study examined 72 teeth from ten ovarian mature teratomas and 12 unerupted and erupted teeth from subjects aged 8 to 21 years using scanning electron microscopy. Teratomatous teeth showed ultrastructure similar to orthotopic teeth, but their morphology was less well defined. The authors attribute this to the inductive influence of adjacent tissues that normally surround teeth in the oral cavity.

pmid-2712191.summary_ja: 卵巣成熟嚢胞性奇形腫に発生した扁平上皮癌28例を解析した研究である。5年生存率は52%であった。予後因子は病期、組織学的分化度、脈管侵襲であった。連続切片による検討から、多くの扁平上皮癌は奇形腫内の円柱上皮または化生性扁平上皮に由来すると示唆された。奇形腫の通常の表皮から直接移行した例は認められなかった。
pmid-2712191.summary_en: This study analyzed 28 patients with squamous cell carcinoma arising in ovarian mature cystic teratoma. The 5-year survival rate was 52%. Prognostic factors included clinical stage, histologic differentiation of the carcinoma, and vascular invasion. Histologic and serial-section analyses suggested that most SCCs originated from columnar or metaplastic squamous epithelium within the teratoma rather than directly from the ordinary epidermis, supporting a columnar epithelial origin for these carcinomas.

pmid-2712240.summary_ja: 一施設で11年間に経験した小児の性腺・性腺外卵黄嚢腫瘍9例のレビューである。発生部位は膣、顔面、仙骨、縦隔、卵巣、精巣など多様で、性腺外例が多かった。全例で αフェトプロテイン(AFP)が上昇していた。多剤併用化学療法が行われ、3例が無病生存、5例が死亡した。
pmid-2712240.summary_en: This retrospective review describes nine children with gonadal and extragonadal yolk sac tumors treated over 11 years at a single center. Sites included the vagina, face, sacrum, mediastinum, ovary, and testis, with a predominance of extragonadal disease. All had elevated AFP. Most tumors were unresectable, and patients received multiagent chemotherapy, with biopsy alone in six. Five children died, while three remained disease-free at follow-up. The authors note an unusual preponderance of extragonadal endodermal sinus tumors in their population.

pmid-2713991.summary_ja: 92歳女性に発見された卵巣甲状腺腫の症例報告である。甲状腺機能異常を伴っていた。卵巣甲状腺腫は主に甲状腺組織から成る特殊型の卵巣奇形腫である。極めて稀な病態で、高齢者における症例は文献上も限られる。
pmid-2713991.summary_en: This case report describes struma ovarii, a monodermal teratoma composed predominantly of thyroid tissue, in a 92-year-old woman with altered thyroid function. Struma ovarii is a specialized form of ovarian teratoma. The report is brief, presenting the clinical presentation of an elderly patient with thyroid dysfunction associated with this rare ovarian tumor. It adds to the limited literature on struma ovarii in advanced age.

pmid-2714404.summary_ja: F9およびPC13胎児性癌細胞のフィブロネクチンおよびラミニンへの接着能を比較した研究である。内胚葉様細胞への分化によりラミニンへの接着は低下したが、フィブロネクチンへの接着は保たれた。奇形癌由来の内胚葉細胞株でも同様であった。胎児性癌幹細胞の接着機構が分化により変化することが示唆された。
pmid-2714404.summary_en: This study compares adhesion of F9 and PC13 embryonal carcinoma cells to fibronectin and laminin. Upon induction toward visceral or parietal endoderm-like differentiation, F9 cells lost adherence to laminin but retained adherence to fibronectin. Permanently differentiated teratocarcinoma-derived endoderm lines behaved similarly. Adhesion to fibronectin fragments depended on the cell-binding site, and gelatin adhesion required protein synthesis. The authors conclude that embryonal carcinoma stem cells possess specific adhesion mechanisms that endodermal differentiation alters.

pmid-2714406.summary_ja: 胎児性癌細胞の代謝協同欠損と微絨毛の関係を検討した短報である。欠損株から復帰株を単離し、協同能と微絨毛の出現頻度は逆相関した。独立した先行研究と合わせ、微絨毛が細胞間通信の欠損に因果的に関与すると結論された。
pmid-2714406.summary_en: This short report links microvilli to metabolic cooperation deficiency in embryonal carcinoma cells. A revertant clone was isolated from the cooperation-deficient PT2md1 line. Across the deficient line, its cooperation-competent parent, and the revertant, an inverse relation between cooperation competence and microvillus incidence was found. Combined with a similar prior observation in independent lines, the authors argue for a causal relationship between microvilli and intercellular communication deficiency.

pmid-2717741.summary_ja: 卵巣嚢胞性奇形腫38例（良性41病変、悪性転化2例）に対するCTの診断能を検討した研究である。全腫瘍が描出され、脂肪や石灰化などの所見で98%が確定診断可能であった。大きな不整な充実性成分は悪性転化を示唆した。CTは奇形腫の画像診断に最も優れた検査と結論された。
pmid-2717741.summary_en: This study evaluated CT for detecting ovarian cystic teratomas in 38 patients with 41 benign tumors and two with malignant transformation. CT identified all tumors, with fat, calcification, Rokitansky protuberance, and hair tufts enabling a definite diagnosis in 98% of cases. Malignant transformation was suggested by large solid components with irregular borders. CT was judged superior to radiography, hysterosalpingography, ultrasound, and MRI for imaging cystic teratomas, supporting its role in preoperative assessment.

pmid-2718768.summary_ja: 71歳男性の右上葉に生じた絨毛癌と腺癌の合併例で、肺、腎臓、骨髄、リンパ節に転移を認めた。絨毛癌細胞はヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)に強陽性であった。腺癌細胞はCEAやケラチンに陽性であった。肺原発絨毛癌は腺癌の脱分化により生じる可能性が示唆された。
pmid-2718768.summary_en: This case report describes a 71-year-old Japanese man with combined choriocarcinoma and adenocarcinoma in the right upper lung, with separate metastases to lungs, kidney, bone marrow, and lymph nodes. Immunohistochemistry showed intense hCG staining in trophoblastic cells, while adenocarcinoma cells stained for CEA, EMA, keratin, and KM-93. The authors propose that primary pulmonary choriocarcinoma may arise through dedifferentiation of adenocarcinoma, a hypothesis supported by these phenotypic findings.

pmid-2720636.summary_ja: 絨毛癌由来の4株（BeWo、DoSmi、ElFa、Jar）について染色体解析を行い、全株に広範な染色体再構成と一定したマーカー染色体を認めた。その多くは絨毛癌で従来報告のないものであった。1、7、9、10、12番染色体の再構成が共通してみられ、再構成に関与する切断点は86箇所に及んだ。本研究は、この悪性栄養膜腫瘍の細胞遺伝学的基盤を示すものである。
pmid-2720636.summary_en: Four human choriocarcinoma cell lines (BeWo, DoSmi, ElFa and Jar) were characterised by Q-, G- and C-banding at several passages. All lines showed extensive chromosomal rearrangements and several consistent marker chromosomes, many not previously recognised in choriocarcinoma. Rearrangements of chromosomes 1, 7, 9, 10 and 12 were common, and telomeric associations involving chromosomes 11, 21, 3 and 12 produced two recurrent markers. Most of the 86 breakpoints in shared rearrangements mapped to chromosomes 1, 3, 9, 13, 12, 7 and 21. The study provides a cytogenetic baseline for this malignant trophoblastic tumour.

pmid-2721586.summary_ja: 胎児性癌細胞株PSA4TG12と胚性幹細胞E14の分化を、凝集、レチノイン酸、BRL細胞馴化培地の単独および併用条件下で比較した基礎研究である。馴化培地は複数の作用を持ち、レチノイン酸は異なる濃度域で作用する少なくとも2つの効果を示した。両因子は分化経路の選択と分化の程度の双方に影響した。胎児性癌の多能性モデルとしての理解に資する研究である。
pmid-2721586.summary_en: This experimental study examines how aggregation, retinoic acid and Buffalo rat liver cell-conditioned medium, alone and in combination, influence differentiation of PSA4TG12 embryonal carcinoma cells and E14 embryonic stem cells. The findings show that conditioned medium exerts more than one effect on differentiation, and that retinoic acid acts through at least two mechanisms operating in different concentration ranges. Both agents influence the choice of differentiation pathway as well as the extent of differentiation. The work informs understanding of embryonal carcinoma as a pluripotent model system.

pmid-2722058.summary_ja: 1960～1984年にイスラエルで診断された妊娠中の卵巣悪性腫瘍23例を解析した。境界悪性腫瘍が最も多く、ディスジャーミノーマ（未分化胚細胞腫）は17%を占めた。患者の74%は病期Iで、保存的手術後に23例中14例が生児を得た。進行例には積極的手術、化学療法、放射線療法が必要とされた。予後は年齢、組織型、病期に左右された。全体として多くは低悪性度で早期に発見されるため、生存率は一般の卵巣腫瘍より良好であった。
pmid-2722058.summary_en: This Israeli population-based study reviews 23 malignant ovarian tumours diagnosed during pregnancy between 1960 and 1984, an incidence of 0.12 per 100,000 women over 14. Borderline tumours were most common, followed by invasive epithelial tumours, dysgerminomas (17%), granulosa cell tumours and undifferentiated carcinomas. Most patients had stage I disease, and 14 of 23 women bore a live child after conservative surgery. Advanced disease required aggressive surgery, chemotherapy and/or radiotherapy. Prognosis depended on age, histology and stage, and survival exceeded that of ovarian tumours overall.

pmid-2722068.summary_ja: 進行卵巣未分化胚細胞腫の女性が、化学療法の第5コース後に発熱を伴う癌性髄膜炎を発症した症例報告である。脳実質病変はなく、軟膜に病変が残存していた。血液脳関門が化学療法薬を排除することが一因とされる。頭蓋脊髄照射により反応が得られ、治療終了後2年間無病であった。孤立性髄膜再発でも治癒し得ることを示す。
pmid-2722068.summary_en: This case report describes a patient with advanced ovarian dysgerminoma who developed febrile carcinomatous meningitis two weeks after her fifth course of combination chemotherapy, about five months after treatment began. No parenchymal brain disease was found. The authors attribute persistence of disease in the leptomeninges to the blood-brain barrier excluding chemotherapeutic agents. Craniospinal radiation produced a response, and the patient remained disease-free two years after completing treatment, suggesting that isolated meningeal recurrence can be curable.

pmid-2723988.summary_ja: 新生児の悪性頸部奇形腫で、肝臓、肺、臀部に大きな先天性転移を伴う症例を報告する。急性期には気道閉塞が主な懸念であった。磁気共鳴画像法(MRI)で病変を描出し、肉眼的病変を対象に4段階で根治的切除を計画・実施し、良好な経過を得た。これまで同様の症例は報告されていないとされる。
pmid-2723988.summary_en: This paediatric surgical report describes a neonate with malignant cervical teratoma and large congenital metastases to liver, lung and buttocks. Airway obstruction was the main acute concern, and total excision is essential for benign lesions, while malignant lesions carry a risk of later metastatic death. MRI was valuable for delineating lesions and planning a four-stage curative resection of all macroscopic disease. The authors state that such a case had not been reported previously.

pmid-2724737.summary_ja: 10歳女児に発生した縦隔後部奇形腫の症例報告である。縦隔の一般的部位である前上部とは異なる後部の発生例である。開胸手術により切除された。T1強調、T2強調SE像およびIR像を用いた磁気共鳴画像法(MRI)が、腫瘤影の性状の臨床診断に有用であった。小児の縦隔奇形腫の画像診断におけるMRIの価値を示す。
pmid-2724737.summary_en: This Japanese case report describes a 10-year-old girl with a teratoma of the posterior mediastinum, a location less common than the typical anterosuperior mediastinum. She underwent thoracotomy at the authors' department. Magnetic resonance imaging using T1-weighted, T2-weighted spin-echo and inversion-recovery sequences was useful for the clinical diagnosis of the nature of the mass shadow. The report highlights the diagnostic value of MRI for mediastinal teratoma in children.

pmid-2724976.summary_ja: 縦隔成熟奇形腫、気管支原性嚢胞、肺分画症などの良性嚢胞性病変で、血清および嚢胞液のCA19-9とCEAを測定した研究です。CA19-9は嚢胞内で高濃度となり、血中へ移行する可能性が示唆されました。術後には正常化しています。CEAは免疫学的交差反応性のものと考えられました。良性嚢胞でも腫瘍マーカーが上昇しうることを示します。
pmid-2724976.summary_en: This study measured serum CA 19-9 and CEA in patients with benign pulmonary or mediastinal cystic lesions, including pulmonary sequestration, bronchogenic cysts, and mediastinal mature teratomas. CA 19-9 was elevated in serum and cyst fluid and normalized after surgery. Mucosal epithelium stained positive for CA 19-9. CEA was high in cyst fluid, and its staining pattern suggested immunologically cross-reacting CEA rather than true tumor CEA. The authors suggest cyst-concentrated CA 19-9 may leak into the blood, so tumor markers can be misleading in benign cystic disease.

pmid-2725975.summary_ja: HIV感染を合併した患者に生じた精巣セミノーマの症例報告です。腫瘍間質にリンパ球浸潤がみられない非典型的な像を示しました。HIV感染では、カポジ肉腫や非ホジキンリンパ腫などの腫瘍リスクが上昇することが知られています。HIV陽性者のセミノーマが典型像と異なる場合があることを示す報告です。
pmid-2725975.summary_en: This case report describes a patient with HIV infection who had testicular seminoma. The tumor presented atypically, with no lymphocytic infiltrates within the stroma. The authors note that HIV infection has been associated with increased incidence of Kaposi sarcoma, non-Hodgkin lymphoma, oropharyngeal carcinoma, and pancreatic carcinoma. The report highlights that seminoma in HIV-positive patients may not follow typical histologic features, which can complicate diagnosis.

pmid-2726609.summary_ja: 未熟卵巣奇形腫に伴う腹膜神経膠腫症の小児・青年13例を解析した研究です。GFAPとS-100陽性の成熟グリア結節が特徴で、13例中12例が生存しています。予後は移植巣の成熟度に依存し、未熟な病変では化学療法により成熟が誘導される可能性があります。
pmid-2726609.summary_en: This clinicopathological study reviews 13 children and adolescents with gliomatosis peritonei, peritoneal implants of neural tissue arising in immature ovarian teratomas. Most patients had the implants discovered together with the primary tumor, and two at second-look surgery. Immunohistochemistry showed GFAP and S-100 positive astroglia in mature implants. Twelve of 13 patients were alive and clinically healthy at follow-up. Prognosis depends on implant maturity, and chemotherapy may induce maturation of immature implants.

pmid-2726948.summary_ja: 1972年から1986年にデラウェア州で診断された精巣胚細胞がん135例を解析した研究です。セミノーマが52%を占め、組織型により年齢分布が異なりました。地域での10年生存率は90%を超えています。早期診断、積極的治療、フォローアップの重要性を指摘しています。
pmid-2726948.summary_en: This population-based analysis reviews 135 germ cell testicular cancers diagnosed in Delaware between 1972 and 1986. Seminomas comprised 52% of cases, with significant age differences between histologic types. Adjusted ten-year survival in the community exceeded 90%. The authors argue that earlier diagnosis, more aggressive therapy, and careful follow-up, especially for teratocarcinomas, could improve outcomes. They also note that recurrent slow-growing seminomas merit curative chemotherapy and encourage prospective community studies.

pmid-2727187.summary_ja: クロマトフォーカシングにより、ヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)の多様な分子形を分離解析した研究です。胞状奇胎や絨毛癌由来のhCGは主に酸性を示しました。妊娠末期や妊娠中毒症では塩基性が優位で、由来によって適切なpH範囲が異なります。絨毛癌や胞状奇胎のマーカー測定への応用が期待されます。
pmid-2727187.summary_en: This study uses chromatofocusing to separate multiple forms of hCG from biological fluids. Purified hCG was acidic, with pI 4.22-3.8, and hCG beta was more acidic. hCG from first-trimester pregnancy, hydatidiform mole, and choriocarcinoma was predominantly acidic, whereas hCG from third-trimester pregnancy and toxemia of pregnancy was mainly alkaline. Different pH ranges are therefore needed to analyze hCG from different clinical sources, which is relevant to tracking gestational trophoblastic disease and choriocarcinoma markers.

pmid-2727931.summary_ja: 後腹膜奇形腫の内部に、2体の整った胎児が含まれていた症例の報告です。後腹膜奇形腫は稀で、多くは良性です。指や四肢などの高度に組織化された構造を含むことがあります。奇形腫内に胎児が存在する例は極めてまれであり、本例はその記録となります。
pmid-2727931.summary_en: This report describes a retroperitoneal teratoma containing two well-formed fetuses. The authors note that teratomas arise infrequently in the retroperitoneum and are usually benign, and that they may contain highly organized structures such as digits and limbs. The presence of a well-formed fetus within a teratoma is extremely rare, and this case documents two fetuses embedded within the retroperitoneal tumor.

pmid-2728152.summary_ja: 31歳男性の精巣の奇形腫が、良性の分化型の形態で転移した稀な症例の報告です。文献を概説しています。成熟様の組織像を保つ奇形腫が転移する例は稀です。転移病変が良性の像を示すことがあり、評価やフォローアップを難しくする可能性があります。
pmid-2728152.summary_en: This report describes a 31-year-old man with an unusual adult teratoma of the testis that metastasized in benign, differentiated form. The authors review the literature on this presentation. Metastasis of a testicular teratoma that retains mature-appearing histology is unusual. The case shows that metastatic lesions may remain benign in appearance, which can complicate interpretation and surveillance.

pmid-2732884.summary_ja: 口腔から突出する稀な先天性の奇形腫様腫瘍であるエピグナサスについて、新生児2例を報告している。本腫瘍は新生児に呼吸困難を生じるため、出生直後の気道確保が重要となる。症例の臨床経過を示し、奇形腫としての特徴と緊急性を提示した。奇形腫に関する症例報告として位置づけられる。
pmid-2732884.summary_en: This report describes two neonatal cases of epignathus, a rare congenital teratoid tumor that protrudes through the mouth and causes respiratory distress in newborns. Epignathus is a teratoma-type lesion of the oral and pharyngeal region. The paper documents the clinical presentation in two infants and highlights the airway emergency such lesions pose. It is a case-based contribution to the teratoma literature.

pmid-2733088.summary_ja: HIVに感染した男性2例に精巣セミノーマが発症した症例を報告している。1例はAIDS、もう1例はAIDS関連症候群であり、いずれも精巣セミノーマの既知の危険因子は認められなかった。AIDSおよびAIDS関連症候群の患者ではセミノーマのリスクが高まる可能性を支持する所見と考察されている。
pmid-2733088.summary_en: This report describes two HIV-positive homosexual men diagnosed with testicular seminoma, one with AIDS and one with AIDS-related complex. Neither had a known risk factor for testicular seminoma. The authors argue that the cases provide supportive evidence for an increased risk of seminoma in patients with AIDS and AIDS-related complex. Clinical features, including immune parameters and opportunistic infections, are described for both patients.

pmid-2735231.summary_ja: 絨毛癌を標的とする抗ヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)β抗体結合リポソームによるアドリアマイシン送達の有用性を検討した基礎研究である。担がんマウスでは抗体が4時間以内に腫瘍組織へ集積し、その後も増加した。培養BeWo細胞では、リポソーム製剤でのみ薬剤の核内集積が認められた。免疫標的化化学療法の担体として有望と結論されている。
pmid-2735231.summary_en: This preclinical study tests whether anti-hCG beta antibody-conjugated liposomes can deliver adriamycin specifically to choriocarcinoma. In mice bearing human choriocarcinoma, the antibody accumulated in tumor tissue within four hours and increased over time. In vitro, BeWo cells showed nuclear accumulation of adriamycin when exposed to liposomal formulations, but not to free drug. The authors conclude that liposomes are a promising carrier for immunotargeted chemotherapy of choriocarcinoma.

pmid-2735272.summary_ja: 53歳男性が左下腹部痛で受診し、直腸診と画像検査で膀胱後腔腫瘍が疑われた。手術では周囲臓器と癒着しない被包性腫瘍を認め、完全切除した。病理診断は成熟奇形腫で、術後1年時点で再発なく生存している。膀胱後部奇形腫の本邦報告は本例が2例目とされる稀な症例である。
pmid-2735272.summary_en: A case report of a 53-year-old man with left lower abdominal pain and a retrovesical tumor. At surgery, an encapsulated tumor occupied the retrovesical space without adhering to the prostate, seminal vesicles, bladder, or rectum, and it was completely resected. Histopathology showed a mature teratoma. The patient remained alive without recurrence one year after surgery. The authors note this is only the second reported case of retrovesical teratoma in the Japanese literature, highlighting an uncommon extragonadal site.

pmid-2736112.summary_ja: 1982年以降、バルキーセミノーマ24例にVIP化学療法（ビンブラスチン・イホスファミド・シスプラチン）を施行した。21例（87%）が完全寛解に至り、中央観察期間は30か月超である。1例が再発したが、反復治療で寛解を得た。骨髄毒性が強く、半数以上で減量を要したため、ビンブラスチンの減量が推奨された。
pmid-2736112.summary_en: Retrospective report of 24 patients with bulky seminoma treated with the VIP regimen (vinblastine, ifosfamide, cisplatin) from 1982 onward. Complete remission was achieved in 21 of 24 patients (87%), with a median observation of over 30 months. One patient relapsed but achieved remission after repeated therapy. Bone marrow toxicity was severe, requiring dose reduction in more than half of patients. The authors recommend reducing the vinblastine dose because of this toxicity.

pmid-2736486.summary_ja: 1970～1982年に横隔膜下放射線療法を受けた精巣がん患者357例の晩期合併症を評価した。重篤な合併症は稀で、消化器症状は軽度が多かった。正中面線量が40Gy未満では消化器リスクが低く、生殖機能への影響は有意ではなかった。病期Iセミノーマに対しては、正中面線量36Gy以下が推奨される。
pmid-2736486.summary_en: A study of 357 men treated with infradiaphragmatic radiotherapy for testicular cancer between 1970 and 1982. Myelopathy, osteomyelitis, and hepatitis were rare. Gastrointestinal symptoms were common in questionnaire responses but mild, and postirradiation peptic ulcer occurred in 9%. Risk increased with midplane dose, and gonadal toxicity was not significant. The authors conclude that radiotherapy is a safe adjuvant treatment for stage I seminoma when the midplane dose does not exceed 36 Gy.

pmid-2736493.summary_ja: 卵巣成熟嚢胞性奇形腫に扁平上皮癌が発生した6例で、血清TA-4を測定した。術前に6例中5例で上昇し、良性の卵巣成熟嚢胞性奇形腫28例では上昇はなかった。経時的測定は臨床経過と相関し、2例では臨床的再発に2か月先行した。悪性転化の診断と経過観察に有用と考えられる。
pmid-2736493.summary_en: Six cases of squamous cell carcinoma arising in ovarian mature cystic teratomas were evaluated for serum TA-4, a squamous cell carcinoma-associated antigen. Five of six had elevated preoperative TA-4 levels, whereas none of 28 patients with benign mature cystic teratomas did. Serial TA-4 measurements correlated with the clinical course and preceded clinical recurrence by two months in two patients. The authors suggest TA-4 may aid diagnosis and monitoring of this malignant transformation.

pmid-2737525.summary_ja: コネチカット腫瘍登録から1969～1984年の純粋型卵巣未熟奇形腫25例を検討した。大多数は病期Iであった。再発は悪性度3の2例で、いずれも外科的切除と化学療法で治療された。病期I・悪性度1・2では保存的手術のみで化学療法を省略してよく、悪性度3では追加化学療法が妥当とされる。
pmid-2737525.summary_en: A review of 25 patients with pure immature teratoma of the ovary from the Connecticut Tumor Registry (1969 to 1984). Most patients were stage I at initial surgery. The two recurrences occurred in grade 3 tumors and were treated with surgical resection and chemotherapy. No deaths were attributed to immature teratoma. The authors suggest that chemotherapy can be withheld in stage I, grade 1 and 2 tumors treated with conservative surgery, while grade 3 tumors warrant further chemotherapy.

pmid-2737530.summary_ja: 培養下でメトトレキサートに耐性を獲得させた絨毛癌細胞株（HCCM、CC1）の耐性機構を解析した。CC1由来株では主に薬剤輸送の障害が低度耐性の原因であった。HCCM由来株では、遺伝子増幅によるジヒドロ葉酸還元酵素（DHFR）の過剰産生が高度耐性に関与していた。DHFR増幅を伴わない細胞にもダブルミニッツが存在し、別の機構も示唆された。
pmid-2737530.summary_en: Mechanisms of methotrexate resistance were studied in two human choriocarcinoma cell lines (HCCM and CC1) selected for resistance in culture. Low-level resistance in CC1-derived sublines was mainly due to impaired methotrexate transport. High-level resistance in HCCM-derived sublines involved overproduction of dihydrofolate reductase from gene amplification. Double minutes were present, but some cells with them lacked DHFR amplification, indicating additional mechanisms.

pmid-2738669.summary_ja: 42歳女性が、悪性卵巣甲状腺腫からの単発性脊椎転移（T2）による対麻痺で受診した。甲状腺原発は除外された。転移巣に対し外科的切除と131I投与2回を行い、症状は消失した。全身シンチグラフィーの再検査でも異常は認めなかった。卵巣甲状腺腫由来腫瘍の稀な転移経路を示す症例である。
pmid-2738669.summary_en: A 42-year-old woman presented with paraparesis due to a solitary spinal metastasis (T2) from malignant struma ovarii, with the thyroid excluded as the primary site. The metastasis was treated with surgical resection and two doses of radioactive iodine (131I, 200 mCi each). She responded well, is free of symptoms, and a repeat whole-body iodine scan shows no abnormality. The case illustrates a rare metastatic route for ovarian struma-derived tumors.

pmid-2740345.summary_ja: マウス胎児性癌株402AXとPCC4は、H-2KおよびH-2D抗原を欠くにもかかわらず生体内で免疫学的に拒絶される。本研究では、両細胞株がQa-2およびTla領域のクラスI様遺伝子を転写し、非古典的クラスI蛋白と会合する低レベルのβ2-ミクログロブリンを発現することを示した。移植実験から、拒絶はクラスI様MHC抗原を介することが示唆された。ヒト患者ではなく前臨床の基礎研究である。
pmid-2740345.summary_en: This basic immunology study examined two murine embryonal carcinoma tumor lines, 402AX and PCC4, which are immunologically rejected in vivo despite lacking H-2K and H-2D antigens. The authors found that these cells transcribe class I-like Qa-2 and Tla region genes and express low levels of beta 2-microglobulin associated with non-classical class I proteins. Transplantation experiments suggested that rejection is mediated by class-I-like MHC antigens. The findings provide a first step toward understanding possible roles of Qa/Tla molecules in embryonic cell interactions and antitumor immunity. The study is preclinical and uses murine cell lines rather than patient samples.

pmid-2742461.summary_ja: 56歳女性が卵巣腫瘤に対し開腹術を受けた際、子宮仙骨靱帯の成熟奇形腫内に下垂体組織が偶発的に見つかった。卵巣の嚢胞性奇形腫で下垂体組織が認められた報告はまれである。成熟した腺下垂体と神経下垂体からなる性腺外の良性嚢胞性奇形腫は文献上1例のみで、本症例は珍しい性腺外奇形腫の一例である。
pmid-2742461.summary_en: A 56-year-old woman underwent exploratory laparotomy for ovarian masses and was incidentally found to have pituitary tissue within a mature teratoma of the uterosacral ligament. Pituitary tissue has rarely been reported in benign cystic ovarian teratomas, and ectopic pituitary adenomas occur. The authors identified only one prior report of an extragonadal benign cystic teratoma containing mature adenohypophyseal and neurohypophyseal elements. The case illustrates an unusual extragonadal teratoma with neuroendocrine-derived components.

pmid-2743762.summary_ja: コネチカット腫瘍登録の卵巣ディスジャーミノーマ13例を解析した。病期I 7例のうち2例は性腺芽腫内に発生していた。手術、放射線療法、VAC等の併用化学療法で治療され、腫瘍死は認められなかった。進行・再発例における放射線療法の役割と、妊孕性温存のための保存的手術後の化学療法の重要性が示された。
pmid-2743762.summary_en: Thirteen patients with ovarian dysgerminoma from the Connecticut Tumor Registry (1974-1984) were reviewed. Seven were stage I at surgery, two of whom had dysgerminoma arising in gonadoblastoma. Six had advanced disease. Treatments included adnexal surgery, total abdominal hysterectomy with bilateral salpingo-oophorectomy, radiation therapy, and combination chemotherapy such as VAC and VAB-VI. No patient died from the tumor. The authors highlight radiation therapy's role in advanced and recurrent disease and the growing use of chemotherapy after conservative surgery to preserve fertility.

pmid-2743946.summary_ja: 76歳女性が鮮紅色の直腸出血で受診し、内視鏡でS状結腸に毛髪を伴う有茎性病変を認めた。組織学的に三胚葉の成分からなり、奇形腫の基準を満たした。この良性結腸ポリープの鑑別診断と臨床的意義が論じられている。性腺外の大腸に生じたまれな良性奇形腫の一例である。
pmid-2743946.summary_en: A 76-year-old woman presented with bright red rectal bleeding, and endoscopy revealed a polypoid lesion sprouting hair in the sigmoid colon. Histology showed elements of all three germ layers, meeting the criteria for teratoma. The authors discuss the differential diagnosis of this benign colonic polyp and its clinical significance. The case represents a rare extragonadal benign teratoma arising in the colon, an unusual site outside the gonads.

pmid-2744756.summary_ja: 28歳の女性の片側卵巣に、性腺芽腫とディスジャーミノーマ（未分化胚細胞腫）が併存したまれな症例の報告である。患者は健常な子を2人持つ。性腺胚細胞腫瘍のこの組み合わせは極めてまれであり、卵巣胚細胞腫瘍の多様な病理像を示す貴重な症例である。
pmid-2744756.summary_en: This case report describes a rare unilateral ovarian gonadoblastoma coexisting with dysgerminoma in a 28-year-old woman who had two healthy children. Gonadoblastoma with dysgerminoma is an unusual combination of gonadal germ cell neoplasms within a single ovary. The report highlights the rarity of this presentation in an adult patient and underscores the diverse histologic patterns that ovarian germ cell tumors can display.

pmid-2745460.summary_ja: 絨毛癌細胞（悪性栄養膜細胞）で発現する胚細胞型ALP遺伝子を解析した基礎研究である。絨毛癌ALPは胎盤ALPと阻害剤感受性や移動度、mRNAサイズが異なる。酪酸処理で発現が増加し、cDNAクローニングにより遺伝子のエクソンIとXIの構造が明らかにされた。
pmid-2745460.summary_en: This study characterizes the germ cell alkaline phosphatase gene expressed in human choriocarcinoma cells, which are malignant trophoblasts. Choriocarcinoma ALP differs from placental ALP in inhibitor sensitivity, electrophoretic mobility, and mRNA size (2.6 kb versus 2.8 kb). Butyrate increases expression of the choriocarcinoma transcript. Using cDNA cloning and nuclease protection assays, the authors define exons I and XI of this gene, which is normally expressed in thymus, testis, and germ cell tumors.

pmid-2746749.summary_ja: 精巣摘除術後に補助放射線療法を行わない監視療法を、精巣限局の純粋セミノーマ81例で評価した。臨床診察、リンパ管造影、CT、胸部X線、血清マーカーで3〜43か月追跡した。再発は3例のみで、いずれも非巨大な後腹膜病変であった。1例はβ-hCGの上昇を示し、潜在性の非セミノーマが示唆された。監視療法は転帰を損なわないと結論された。
pmid-2746749.summary_en: This study evaluated surveillance without adjuvant radiotherapy after orchiectomy in 81 patients with pure seminoma confined to the testis. Patients were followed with clinical examinations, lymphograms, CT, chest radiographs, and serum markers for 3 to 43 months. Only three relapsed, all with nonbulky retroperitoneal disease, and one later showed a rising beta-hCG suggesting occult nonseminoma. The authors conclude that surveillance in place of routine radiotherapy did not appear to compromise outcome, though longer follow-up is needed.

pmid-2747937.summary_ja: 絨毛癌の脳転移による転移性動脈瘤の破裂例を報告し、文献上の14例を併せて概説している。治療は切除後に化学療法と全脳放射線療法を行うのが基本とされるが、予後は不良である。胚細胞腫瘍の転移形式として稀な病態であり、病理学的意義を論じている。
pmid-2747937.summary_en: This case report describes a ruptured cerebral aneurysm arising from metastatic choriocarcinoma, a rare manifestation of metastatic germ cell disease. The authors also summarize fourteen previously reported cases from the literature. They discuss the pathological significance of this presentation and note that the treatment of choice is excision followed by chemotherapy and whole-brain irradiation, with a poor prognosis.

pmid-2748840.summary_ja: 1966〜1985年に単施設で治療された病期II精巣セミノーマ32例の成績である。根治的精巣摘除術後に横隔膜下照射を行い、多くで縦隔・鎖骨上窩照射も加えられた。中央値8年半の追跡で大多数が生存し、再発は縦隔と非照射側鼠径部に生じたが、救済治療で治癒した。
pmid-2748840.summary_en: This study reports outcomes of 32 patients with stage II testicular seminoma treated at one institution from 1966 to 1985. All received radical orchiectomy followed by infradiaphragmatic irradiation, and 28 also received planned mediastinal and supraclavicular irradiation. With a median follow-up of 8.5 years, most patients remained alive and well. Recurrences in the mediastinum were cured, and one nonseminomatous recurrence in an unirradiated inguinal node responded to chemotherapy.

pmid-2752694.summary_ja: 精巣奇形腫の治療歴がある患者が不妊外来を受診した症例報告です。精液検査で偶然に精巣上皮内癌を疑う異型細胞が見つかり、残存精巣の生検で確定しました。著者らは、ライディッヒ細胞機能を温存しつつ胚細胞上皮を除去するため、精巣への放射線療法を提案しています。胚細胞腫瘍治療後の生存者における精液細胞診と長期経過観察の重要性を示した報告です。
pmid-2752694.summary_en: This case report describes a man previously treated for testicular teratoma who was evaluated at an infertility clinic. Semen analysis incidentally showed atypical cells suggestive of testicular carcinoma in situ, later confirmed by biopsy of the remaining testis. The authors propose radiotherapy to the testis to ablate germinal epithelium while preserving Leydig cell function. The report highlights the value of semen cytology and long-term surveillance in survivors after germ cell tumor treatment.

pmid-2753421.summary_ja: 卵巣の悪性非ジャーミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍33例に対し、ビンクリスチン・ダクチノマイシン・シクロホスファミド療法を一次治療として施行した研究です。解析対象32例の治癒率は68.7%で、シスプラチン・ビンブラスチン・ブレオマイシン療法と同程度と報告されています。悪性胚細胞腫瘍におけるセカンドルック開腹術の役割についても考察されています。卵巣胚細胞腫瘍の治療戦略と効果判定を考えるうえで参考になる報告です。
pmid-2753421.summary_en: This study evaluated primary treatment of malignant nondysgerminomatous germ cell tumors of the ovary with a vincristine, dactinomycin, and cyclophosphamide regimen in 33 patients, 32 of whom were analyzable. The overall cure rate was 68.7 percent, which the authors describe as comparable to that of the cisplatin, vinblastine, and bleomycin regimen. The article also discusses the role of second-look laparotomy in managing malignant germ cell tumors. It offers practical insight into treatment strategy and response assessment for ovarian germ cell tumor patients.

pmid-2753429.summary_ja: 卵巣の成熟嚢胞性奇形腫内に多発性の神経外胚葉性腫瘍が生じた症例の報告です。奇形腫には神経成分が認められることが多いものの、これほど多発した例は報告がないと著者らは述べています。卵巣奇形腫から悪性神経腫瘍が生じることは稀とされています。神経成分を伴う卵巣胚細胞腫瘍の病理診断や悪性転化の評価に参考となる症例です。
pmid-2753429.summary_en: This report describes multiple neuroectodermal tumor foci arising within a mature cystic teratoma of the ovary, a finding the authors state has not been previously described. The introduction reviews the frequency of benign cystic teratomas among ovarian tumors and the presence of neural elements within them. It notes that malignant neural neoplasms arising in ovarian teratomas are rare. The case is relevant to pathologists and clinicians evaluating ovarian germ cell tumors with neural components and their potential for malignant transformation.

pmid-2755080.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍の異種移植片を用いて、パラフィン包埋切片から染色体異常を検出する間期細胞遺伝学の手法を開発した研究です。染色体1q12のプローブを用い、組織内および培養細胞で異数性の腫瘍細胞やサブクローンを検出できました。体液や腫瘍組織中の特定の染色体異常を直接捉える応用の可能性についても論じられています。
pmid-2755080.summary_en: This methods study developed an interphase cytogenetics protocol to detect chromosome 1 aberrations in paraffin-embedded sections of human testicular germ cell tumor xenografts. Tissue from three xenografts, two teratocarcinomas and one embryonal carcinoma, was hybridized with a biotin-labeled 1q12 probe and compared with cultured cells and normal tissues. Tumor cells with abnormal chromosome 1 copy numbers and subclones were reliably detected both in vitro and in vivo. The authors discuss future applications for detecting chromosomal aberrations in body fluids or tumor tissue.

pmid-2763798.summary_ja: 中枢神経系外に生じた奇形腫10例を、免疫組織化学染色とレクチン染色で検討した研究です。10例中8例でミクログリアが確認され、その多くは神経成熟を示す成熟領域に分布していました。未熟な組織内には前駆細胞様の細胞も認められました。中枢神経系外の奇形腫にはミクログリアが高頻度に存在し、神経分化と並行して成熟すると考えられます。
pmid-2763798.summary_en: This study examined ten human teratomas arising outside the central nervous system using immunohistochemical and lectin stains. Microglia were identified in eight of the ten cases, mainly within mature neural areas that also expressed S-100, GFAP, vimentin, neurofilament, and synaptophysin. Cells resembling microglial precursors were seen in immature tissue. The findings suggest that microglia are frequent in nonCNS teratomas and mature alongside neural differentiation within these tumors.

pmid-2765138.summary_ja: 新たに樹立された妊娠性絨毛癌細胞株4種について、細胞表面抗原を解析した研究である。全株でHLAクラスI抗原の発現が確認されたが、クラスII抗原は検出されなかった。一部の株は同種抗原を発現しており、絨毛癌が患者に移植免疫を誘導しうる移植腫瘍様の性質を持つことが示唆された。
pmid-2765138.summary_en: This study characterized four newly established gestational choriocarcinoma cell lines, examining surface antigens using protein A and immune adherence assays. All lines expressed HLA class I antigens, but class II expression was not detected. Blood group A and B antigens were absent, and Rho(D) antigen binding was positive only in one line. Some lines expressed alloantigens, suggesting that choriocarcinomas behave like transplanted tumors capable of inducing transplantation immunity in patients.

pmid-2766060.summary_ja: 1974年から1986年に当院で治療された縦隔原発セミノーマの5症例を報告している。全例に開胸探索術が行われたが、切除可能であったのは2例のみであった。全例に術後放射線療法が実施され、1例は節病変に対して追加の化学療法を受けた。全例が完全寛解し、平均42.6か月の観察期間中無病生存であった。
pmid-2766060.summary_en: This report describes five patients with primary mediastinal seminoma treated at a single center between 1974 and 1986. All underwent exploratory thoracotomy, but only two were resectable. Postoperative radiation therapy was given to all patients, and one received additional chemotherapy for nodal involvement. All five achieved complete resolution and remained disease-free over an average follow-up of 42.6 months. The authors conclude that mediastinal seminoma can be treated primarily by surgery, and that irradiation can also achieve durable remission in unresectable tumors.

pmid-2766279.summary_ja: 精巣奇形癌15例を対象に、多型性プローブを用いて染色体6の生殖細胞系列ヘテロ接合性の消失を検討している。6p11-cenのプローブ4c11では14例中3例で欠失が認められた。腎細胞癌では33例中6例で同様の欠失が見られ、他の15種類の腫瘍では23検体中2例のみであった。著者らは、HLAより動原体側の6p領域に非ランダムな欠失があり、腫瘍抑制遺伝子の存在を示唆すると考察している。
pmid-2766279.summary_en: This study examined loss of germline heterozygosity on chromosome 6 in 15 human testicular teratocarcinomas, using three polymorphic probes. Probe 4c11 at 6p11-cen showed loss in three of 14 analyzable tumors, while flanking probes did not. Among 33 renal cell carcinomas, six showed loss with the same probe, compared with only two of 23 samples from 15 other tumor types. The authors propose nonrandom loss of chromosome 6p DNA centromeric to HLA in testicular teratocarcinoma and renal cell carcinoma, supporting a tumor suppressor gene hypothesis.

pmid-2767519.summary_ja: ハムスター頬袋に移植したヒト絨毛癌に対し、腫瘍内DHE投与後のレーザー照射による光線力学療法を検討している。反復治療により38腫瘍中29腫瘍(76%)が完全奏効し、無効例は5%であった。DHEの蛍光は微小な悪性病巣の検出にも役立つ可能性がある。著者らは婦人科がんに対する臨床試験の必要性を示唆している。
pmid-2767519.summary_en: This study tested intratumoral dihematoporphyrin ether (DHE) followed by laser light for photodynamic therapy of human choriocarcinoma transplanted into hamster cheek pouches. Tumor response was monitored by hCG levels. After repeated treatments, 29 of 38 tumors (76%) completely responded, and 5% were non-responders. The authors report that DHE fluorescence can help detect occult malignant foci, and suggest that clinical trials in gynecologic cancers are warranted.

pmid-2767876.summary_ja: 18歳女性の悪性の卵巣未熟奇形腫と腹膜播種の症例を報告している。3回の開腹術と補助化学療法により寛解が得られた。残存した腹膜病変は成熟した上皮・神経膠組織を示した。培養細胞は胚細胞の性質と卵黄嚢様の形態を示し、トリソミー12と転座(7;9)を有していた。
pmid-2767876.summary_en: This report describes an 18-year-old woman with an immature malignant ovarian teratoma and peritoneal implants. Remission was achieved after three laparotomies and adjuvant chemotherapy. A residual peritoneal implant showed mature epithelial and glial components. Immunohistochemistry and electron microscopy confirmed the dominant neuroectodermal component. Cultured cells had a germ cell character and yolk sac configuration, with trisomy 12 and a translocation (7;9), similar to abnormalities described in testicular and ovarian immature teratomas.

pmid-2768972.summary_ja: 婦人科腫瘍74例をヌードマウスに移植し、初回移植の生着率は35.1%であった。絨毛性腫瘍の生着率が最も高く55.5%であった。継代移植が可能であった14例には絨毛癌株3例が含まれ、hCG分泌能を保持していた。絨毛癌の腫瘍倍加時間は短く、腫瘍サイズは血清hCG値と良好に相関した。
pmid-2768972.summary_en: This study transplanted 74 gynecologic tumors into nude mice, achieving a 35.1% primary take rate. Trophoblastic neoplasia showed the highest engraftment (55.5%). Among 26 successful primary transplants, 14 were serially transplantable, including three choriocarcinoma lines. Serially transplanted tumors retained original morphology, and choriocarcinoma doubling times were short. Choriocarcinoma lines preserved hCG secretion, and tumor size correlated with serum hCG titer, supporting their use in gynecologic cancer research.

pmid-2769034.summary_ja: 生後12週の男児の舌に生じた神経膠奇形腫の症例を報告している。臨床的には舌甲状腺が疑われていた。病理組織学的検査により正しい診断が得られた。病変は出生時から存在していたが、呼吸困難が出現して初めて受診した。頭頸部の奇形腫は稀であり、舌甲状腺と誤診されることが多く、通常は良性であると指摘している。
pmid-2769034.summary_en: This paper reports a glial teratoma of the tongue in a 12-week-old boy, initially suspected clinically to be a lingual thyroid. Histopathological examination established the true diagnosis. The lesion had been present since birth, and presentation was delayed until breathing difficulty developed. The authors note that head and neck teratomas are uncommon and frequently misdiagnosed as lingual thyroid, and that these lesions are usually benign.

pmid-2773854.summary_ja: 胎盤に生じる奇形腫はまれな腫瘍である。本論文では正期胎盤に発生した症例を報告し、既報例を概観したうえで、発症機序の可能性について考察している。胎盤表面の病変であるため、他の胎盤・胎児病変との鑑別も重要とされる。
pmid-2773854.summary_en: Placental teratomas are rare tumors. This report describes a case arising in a term placenta, reviews previously published cases, and considers possible mechanisms of pathogenesis. Because these lesions sit on the placental surface, they require careful differentiation from other placental and fetal lesions. The paper contributes to understanding how teratomas can arise outside the gonads, within the placenta.

pmid-2775368.summary_ja: セミノーマに対して放射線療法を受けた患者で、19年後に照射野内に神経原性線維肉腫が発生した症例の報告。GCT治療後の晩期合併症としての放射線誘発性二次腫瘍であり、照射後に長期間を経て腫瘍が増大した場合は鑑別に加えるべきと論じている。
pmid-2775368.summary_en: A patient treated with radiation therapy for seminoma developed a neurogenic fibrosarcoma within the irradiated field 19 years later. The authors report this radiation-induced secondary sarcoma as a late complication of GCT treatment. Although second neoplasms after radiotherapy are unusual, they should be considered in the differential diagnosis of tumor growth that appears long after irradiation in patients previously treated for seminoma.

pmid-2776955.summary_ja: 羊膜と絨毛膜の間の胎盤表面に生じた成熟型充実性胎盤奇形腫の症例報告。既報6例と同様の部位に位置していた。腫瘍の性質と、類似した病変である無形性無心体胎児（fetus acardius amorphus）との鑑別点を考察しており、胎盤腫瘍の診断において重要な知見を提供している。
pmid-2776955.summary_en: A mature solid teratoma of the placenta is presented. It lay on the placental surface between the amnion and chorion, as did the six previously reported cases. This is a case report of a rare placental teratoma. The authors discuss the nature of the tumor and its differential features relative to fetus acardius amorphus, a placental and fetal anomaly that can resemble it.

pmid-2778480.summary_ja: シスプラチン併用化学療法を受けた進行セミノーマ患者36例を対象に、治療後の残存腫瘤の意義を検討した。残存腫瘤を有する21例のうち、後腹膜リンパ節郭清を受けた3例は壊死性線維組織のみであった。残りは経過観察され、19例で病勢の証拠は認められなかった。著者らは観察を有効な選択肢と結論している。
pmid-2778480.summary_en: Thirty-six patients with advanced seminoma treated with cisplatin-based chemotherapy were reviewed to assess the significance of residual radiographic masses after treatment. Of 21 patients with evaluable residual masses, only three underwent retroperitoneal lymph node dissection, which showed only necrotic fibrous tissue. The remaining patients were observed with serial CT, and 19 of 21 had no evidence of disease at follow-up, including eight of nine with masses over 3 cm. The authors conclude that observation is a viable option, reserving radiotherapy or chemotherapy for progressive disease.

pmid-2778588.summary_ja: 仙尾部奇形腫に胎児内胎児の特徴を示す症例を報告する。さらに鼠径リンパ節内に認められた奇形腫性組織についても記載している。本報告は、その所見が真の胎児内胎児であるのか、別の病態であるのかという問題を提起する。リンパ節内に生じた奇形腫性組織の臨床的意義を検討する。本症例は、小児例においてこれらの病態を鑑別することの診断上の難しさを示している。
pmid-2778588.summary_en: A case of sacrococcygeal teratoma with features of fetus in fetu is presented. The authors also describe teratomatous tissue found within an inguinal lymph node. The report raises the question of whether the findings represent true fetus in fetu or another entity. The clinical implications of teratomatous tissue in a nodal location are discussed. The case highlights the diagnostic challenge of distinguishing these entities in pediatric patients.

pmid-2779945.summary_ja: 1970～1980年に放射線療法、経過観察、後腹膜リンパ節郭清を受けた臨床病期I非セミノーマ精巣腫瘍186例の後方視的解析。原発腫瘍の病理組織学的再評価で、リンパ管および血管浸潤が治療失敗の独立した予測因子であった。両者の浸潤を有する患者の80%で治療失敗が認められた。再発リスクの層別化と治療選択への示唆がある。
pmid-2779945.summary_en: Retrospective analysis of 186 patients with clinical stage I testicular non-seminoma treated between 1970 and 1980 with radiotherapy, observation, or retroperitoneal lymph node dissection. Histopathological reevaluation of primary tumours assessed vascular invasion, syncytiotrophoblasts, and endodermal sinus tumour. Lymphatic and blood vessel invasion were independent predictors of management failure in multivariate analysis, with 80% failure among patients showing both. Endodermal sinus tumour presence did not correlate with failure. The authors conclude that easily assessable parameters, especially small vessel invasion, can stratify relapse risk and guide therapy.

pmid-2780673.summary_ja: 1962〜1980年にペルーの腫瘍研究所で治療された臨床病期I精巣卵黄嚢腫瘍37例を後方視的に検討した。後腹膜リンパ節郭清を受けた18例と受けなかった19例を比較した。無病生存は郭清群で61%、非郭清群で37%であった。病勢進行による死亡は、それぞれ22%と42%であった。郭清群でリンパ節転移が陽性であったのは2例のみであった。著者らは、臨床病期I患者は経過観察と比べてリンパ節郭清の恩恵を受けると結論づけた。症例数が少ないため一般化には限界がある。
pmid-2780673.summary_en: Retrospective review of 37 patients with clinical stage I testicular yolk sac tumour treated at a Peruvian cancer institute from 1962 to 1980, comparing 18 patients who underwent retroperitoneal lymph node dissection with 19 who did not. Survival without evidence of disease was 61% in the dissected group versus 37% in the non-dissected group, though deaths from disease were 22% and 42% respectively. Only two dissected patients had positive nodes. The authors conclude that clinical stage I patients benefit from retroperitoneal lymph node dissection compared with observation. The small sample size limits generalizability.

pmid-2781220.summary_ja: セミノーマと正常精巣のALPアイソザイムをHPLCで分離し、コンカナバリンAアフィニティクロマトグラフィーで糖鎖修飾を比較した研究。肝型ALPが主体で、胎盤型様酵素は活性の4〜8%を占めた。腫瘍由来の酵素は胎盤型や肝型と異なるレクチン親和性を示し、正常精巣に類似していた。セミノーマにおけるALP増加は精巣由来酵素の発現亢進を反映すると考えられる。
pmid-2781220.summary_en: This study separated alkaline phosphatase (ALP) isozymes from seminoma and normal testis using HPLC and characterized their glycosylation with concanavalin A affinity chromatography. Liver-type ALP dominated, with a placental-like enzyme making up 4-8% of activity. The placental-like enzyme and liver-type ALP in tumors showed lower Con A binding than placental and liver forms, resembling normal testis. The findings suggest that testicular ALP isozymes can be distinguished from placental and hepatic forms by lectin affinity, and that increased ALP in seminoma reflects enhanced expression of testis-associated enzymes.

pmid-2781221.summary_ja: セミノーマと正常精巣のALPアイソザイムを、デンプンゲル電気泳動と等電点電気泳動で解析した研究。腫瘍ごとに染色パターンは異なったが、主要活性はpI 4.3〜4.6に共通して認められた。セミノーマ由来のPLAP様酵素はノイラミニダーゼ処理により胎盤型PLAPと区別された。不均一性は糖鎖修飾や疎水性の違いに起因し、肝型LAPの不均一性はシアル酸含量の差によると考えられた。
pmid-2781221.summary_en: This study analyzed alkaline phosphatase isozymes from seminoma and normal testis by starch gel electrophoresis and isoelectric focusing. The placental-like enzyme showed different migration patterns in tumors and normal testes. Seminomas displayed variable staining among tumors, with a common main activity at pI 4.3-4.6 matching placental ALP. Neuraminidase treatment distinguished the placental-like enzyme in seminoma from placental ALP. Microheterogeneity was attributed to carbohydrate modification and hydrophobicity, while LAP heterogeneity was mainly due to sialic acid content.

pmid-2781889.summary_ja: 35歳女性の卵巣奇形腫の症例報告。主体をなす軟骨組織に核異型が認められ、組織像は胚性軟骨芽腫や軟骨肉腫に類似していた。細胞異型があるにもかかわらず、悪性の臨床経過を示す症状はなかった。卵巣奇形腫内の異型軟骨成分は悪性軟骨腫瘍と紛らわしく、診断上の難しさがあることが示された。
pmid-2781889.summary_en: This report describes a 35-year-old woman with an ovarian teratoma showing unusual cartilaginous differentiation. The predominant cartilaginous tissue showed nuclear atypia, and microscopic features resembled embryonal chondroblastoma or even chondrosarcoma. Despite the cellular atypia, the patient had no symptoms suggesting a malignant clinical course. The authors highlight the diagnostic challenge posed by atypical cartilaginous components in ovarian teratomas, which may mimic malignant cartilage tumors.

pmid-2782332.summary_ja: 完全型アンドロゲン不応症候群をもつ14歳女児に生じた転移性セミノーマの症例報告。両側付属器摘出、傍大動脈リンパ節郭清、術後放射線療法、エストロゲン補充療法で治療された。思春期患者でこの疾患に伴う性腺悪性腫瘍の報告は4例目とされる。
pmid-2782332.summary_en: This report describes a 14-year-old girl with complete androgen insensitivity syndrome who developed metastatic seminoma. She was treated with bilateral adnexectomy, paraaortic lymph node removal, postoperative radiation, and estrogen replacement therapy. The authors note that this is the fourth reported case of gonadal malignancy in a teenage patient with androgen insensitivity syndrome, adding to the limited literature on gonadal malignancy in this population.

pmid-2784051.summary_ja: 古典的セミノーマ型精巣腫瘍5例で炎症性細胞浸潤を免疫組織化学的に解析した研究。浸潤細胞は主に血管周囲に分布し、リンパ球が最も多く、T細胞はB細胞を上回った。ヘルパー/誘導T細胞が優勢で、NK細胞や形質細胞は少なく、ランゲルハンス細胞は認められなかった。
pmid-2784051.summary_en: This immunohistochemical study characterized inflammatory cell infiltrates in five classical seminomatous testicular tumors. Infiltrating cells were mostly located around vessels, and lymphocytes were the most numerous, with T cells outnumbering B cells. Helper/inducer T cells predominated, and suppressor cells were more common than cytotoxic cells. Plasma cells and natural killer cells were rare, and no Langerhans cells were found. Phagocytic macrophages were about twice as common as antigen-presenting macrophages, while T lymphocytes outnumbered antigen-presenting macrophages about 15-fold.

pmid-2784429.summary_ja: 若年男性で、精巣絨毛癌の転移による慢性的な消化管出血が初発症状となった症例報告です。失神前状態、ヘマトクリット22%、便潜血陽性を呈し、内視鏡で胃大弯の単発性出血病変が確認されました。若年男性の原因不明の消化管出血では、胚細胞腫瘍を鑑別に含める必要性が示されています。
pmid-2784429.summary_en: This case report describes a young adult man with metastatic testicular choriocarcinoma, the rarest testicular germ cell tumor, who presented with chronic occult gastrointestinal blood loss rather than acute bleeding. He had near-syncope, a hematocrit of 22%, and hemoccult-positive stool. Endoscopy revealed a solitary bleeding gastric lesion along the greater curvature. The authors suggest this may be the first testicular choriocarcinoma case in which chronic GI bleeding was the initial manifestation of metastatic disease, highlighting the need to consider germ cell tumors in unexplained GI bleeding in young men.

pmid-2784473.summary_ja: rIL-2で誘導したLAK細胞を16種類の癌細胞株に作用させた研究です。多くの株は強く溶解されましたが、絨毛癌細胞株5種は溶解率30%未満と耐性を示しました。絨毛癌株GCH-1は競合阻害の影響が小さく、キラー細胞が認識するエフェクター分子の欠如が低感受性の原因と考えられています。婦人科癌の免疫療法への示唆があります。
pmid-2784473.summary_en: This study tested lymphokine-activated killer (LAK) cells generated with recombinant IL-2 against sixteen carcinoma cell lines using a 4-hour chromium release assay. Most lines were markedly lysed, but five choriocarcinoma cell lines were resistant, with specific lysis below 30% at an effector-to-target ratio of 20. Cold-target inhibition showed that the choriocarcinoma line GCH-1 was much less inhibited than Daudi cells. The authors suggest the low susceptibility reflects absence of effector molecules recognized by killer cells, which is relevant to immunotherapy of gynecologic cancers.

pmid-2785847.summary_ja: マウス卵巣奇形腫モデルを用いた研究です。腹腔内投与の10EDAMとシスプラチンの併用は、単剤より強い抗腫瘍効果を示しました。遅延性のロイコボリン救済を加えると、毒性を増やさずに10EDAMを4倍に増量でき、40%が長期無腫瘍生存しました。ヒト卵巣癌の腔内療法への応用可能性が示唆されています。
pmid-2785847.summary_en: In a murine model, intraperitoneal 10-ethyl-10-deazaaminopterin (10EDAM) combined with cisplatin produced greater antitumor activity than either agent alone against an ovarian teratoma. Adding delayed subcutaneous leucovorin rescue allowed a fourfold dose increase of 10EDAM without added toxicity and yielded 40% long-term tumor-free survivors. Methotrexate was only modestly active. The authors suggest this regimen may have potential for intracavitary treatment of human ovarian cancer when combined with systemic calcium leucovorin rescue.

pmid-2788431.summary_ja: 絨毛癌由来を含む培養細胞株21種に対し、NK細胞とLAK細胞の細胞傷害性を比較した研究です。絨毛癌由来の5株でLAK細胞による溶解が低下し、共通の標的分子の減少が示唆されました。この感受性低下は半同種の胎児の生存に寄与する可能性があり、母児の免疫関係への示唆があります。
pmid-2788431.summary_en: This study tested whether human trophoblastic tumor cells resist MHC-nonrestricted killer cells, comparing NK and LAK cytotoxicity across 21 cultured cell lines. Five choriocarcinoma-derived lines showed decreased LAK lysis. Cold-target inhibition and TNP modification experiments indicated a reduced common target molecule recognized by LAK effectors. The authors propose that this impaired susceptibility of trophoblast to killer cells may be functional for survival of the semiallogeneic fetus, linking the finding to maternal-fetal immune relations.

pmid-2789097.summary_ja: 精巣がん治療終了の約4年後、34組の夫婦の双方に個別面接を行った研究です。性機能と妊孕性に関する患者と配偶者の回答を比較しました。患者の23.5%が治療後に魅力が低下したと感じており、性的満足度の低下も多く報告されました。配偶者との回答の一致度は全体的に高いものでした。
pmid-2789097.summary_en: This study interviewed both members of 34 married couples about four years after testicular cancer treatment ended, comparing their responses on psychosexual functioning and fertility. Patients were more likely than spouses to feel less attractive and reported decreased sexual satisfaction. Both groups more often reported decreased intercourse frequency. Concordance between spouses was generally high. Few couples saw infertility as a problem, yet 53% were parents, and men who banked sperm were less likely to already have children.

pmid-2790671.summary_ja: 1964〜1984年にイェール大学で放射線療法を受けた精巣セミノーマ83例の解析。病期Iおよび病期IIの大半で15年生存率は95%、再発は病期Iの1例のみ（照射野辺縁）であった。進行例では化学療法併用で生存した1例が唯一の無病生存者であった。術後放射線療法は病期Iおよび病期IIのセミノーマに有効な治療選択肢と結論づけられている。
pmid-2790671.summary_en: This Yale University series reviewed 83 testicular seminoma patients treated with radiation therapy between 1964 and 1984. Most had early disease: 61 stage I, 15 stage IIA, and 3 stage IIB. The 15-year survival rate was 95%. Only one stage I patient relapsed, at the field margin, and no stage II patients recurred. Among four patients with advanced disease, the only disease-free survivor received cisplatin-based chemotherapy plus radiation. Minor radiation complications occurred, and the 15-year risk of a second malignancy was 3.3%. The authors conclude that postoperative radiation is a successful option for stage I and II seminoma.

pmid-2790757.summary_ja: 骨または軟部組織の肉腫を有する小児の親族に発生した胚細胞腫瘍6例（精巣5例、卵巣1例）の報告。著者らは、胚細胞腫瘍がLi-Fraumeni癌家系症候群にみられる癌の遺伝的素因のまれな表現型である可能性を提唱している。症例数が少ないため関連は示唆にとどまり、確認には追加の検証が必要である。
pmid-2790757.summary_en: This report describes six germ cell tumors (five testicular and one ovarian) occurring in relatives of children with bone or soft tissue sarcomas. The authors propose that germ cell tumors may be an uncommon manifestation of the genetic predisposition to cancer seen in Li-Fraumeni cancer family syndrome. Because this is a small set of clinical observations, the link is suggested rather than proven. Further study would be needed to confirm whether germ cell tumors belong to this familial cancer spectrum.

pmid-2790759.summary_ja: 縦隔に発生した性腺外胚細胞腫瘍で、精巣胚細胞腫瘍に特徴的な等染色体12p（i(12p)）が検出された1例の細胞遺伝学的報告。i(12p)は性腺外の胚細胞腫瘍にも生じうることを示す。核型は精巣腫瘍に典型的な近三倍体・近四倍体と異なり近二倍体であり、発生部位による生物学的差異が示唆される。
pmid-2790759.summary_en: This report describes an extragonadal mediastinal germ cell tumor carrying an isochromosome 12p, a chromosomal abnormality characteristic of testicular germ cell tumors. The finding shows that i(12p) can also arise in germ cell tumors outside the gonads. The patient's karyotype was near-diploid, unlike the near-triploid or near-tetraploid karyotypes typical of testicular tumors. This difference suggests possible biological variation by tumor site. It is a single-patient cytogenetic observation.

pmid-2790945.summary_ja: 16歳女児が回腸・回腸型腸重積で発症し、原因は絨毛癌であった。文献検索により、この特異な発症形式の絨毛癌は2例目の報告とされる。絨毛癌が腸閉塞として初発しうることを示し、若年者の腸重積の鑑別において留意すべき稀な病態であることを強調している。
pmid-2790945.summary_en: The report describes a 16-year-old girl who presented with ileo-ileal intussusception caused by choriocarcinoma. Based on a literature review, the authors state that this is only the second reported case of choriocarcinoma presenting in this unusual way. The case shows that choriocarcinoma, usually considered a gestational or germ cell malignancy, can first manifest as bowel obstruction. It is a brief case report from Central Africa that emphasizes the rarity of this presentation in young patients with intussusception.

pmid-2791350.summary_ja: 化学変異誘発により、H6胎児性癌細胞株からコンパクション（細胞凝集）欠損変異株を2株単離した。自然発生変異体は得られず、F9胎児性癌株やES-D3胚性幹細胞株からも取得できなかった。雑種解析で一方は優性、他方は劣性を示した。胎児性癌細胞を初期胚発生のモデルとして用いた体外培養の細胞生物学研究である。
pmid-2791350.summary_en: The authors isolated two compaction-defective variants of the H6 embryonal carcinoma cell line after chemical mutagenesis. Compaction is required for morula differentiation, and a similar process occurs in embryonal carcinoma cell aggregates. No spontaneous variants arose, and such variants could not be obtained from F9 embryonal carcinoma or ES-D3 embryonic stem cells. In hybridization tests, one variant behaved as dominant and the other as recessive. The work is an in vitro cell-biology study that uses embryonal carcinoma cells as a model of early embryogenesis.

pmid-2796103.summary_ja: 精巣腫瘍の純粋セミノーマ19例、非セミノーマ14例、正常精巣11例において、腫瘍組織と血清のhCGおよびhCG-βを測定。絨毛癌成分を含む非セミノーマで組織内hCGは極めて高値だった。純粋セミノーマの組織hCG-βは正常精巣より有意に高いが、血清hCGは陽性率・値とも低く、腫瘍マーカーとしての有用性は限定的と結論づけている。
pmid-2796103.summary_en: This Japanese study measured hCG and hCG-beta in tumor tissue and serum of 19 pure seminomas, 14 non-seminomas, and 11 normal testes. Tissue hCG was far higher in non-seminomas containing choriocarcinoma than in pure seminomas. Tissue hCG-beta in pure seminomas was significantly higher than in normal testes but lower than in choriocarcinoma-containing non-seminomas. Positivity and levels of serum hCG were lower in pure seminomas than in non-seminomas. The authors conclude that serum hCG has limited value as a tumor marker for pure seminoma.

pmid-2797645.summary_ja: マウス卵巣奇形癌モデルで、腹腔内投与のシスプラチンとシトシンアラビノシドの相乗効果を検討した。両薬剤の同時投与により生存期間の相乗効果が認められ、3日間の連日投与では120日後も全例生存した。著者らは、この3日間スケジュールによる臨床試験を提案している。
pmid-2797645.summary_en: In a murine ovarian teratocarcinoma model, the authors tested intraperitoneal cisplatin combined with cytosine arabinoside for synergy. Cisplatin alone prolonged survival, and simultaneous combination dosing produced synergy. Daily dosing for three days yielded 100% survival at 120 days. Both agents have favorable pharmacokinetics when given intraperitoneally. The authors conclude that a clinical trial of this three-day schedule is warranted.

pmid-2798067.summary_ja: 精巣の純粋型セミノーマ75例を後方視的に検討し、精巣摘除後に大動脈周囲および同側の腸骨領域へ放射線療法を行った。N0症例は28～30 Gyで全例制御され、N1・N2症例では35 Gy以上が推奨された。合併症や不妊は認められなかった。
pmid-2798067.summary_en: This retrospective study reviewed 75 patients with pure testicular seminoma treated with radiotherapy to periaortic and ipsilateral iliac fields after orchiectomy. All patients with N0 disease receiving 28-30 Gy were controlled and alive. Higher doses of 35 Gy or more were recommended for N1 and N2 disease. No treatment complications and no induced sterility were observed, supporting 30 Gy for N0 disease.

pmid-2798225.summary_ja: 30歳女性の右卵巣類皮嚢腫に生じた扁平上皮癌in situの症例である。ラミニン免疫染色で基底膜が保たれ、in situ病変であることを確認した。予後は腫瘍の浸潤度に依存するため温存手術が可能となり、4年後も良好な経過であった。
pmid-2798225.summary_en: A 30-year-old woman had squamous cell carcinoma in situ arising in a dermoid cyst of the right ovary. Laminin immunostaining demonstrated intact basement membranes, confirming the in situ nature of the lesion. Because prognosis depends on the degree of tumor penetration, conservative surgery could be performed. Four years later the patient remained well, supporting the diagnosis and the value of laminin labelling in excluding invasive carcinoma.

pmid-2800850.summary_ja: 非セミノーマ性の原発精巣がんに伴う肺転移を外科的切除した3症例を報告する。化学療法後に残存病変が部分奏効または無効の場合に手術が検討された。組織所見は壊死や良性変化から生存腫瘍まで多様で、以後の治療方針の決定に役立った。
pmid-2800850.summary_en: This case series describes three patients who underwent surgical excision of pulmonary metastases from nonseminomatous primary testicular cancer. Surgery was considered after chemotherapy when residual lesions persisted with partial or no response. Histology ranged from necrotic lesions and benign transformation to viable tumor. These findings guided whether to continue or change further chemotherapy.

pmid-2803301.summary_ja: 絨毛癌細胞株JARを用い、組換えインターロイキン1αと腫瘍壊死因子αがhCG分泌に及ぼす影響を検討した。IL-1αは用量依存的にhCG産生を増加させ、加熱処理で効果が消失した。TNFαはhCG産生と細胞生存に影響しなかった。IL-1が栄養膜細胞のhCG産生を制御する可能性が示唆された。
pmid-2803301.summary_en: Using JAR human choriocarcinoma cells, the authors examined whether recombinant interleukin-1 alpha and tumor necrosis factor alpha regulate hCG secretion. IL-1 alpha increased hCG production in a dose-dependent manner, and heat inactivation abolished this effect. TNF-alpha had no effect on hCG output or cell viability. The results suggest IL-1 may regulate trophoblastic hCG production and that the two cytokines diverge in reproductive regulation.

pmid-2803904.summary_ja: 良性嚢胞性卵巣奇形腫が直腸へ破裂し、排便習慣の変化として発症した症例を報告する。嚢腫内に便が充満して直腸を圧迫していた。卵巣奇形腫の腸管への破裂は稀であり、一般的な良性腫瘍の非典型的な発症形式として注目される。
pmid-2803904.summary_en: This case report describes a benign cystic ovarian teratoma that ruptured into the rectum and presented as a change in bowel habit. Faeces filled the cyst and compressed the rectum. Rupture of an ovarian cystic teratoma into the bowel is rare. The authors highlight it as an unusual presentation of a common benign neoplasm.

pmid-2807845.summary_ja: 24歳女性の症例で、右甲状腺の濾胞性腺腫に加え、偶然見つかった左骨盤内嚢胞性腫瘤を認めました。開腹で卵巣由来の良性甲状腺組織からなる嚢胞性腫瘍が確認され、卵巣甲状腺腫と診断されました。患者は無症状で甲状腺機能亢進症はありませんでした。卵巣甲状腺腫は稀で、甲状腺機能亢進を伴うのは約1/4とされています。
pmid-2807845.summary_en: This case report describes a 24-year-old woman with a right thyroid follicular adenoma and an incidentally found left pelvic cystic mass. At laparotomy the mass was a cystic tumor composed of benign thyroid tissue arising from the left ovary, consistent with struma ovarii. The patient was clinically asymptomatic with no hyperthyroidism. The authors review that struma ovarii is rare and is seen with hyperthyroidism in only about one quarter of cases, and classify patients into hyperthyroid, ascitic, and asymptomatic groups.

pmid-2807988.summary_ja: 絨毛上皮腫(絨毛癌)組織と妊娠初期の正常栄養膜細胞について、標識ネオ糖タンパク質を用いて糖鎖受容体(レクチン)の発現を比較しました。両者の間には明らかな違いがあり、正常細胞では成熟に伴い結合が減少しました。この違いは、栄養膜細胞の浸潤・接着性に関係している可能性があると考察されています。
pmid-2807988.summary_en: This study compares lectin and sugar-receptor expression in malignant chorionepithelioma (choriocarcinoma) tissue and normal early-gestation placental trophoblast using labelled neoglycoproteins and glycohistochemistry. Controls excluded glycosidase or glycosyltransferase artifacts. Pronounced differences were found in receptors for glucosides, N-acetylgalactosamine, N-acetylglucosamine and other carbohydrates, and normal trophoblast binding decreased with maturation. The authors suggest that transient early-pregnancy lectins may relate to the invasive and adhesive behavior of trophoblast and chorionepithelioma.

pmid-2809303.summary_ja: 15歳女性の縦隔前部の大きな腫瘤の症例です。術前に血清CA19-9が高値を示し、切除標本の病理検査で未熟奇形腫と診断されました。腫瘍内液のCA19-9も高値で、腫瘍内には膵・気管支・腸管様上皮に陽性所見がみられました。術後にCA19-9は正常化し、経過は良好でした。縦隔胚細胞腫瘍でCA19-9が検出された報告は従来なく、症例の蓄積が必要とされています。
pmid-2809303.summary_en: This case report describes a 15-year-old woman with a large anterior mediastinal mass and elevated preoperative serum CA19-9. Pathology after resection confirmed an immature teratoma. CA19-9 was also elevated in tumor fluid, and immunostaining showed positivity in pancreatic, bronchial, and intestinal-type epithelium within the tumor. CA19-9 normalized after surgery and the postoperative course was satisfactory. The authors note that no prior mediastinal germ cell tumor has been reported with CA19-9 elevation, calling for more cases.

pmid-2809326.summary_ja: 40歳男性の前縦隔ジャーミノーマの症例で、心タンポナーデを合併していました。シスプラチン、ビンデシン、ペプロマイシンによる化学療法2コースで腫瘍が著明に縮小したのち、完全な外科的切除を実施しました。術後は化学療法1コースと40Gyの放射線療法を行い、術後7か月の時点で再発はありません。右大動脈弓と先天性鎖骨下動脈盗血現象も合併していました。
pmid-2809326.summary_en: This case report describes a 40-year-old man with anterior mediastinal germinoma complicated by cardiac tamponade. Two courses of cisplatin, vindesine and peplomycin chemotherapy shrank the tumor markedly before complete surgical resection. After surgery he received one more chemotherapy course and 40 Gy of radiotherapy and remained recurrence-free at 7 months. The patient also had a right aortic arch and congenital subclavian steal phenomenon, rare anomalies that the authors note were not previously reported together with a mediastinal tumor.

pmid-2809953.summary_ja: 奇形腫の家族性発症を示した家族の報告です。父親は髄膜瘤が疑われ、その2人の子どもは仙尾部奇形腫を有し、そのうち1人には前方髄膜瘤を伴っていました。遺伝性仙骨前奇形腫とその関連奇形は過去6家系で報告されており、本報告はその文献に加わるものです。
pmid-2809953.summary_en: This report describes a family with hereditary sacrococcygeal teratomas. The father presented with a presumed meningocele, while his two children both had sacrococcygeal teratomas, one with an associated anterior meningocele. The authors note that hereditary presacral teratoma with associated anomalies has been described in six previous kindreds, and add this family to that literature. The case highlights the familial occurrence of these tumors and their association with spinal malformations.

pmid-2809954.summary_ja: 生後1日の男児で、肛門狭窄、三日月状仙骨、前後の髄膜瘤に加え、仙骨前奇形腫を認めた症例です。メトリザミド脊髄造影と三次元CT再構成を組み合わせた画像法で診断しました。後方到達法で髄膜瘤と脊髄係留を修復し、人工肛門造設後に閉鎖しました。術後2年の時点で良好な経過です。仙骨前腫瘤、仙骨形成異常、直腸肛門奇形の3徴候がある場合は、仙骨前奇形の精査が必要と提唱されています。
pmid-2809954.summary_en: This report describes a 1-day-old boy with anal stenosis, a scimitar-shaped sacrum, large anterior and posterior meningoceles, and a presacral teratoma. A new radiographic approach combining metrizamide myelography and three-dimensional CT reconstruction allowed diagnosis. The meningoceles and tethered cord were corrected through a posterior approach, and a colostomy was performed and later reversed. At two years the child was doing well. The authors propose that this triad of presacral mass, sacral dysgenesis and anorectal malformation should prompt investigation for presacral malformation.

pmid-2810512.summary_ja: 曖昧性器、性腺芽腫、無虹彩症、知的障害を有し、染色体11番(11p13)の欠失を伴う46,XY症例です。性腺芽腫は性腺形成異常に伴う胚細胞腫瘍の一型で、性分化疾患との関連が知られています。この組み合わせは過去2例の報告しかなく、稀な遺伝型と表現型の関係を示すものです。
pmid-2810512.summary_en: This report describes a patient with ambiguous genitalia, gonadoblastoma, aniridia, and intellectual disability with a 46,XY karyotype carrying a deletion of chromosome 11 at 11p13. Gonadoblastoma is a germ cell neoplasm associated with dysgenetic gonads and disorders of sex development. The authors note that this combination of features has been observed in only two previous patients, making it a rare genotype-phenotype association relevant to gonadoblastoma development.

pmid-2811300.summary_ja: パラフィン包埋したヒト精細管内の異型胚細胞、すなわちセミノーマ様細胞の前駆病変を調べた研究です。1q12領域のDNAプローブを用いた解析で、異型胚細胞を含む管内核の3分の1に3つのシグナルがみられ、正常な腸管や精原細胞は2つでした。これは、前がん細胞の染色体解析を発生源の組織上で直接行えることを示しています。
pmid-2811300.summary_en: This study examined atypical germ cells, the precursor of testicular germ cell tumors resembling seminoma cells, in paraffin-embedded human seminiferous tubules. Using a chromosome 1q12 DNA probe in situ, one-third of intratubular nuclei containing atypical germ cells showed three hybridization signals, whereas normal intestine and spermatogonia showed two. This demonstrates that cytogenetic analysis of precancerous cells can be performed directly on the originating tissue, and reveals a chromosome 1 gain in a precursor of seminoma.

pmid-2812558.summary_ja: 早期病期の純粋精巣セミノーマ患者43例を対象とした後方視的研究である。精巣摘除術と放射線療法で治療し、経過観察期間は4.3～17.4年、全生存率は97.7%であった。病期Iセミノーマに対するこの治療アプローチの長期成績を示している。
pmid-2812558.summary_en: This retrospective study analyzed 43 patients with early-stage pure testicular seminoma treated with orchiectomy and radiation therapy. Follow-up ranged from 4.3 to 17.4 years, and overall survival was 97.7%. The report documents long-term outcomes of this treatment approach for stage I seminoma, offering historical benchmark survival data for this germ cell tumor subtype.

pmid-2817080.summary_ja: LTXBO系統マウスに自然発生する卵巣奇形腫の神経上皮成分を免疫組織化学的に解析した研究である。原始神経上皮は神経ペプチドやクラスIIIβチューブリンを発現し、神経細胞への初期分化を示唆した。未分化幹細胞やアストログリアは一般的なβチューブリンのみを発現した。ヒト胎児性腫瘍の神経上皮分化の研究にも応用可能な知見である。
pmid-2817080.summary_en: This study characterizes spontaneous ovarian teratomas in LTXBO mice, which contain a large neuroepithelial component. Immunohistochemistry showed that primitive neuroepithelial rosettes express neuropeptides such as somatostatin and neuropeptide Y, along with neuron-associated class III β-tubulin, while stem cells and astroglia express only general β-tubulin. The findings indicate early neuronal commitment in neoplastic primitive neuroepithelium and provide a framework for analyzing neuroepithelial differentiation in embryonal tumors.

pmid-2910230.summary_ja: 中年男性に発生した非妊娠性・性腺外の絨毛癌の症例です。剖検により腫瘍が肺由来であることが確認されました。免疫組織化学染色でヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)が陽性を示し、絨毛性の起源が裏付けられました。妊娠歴のない原発性肺絨毛癌という稀な病態を示しています。
pmid-2910230.summary_en: This report describes a middle-aged man with nongestational, extragonadal choriocarcinoma that originated in the lung, confirmed at autopsy. The trophoblastic origin was demonstrated by immunoperoxidase staining for human chorionic gonadotropin, supporting the diagnosis of a primary pulmonary choriocarcinoma. The case highlights that choriocarcinoma can arise outside the gonads without a gestational precedent, a rare presentation relevant to the germ cell tumor spectrum.

pmid-2910461.summary_ja: ヒトのセミノーマ10例について、腫瘍細胞を直接採取して細胞遺伝学的解析を行いました。modal染色体数は63から112の範囲で、フローサイトメトリーによるDNA量測定と一致しました。8例で少なくとも1コピーのi(12p)が認められ、2例では認められませんでした。
pmid-2910461.summary_en: This study performed cytogenetic analysis on ten human seminomas harvested directly from tumor cells. Modal chromosome numbers ranged from 63 to 112, consistent with flow cytometric DNA content. Eight tumors carried at least one i(12p) abnormality, while two lacked it. The findings describe the chromosomal characteristics of seminoma, with i(12p) being a frequent marker in these germ cell tumors.

pmid-2910486.summary_ja: 多剤化学療法後に残存した成熟奇形腫13例の細胞遺伝学的解析を行いました。modal染色体数は52から85の範囲でした。12例で少なくとも1コピーのi(12p)が認められました。原発性精巣非セミノーマとの比較から、残存奇形腫は核型異常の少ないクローンが選択されて生じたと考察しています。
pmid-2910486.summary_en: This study cytogenetically analyzed 13 mature residual teratomas after polychemotherapy, with modal chromosome numbers of 52 to 85. At least one i(12p) was present in 12 tumors. The authors compared these karyotypes with primary testicular nonseminomas and suggested that residual teratomas arise from selection of clones with less abnormal karyotypes from the primary tumor.

pmid-2910781.summary_ja: 卵巣胚細胞腫瘍54例および胚細胞腫瘍細胞株9株で血清神経特異エノラーゼ(NSE)を測定しました。未熟奇形腫8例中4例、ディスジャーミノーマ6例中5例で血清NSEが上昇していました。ディスジャーミノーマでは広範な陽性染色が見られ、未熟奇形腫では神経成分に限局していました。NSEは両腫瘍の診断マーカーとして有用と考察されています。
pmid-2910781.summary_en: This study measured serum neuron-specific enolase in 54 patients with ovarian germ cell tumors and in nine germ cell tumor cell lines. Serum NSE was raised in 4 of 8 immature teratomas and 5 of 6 dysgerminomas. Immunohistochemistry showed widespread NSE staining in dysgerminomas but neural-restricted staining in immature teratomas. The authors conclude NSE may be a diagnostic marker for both tumor types.

pmid-2910784.summary_ja: 悪性卵巣甲状腺腫は histologic な悪性基準に議論がある極めて稀な腫瘍です。転移例では予後が不良となりえます。本症例では、腹腔内転移に対して腹腔内リン酸クロム投与と甲状腺ホルモン抑制療法を用いました。長期フォローアップによる治療効果の評価が必要とされています。
pmid-2910784.summary_en: This case report describes malignant struma ovarii, a very rare tumor with debated histologic criteria for malignancy. Patients often respond well to surgery, but metastatic disease carries a poorer prognosis. The authors report using intraperitoneal chromic phosphate for metastatic intraperitoneal disease with thyroid suppression, and suggest prophylactic thyroid hormone in such cases. Long-term follow-up is needed to evaluate this therapy.

pmid-2910791.summary_ja: 無月経を主訴とした姉妹2例で、家族性46,XY純粋性腺形成不全を認めました。両側の性腺に性索腫とディスジャーミノーマが認められました。手術と放射線療法を行い、5年後も再発は認められていません。Y染色体物質を有する性腺形成不全では悪性化のリスクが高く、予防的性腺摘出が必要と述べています。
pmid-2910791.summary_en: This case report describes two sisters with familial 46,XY pure gonadal dysgenesis who had gonadoblastoma and dysgerminoma in dysgenetic gonads. Both underwent bilateral salpingo-oophorectomy and hysterectomy, with irradiation. Five years after treatment, both remained free of recurrence. The report emphasizes the malignancy risk in gonadal dysgenesis with Y chromosome material and the need for prophylactic gonadectomy.

pmid-2912523.summary_ja: 転移性胚細胞腫瘍216例のうち、シスプラチン併用化学療法で完全奏効に至った患者を解析しました。38例が再発しました。化学療法後に残存腫瘍の外科的切除を要した患者は、完全切除されていても再発リスクが高いと示されました。初回化学療法時のLDHおよびhCG高値も再発因子でした。
pmid-2912523.summary_en: This study analyzed 216 patients with metastatic germ cell tumors who achieved complete response to cisplatin-based chemotherapy, of whom 38 relapsed. Patients requiring surgical resection of residual tumor after chemotherapy had markedly higher relapse risk, even when fully resected. Elevated LDH and hCG at initial chemotherapy were also associated with relapse. The authors note that these patients remain at high risk despite additional chemotherapy.

pmid-2915313.summary_ja: 1989年の報告で、眼窩原発奇形腫2例と、上顎洞から眼窩へ浸潤した奇形腫1例を提示した。眼球が強く突出し、コンピュータ断層撮影(CT)で充実性と嚢胞性が混在する腫瘤が確認された。組織学的に2〜3胚葉由来の組織を認め、外科的切除が行われたが視力予後は不良であった。中枢神経系外の胚細胞腫瘍として位置づけられる。
pmid-2915313.summary_en: This 1989 report describes three patients with orbital teratomas: two primary orbital tumors and one teratoma invading the orbit from the maxillary sinus. Presentations were dramatic, with the globe displaced by extreme proptosis. Computed tomography was nearly diagnostic, showing a mixed solid and cystic mass. Histology revealed tissues from two or three germ layers. Surgical removal was performed, but visual outcomes were poor. The authors attribute these tumors to proliferation of germ cells deposited in cephalic structures during embryogenesis. This is an extragonadal germ cell tumor not arising in the central nervous system.

pmid-2916286.summary_ja: 1989年の報告で、生後15日の乳児の後腹膜奇形腫を提示した。3か月後に再発と腹膜転移を来し、12か月後には左精巣の鞘膜や精索へ転移した。転移巣では成熟した神経細胞とグリア細胞が認められた。腔内進展と、中皮細胞が胚細胞の分化に関与する可能性が示唆された。
pmid-2916286.summary_en: This 1989 Urology report describes a retroperitoneal teratoma removed from a 15-day-old infant, consisting mainly of immature nervous tissue. Three months later, the tumor recurred with numerous peritoneal metastases. Twelve months later, teratoma metastases infiltrated the tunica vaginalis, epididymis, and spermatic cord of the left testis, showing mature neurons and glial cells. The authors note early dissemination suggesting intracavitary spread. They propose that tumor maturation in paratesticular structures implies mesothelial involvement in germ cell differentiation.

pmid-2917494.summary_ja: 1989年の研究で、正常妊娠と絨毛癌患者の血清からヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)を精製し比較した。絨毛癌由来のものは生物活性と免疫活性の比が低く(0.69対0.90)、個々の血清でも差が確認された。この比は絨毛癌の治療評価に有用と考えられた。
pmid-2917494.summary_en: This 1989 East African Medical Journal study purified human chorionic gonadotropin (hCG) from pooled serum of normal pregnant women and patients with choriocarcinoma. Both preparations were heterogeneous on ion exchange chromatography and focusing, with similar Stokes radii. Choriocarcinoma hCG had a lower biological-to-immunological activity ratio (0.69) than normal pregnancy hCG (0.90), a difference confirmed in individual serum samples. The authors suggest this ratio could help evaluate treatment of choriocarcinoma patients, particularly in resource-limited settings.

pmid-2918591.summary_ja: 1989年の研究で、進行非セミノーマ精巣がん37例がシスプラチン併用化学療法後にCT陰性でも後腹膜リンパ節郭清を受けた。25例で完全壊死・線維化、11例で成熟奇形腫、残存悪性腫瘍は1例のみだった。CT陰性でも化学療法後の手術を日常的に行うべきと提案された。
pmid-2918591.summary_en: This 1989 Journal of Urology study reviewed 37 patients with advanced nonseminomatous testicular cancer who underwent retroperitoneal lymph node dissection after cisplatin-based chemotherapy despite normal CT findings. Complete necrosis or fibrosis was found in 25 patients, and 11 had mature teratoma. Residual viable malignancy occurred in only one patient. Neither initial mass size nor primary tumor histology predicted pathology. Given the high rate of mature teratoma, the authors recommend routine post-chemotherapy retroperitoneal surgery even when CT is negative.

pmid-2920085.summary_ja: 1989年の症例報告で、出産後4週の29歳女性が、未診断の絨毛癌の肝転移破裂による大量血腹症を呈した。腹腔内大量出血は通常、子宮外妊娠が原因となるため、まれな病態である。絨毛癌の転移巣からの出血の可能性と、予後分類および治療法を論じている。
pmid-2920085.summary_en: This 1989 case report describes massive hemoperitoneum in a 29-year-old woman four weeks postpartum, caused by spontaneous rupture of hepatic metastases from previously unsuspected choriocarcinoma. Massive intraperitoneal hemorrhage is usually associated with ectopic pregnancy, making this presentation unusual. The authors note that choriocarcinoma can bleed from secondary sites, although rupture of hepatic metastases is rare. The report reviews presentation, prognostic grouping, and treatment modalities.

pmid-2920767.summary_ja: 非セミノーマ性精巣がんの後腹膜転移40例を後方視的に検討し、化学療法後の残存腫瘤の予測因子を評価した研究です。初診時CTで腫瘤が2cm未満の症例では残存腫瘤が少なく、1cm以上の残存腫瘤には後腹膜リンパ節郭清が必要と結論づけています。
pmid-2920767.summary_en: This retrospective study of 40 patients treated for retroperitoneal metastases from nonseminomatous testicular cancer examined whether CT-measured mass size predicts residual masses after chemotherapy.
