Patients with initial masses under 2 cm had markedly fewer residual masses than those with larger lesions. Residual masses were found in seven of 22 patients with embryonal carcinoma, and three of those seven had mature teratoma. Residual masses of 1 cm or more warranted retroperitoneal lymphadenectomy regardless of histology. The role of surgery for residual masses under 1 cm remained undetermined.

pmid-2921142.summary_ja: 1970〜1982年に治療された病期Iの精巣セミノーマ365例を対象としたノルウェーの研究。10年がん関連生存率は99%で、13例が再発し、9例は救済療法で治癒した。長期的には16例に消化不良、9例に消化性潰瘍が生じ、肺がんリスクは境界域の増加であった。著者らは、横隔膜下放射線療法が病期Iセミノーマの標準治療として最適であると結論づけた。
pmid-2921142.summary_en: This Norwegian Radium Hospital study reviewed 365 patients with stage I testicular seminoma treated with infradiaphragmatic radiotherapy between 1970 and 1982. The 10-year cancer-related survival was 99%, and 13 patients relapsed, most within three years, with nine cured by salvage therapy. Long-term effects included dyspepsia in 16 patients and peptic ulcers in nine, with a borderline increased risk of pulmonary cancer. The authors concluded that infradiaphragmatic radiotherapy remains the optimal routine treatment for stage I seminoma and that inguinal and scrotal fields are unnecessary.

pmid-2921803.summary_ja: 33歳男性の右陰嚢内容の無痛性腫大に対し精巣摘除術を施行した精母細胞性セミノーマの症例報告です。病理組織学的検査で3種類の腫瘍細胞と特徴的な巨細胞が確認され、術後10か月の時点で転移や病勢の再燃はありませんでした。稀なセミノーマ亜型の形態と経過を示した報告です。
pmid-2921803.summary_en: This Japanese case report describes a 33-year-old man with a painless right scrotal swelling of six months' duration. Surgical orchiectomy revealed a 130 g testis with an edematous, homogeneous tumor. Histopathology showed a typical spermatocytic seminoma with three distinct cell types, including giant cells containing spireme-like chromatin of primary spermatocytes. Chest radiography, CT and lymphography showed no metastases, and the patient remained disease-free 10 months after orchiectomy. The report illustrates the characteristic morphology and favorable early outcome of this rare seminoma variant.

pmid-2921819.summary_ja: 非双生児の兄弟2例に精巣セミノーマが同時に発生した症例を報告した論文です。両者はHLAのハプロタイプが同一で、遺伝的素因の関与が議論されています。過去に64組の同胞例が報告されており、本報告は症例数が少ないため結論は暫定的です。
pmid-2921819.summary_en: This short Japanese case report describes two brothers, not twins, who developed testicular seminoma simultaneously. Both siblings showed identical HLA-A, -B, -C and -DR haplotypes, and HLA-DR antigens were examined in the brothers with testicular tumors. The authors note that 64 earlier sibling sets had been reported and discuss a possible hereditary role in etiology. Because the report includes only two cases, its conclusions about genetic susceptibility remain tentative.

pmid-2922391.summary_ja: 22歳女性の両側卵巣良性嚢胞性奇形腫の一方に、類組織球性（類上皮性）血管腫瘍が見つかった症例の病理学的報告です。核分裂像は10高倍率視野で4〜6個でしたが血管内発育はなく、術後30か月の時点で良好な経過でした。卵巣の血管腫瘍に関する文献的レビューも含みます。
pmid-2922391.summary_en: This pathology report describes a 22-year-old woman with benign cystic teratomas of both ovaries, one of which contained a histiocytoid (epithelioid) vascular tumor. The lesion showed closely arranged, canalized nests of vacuolated endothelial cells, with four to six mitoses per ten high-power fields but no intravascular growth. The patient remained well 30 months after surgery. The authors review the literature on ovarian vascular tumors and histiocytoid vascular lesions in general, presenting this as an unusual finding within a teratoma.

pmid-2925922.summary_ja: 妊娠性絨毛癌の転移による脳内出血を繰り返した女性の症例報告です。運動性失語や片麻痺などの症状を呈し、脳内血腫は計5回生じました。多発性頭蓋内出血の鑑別診断の重要性と、中枢神経系絨毛癌の特徴を文献的にまとめています。
pmid-2925922.summary_en: This report describes a woman with metastatic gestational choriocarcinoma who presented with headache, speech difficulty, motor aphasia, facial weakness and hemiparesis, and had a large intraparenchymal hematoma. She subsequently developed five intraparenchymal hemorrhages in total. The authors emphasize the diagnostic dilemma posed by multiple intracranial hemorrhages and the importance of a complete differential diagnosis. They also review the imaging and clinical features of CNS choriocarcinoma, showing that brain metastases from gestational tumors can present primarily as hemorrhage.

pmid-2926735.summary_ja: 成熟嚢胞性奇形腫内に発生した粘液産生性腺癌の症例報告です。全腹式子宮摘出術、左卵管卵巣摘除術、大網切除、傍大動脈リンパ節生検が行われました。腫瘍が嚢胞壁を越えて腹腔内構造に及ぶと予後が不良であることが示されています。奇形腫由来の悪性転化の稀な症例として、手術時に嚢胞壁外への進展を評価する重要性が強調されています。
pmid-2926735.summary_en: This case report describes a mucin-producing adenocarcinoma that arose within a well-differentiated mature cystic teratoma. The patient underwent total abdominal hysterectomy, left salpingo-oophorectomy, omentectomy and paraaortic lymph node biopsy. The authors note that prognosis is unfavorable when the tumor extends through the cyst wall to involve intraperitoneal structures. The case illustrates malignant transformation within a mature cystic teratoma, a recognized but uncommon complication, and highlights the importance of assessing extension beyond the cyst wall at surgery.

pmid-2927411.summary_ja: セミノーマ患者23例の放射線療法後の末梢リンパ球について、二動原体染色体と不安定型染色体異常を有する細胞の経時的変化を解析した研究です。損傷細胞の消失速度を示す差分半減期を数理モデルで算出し、治療終了時0.4年、1720日後で3.6年でした。
pmid-2927411.summary_en: This study analyzed dicentric chromosomes and cells with unstable chromosome aberrations (Cu cells) in peripheral lymphocytes from 23 seminoma patients sampled over 0 to 1720 days after radiotherapy. Nine patients were also studied before treatment. The authors propose a model that separates the mean lymphocyte lifetime, estimated at about 10 years, from a differential half-time for the decline of damaged cells immediately after exposure. Differential half-times for dicentrics were 0.4 years at the end of therapy and 3.6 years at 1720 days.

pmid-2929067.summary_ja: 精巣原発の絨毛癌(主体はセミノーマ)が皮下組織に単発転移した稀な症例を報告している。血管経路による転移が特徴で、術前β-hCGは4,200単位と高値だったが術後2週間で正常化した。転移経路から微小転移の可能性を考慮し、完全切除後も化学療法が行われた。近年の化学療法により精巣腫瘍の予後は大きく改善したと総括している。
pmid-2929067.summary_en: A rare case of a solitary subcutaneous metastasis from a testicular choriocarcinoma with a predominant seminoma component is described. The tumor spread via the vascular route, and preoperative beta-hCG of 4,200 units normalized within two weeks of surgery, suggesting complete extirpation of a solitary site. Because of the metastatic pattern, chemotherapy was given despite apparent complete removal. The authors review the markedly improved prognosis of testicular germ cell tumors with modern chemotherapy.

pmid-2929690.summary_ja: 卵管に原発した未熟(悪性)奇形腫の症例を報告している。奇形腫は胚細胞腫瘍の一型だが、生殖器以外の卵管に生じることは極めて稀で、本報告は文献上3例目と考えられている。症例の希少性を示す報告である。抄録には患者の臨床経過、治療内容、転帰の詳細は記載されていない。
pmid-2929690.summary_en: The authors report a case of primary immature (malignant) teratoma arising in the fallopian tube, an extremely rare site for this tumor. They note that it appears to be only the third such case reported in the literature. The report highlights the rarity of this presentation. The abstract provides limited clinical detail regarding the patient's presentation, treatment, or outcome.

pmid-9301895.summary_ja: 原発性縦隔胚細胞腫瘍の治療に関する総説。成熟奇形腫は診断後に速やかに切除すべきで、完全切除後の予後は良好である。悪性胚細胞腫瘍はセミノーマと非セミノーマ性に分類され、非セミノーマ性では シスプラチン を含む積極的化学療法が行われる。AFPやβ-hCGなどの腫瘍マーカーが治療後に正常化すれば長期予後は良く、高値が持続する場合は予後不良とされる。
pmid-9301895.summary_en: This Japanese review addresses treatment of primary mediastinal germ cell tumors. Mature teratomas should be resected promptly, with good prognosis after complete excision. Malignant germ cell tumors are divided into seminomatous and nonseminomatous types, and seminomas respond well to radiotherapy or chemotherapy. Nonseminomatous tumors receive aggressive cisplatin-based chemotherapy and are guided by AFP and beta-hCG levels. Normalized tumor markers after treatment predict better long-term prognosis, while persistently elevated markers indicate poor outcome.

pmid-9301951.summary_ja: 縦隔腫瘍の外科治療の現状をまとめた総説。奇形腫などの良性腫瘍は完全切除で良好な予後が得られる。浸潤性胸腺腫では完全切除後の放射線療法が推奨される。純粋セミノーマは切除と放射線療法、非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍はAFPとβ-hCGが陰性化するまで積極的な化学療法と放射線療法を行い、その後に手術を行う方針が示されている。
pmid-9301951.summary_en: This review summarizes the role of surgery across mediastinal tumors. Benign lesions such as teratoma, congenital cyst, intrathoracic goiter, and neurogenic tumors have good outcomes with complete resection. Invasive thymoma benefits from complete excision followed by radiation therapy. Pure seminoma is treated with resection and radiation therapy, while non-seminomatous germ cell tumors receive aggressive chemotherapy and radiation therapy until AFP and HCG normalize, followed by surgery. The authors also discuss neuroblastoma screening and stress accurate diagnosis.

pmid-2466636.summary_ja: 本研究は、悪性栄養膜細胞や異所性に腫瘍から分泌される遊離ヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)αサブユニットの生化学的特徴を検討した基礎研究である。絨毛癌細胞株JARと肺癌細胞株ChaGoから精製したαサブユニットを解析し、移動度の遅い型ほど複合型N結合型糖鎖が多く、βサブユニットとの再結合が低いことを示した。糖鎖修飾がダイマー形成を制限することが示唆される。
pmid-2466636.summary_en: This basic biochemistry study examines the free alpha-subunit of human chorionic gonadotropin (hCG), which malignant trophoblast secretes in excess and other tumors produce ectopically. Using purified alpha forms from the JAR choriocarcinoma cell line and the ChaGo lung carcinoma line, the authors show that slower-migrating forms carry more complex N-linked glycans and recombine poorly with the beta-subunit, suggesting that glycosylation limits dimer formation.

pmid-2469421.summary_ja: 培養絨毛癌細胞を用いて、アデニンヌクレオチドがヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(CG)のαおよびβサブユニット遺伝子を制御する機構を検討した。CGβプロモーターの欠失解析では、明確なcAMP応答配列は同定されなかった。一方、AMPとアデノシンはCGβプロモーター活性とCGα・β合成を増加させ、cAMPとは異なる機構の存在が示唆された。
pmid-2469421.summary_en: Using cultured choriocarcinoma cells, the authors examined how adenine nucleotides regulate choriogonadotropin (CG) subunit genes. Deletion analysis of the CG beta promoter, transfected into placental tumour cells, found no discrete cAMP response element. Instead, AMP and adenosine stimulated CG beta promoter activity and increased CG alpha and beta subunit synthesis, while GMP, CMP, guanosine and cytosine were inactive, suggesting a mechanism distinct from cAMP.

pmid-2470757.summary_ja: Lex決定基による炭水化物同士の相互作用が細胞認識を担うという仮説を、F9胎児性癌細胞を用いて検証した基礎研究である。F9細胞の凝集はlacto-N-fucopentaose IIIで阻害され、Lexリポソームとの選択的結合や自己凝集が示された。胎児性癌細胞株はモデルとして用いられており、臨床的な腫瘍の評価は行われていない。
pmid-2470757.summary_en: This basic study proposes that carbohydrate-carbohydrate interactions involving the Lex determinant mediate cell recognition. Using F9 embryonal carcinoma cells, the authors show that homotypic aggregation is inhibited by lacto-N-fucopentaose III, that F9 cells preferentially bind Lex liposomes, and that Lex-containing liposomes self-aggregate. Interactions require Ca2+ and Mg2+, are enhanced by Mn2+, and are blocked by EDTA. The work suggests a mechanism for compaction in preimplantation embryos. The F9 line is used as a model system, and the study does not address clinical tumors.

pmid-2475175.summary_ja: F9マウス奇形癌（胎児性癌様）幹細胞において、恒常的なc-myc発現が増殖、分化、造腫瘍能に与える影響を検討した。c-myc発現の増強は幹細胞の性質やレチノイン酸による分化を変化させず、分化中の増殖のみを延長させた。造腫瘍能も変化しなかった。c-mycの低下は分化ではなく増殖停止と関連すると結論づけられた。
pmid-2475175.summary_en: This study examined how constitutive c-myc expression affects proliferation, differentiation, and tumorigenicity of F9 mouse teratocarcinoma (embryonal carcinoma) stem cells. Enhanced c-myc did not alter stem cell properties or retinoic acid-induced differentiation, but it prolonged proliferation during differentiation. Tumorigenicity in soft agar and syngeneic mice was unchanged. The authors conclude that c-myc downregulation in F9 cells is linked to proliferation arrest rather than differentiation.

pmid-2475853.summary_ja: ヒト奇形癌細胞株NTERA-2 D1の転写産物から新規の反復配列を同定した。未分化な胎児性癌の表現型で発現量が最も高く、レチノイン酸による分化に伴って低下した。発現は組織特異的で、異なる胚発生由来の細胞株では検出されなかった。cDNA解析では独自配列と縦列反復サブ配列からなる構造が示された。
pmid-2475853.summary_en: The authors identified new human interspersed repetitive sequences from the NTERA-2 clone D1 embryonal carcinoma line. Transcript abundance was highest in the undifferentiated embryonal carcinoma phenotype and decreased with retinoic acid-induced differentiation. Expression was tissue specific and absent in other cell lines of different embryological origin. cDNA sequencing revealed unique and tandemly repeated sub-elements.

pmid-2478269.summary_ja: マウス奇形癌株PCC-4 AzaRとラット腹水肝癌を融合し、雑種細胞株F2231Aを作製した。本株はマウスで未分化腫瘍を形成し、レチノイン酸に応答して分化し、SSEA-1など奇形癌の性質の一部を保持していた。AFP mRNAの発現も認められた。臨床的な胚細胞腫瘍の治療よりも体細胞雑種の生物学に焦点を当てた研究である。
pmid-2478269.summary_en: The authors fused a pluripotent mouse teratocarcinoma line (PCC-4 AzaR) with a rat ascitic hepatoma to create a hybrid cell line, F2231A. The hybrid formed undifferentiated tumors in mice, differentiated in response to retinoic acid, and retained several teratocarcinoma properties, including SSEA-1 expression. It also expressed alpha-fetoprotein mRNA and high levels of p53. The study focuses on the biology of somatic cell hybridization rather than clinical germ cell tumor management.

pmid-2481673.summary_ja: F9、PC-13、NT2/D1の胎児性癌細胞株を用い、RT-PCRでFGFファミリーの発現を検討した。k-FGF癌遺伝子は3細胞株すべてで検出され、分化誘導により著明に低下した。EC細胞のFGF関連活性は主にk-FGFに起因すると考えられた。本研究は腫瘍患者ではなく、発生生物学の観点からのモデル研究である。
pmid-2481673.summary_en: Investigates expression of FGF family members in embryonal carcinoma (EC) cell lines F9, PC-13 and NT2/D1 using RT-PCR. The k-FGF oncogene was detected in all three lines and was markedly reduced when the cells were induced to differentiate, suggesting that k-FGF largely accounts for the FGF-related activity of EC cells. The study is framed around growth factor biology in embryogenesis, using EC cells as a model rather than studying tumor patients.

pmid-2482820.summary_ja: マウスのc-mybプロモーター領域の染色質構造を解析し、胎児性癌細胞(EC細胞)と胚性幹細胞(ES細胞)で発現していることを示した。発現量は造血細胞より低かった。ES細胞を胚様体へ分化させると発現が増加した。研究は腫瘍生物学ではなく、多能性細胞モデルにおける発生調節に焦点を当てている。
pmid-2482820.summary_en: Shows that c-myb mRNA is expressed in mouse embryonal carcinoma (EC) and embryonal stem (ES) cells. The c-myb promoter has a DNase I-hypersensitive site shared with hematopoietic cells but absent in fibroblasts. Expression is lower than in hematopoietic cells, and differentiation of ES cells into embryoid bodies increases c-myb expression. The study addresses developmental regulation in pluripotent cell models rather than tumor biology.

pmid-2483683.summary_ja: 多能性P19胎児性癌細胞の分化培養から、足場非依存性増殖を指標に、中胚葉系譜に限定された発生能を持つ細胞株を単離した。これらは胎児骨格筋様の筋細胞とI型コラーゲンを分泌する結合組織細胞に分化した。骨格筋と結合組織が共通の前駆細胞に由来することが示唆された。研究は腫瘍ではなく、系譜関係の研究モデルとして胎児性癌細胞を用いている。
pmid-2483683.summary_en: Isolates cell lines with restricted mesodermal developmental potential from differentiating cultures of pluripotent P19 embryonal carcinoma cells, by selecting for anchorage-independent growth. The derived lines differentiate into fetal-like skeletal myocytes and collagen-secreting connective tissue cells, suggesting a shared precursor. The work uses EC cells as a developmental model to study lineage relationships rather than as a tumor.

pmid-2484657.summary_ja: マウス胎児性癌細胞P19の細胞表面にThy-1糖タンパク質が発現することを、抗体結合、遺伝子導入、ノーザン解析で示した。レチノイン酸処理で発現が低下し、形態変化に先行した。培養細胞を用いた基礎研究であり、患者の腫瘍を対象とした研究ではない。
pmid-2484657.summary_en: This basic study shows that the Thy-1.2 glycoprotein is expressed on the surface of mouse P19 embryonal carcinoma cells, using monoclonal antibody binding, transfection, and Northern blot analysis. Expression decreases upon retinoic acid treatment and precedes morphological differentiation. The authors propose Thy-1 as a developmentally regulated surface marker amenable to genetic analysis. The work concerns cultured murine cell lines rather than patient tumors and is aimed at developmental biology.

pmid-2485243.summary_ja: F9胎児性癌細胞の増殖と分化を二重免疫蛍光法で同時に評価する方法を開発した。レチノイン酸とジブチリルcAMPで分化させると、サイトケラチン陽性細胞が出現し、その発現は増殖の低下にわずかに先行した。マウス細胞株を用いた細胞生物学的研究である。
pmid-2485243.summary_en: This study developed a double immunofluorescence method to monitor proliferation and differentiation of F9 embryonal carcinoma cells, using cytokeratin filament expression as a differentiation marker and PCNA/cyclin or BrdU labeling as proliferation markers. Undifferentiated F9 cells proliferated rapidly and lacked cytokeratin filaments. Retinoic acid and dibutyryl cyclic AMP induced cytokeratin-positive differentiated cells. Cytokeratin expression was associated with, and slightly preceded, a marked decline in proliferation. The work is a cell biology study on a murine cell line rather than a clinical investigation.

pmid-2485690.summary_ja: マウスF9胎児性癌幹細胞が内胚葉へ分化する過程で生じる、細胞表面分子、細胞骨格、接着性、増殖の変化を総説した。分化に伴いG1期とS期が延長し増殖が著明に低下する。これらの変化は胚発生時の内胚葉形成と類似し、奇形腫型腫瘍の理解にも役立つとされている。
pmid-2485690.summary_en: This review summarizes changes in cell surface molecules, cytoskeletal proteins, adhesion properties, and proliferation during endodermal differentiation of murine F9 embryonal carcinoma stem cells. Proliferation slows markedly as G1 and S phases lengthen. The authors argue that these changes closely parallel endoderm development in the embryo. They conclude that teratocarcinoma stem cell lines can help elucidate teratoma-type neoplasms as well as embryonic development. The focus is largely the developmental biology of cultured cells.

pmid-2486662.summary_ja: 奇形癌由来の7株を用いてマウス胚とのキメラを作製し、発生能を評価した。生きて生まれるキメラを形成したのは2株のみで、自然発生腫瘍由来のSTT-3は胎生中期の胎仔と成体によく定着した。雄の始原胚細胞に由来する胎児性癌細胞が生存可能なキメラを形成しうることが示された。
pmid-2486662.summary_en: This study examined the developmental potential of seven teratocarcinoma lines by making chimeras with mouse embryos. Only two lines, OTTBALB-2 and STT-3, contained stem cells able to form live-born chimeras. STT-3, a spontaneously occurring tumor line, colonized mid-gestational fetuses and adults well. The results indicate that embryonal carcinoma cells derived from male primordial germ cells can form viable chimeras. The authors suggest such tumor-derived lines could be useful as sources of embryonal carcinoma cells for introducing genes into embryos, and they compare their utility with embryonic stem cells.

pmid-2492529.summary_ja: 絨毛癌由来のヒト細胞株JARを用いて、基底膜成分の合成と細胞外マトリックスへの沈着を解析している。ラミニンとヘパラン硫酸プロテオグリカンは非共有結合で複合体を形成し、ECMに保持される。腫瘍そのものより、マトリックス生物学に主眼を置いた研究である。
pmid-2492529.summary_en: This study uses the JAR human choriocarcinoma cell line to examine how basal lamina components are synthesized and deposited. Laminin and heparan sulfate proteoglycan form a noncovalent complex that is stable under detergent conditions and is retained in the extracellular matrix. Ascorbate omission eliminated type IV collagen deposition but did not affect laminin-HSPG deposition, indicating that laminin-HSPG assembly does not depend on a type IV collagen network. The work focuses on matrix biology rather than on the tumor itself.

pmid-2497776.summary_ja: TERA-2由来のヒト胎児性癌細胞を用い、レチノイン酸による分化に伴う糖脂質と糖転移酵素の変化を解析している。グロボ系糖脂質は減少し、ラクト系やLex、ガングリオシド系は増加する。未報告であったβ1-3ガラクトシルトランスフェラーゼの性質も詳細に検討している。
pmid-2497776.summary_en: This study examines glycolipid and glycosyltransferase changes in TERA-2-derived human embryonal carcinoma cells during retinoic acid-induced differentiation. Globo-series glycolipids and the enzymes that synthesize them decrease, while lacto-series, Lex, and ganglioside pathways increase. The authors characterize a previously unreported beta1-3 galactosyltransferase in detail. The results suggest coordinated regulation of glycosyltransferases that control core structure assembly and terminal chain modification during differentiation.

pmid-2503706.summary_ja: マウスF9胎児性癌細胞が内胚葉上皮へ分化する過程で、β-1,4-ガラクトシルトランスフェラーゼの発現を解析している。酵素のmRNAと活性は分化に伴って上昇し、増加はゴルジ体に限局する。細胞表面の酵素活性は一定であった。胎児性癌細胞は分化モデルとして用いられている。
pmid-2503706.summary_en: This study examines beta-1,4-galactosyltransferase in F9 murine embryonal carcinoma cells during differentiation into endodermal epithelium. Enzyme mRNA and activity rise sharply as differentiation progresses, with the increase localized to the Golgi apparatus. Plasma membrane enzyme activity remains constant. The findings indicate that the cell-surface and Golgi enzyme pools are regulated independently during differentiation. The embryonal carcinoma cells serve as a differentiation model.

pmid-2511439.summary_ja: レチノイン酸処理によりマウスF9奇形癌腫幹細胞は分化する。著者らは、レチノイン酸投与後12時間以内に発現が減少するジンクフィンガー遺伝子REX-1をクローニングした。発現低下は主に転写速度の低下によるもので、細胞増殖の抑制とは無関係だった。本研究は基礎的な発生遺伝子制御に関する知見であり、臨床的な精巣腫瘍の研究ではない。
pmid-2511439.summary_en: Retinoic acid induces F9 murine teratocarcinoma stem cells to differentiate into cells resembling extraembryonic endoderm. The authors cloned REX-1, a zinc finger gene whose mRNA declines within 12 hours of retinoic acid treatment, mainly through reduced transcription. The decrease was independent of growth arrest. REX-1 was not detected in P19 cells or mouse embryos, and its protein may act as a transcriptional regulator.

pmid-2516796.summary_ja: マウスF9奇形癌腫の胚様体およびその内胚葉誘導体におけるプラスミノーゲン活性化因子の発現を検討した。臓側内胚葉はtPAとuPAの両方を分泌したが、そこから派生した壁側内胚葉はtPAを多く分泌しuPAはほぼ消失した。臓側から壁側内胚葉への転換を支持し、胚発生時の両因子の制御機構を研究する基礎モデルとなる。
pmid-2516796.summary_en: Plasminogen activator expression was studied in F9 teratocarcinoma embryoid bodies and their endoderm derivatives. Visceral endoderm secreted both tPA and uPA, whereas the parietal endoderm derived from it secreted high tPA and little uPA. The findings support transdifferentiation of visceral to parietal endoderm and provide a model for studying the coordinated regulation of these activators during embryogenesis.

pmid-2521339.summary_ja: 胎児性癌モデルであるF9奇形癌細胞を用い、レチノイン酸による分化過程でのインテグリンを解析した。インテグリンの総量は変化しないが、そのリン酸化は分化とともに著明に低下した。この変化はアクチン、フィブロネクチン、インテグリンの構造変化と時期が一致しており、細胞と基質の相互作用の制御に関与する可能性が示唆された。臨床的な腫瘍研究ではなく基礎的な発生生物学研究である。
pmid-2521339.summary_en: This study examines F9 teratocarcinoma cells, a model of embryonal carcinoma, during retinoic acid-induced differentiation in monolayer culture. The authors show that the 140-kD fibronectin receptor integrin is present at similar levels before and after differentiation, but its phosphorylation falls markedly. This loss coincides with changes in actin, fibronectin, and integrin organization, suggesting phosphorylation regulates developmentally controlled cell-matrix interactions. The work is basic developmental cell biology rather than tumor-clinical research.

pmid-2528953.summary_ja: DNA合成を阻害するヌクレオシドアナログがF9奇形癌細胞の分化を誘導し、正常ヌクレオシドがその効果を特異的に打ち消すことを示した。内胚葉分化の初期マーカーとしてプラスミノーゲンアクチベーターを用い、野生型とチミジンキナーゼ欠損株を比較した。結果は既知の作用機序と整合し、DNA合成阻害が奇形癌幹細胞の分化を直接引き起こすという見解を支持する。臨床的要素を含まない実験研究である。
pmid-2528953.summary_en: This study shows that nucleoside analogues that inhibit DNA synthesis induce differentiation of F9 teratocarcinoma cells, and that normal nucleosides specifically counteract this effect. Using plasminogen activator as an early endodermal marker, the authors compare wild-type F9 cells with a thymidine kinase-deficient mutant. The results are consistent with known mechanisms of the analogues, supporting the view that DNA synthesis inhibition directly drives differentiation of teratocarcinoma stem cells. The work is experimental, with no clinical component.

pmid-2538306.summary_ja: 絨毛癌由来のJAR細胞と妊娠初期の胎盤外植片を用いて、hCGα鎖のO-糖鎖付加がα/βダイマー形成を規定するかを検討した。O-糖鎖は小胞体でのダイマー形成後、分泌経路の後期に付加されることが示された。臨床管理ではなく、栄養膜細胞のホルモン生合成の基礎研究である。
pmid-2538306.summary_en: This study tested whether O-glycosylation of the hCG alpha-subunit regulates assembly of the alpha-beta dimer in JAR choriocarcinoma cells and first-trimester placental explants. Labeling experiments showed that the O-linked glycan is added late in the secretory pathway, after dimer formation in the endoplasmic reticulum. Only half of secreted free alpha-subunit from JAR cells carried the glycan, and less than 10% in placental explants. The findings clarify trophoblast hormone biosynthesis but do not address clinical management of choriocarcinoma.

pmid-2538320.summary_ja: 分化したマウス胎児性癌細胞株P19 EPI-7の増殖因子産生を検討した研究である。本株はPDGF様因子、TGF-βおよび大量のIGF-IIを産生し、IGF-I受容体を発現していた。細胞密度に依存した増殖停止には、オートクリン機構が関与する可能性がある。ヒトの臨床データはなく、基礎的な細胞生物学の報告である。
pmid-2538320.summary_en: This study characterized growth factor production by P19 EPI-7, a differentiated murine embryonal carcinoma cell line. The cells produce platelet-derived growth factor-like factor, transforming growth factor-beta, and large amounts of insulin-like growth factor II, and express IGF-I receptors. Density-dependent growth arrest in these cells may involve autocrine loops. The work addresses developmental cell biology in an animal cell line, with no clinical or human patient data on germ cell tumors.

pmid-2544608.summary_ja: F9奇形癌幹細胞と、レチノイン酸・cAMPで分化させた壁側内胚葉様細胞におけるFGF発現を比較した基礎研究です。活性を持つ酸性・塩基性FGFは分化後にのみ検出され、幹細胞ではmRNAはあるもののタンパク質は合成されませんでした。発生期の胚盤胞へのFGF供給源となる可能性が示唆されています。臨床の胚細胞腫瘍を扱ったものではありません。
pmid-2544608.summary_en: This basic developmental study examines fibroblast growth factor expression in F9 teratocarcinoma stem cells and in their retinoic acid and dibutyryl cAMP-differentiated derivatives, parietal endoderm. Using heparin-affinity chromatography, endothelial proliferation assays, immunoprecipitation, and Western blotting, the authors detect biologically active acidic and basic FGF only after differentiation. Although FGF mRNAs are present in stem cells, protein synthesis is restricted to differentiated cells. The authors suggest embryonic parietal endoderm may supply FGFs to the developing blastocyst. The study does not address clinical germ cell tumors.

pmid-2553454.summary_ja: マウス胚の卵黄嚢内胚葉とF9胎児性癌細胞を用い、アクチン細胞骨格の構成を比較した基礎研究。壁側内胚葉は細胞内にストレスファイバーを形成するが、臓側内胚葉は形成しない。F9由来の壁側内胚葉様細胞は、フィブロネクチン上でのみストレスファイバーを形成し、細胞骨格の応答が発生段階で調節されることを示唆している。
pmid-2553454.summary_en: Using mouse parietal and visceral yolk sac endoderm and F9 embryonal carcinoma cells, this study examines actin cytoskeleton organization. Parietal endoderm cells form stress fibers in vivo and in culture, whereas visceral endoderm does not. Undifferentiated F9 cells show only short actin spikes, but their parietal endoderm-like derivatives form stress fibers on fibronectin and not gelatin. The teratocarcinoma-derived PYS-2 line behaves similarly. The authors conclude that the cytoskeletal response of teratocarcinoma cells to matrix is developmentally regulated.

pmid-2553456.summary_ja: ヒト胚性癌細胞株Tera 2 clone 13の細胞表面にIGF-I受容体が発現することを示した基礎研究。レチノイン酸による分化誘導で受容体数が増加し、IGF-Iおよびインスリン刺激によりチロシンリン酸化が起こった。結合実験では、I型とII型双方の特徴を持つ受容体タンパク質が検出された。I型受容体が細胞増殖に関与する可能性を示唆している。
pmid-2553456.summary_en: This study shows that the human embryonal carcinoma line Tera 2 clone 13 expresses functional type-I and type-II insulin-like growth factor receptors at the cell surface. Affinity crosslinking revealed receptor proteins with features of both types. Retinoic acid-induced differentiation increased receptor number without changing the type I to type II ratio. IGF-I receptors showed ligand-stimulated tyrosine autophosphorylation after IGF-I and insulin binding. The authors suggest type-I receptors may mediate IGF and insulin effects on proliferation.

pmid-2557358.summary_ja: 本研究は、マウスF9胎児性癌細胞の未分化状態と、レチノイン酸などで誘導した分化細胞について、レクチン結合性の違いを解析したものである。DBA結合の不均一性や、分化に伴う高分子量糖タンパク質の出現が示された。個々の細胞の特徴づけにおけるレクチンの有用性は限られるとされた。
pmid-2557358.summary_en: This 1989 cell-biology study examines lectin binding to murine F9 embryonal carcinoma cells before and after chemically induced differentiation into parietal endoderm-like derivatives. Undifferentiated cells bound some lectins homogeneously but showed heterogeneous binding to Dolichos biflorus agglutinin, and differentiation altered glycoprotein profiles, including emergence of high-Mr surface proteins and a laminin-like secreted glycoprotein. The authors conclude that lectin conjugates reveal population heterogeneity and have limited value for characterizing individual cells.

pmid-2558044.summary_ja: ヒトRAR-αの一部領域を発現するベクターをF9胎児性癌細胞に導入した。過剰発現クローンはレチノイン酸による分化誘導に抵抗性を示し、一部の分化マーカーの誘導が失われた。内因性のレチノイン酸受容体を優性阻害的に抑制している可能性が示唆された。
pmid-2558044.summary_en: This study constructed expression vectors encoding a region of human retinoic acid receptor-alpha (hRAR-alpha) and introduced them into F9 embryonal carcinoma cells. Overexpression yielded clones resistant to retinoic acid-induced differentiation, which lost normal induction of endo B cytokeratin, laminin B-1, and tissue plasminogen activator mRNAs, while type IV collagen and Hox-1.3 induction persisted. The resistant clones also showed reduced reporter activity. The authors propose that the vectors act as dominant-negative inhibitors of endogenous retinoic acid receptors.

pmid-2564417.summary_ja: ヒトサイトメガロウイルス感染により、分化した奇形癌細胞と線維芽細胞でSSEA-1が誘導されることを示した。感染細胞のみでSSEA-1エピトープを持つ糖脂質が検出された。糖転移酵素の発現も変化していた。子宮内感染による胎児神経系障害の機序として示唆されている。奇形癌細胞は2種の実験細胞の一つである。
pmid-2564417.summary_en: This study shows that human cytomegalovirus (HCMV) infection induces stage-specific embryonic antigen-1 (SSEA-1, Lex) on the surface of differentiated human teratocarcinoma cells and human diploid fibroblasts 3 to 6 days after infection. SSEA-1 epitope-bearing fucosylated lactoseries glycolipids appeared only in infected cells. Infection altered several glycosyltransferases, including increased beta1-3 N-acetylglucosaminyltransferase. The authors suggest that inappropriate induction of SSEA-1 during intrauterine infection could damage the developing fetal nervous system. Teratocarcinoma cells are one of two experimental cell types.

pmid-2573835.summary_ja: マウス胎児性癌細胞および胚性幹細胞において、血小板由来成長因子受容体(PDGFR)の新規転写産物が発現することを示した。幹細胞では細胞外ドメインの大部分を欠く短型が優位で、分化に伴い長型が増加する。発生初期に特異的なプロモーターが使われる可能性を示す基礎研究であり、腫瘍学的研究ではない。
pmid-2573835.summary_en: This basic research study examines platelet-derived growth factor receptor (PDGFR) transcripts in mouse embryonal carcinoma and embryonic stem cells. These cells express a 4.2-kb PDGFR mRNA initiated from an alternative promoter, lacking the first five exons that encode much of the extracellular domain. The short form predominates in stem cells, while the long form increases after in vitro differentiation. The findings suggest a stage- and cell-type-specific promoter regulates a ligand-independent receptor form during early embryogenesis.

pmid-2574037.summary_ja: マウス胎児性癌細胞から、非許容温度で増殖が障害され分化する温度感受性変異株を3種単離した。変異はS期での一過性の細胞蓄積を引き起こし、DNA合成阻害がEC細胞の分化誘導の主因であると考察している。胚発生と幹細胞分化の研究モデルとしての基礎研究である。
pmid-2574037.summary_en: Researchers isolated three temperature-sensitive mutant lines from mouse embryonal carcinoma (EC) cells whose growth is impaired at a non-permissive temperature, causing them to differentiate. The mutations disrupt cell cycle progression, leading to transient accumulation in S phase. The authors propose that inhibition of DNA synthesis is the primary trigger for stem cell differentiation in EC cells. The work uses EC cells as a model for early embryonic development and stem cell biology rather than for tumor-focused investigation.

pmid-2574458.summary_ja: 胎児性癌細胞を免疫原としてモノクローナル抗体を作製し、TEC-4と名付けた。この抗体は胎児性癌細胞や胚由来幹細胞株、初期胚に反応し、後期胚や成体組織には検出されない。抗原は120kDaおよび240kDaの糖タンパク質に関連し、エピトープはタンパク質部分にある。レチノイン酸による分化初期にこのエピトープは消失する。
pmid-2574458.summary_en: A monoclonal antibody was raised against embryoglycan-negative mouse embryonal carcinoma cells to identify less immunogenic stage-specific embryonic antigens. The antibody, termed TEC-4, reacts with mouse embryonal carcinoma and embryo-derived stem cell lines, and with eggs and two-cell embryos, but not with later embryos or adult tissues. The antigen is associated with glycoproteins of about 120 and 240 kDa, and its epitope lies in the protein moiety. The epitope disappears early during retinoic acid-induced differentiation.

pmid-2576519.summary_ja: 胎児性癌細胞株NT2/D1を用い、レチノイン酸による分化誘導中のヒトHOX遺伝子4種の発現を解析した。転写速度に差はなく、シクロヘキシミド処理によるmRNA蓄積から、転写後制御の関与が示唆された。胚発生モデルとしての基礎研究であり、臨床的な腫瘍研究ではない。
pmid-2576519.summary_en: The authors examine expression of four human homeobox genes (HOX-1, HOX-2, HOX-3, HOX-5) in the embryonal carcinoma cell line NT2/D1 during retinoic acid-induced differentiation. Transcripts accumulate over 18 hours to 14 days, with sizes matching those in human embryos. Nuclear run-on assays show no transcriptional rate difference between differentiated and undifferentiated cells. Cycloheximide treatment raises some transcripts, suggesting posttranscriptional control of homeobox expression. The study uses a germ cell tumor-derived line as a developmental model.

pmid-2627890.summary_ja: ヘパリン存在下で培養したP19胎児性癌細胞の馴化培地には強力な有糸分裂促進活性があった。分画により、ヒトK-FGF産物と免疫学的に関連する15kDaのポリペプチドと、酸性・塩基性FGFとは異なる4本鎖複合体の2種類のヘパリン結合性増殖因子を同定した。いずれも両生類で中胚葉誘導活性を示した。
pmid-2627890.summary_en: Conditioned medium from P19 embryonal carcinoma cells, grown with heparin, contains potent mitogenic activity. Fractionation revealed two distinct heparin-binding growth factors. One is a 15 kDa polypeptide immunologically related to the human K-FGF oncogene product, and the other is a four-polypeptide complex that is distinct from acidic and basic FGF. Both showed mesoderm-inducing activity in amphibians. K-FGF transcripts were expressed in embryonal carcinoma and embryonic stem cells.

pmid-2628163.summary_ja: 胎児性癌細胞ではウイルスLTRプロモーターの機能が不十分なため、組み込み後にレトロウイルスの発現が阻害される。一方、ゲノム上の稀な部位では発現が許容される。発現する3つのプロウイルスを解析したところ、2つは活発に転写される細胞遺伝子のイントロンに組み込まれ、近傍の細胞プロモーターから転写されていた。この手法は活性遺伝子とプロモーターの同定に応用可能と考えられる。
pmid-2628163.summary_en: Retroviral expression in embryonal carcinoma cells is blocked after integration because the viral LTR promoter functions poorly in this cell type. Some rare genomic sites nonetheless permit expression. The study analyzed three expressed proviruses and found that two inserted into first introns of actively transcribed cellular genes, near active cellular promoters. Viral transcripts were initiated from the cellular 5' flank and spliced from cellular donors to viral acceptors. The authors suggest this approach could isolate active genes and promoters in different tissues.

pmid-2639910.summary_ja: 胚性癌由来のTera-2細胞と絨毛癌由来のJeg-3細胞を用いて、HLAクラスI様遺伝子の発現を解析した報告である。両細胞株ともHLA転写産物は著しく低下しており、Tera-2はガンマインターフェロンにより発現が誘導された。Jeg-3では新規のHLA-C様配列が同定された。
pmid-2639910.summary_en: Examines HLA class I-like gene expression in two human developmental tumour cell lines: Tera-2, derived from embryonal carcinoma, and Jeg-3, a choriocarcinoma line representing extraembryonic tissue. Both lines show markedly reduced HLA transcripts, and Tera-2 expression is upregulated by gamma interferon. A novel HLA-C-like sequence was identified in Jeg-3, providing immunogenetic insight into germ cell-derived lines.

pmid-2647482.summary_ja: マウス胎児性癌(EC)細胞が分化する際の原癌遺伝子発現の変化を検討した基礎研究。未分化EC細胞と分化誘導細胞を比較し、c-srcやc-fos、EGF受容体の発現は増加し、c-mosやN-mycなどは減少した。これらの変化が分化に寄与するか、単なる二次的現象かは不明とされる。臨床の胚細胞腫瘍を対象とした研究ではない。
pmid-2647482.summary_en: This basic research study examines how protooncogene expression changes when murine embryonal carcinoma (EC) cells differentiate. Ubiquitously expressed genes such as c-myc and c-K-ras, along with restricted genes like N-myc and c-mos, were compared between undifferentiated EC cells and their differentiated derivatives. Increased expression of c-src, c-fos, int-1, int-2, and EGF receptor accompanied differentiation, whereas c-mos, c-K-ras, c-myc, and N-myc decreased. The authors note these changes may either drive differentiation or be secondary events without functional significance. The work uses EC cells as a developmental model rather than clinical tumors.

pmid-2651184.summary_ja: マウス胎児性癌細胞株P19とPC13が分泌する増殖因子を解析した基礎研究。両株はPDGF様因子、TGF-β、インスリン様増殖因子を分泌し、PC13はFGF関連因子、P19はTGF-αを分泌した。分化したP19由来細胞への傍分泌効果も検討された。臨床の胚細胞腫瘍を直接対象とするものではない。
pmid-2651184.summary_en: This study investigates polypeptide growth factors secreted by murine embryonal carcinoma (EC) cell lines P19 and PC13. Both lines secrete a PDGF-like factor, TGF-beta, and insulin-like growth factors. PC13 additionally secretes a heparin-binding growth factor related to FGF, while P19 secretes TGF-alpha, the first such demonstration for an early embryonic cell equivalent. The authors tested possible paracrine growth effects on differentiated P19 derivatives representing all three germ layers. Differences in growth factor production are discussed in relation to the developmental origin of the cell lines.

pmid-2661360.summary_ja: 同一卵巣に子宮内膜嚢胞、類皮嚢腫、粘液性嚢胞腺腫が併存した1例の症例報告。超音波所見と病理組織所見を比較し、卵巣腫瘍の超音波評価の有用性と限界を検討している。類皮嚢腫は成熟奇形腫に相当するが、胚細胞腫瘍は主題ではない。
pmid-2661360.summary_en: Case report of a single ovary containing three coexisting lesions: an endometrial cyst, a dermoid cyst, and a mucinous cystadenoma. Ultrasonographic findings were compared with histological results. The authors discuss the usefulness, drawbacks, and limitations of ultrasound in evaluating ovarian tumors. The dermoid cyst component corresponds to a mature teratoma, but germ cell tumor biology and management are not the main focus of the report.

pmid-2665885.summary_ja: c-Ki-ras遺伝子が増幅したマウス胎児性癌細胞株PCC4を含む細胞株を用いた研究。増幅は倍加時間および播種効率に有意な影響を与えなかった。増幅Ki-ras遺伝子のPCR解析では、いずれの細胞株にも活性化点変異は認められず、c-Ki-ras増幅だけでは悪性の振る舞いを説明できないことが示唆された。
pmid-2665885.summary_en: This study examined growth properties and Ki-ras gene status in murine embryonal carcinoma cell lines, including PCC4, which carries an amplified c-Ki-ras gene. Doubling time and plating efficiency were not significantly altered by amplification. PCR analysis of the amplified Ki-ras gene in PCC4 and other embryonal carcinoma lines revealed no activating point mutations. The findings suggest that c-Ki-ras amplification alone does not explain malignant behavior in these cells.

pmid-2676162.summary_ja: チェコスロバキアの小児13例を報告した。症例は生後2〜19か月、腫瘤径10〜30mm、男女比は2:1であった。著者らは既報と合わせ、これまでに報告された小児例は世界で174例、うち欧州は30例と集計し、地域分布を示している。大泉門上の類皮嚢腫は先天性の病変であり、典型的な胚細胞腫瘍ではない。
pmid-2676162.summary_en: This report describes 13 Czechoslovak children, aged 2 to 19 months, with dermoid cysts over the anterior fontanelle, measuring 10 to 30 mm, with a male-to-female ratio of 2:1. The authors combine these cases with previously published reports to show the global and European distribution of this condition, which now totals 174 pediatric cases. Dermoid cysts at the cranial midline are congenital lesions and are not typical germ cell tumors.

pmid-2680806.summary_ja: 良性疾患の女性5例で腫瘍マーカーCA 125またはCA 19-9が高値を示した。子宮内膜症3例でCA 125が、類皮嚢腫2例でCA 19-9が上昇していた。術前に全例で悪性腫瘍を否定できなかった。卵巣腫瘍の診断では、双合診、超音波検査、コンピュータ断層撮影(CT)、腫瘍マーカーを併せて評価すべきと結論された。
pmid-2680806.summary_en: The authors report five women with benign gynecologic tumors and elevated CA 125 or CA 19-9. Three had endometriosis with high CA 125, and two had dermoid cysts with high CA 19-9. Malignancy could not be excluded preoperatively in any case, showing that tumor marker elevations can mislead. Bimanual examination, ultrasound, CT and tumor markers should be considered together in diagnosing ovarian tumors.

pmid-2689021.summary_ja: 低カルシウム培地で増殖するF9胎児性癌細胞株を用い、凝集体のコンパクション化と分化の関係を検討した。コンパクション化していない凝集体はレチノイン酸処理後も胚様体を形成できず、カルシウム添加によるコンパクション化で分化能が回復した。コンパクト化した単層から作製した凝集体はより速く分化し、関与タンパク質の持続やコンパクション阻害因子の減少が示唆された。
pmid-2689021.summary_en: Using a low-calcium subline of F9 embryonal carcinoma cells, the authors examined how cell compaction relates to differentiation in suspension aggregates. Uncompacted aggregates failed to form embryoid bodies after retinoic acid exposure, while calcium-induced compaction restored this capacity. Aggregates formed from previously compacted monolayers compacted and differentiated faster. This suggests that compaction-related proteins persist through trypsinization or that a compaction inhibitor declines.

pmid-2725075.summary_ja: レチノイン酸で神経細胞へ分化させたP19胎児性癌細胞において、原がん遺伝子の発現変化を解析した基礎研究です。erbBとsrcは分化決定期に一過性に上昇し、mycは分化過程で低下しました。対照細胞や分化しない変異株では見られず、神経分化に特異的な変化と考えられます。臨床的な腫瘍研究ではありません。
pmid-2725075.summary_en: This study examines P19 embryonal carcinoma cells during retinoic acid-induced neuronal differentiation. erbB and src proto-oncogene expression rose transiently during the commitment phase, before the differentiated phenotype appeared, while myc expression decreased during differentiation. These changes were absent in untreated cells, cells treated while growing as monolayers, and non-differentiating mutants, suggesting specificity for neuronal differentiation. The work uses embryonal carcinoma cells as a developmental model rather than studying tumor behavior in patients.

pmid-2745553.summary_ja: チロシンリン酸化を阻害するハービマイシンAが、マウスのF9胎児性癌細胞の内胚葉分化とMEL赤白血病細胞の赤芽球分化を誘導することを示した研究である。両系に共通する分化誘導段階がチロシンリン酸化に関連すると考察されている。胚細胞腫瘍の臨床的生物学ではなく、分化機構が主題である。
pmid-2745553.summary_en: Herbimycin A, a tyrosine kinase phosphorylation inhibitor, induces differentiation in two mouse systems: endoderm differentiation of F9 embryonal carcinoma cells and terminal erythroid differentiation of MEL erythroleukemia cells. The shared triggering effect suggests a common intracellular step linked to tyrosine phosphorylation. Embryonal carcinoma cells serve here as an experimental model, and the study addresses general differentiation signaling rather than the clinical biology of germ cell tumors.

pmid-2769032.summary_ja: 口腔・鼻咽頭に生じる稀な先天性良性病変である毛髪性ポリープ(皮様嚢胞)について報告している。新たに3例を報告し、うち2例は鼻咽頭、1例は中咽頭に発生していた。1例の新生児は重度の大理石骨病を合併していた。全例が全身麻酔下に手術で切除され、合併症はなかった。乳幼児では気道閉塞のリスクがあり、経験豊富な小児麻酔科医が必要であると強調している。
pmid-2769032.summary_en: This paper reviews dermoids, or hairy polyps, of the oro-nasopharynx, rare benign congenital lesions of which about 120 cases have been recorded. The authors describe three new cases, two in the nasopharynx and one in the oropharynx. One neonate also had severe osteopetrosis. All lesions were removed surgically under general anaesthesia without complications. The paper emphasizes the airway risk in young children and the need for an experienced paediatric anaesthetist.

pmid-2792079.summary_ja: 未分化ヒトNTERA2奇形癌細胞で発現する、EGF様領域を持つ188アミノ酸のポリペプチドをコードする新規遺伝子を単離した。レチノイン酸による分化誘導で発現が消失した。cDNAの導入はNIH3T3線維芽細胞を形質転換させた。主眼は遺伝子の同定と形質転換活性にあり、奇形癌細胞は供給源として用いられている。
pmid-2792079.summary_en: The authors isolated a human gene encoding a 188-amino-acid polypeptide with a region similar to epidermal growth factor. The gene was expressed in undifferentiated NTERA2 human teratocarcinoma cells and in mouse teratocarcinoma cells. Its expression was shut off when the cells were induced to differentiate with retinoic acid. Introducing the cDNA transformed NIH3T3 fibroblasts. The study focuses on gene identification and transforming activity, using a teratocarcinoma line as its source, so its relevance to germ cell tumors is indirect.

pmid-2914580.summary_ja: 1989年の基礎研究で、マウスP19胎児性癌細胞の核マトリックス蛋白質を、分化由来のクローン細胞やレチノイン酸処理細胞と比較した。未分化細胞と分化細胞で蛋白質組成が異なり、レチノイン酸処理では一過性の変化が見られた。核マトリックス蛋白質が分化段階を反映するという結論である。ヒトの胚細胞腫瘍の臨床は主題ではない。
pmid-2914580.summary_en: This 1989 experimental study compared nuclear matrix protein composition in murine P19 embryonal carcinoma cells with in vitro-differentiated clonal derivatives and with retinoic acid-induced differentiated cells. The authors found distinct protein profiles across cell lines, with some proteins restricted to undifferentiated EC cells and others to differentiated derivatives. Transient changes in matrix proteins occurred during retinoic acid treatment. The results suggest nuclear matrix protein composition reflects cellular differentiation state. The work uses EC cells as a laboratory model of differentiation rather than addressing human germ cell tumor management.

pmid-2917609.summary_ja: 1989年の基礎研究で、多能性胎児性癌細胞株の融合雑種PR3を作製し、代謝協調能と分化能を検討した。細胞間の通信能と多能性は独立に分離することが示された。主題は胎児性癌細胞の細胞生物学であり、臨床の胚細胞腫瘍診療ではない。
pmid-2917609.summary_en: This 1989 experimental study created a fusion hybrid, PR3, from a pluripotent embryonal carcinoma cell line and examined its metabolic cooperation and developmental capacity. The hybrid resembled its pluripotent parent in gap-junction communication and in forming embryoid bodies and tumors. Using segregant lines, the authors showed that communication competence and in vitro pluripotency segregate independently. Thus, the loss of developmental capacity in a less pluripotent line is not explained by communication deficiency. The work is basic cell biology of EC cells rather than clinical germ cell tumor care.

pmid-2447720.summary_ja: 卵巣卵黄嚢腫瘍の一例で、腹水検体の細胞診により診断が示唆された症例です。塗抹標本に加え細胞ブロックの検討が追加の診断所見をもたらしました。血清学的、免疫細胞化学的、組織学的所見も報告され、細胞形態に基づく予備診断が後続の検査計画に有用であることが強調されています。
pmid-2447720.summary_en: This case report describes a yolk sac tumor of the ovary first suggested by cytologic examination of ascitic fluid. Conventional smears and, importantly, a cell block prepared from the effusion provided additional diagnostic clues. The authors also report serologic, immunocytochemical, and histologic findings. They emphasize that a preliminary cytomorphologic diagnosis of this highly malignant tumor guides subsequent immunocytochemical and serologic studies, highlighting the value of cell block preparation for effusion specimens.

pmid-2447774.summary_ja: 妊娠性絨毛性疾患を対象に、血清hCGと遊離サブユニットを高感度免疫放射定量法で測定した研究です。絨毛癌ではβ-hCGとhCGの比が著明に高値を示し、胞状奇胎は中間的な値でした。この比により正常妊娠、胞状奇胎、絨毛癌を高い確率で鑑別でき、絨毛癌の極早期の再発予測にも有用でした。
pmid-2447774.summary_en: This study measured serum hCG and its free alpha and beta subunits using highly sensitive immunoradiometric assays in gestational trophoblastic disease. Normal pregnancy showed a stable beta-hCG to hCG ratio, whereas gestational choriocarcinoma had markedly elevated beta-hCG levels and ratios. Complete hydatidiform mole showed intermediate values. These ratios discriminated normal pregnancy, mole, and choriocarcinoma with high probability. The assay also predicted very early tumor recurrence in choriocarcinoma patients, suggesting clinical utility for monitoring.

pmid-2447775.summary_ja: 絨毛癌由来JEG-3細胞を用い、活性化白血球の培養上清およびリンフォカイン・モノカインの増殖への影響を検討したin vitro研究です。γ-インターフェロン、腫瘍壊死因子、コロニー刺激因子は増殖を抑制し、高用量のインターロイキン1および2は増殖を促進しました。妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍における免疫学的機序の理解に示唆を与えるとされています。
pmid-2447775.summary_en: This in vitro study examined how supernatants from activated leukocytes and individual lymphokines and monokines affect proliferation of JEG-3 human gestational choriocarcinoma cells. Gamma-interferon, tumor necrosis factor, and colony-stimulating factor inhibited growth, while high-dose interleukin-1 and interleukin-2 stimulated it. B cell growth factor showed dose-dependent effects. The authors suggest these findings may inform understanding of immunologic mechanisms in early pregnancy and tumor-host interactions in gestational trophoblastic neoplasia.

pmid-2448192.summary_ja: 毛細血管拡張性運動失調症の患者に卵巣卵黄嚢腫瘍が生じた症例報告です。両疾患ともαフェトプロテイン産生異常と関連し、同一の血清マーカーを示すことから診断・管理上の課題が論じられています。この合併は文献上初の報告とされています。
pmid-2448192.summary_en: This case report describes a patient with ataxia-telangiectasia who developed an endodermal sinus (yolk sac) tumor of the ovary. Both conditions are associated with abnormal alpha-fetoprotein production, and ataxia-telangiectasia carries an increased risk of malignancy. The authors note that primary ovarian tumors in these patients are extremely rare and that this association had not previously been reported. They focus on the diagnostic and management challenges of two diseases sharing the same serum marker.

pmid-2448942.summary_ja: 精巣の混合型胚細胞腫瘍(胎児性癌とセミノーマ)に対する後腹膜リンパ節郭清と化学療法後、肺門リンパ節腫大とαフェトプロテイン上昇を呈した35歳男性の症例報告です。縦隔鏡下生検によりサルコイドーシスと診断されました。精巣腫瘍治療後の腫瘍マーカー上昇や所見の解釈における鑑別の重要性が示されています。
pmid-2448942.summary_en: This case report describes a 35-year-old man who presented with hilar lymphadenopathy and elevated alpha-fetoprotein after retroperitoneal lymph node dissection and chemotherapy for a mixed embryonal and seminomatous testicular tumor. Mediastinoscopy-guided biopsy established the diagnosis of sarcoidosis. The case highlights a diagnostic pitfall in which findings and elevated tumor markers after testicular germ cell tumor treatment may be confused with malignant relapse.

pmid-2449134.summary_ja: 精巣がんの治療の進歩を、シスプラチンを中心とした化学療法の導入を軸にまとめた総説です。播種性病変の約70%はPVBまたはVAB-6療法で無病状態となる一方、約30%は難治性で、その20〜40%はシスプラチンとVP-16またはVM-26の併用救援化学療法で救済可能とされています。化学療法、手術、放射線療法の適切な組み合わせが治癒に不可欠と述べられています。
pmid-2449134.summary_en: This Japanese review summarizes current management of testicular cancer. Cisplatin-based chemotherapy has dramatically improved outcomes, with about 70% of disseminated patients achieving disease-free status after PVB or VAB-6 therapy. Roughly 30% have unresectable or refractory disease, and 20-40% of these can be salvaged with cisplatin plus VP-16 or VM-26 combination salvage chemotherapy. Selected patients with negative serum markers may undergo salvage surgery. The authors stress that combining chemotherapy, surgery, and radiation therapy is essential for cure.

pmid-2449257.summary_ja: 転移性胚細胞腫瘍およびStage I精巣腫瘍の補助化学療法を想定し、EBCi(3)レジメン（エトポシド・ブレオマイシン・シスプラチン、ブレオマイシン3日間持続投与）を評価した研究です。44例中40例が中央値21か月の観察で無病であり、2年無病生存率は91%でした。ブレオマイシン肺毒性は認めず、低毒性・高い有効性が示唆されています。
pmid-2449257.summary_en: This study evaluated a short-course regimen of etoposide, bleomycin, and cisplatin with prolonged daily bleomycin infusion over 3 days for metastatic germ cell tumors and as potential adjuvant treatment for stage 1 testicular tumors. Among 44 patients, 40 remained disease free at a median follow-up of 21 months, with 2-year disease-free survival of 91%. No bleomycin-related lung toxicity was observed, compared with four cases among 91 previously treated patients. The authors conclude the regimen may be suitable as adjuvant treatment.

pmid-2449547.summary_ja: 男性がん患者でラジオイムノアッセイにより高値を示した血清hCGを、無傷分子を認識する免疫測定法と比較した研究です。免疫測定法で確認されたのは72%で、28%は乖離していました。そのうち22例は精巣セミノーマ患者（検討例の42%）であり、不完全型hCGの存在が示唆され、セミノーマにおける腫瘍マーカーの解釈に影響を与えます。
pmid-2449547.summary_en: This study compared immunometric assays requiring intact hCG with a competitive radioimmunoassay measuring intact hCG and its free beta chain in male cancer patients with elevated levels. Immunometric methods confirmed elevation in 72% of samples, but 28% were discordant, reading normal by immunometric assays. Of these discrepancies, 22 patients had seminomatous tumors, representing 42% of seminoma patients tested. The authors attribute this to incomplete hCG forms detected by the radioimmunoassay, which affects tumor marker interpretation in seminoma.

pmid-2449757.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍患者の血清を用い、モノクローナル抗体でαフェトプロテイン(AFP)、ヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)、PLAP、CEAのエピトープ別マーカーを測定した1988年の研究。セミノーマでは特徴的なPLAPパターンがみられ、1例では臨床的再発の10か月前から上昇した。AFP単独高値は卵黄嚢腫瘍、hCGとAFPの併存は奇形腫または胎児性癌成分を示唆した。マーカープロファイルが組織型の推定や病態把握に有用であることを示した。
pmid-2449757.summary_en: This 1988 study measured epitope-defined tumor markers, AFP, hCG, PLAP and CEA, in sera of patients with testicular germ cell tumors using monoclonal antibodies. Localized and metastatic seminoma showed characteristic PLAP profiles, and PLAP rose ten months before clinical recurrence in one case. Persistent PLAP elevation suggested metastatic seminoma, while high AFP alone indicated yolk sac tumors and combined hCG and AFP suggested teratoma or embryonal carcinoma components. The authors conclude that marker profiles may help characterize histology and detect disease.

pmid-2450500.summary_ja: 進行性性腺外・病期IIC・病期III期セミノーマ患者62例を対象とした非ランダム化前向き試験の報告。シスプラチン併用化学療法で88%が完全寛解を得て、85%が無病生存を維持した。エトポシドとシスプラチンの併用は多剤併用と同等の効果を示した。治療開始時のヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)高値は予後不良と関連していた。
pmid-2450500.summary_en: This 1988 nonrandomized prospective trial treated 62 patients with advanced extragonadal, stage IIC, or stage III seminoma, mostly with cisplatin-based chemotherapy. Complete remission was achieved in 88% of evaluable patients, and 85% of all patients remained alive and disease-free. The etoposide plus cisplatin regimen performed as well as multidrug regimens. Elevated hCG at treatment start predicted worse outcome. The authors conclude that cisplatin-based chemotherapy is effective and should be considered as initial therapy for these patients.

pmid-2450555.summary_ja: 1979〜1984年に転移性セミノーマの37例に化学療法と放射線療法を施行した研究。5年全生存期間(全生存率)は49%で、バルキー病変は不良因子だった。完全寛解は24%、良好な部分奏効は56%だった。シクロホスファミドとエトポシドの併用は、シスプラチン併用療法より好中球減少や敗血症が少なかった。
pmid-2450555.summary_en: This 1988 British Journal of Cancer study reviews 37 patients treated for metastatic seminoma between 1979 and 1984. Twenty-seven had relapsed after initial radiotherapy for stage I or IIA disease, and ten received chemotherapy first followed by radiotherapy to bulky sites. Regimens included cisplatin-containing combinations or cyclophosphamide with etoposide. Five-year overall survival was 49%, with bulky disease an adverse factor. Complete response occurred in 24% and good partial response in 56% of assessable patients. Cyclophosphamide-etoposide caused less neutropenia and sepsis.

pmid-2450632.summary_ja: 精巣奇形癌3株をヌードマウスに皮下継代し、その後腹腔内に移植して性状の違いを比較した研究。皮下移植では胎児性癌1例と卵黄嚢腫瘍2例の成分が維持され、卵黄嚢腫瘍はAFPを産生した。腹腔内では臓器浸潤型の腫瘍と遊離スフェロイドが生じ、AFP産生は付着型の病変に限られた。
pmid-2450632.summary_en: This 1988 study serially passaged three human testicular teratocarcinomas in nude mice by subcutaneous transplantation, then injected tumor cell suspensions intraperitoneally. Subcutaneous transplants preserved one primary tumor component each: embryonal carcinoma in one case and yolk sac tumor in two, the latter producing AFP. Intraperitoneal injection yielded attached tumors invading abdominal organs and free-floating spheroids. AFP localized only in attached growths, suggesting that a critical tumor volume or vascularization is needed for AFP production.

pmid-2450890.summary_ja: 絨毛性疾患138例と胚細胞腫瘍123例の血清hCG、α-hCG、β-hCGをモノクローナル抗体で測定した1988年の研究。β-hCG/hCG比の上昇は多剤併用化学療法を要する高リスク例の同定に有用だった。非妊娠性悪性腫瘍ではサブユニットの上昇がより少なかった。組織学的特徴とhCGの分泌パターンの関連が検討された。
pmid-2450890.summary_en: This 1988 study measured serum hCG, alpha-hCG and beta-hCG using monoclonal antibodies in 138 women with trophoblastic disease and 123 with germ cell neoplasia. Elevated beta-hCG was common initially in trophoblastic disease, and a rising beta-hCG to hCG ratio identified high-risk patients needing multiagent chemotherapy. Subunit elevation was less frequent in nongestational malignancy. The authors propose that imbalanced differentiation of cytotrophoblasts disrupts subunit secretion, linking histology to hCG patterns.

pmid-2451042.summary_ja: 57歳男性で、移行上皮癌に対する膀胱摘除術後の標本から膀胱原発の絨毛癌が見出された症例報告です。術後に両肺転移が出現し、化学療法にもかかわらず急速に進行して、入院後5か月で死亡しました。免疫染色では、ヒト胎盤性ラクトゲンが強陽性、hCGのαおよびβサブユニットが弱陽性でした。
pmid-2451042.summary_en: A case report of primary choriocarcinoma arising in the urinary bladder of a 57-year-old man who had undergone cystectomy for transitional cell carcinoma. Metastases to both lungs developed after surgery and progressed rapidly despite chemotherapy, and the patient died five months after admission. Immunohistochemistry showed strong human placental lactogen staining and weak staining for both alpha and beta subunits of hCG in the primary tumor and metastases.

pmid-2451334.summary_ja: 1976年から1985年にミラノ大学で、胞状奇胎患者309例(完全223例、部分86例)を連続的なβ-hCG測定で追跡した後方視的解析。92.9%で自然寛解が生じた。奇胎の種類に応じて異なるフォローアップ期間を設定すべきと提案されている。
pmid-2451334.summary_en: A retrospective analysis of 309 patients with hydatidiform mole (223 complete, 86 partial) followed with serial beta-hCG monitoring at Milan University from 1976 to 1985. Spontaneous remission occurred in 92.9%. Marker levels were undetectable within 60 days in 80.4% of cases and between 61 and 140 days in 19.6%. Twenty-two patients (7.1%) developed gestational trophoblastic tumors requiring chemotherapy, mostly after complete moles. The authors propose different follow-up durations for partial and complete moles.

pmid-2451763.summary_ja: 28歳男性の剖検例で、左右の精巣に異なる組織型の胚細胞腫瘍が順次発生しました。右精巣はセミノーマで、11か月後の左精巣は非セミノーマ性腫瘍(AFP 3319 ng/ml)、組織学的には胎児性癌でした。鎖骨上窩リンパ節転移に補助化学療法を行いましたが、進行により死亡しました。剖検では後腹膜および大動脈傍リンパ節に成熟奇形腫と胎児性癌の転移が確認されました。
pmid-2451763.summary_en: An autopsy report of a 28-year-old man with bilateral successive testicular germ cell tumors of different histology. The right testicular tumor was a seminoma treated by orchiectomy. Eleven months later, the left testis showed a non-seminomatous tumor with AFP of 3319 ng/ml, and histology after orchiectomy revealed embryonal carcinoma. Supraclavicular metastasis led to adjuvant chemotherapy, but he died of progression. Autopsy showed retroperitoneal and para-aortic metastases with mature teratoma and embryonal carcinoma.

pmid-2452491.summary_ja: 精巣奇形癌に対するCVB化学療法を受けた栄養状態の良好な23例を、入院中の完全静脈栄養群と経口摂取群に無作為化した前向き研究です。静脈栄養群は入院中に窒素出納を維持しましたが、10週間の体重と体内窒素の減少は大きくなりました。主因は化学療法後の長期の食欲不振で、院内栄養の効果は限定的でした。
pmid-2452491.summary_en: A randomized prospective study of 23 well-nourished patients receiving CVB chemotherapy for testicular teratocarcinoma, comparing total parenteral nutrition with oral intake alone during hospitalization. The TPN group maintained nitrogen balance during in-hospital chemotherapy but lost more body weight and nitrogen over 10 weeks than the oral group. Weight loss was mainly caused by prolonged anorexia after each chemotherapy cycle. Intermittent in-hospital nutrition had only marginal benefit.

pmid-2452507.summary_ja: 予後不良の胚細胞腫瘍15例(精巣原発9例、性腺外4例、成人奇形腫症候群2例)に、VP-16を含む併用化学療法の後に手術を行った報告です。精巣原発の9例は全例生存しましたが、2例で再発がみられました。性腺外の4例中2例は無病生存し、成人奇形腫症候群の2例はいずれも死亡しました。
pmid-2452507.summary_en: Fifteen patients with poor-prognosis germ cell neoplasms (9 testicular, 4 extragonadal, 2 adult teratoma syndrome) were treated with combination chemotherapy including VP-16, followed by surgery. All 9 testicular-primary patients remained alive at median follow-up of 36 months, though 2 relapsed. Two of 4 extragonadal patients were alive without disease, and both adult teratoma syndrome patients died. The authors conclude that chemotherapy followed by surgery can be employed successfully in this subset.

pmid-2452771.summary_ja: 21歳女性の片側性純粋卵巣未分化胚細胞腫例で、血清LDH、hCG、ALPが著明に上昇し、腫瘍摘出後に正常化した。腫瘍組織では正常卵巣より数倍高いこれらの物質が検出され、組織化学的にも腫瘍細胞内に酵素の存在が確認された。著者らは、これらが本腫瘍の診断とフォローアップに有用な腫瘍マーカーになりうると提唱している。
pmid-2452771.summary_en: This case report describes a 21-year-old woman with unilateral pure ovarian dysgerminoma whose serum lactate dehydrogenase, hCG and alkaline phosphatase were markedly elevated. Levels normalized after tumor removal. Homogenized tumor tissue contained several-fold higher amounts of these substances than normal ovary, and histochemistry confirmed enzyme presence within tumor cells. The authors propose that these enzymes and hormone may serve as tumor markers for diagnosis and follow-up of this germ cell tumor type.

pmid-2452881.summary_ja: 脳転移を伴う絨毛癌の女性患者に対し、従来法より毒性の低い化学療法と全脳照射を併用して治療に成功した症例報告である。その後、患者は2回の正常分娩を経験した。絨毛癌治療後の妊孕性や妊娠転帰に関する知見を示す点で、臨床的に意義がある。
pmid-2452881.summary_en: This case report describes a woman treated for choriocarcinoma with cerebral metastases. She received less toxic chemotherapy than conventional regimens, combined with whole-brain irradiation, and the treatment succeeded. She later had two uneventful pregnancies. The report highlights that fertility and normal pregnancy outcomes may be preserved after this treatment, and it is relevant to choriocarcinoma management and to the brain metastasis of a germ cell tumor.

pmid-2453267.summary_ja: 精巣奇形腫に対するシスプラチン併用化学療法を受けた15例で、ヘマトクリット、血中グルタチオンペルオキシダーゼ活性、セレン濃度を測定した。輸血なしでは、ヘマトクリットは平均約40%低下した。血漿セレンは各コース内で低下し、次コースまでにほぼ回復したが、コースを重ねるごとに低下が進行した。シスプラチンの組織内貯留がセレン代謝に影響すると著者らは考察している。
pmid-2453267.summary_en: This study measured hematocrit, blood glutathione peroxidase activity, and selenium levels in 15 patients receiving cisplatin combination chemotherapy for testicular teratoma. Hematocrit fell by about 40% without transfusion, and GPx decline matched the loss of erythrocytes. Plasma selenium dropped within each course and recovered between cycles, with progressive decline across courses. The authors suggest that cisplatin retention in tissues alters selenium metabolism, a finding relevant to supportive care during germ cell tumor chemotherapy.

pmid-2453444.summary_ja: 縦隔胚細胞腫瘍と原発性の血液増殖性疾患を合併した2例を報告している。1例は卵黄嚢分化を伴う縦隔未熟奇形腫と難治性血小板減少症を、他の1例は死後に判明した未熟奇形腫と劇症型悪性組織球症を有していた。既報19例の検討から、卵黄嚢分化がこの症候群の発症に関与する可能性が示唆された。
pmid-2453444.summary_en: This report describes two men with mediastinal germ cell tumors associated with primary hemoproliferative disorders. One had a mediastinal immature teratoma with yolk sac differentiation alongside refractory thrombocytopenia and benign histiocytic proliferation; the other, found postmortem, had immature teratoma with yolk sac and hepatic differentiation and fulminant malignant histiocytosis. A review of 19 published cases suggests that yolk sac differentiation may contribute to the pathogenesis of this syndrome, which may represent different manifestations of one process.

pmid-2453619.summary_ja: 予後不良の非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍患者52例を対象とした前向きランダム化試験である。2倍量シスプラチンとエトポシドを含む大量化学療法レジメン(PVeBV)が、標準のPVeBと比較された。完全寛解率と再発率は改善傾向を示し、5年生存率は78%対48%であった。骨髄抑制と重度の難聴はPVeBVで多かった。
pmid-2453619.summary_en: This prospective randomized trial compared a high-dose regimen (double-dose cisplatin, vinblastine, bleomycin and etoposide, PVeBV) with standard PVeB in 52 patients with poor-prognosis nonseminomatous germ cell tumors. The high-dose regimen achieved higher complete remission (88% vs 67%) and lower relapse rates, with 5-year survival of 78% versus 48%, a trend not reaching significance. Myelosuppression and severe hearing loss were more frequent with PVeBV. The authors attribute the benefit to double-dose cisplatin, etoposide, or their synergy.

pmid-2454015.summary_ja: 転移性精巣腫瘍16例にシスプラチン併用化学療法を行ったところ、81%が低マグネシウム血症を発症し、累積投与量に応じてマグネシウム値が低下した。神経筋症状や不整脈などの症状もみられ、クレアチニンクリアランスの低下も併せて報告されている。なお、一部の患者では腎機能が不可逆的に低下した。
pmid-2454015.summary_en: This 1988 Japanese study followed 16 patients with metastatic testicular cancer treated with cisplatin-containing combination chemotherapy. Hypomagnesemia developed in 81% of patients, and the magnesium nadir fell with cumulative cisplatin dose. Four patients had clinical symptoms, including neuromuscular disturbance and arrhythmia. Creatinine clearance declined progressively, and in three patients it fell irreversibly below 50 ml/min. Transient changes in potassium and calcium were also noted but did not correlate with magnesium levels.

pmid-2454020.summary_ja: 非セミノーマ性精巣腫瘍で肝転移を生じた2例を報告する。両例とも胎児性癌と絨毛癌などの混合型で、PVB療法などにより完全奏効を得た後に肝転移が出現した。1例はシスプラチンを含む4剤併用療法で部分奏効にとどまり死亡した。もう1例はVAB-6療法で完全奏効を得た。肝転移例の予後は不良であり、従来の化学療法以外の治療法の検討が必要とされる。
pmid-2454020.summary_en: This case report describes two patients with nonseminomatous testicular tumors and liver metastases. Both had mixed histology including embryonal carcinoma and choriocarcinoma, and both achieved complete response to PVB-based chemotherapy before liver metastases appeared. One patient received four-drug cisplatin-based therapy, achieved partial response, and died. The other responded completely to VAB-6. The authors conclude that prognosis is poor and that treatments beyond conventional chemotherapy should be considered.

pmid-2454807.summary_ja: 絨毛癌患者の尿中hCGを解析し、還元条件下でβサブユニットが25kDaのCTP'と18kDaのFMCに解離することを示した。CTP'は正常妊娠のhCGより絨毛癌由来のもので顕著であった。レクチン結合性から、CTP'はO結合型、FMCはN結合型の糖鎖を持つと考えられる。絨毛癌のhCGβサブユニットには特異的な解離部位が存在する。
pmid-2454807.summary_en: This study examines hCG from the urine of a choriocarcinoma patient. Under reducing conditions, the beta-subunit dissociates into a 25 kDa C-terminal-containing fragment (CTP') and an 18 kDa faster-moving component (FMC). CTP' is much more prominent in choriocarcinoma hCG than in normal pregnancy hCG. Lectin binding indicates that CTP' carries O-linked sugars and FMC carries N-linked sugars. The findings suggest an unusual dissociation site in the beta-subunit of choriocarcinoma hCG.

pmid-2454897.summary_ja: 精巣腫瘍10例の血清と腫瘍組織におけるAFPを同時に測定した。セミノーマ2例はいずれも陰性であった。非セミノーマ8例中7例で血清AFPが上昇し、6例で腫瘍組織にAFPが検出され、両者は相関した。AFPの免疫染色は、原発不明転移および性腺外胚細胞腫瘍で臨床的意義があるとされた。
pmid-2454897.summary_en: This study simultaneously measured AFP in the serum and tumor tissue of 10 patients with testicular tumors. Both seminomas were negative. Seven of eight nonseminomas had elevated serum AFP, and six had detectable AFP in tumor tissue. AFP immunoperoxidase staining proved clinically useful mainly in unknown-primary metastases and extragonadal germ cell tumors. The findings suggest that tissue AFP staining adds value only in selected situations.

pmid-2455537.summary_ja: 転移性絨毛癌の女性12例を対象に、妊娠特異的β1糖タンパク(SP1)とβ-hCGの血清比を検討しました。化学療法後に比が1.0を超えた7例は完全寛解に至り、低値のままだった5例は薬剤耐性で死亡しました。治療初期のSP1/β-hCG比は絨毛癌の予後予測に有用である可能性が示されています。
pmid-2455537.summary_en: This study examined the serum ratio of pregnancy-specific beta-1 glycoprotein (SP1) to beta-hCG in 12 women with metastatic choriocarcinoma. Before chemotherapy, the ratio was low, averaging 0.34. In seven patients who achieved complete remission, the ratio rose above 1.0 after one or two chemotherapy courses. In the five patients who died from drug-resistant disease, the ratio stayed low and tended to decline. The authors conclude that the SP1/beta-hCG ratio after early chemotherapy may help predict prognosis in choriocarcinoma.

pmid-2456056.summary_ja: 転移性精巣非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の22歳男性が、シスプラチン・ビンブラスチン・ブレオマイシン療法後に重度の脳症、全身痙攣、視覚障害を発症した症例です。治療可能な原因を除外した後は対症療法のみで、症状は数か月で回復しました。シスプラチン併用療法に特有のまれな毒性として、腫瘍内科医が認識すべき症候群であると提言しています。
pmid-2456056.summary_en: A 22-year-old man with metastatic testicular non-seminomatous germ cell tumor developed severe encephalopathy, generalized seizures and visual disturbance after cisplatin, vinblastine and bleomycin chemotherapy. After treatable causes were excluded, supportive care alone was given, and symptoms resolved over several months. The authors describe this as a distinct clinical syndrome and suggest it is a rare toxicity of cisplatin-based therapy. Given the widespread use of cisplatin, they urge medical oncologists to recognize this complication.

pmid-2456930.summary_ja: 精巣がんに対してPVB療法（ブレオマイシン、ビンブラスチン、シスプラチン）を受けた連続21例で、急性の血管虚血性イベントを評価しました。狭心症は38%に現れ、治療開始から中央値5.6週で2～7日間持続しました。レイノー現象やつま先の一過性虚血も報告されています。動脈閉塞性イベントはPVB療法で頻度の高い毒性であると結論づけています。
pmid-2456930.summary_en: This study evaluated acute vascular ischemic events in 21 consecutive patients with testicular cancer treated with bleomycin, vinblastine and cisplatin (PVB). Angina pectoris occurred in 38 percent of patients, typically about 5.6 weeks after treatment began and lasting 2 to 7 days. Raynaud's phenomenon affected 33 percent and transient toe ischemia 29 percent. No major cerebrovascular events were seen. Ischemia occurred at varying times, and drug dose did not correlate with onset. The authors conclude that arterial occlusive events are a frequent toxicity of PVB chemotherapy.

pmid-2456999.summary_ja: 純粋精巣セミノーマ17例を対象に、精巣摘除術後10～74か月のフォローアップ中の血清β-hCGと尿中hCGを測定しました。術前が正常範囲の症例でも、術後に血清β-hCGは有意に低下しました。セミノーマの術前マーカー値は非セミノーマ性腫瘍より著しく低値ですが、少量のhCG産生はありえると結論づけています。
pmid-2456999.summary_en: This study measured serum beta-hCG and urinary hCG in 17 patients with pure testicular seminoma who were followed for 10 to 74 months after orchiectomy. Preoperative urinary hCG was abnormal in 53 percent of patients, and serum beta-hCG was slightly elevated in six of twelve evaluated. After orchiectomy, serum beta-hCG fell significantly, even in patients with normal preoperative levels. Preoperative marker levels in seminoma were far lower than in non-seminomatous tumors, though small amounts of hCG may still be produced by seminoma cells. No patient had residual disease or recurrence.

pmid-2457130.summary_ja: 上大静脈症候群を呈し、当初切除不能と判断された原発性縦隔胚細胞腫瘍の症例報告です。シスプラチン、ビンデシン、ブレオマイシンによる術前化学療法で腫瘍が65%縮小し、血清hCGも正常化しました。その後、拡張型PTFE人工血管を用いた上大静脈再建を伴う完全切除が行われ、術後15か月で再発はありません。
pmid-2457130.summary_en: This case report describes a primary mediastinal germ cell tumor presenting with superior vena cava syndrome and initially deemed unresectable. Neoadjuvant chemotherapy with cisplatin, vindesine and bleomycin produced a 65 percent tumor reduction and normalized serum hCG. The tumor was then completely resected with superior vena cava reconstruction using an expanded PTFE graft. At 15 months after surgery the patient had returned to work with a patent graft and no recurrence. The authors conclude that neoadjuvant chemotherapy is vital for anterior mediastinal germ cell tumors.

pmid-2457402.summary_ja: 転移性精巣非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の患者320例に対する化学療法の成績を報告しています。中央値39か月の追跡で266例（83%）が生存・健在でした。治療関連死は9例で、化学療法の強度と関連していました。腫瘍量が大きく血清腫瘍マーカーが高い患者以外では再発はまれであり、予後に応じた治療強度の選択を提唱しています。
pmid-2457402.summary_en: This series reviews 320 patients with metastatic non-seminomatous germ cell tumours of the testis treated with chemotherapy. At a median follow-up of 39 months, 266 patients (83 percent) were alive and well. Nine deaths were attributed to treatment-related causes, and mortality correlated with chemotherapy intensity. Relapse was uncommon except in patients with large tumour volume and high serum marker levels. The authors developed a risk-adapted approach that selects chemotherapy by prognostic group, aiming to reduce toxicity in patients with a good prognosis.

pmid-2457424.summary_ja: 胚細胞腫瘍・絨毛性腫瘍121例を15種の抗体で免疫組織化学的に解析した研究。性腺・性腺外、原発・転移病変で類似した免疫プロファイルが得られた。PLAPは胚細胞分化の鋭敏なマーカーで、LCAとS100はリンパ腫・黒色腫との鑑別に有用だった。サイトケラチンはセミノーマと非セミノーマの鑑別に役立つ一方、NSEは特異性に疑問が残った。
pmid-2457424.summary_en: This immunohistochemical study profiled 121 germ cell and trophoblastic neoplasms using a panel of 15 antibodies, including PLAP, AFP, BHCG, cytokeratin, EMA, LCA, S-100 and NSE. Gonadal and extragonadal tumors, gestational and nongestational choriocarcinomas, and primary and metastatic lesions showed similar patterns. PLAP was a sensitive marker of germ cell differentiation, while LCA and S-100 helped exclude lymphoma and melanoma. Cytokeratin distinguished seminomas from nonseminomatous tumors, although some seminomas were positive. NSE was expressed in 75% of cases, limiting its specificity.

pmid-2457427.summary_ja: 50歳男性の転移性精母細胞性セミノーマの症例報告。精巣摘除術後18か月で同側後腹膜傍大動脈リンパ節転移が見つかった。生検・減量的郭清、放射線療法、併用化学療法を受けたが、精巣摘除後25か月で化学療法の合併症により死亡した。転移性精母細胞性セミノーマとして完全に記録された初の症例とされる。
pmid-2457427.summary_en: This case report describes a 50-year-old man with metastatic spermatocytic seminoma involving homolateral retroperitoneal paraaortic lymph nodes, detected 18 months after orchiectomy. He underwent retroperitoneal biopsy with cytoreductive lymphadenectomy, followed by radiotherapy and combination chemotherapy. He died 25 months after orchiectomy from complications of a second chemotherapy course, with no autopsy and no signs of further spread. Light microscopy and electron microscopy showing intercellular bridges, together with absent placental alkaline phosphatase, supported the diagnosis. The authors describe this as the first fully documented metastasizing spermatocytic seminoma.

pmid-2457657.summary_ja: 予後良好な胚細胞腫瘍164例を対象に、EP療法とVAB-6療法をランダム化比較した試験。完全寛解率はVAB-6が96%、EPが93%で、生存成績は同等だった。EPは嘔吐、マグネシウム喪失、粘膜炎、肺毒性が少なかった。有効で毒性の少ない化学療法として、予後良好な播種性胚細胞腫瘍に推奨された。
pmid-2457657.summary_en: This randomized trial compared etoposide plus cisplatin (EP) with the VAB-6 regimen in 164 patients with good-prognosis germ cell tumors. Complete remission rates were 96% with VAB-6 and 93% with EP, and survival outcomes were similar. EP caused less emesis, less magnesium wasting, less mucositis and no pulmonary toxicity, with higher nadir counts. No treatment-related deaths occurred. The authors recommend EP as an efficacious, less toxic regimen for good-prognosis disseminated GCT.

pmid-2457771.summary_ja: 1978〜1983年に進行非セミノーマ性精巣腫瘍53例へシスプラチン・ビンブラスチン・ブレオマイシン療法を行い、化学療法後の残存腫瘍切除を検討した。中央値65か月の追跡で生存率は72%。奇形腫成分を有し腫瘍マーカー陰性の症例では、画像所見にかかわらず開腹探索術を行うことを推奨している。
pmid-2457771.summary_en: This study reviewed 53 patients with advanced nonseminomatous testicular tumors treated with cisplatin, vinblastine and bleomycin between 1978 and 1983. Among 41 marker-negative patients, 35 underwent residual tumor resection, with viable tumor found in four and residual mature teratoma in many. Salvage chemotherapy achieved remission in these cases. Survival was 72% at a median follow-up of 65 months, varying by tumor volume. The authors recommend laparotomy for all marker-negative patients with a teratomatous component in the primary tumor, regardless of imaging findings.

pmid-2458097.summary_ja: 精巣卵黄嚢腫瘍6例を連続切片で免疫組織化学的に検討し、2例で肝組織と腸管組織の特徴を確認した。肝巣はPASおよびAFP、サイトケラチンに陽性で、腸管様管腔はCEAを頂部に示した。卵黄嚢腫瘍は胚体内外の内胚葉への分化能を持ち、単一起源の奇形腫と解釈される可能性が示された。
pmid-2458097.summary_en: This immunohistochemical study examined serial sections of six testicular endodermal sinus tumors and embryonal carcinomas. Two cases showed hepatic structures and enteric tubules. Hepatic nests were PAS-positive and immunoreactive for AFP and cytokeratin, while enteric tubules showed CEA at the apical surface without atypia. The authors suggest that endodermal sinus tumors show both intra- and extraembryonic endodermal differentiation and may represent a monophyletic teratoma.

pmid-2458993.summary_ja: 1976〜1983年にMSKCCで卵巣悪性胚細胞腫瘍に対しシスプラチン併用VAB化学療法を受けた16例の後方視的検討である。治療後に第2回開腹術を受けた11例は全例で無病であった。組織型は未熟奇形腫、卵黄嚢腫瘍、混合型胚細胞腫瘍が中心であった。第2回開腹術は治療の修正や治癒の予測、化学療法の安全な中止に役立つと論じている。
pmid-2458993.summary_en: This retrospective review of 16 patients treated at Memorial Sloan-Kettering from 1976 to 1983 evaluates primary cisplatin-based VAB chemotherapy for malignant ovarian germ cell tumors. Eleven patients underwent second-look laparotomy after therapy, and all were free of disease. Histologies were mainly immature teratoma, endodermal sinus tumor, and mixed germ cell tumor. The authors argue that second-look laparotomy can guide treatment, predict cure, and support safely stopping chemotherapy.

pmid-2459319.summary_ja: 精巣の病期I非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の患者36例を、精巣摘除術と集中的な監視のみで管理した研究である。33.3%が中央値7か月で再発した。腫瘍マーカーは再発の検出に限られた価値しかなく、リンパ管侵襲のみが再発率の上昇と関連した。精巣摘除後の最適な管理は依然として確立されていない。
pmid-2459319.summary_en: This study followed 36 patients with apparent stage I nonseminomatous germ cell tumor of the testis managed by orchidectomy and intensive surveillance without adjuvant therapy. Relapse occurred in 33.3% at a median of seven months. Tumor markers were of limited value for detecting relapse, while lymphatic invasion was the only primary tumor factor linked to higher relapse. All relapsed patients received cisplatin-based chemotherapy, and optimal management after orchidectomy remains undefined.

pmid-2459940.summary_ja: 精巣に病変がない24歳男性の性腺外胚細胞腫瘍の症例報告である。腹部巨大腫瘤と左頸部リンパ節腫脹を認め、リンパ節は絨毛癌と胎児性癌の混合型であった。VAB-6併用化学療法によりほぼ完全寛解に近い部分奏効が得られ、腫瘍マーカーとCT所見も正常化した。
pmid-2459940.summary_en: A 24-year-old man presented with a large abdominal mass and left cervical lymphadenopathy, with no testicular lesion on examination or biopsy. Lymph node biopsy showed mixed choriocarcinoma and embryonal carcinoma, and tumor markers were markedly elevated. VAB-6 combination chemotherapy produced a near-complete partial response, with markers and CT findings normalizing. The case illustrates extragonadal germ cell tumor presenting without a primary testicular lesion.

pmid-2460607.summary_ja: 仙尾部奇形腫の手術を受けた乳児1例の報告である。術前後の血清αフェトプロテイン(AFP)を連続測定した。AFP値は非常に高かったものの提唱された正常範囲内にとどまり、良性を示唆した。病理では成熟組織と少量の未熟神経外胚葉組織を認め、腫瘍内の胎児肝にAFP染色陽性を認めた。
pmid-2460607.summary_en: This case report describes an infant treated surgically for sacrococcygeal teratoma, with serial AFP measurements before and after operation. Although very high, the AFP levels remained within a proposed normal range, suggesting a benign process. Pathology showed mature tissue with a small immature neuroectodermal component, and fetal liver within the tumor stained positive for AFP. The case highlights the diagnostic interpretation of AFP in teratoma.

pmid-2460985.summary_ja: 転移性性腺外胚細胞腫瘍に対し、ブレオマイシン、シスプラチン、ビンブラスチン、エトポシドによる併用化学療法を受けた患者の症例報告である。感染症状を伴わずに出現した肺結節は、開胸術で線維化のみであった。αフェトプロテイン(AFP)の偽陽性上昇とCT所見から、当初は新たな転移と判断された。
pmid-2460985.summary_en: This case report describes pulmonary nodules that appeared during combination chemotherapy with bleomycin, cisplatin, vinblastine and etoposide for metastatic extragonadal germ cell tumor, without infectious symptoms. Thoracotomy revealed only fibrosis. False-positive elevation of alpha-fetoprotein and CT appearance led clinicians to initially interpret the nodules as new metastases, illustrating pitfalls in marker and imaging interpretation during treatment.

pmid-2462286.summary_ja: 1968年から1982年にトゥルク大学病院で治療された精巣腫瘍72例を後方視的に検討した研究です。化学療法を受けた25例のうち、初期の三剤併用療法の患者は2年以内に死亡しました。一方、CBV併用療法では8例中6例が完全寛解を得ました。化学療法による罹患は認められたものの、不可逆的な毒性は長期には認められませんでした。
pmid-2462286.summary_en: This retrospective study reviews 72 patients with malignant testicular tumors treated at Turku University Central Hospital from 1968 to 1982, including 49 seminomas and 21 non-seminomas. Twenty-five patients received chemotherapy. Early triple-drug regimens failed, with patients dying within two years, whereas CBV combination therapy produced six complete remissions among eight treated patients. Chemotherapy caused significant but not irreversible morbidity.

pmid-2462296.summary_ja: 典型的なセミノーマ47例のパラフィン切片を、サイトケラチンおよびビメンチンに対する抗体で免疫染色した研究です。精巣網がほぼ破壊された症例でも残存する微小な精巣網を検出でき、精巣網細管内への上皮内進展も同定できました。この方法はセミノーマの病期分類に有用とされています。
pmid-2462296.summary_en: This study applies immunostaining with antibodies against cytokeratin and vimentin to paraffin sections of 47 typical seminomas. The method detects small rete testis residuals in cases of subtotal rete destruction. It also identifies discrete interepithelial spread of seminoma within the rete ductules. The authors conclude that this approach facilitates staging of seminoma, since such spread may otherwise be difficult to recognize.

pmid-2463034.summary_ja: 進行した悪性奇形腫55例と大きな転移を有するセミノーマ5例に対するPOMB/ACE療法を独立に評価した研究です。肝転移や脳転移を含む予後不良例にも有効でした。マーカー正常化後の長期治療は不要と考えられました。毒性が強いため、予後良好例には推奨されていません。
pmid-2463034.summary_en: This independent evaluation assesses the seven-drug alternating high-dose cisplatin regimen POMB/ACE in 55 patients with advanced malignant teratomas and 5 with bulky metastatic seminomas. Many patients had relapsed after prior treatment. The regimen was effective even in patients with hepatic and cerebral metastases, and prolonged treatment after marker normalization seemed unnecessary. However, the regimen is complex and toxic, so the authors do not recommend it for patients with a good prognosis.

pmid-2463922.summary_ja: 進行精巣胚細胞腫瘍の患者47例を、PVB化学療法の治療終了後平均2.5年に再診した研究です。約3分の1に肺、腎臓、末梢神経の軽度の持続的毒性がみられました。セミノーマで放射線療法を受けた32例では、客観的な長期毒性はまれでした。染色体や精子形成への影響の可能性にも注意が必要とされています。
pmid-2463922.summary_en: This study reexamined 47 patients with advanced germ cell testicular tumors about 2.5 years after treatment with cisplatin, vinblastine, and bleomycin (PVB). About one third had persistent mild long-term toxicity affecting the lungs, kidneys, and peripheral nerves. Among 32 seminoma patients who received radiation therapy, objective long-term toxicity was rare. The authors caution that possible damage to chromosomes and spermatogenesis should be kept in mind.

pmid-2466010.summary_ja: ヒト胎児性癌細胞株5種をヌードマウスに移植し分化能を検討した。多分化能株は体細胞成分を伴う胎児性癌を生じたが、典型的な絨毛癌や卵黄嚢腫瘍成分はまれであった。ヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)とαフェトプロテイン(AFP)の産生が確認され、胎児性癌の形態を保つ移行型細胞が産生の担い手と考えられた。
pmid-2466010.summary_en: Five human embryonal carcinoma cell lines were xenografted into nude mice and examined for differentiation. Pluripotent lines (NEC 14, Tera 2) produced embryonal carcinoma mixed with glandular, neuronal and cartilaginous elements, while nullipotent lines did not. Typical extraembryonic choriocarcinoma or yolk sac elements were rarely seen. Both hCG and AFP production were detected by radioimmunoassay and immunoperoxidase, and appeared to be produced by transitional cells retaining embryonal carcinoma morphology. The study clarifies differentiation capacity and marker secretion in these germ cell tumor-derived lines.

pmid-2466012.summary_ja: 15歳未満の小児の原発精巣腫瘍26例を解析した。良性奇形腫が61.5%、悪性が38.5%で、悪性の多くは卵黄嚢腫瘍であった。良性例は精巣摘除術のみで無病経過した。病期Iは精巣摘除術とαフェトプロテイン(AFP)監視、病期II以上は化学療法や放射線照射を追加した。成人より予後が良く、保存的治療が有用であると結論している。
pmid-2466012.summary_en: This series reviews 26 primary testicular tumors in children under 15, finding 61.5% benign mature or immature teratomas and 38.5% malignant tumors, mostly yolk sac tumors. Benign cases remained disease-free after high inguinal orchiectomy alone, with serum AFP below 50 ng/ml. Stage I malignant tumors were managed by orchiectomy with AFP monitoring, while stage II or III disease received chemotherapy and/or irradiation. Retroperitoneal lymph node dissection was not performed. Most malignant cases survived disease-free. The authors advocate a conservative approach, noting better outcomes than in adult disease.

pmid-2466013.summary_ja: 63歳男性の純粋な精巣胎児性癌の稀な症例を報告する。あわせて60歳以上の男性における胚細胞腫瘍の文献を概観している。通常は若年に多い精巣腫瘍が高齢男性にも生じうることを示す。文献的検討により高齢者の胚細胞腫瘍の特徴を整理している。単一症例の報告であり、臨床的な一般化には限界がある。
pmid-2466013.summary_en: A rare case of pure embryonal carcinoma of the testis is reported in a 63-year-old man. The authors also review the published literature on germ cell tumors in men aged 60 years and older. The report shows that testicular germ cell tumors can occur in elderly men, and the literature review collects prior cases of this age group.
