Because the paper is a single case with a literature review, its clinical generalizability is limited.

pmid-2469323.summary_ja: 両側精巣セミノーマと巨大腹部転移を有する23歳男性の症例を報告する。VAB-6併用化学療法4クールで後腹膜腫瘍は85.5%縮小した。後腹膜リンパ節郭清を行ったが完全切除はできず、切除標本は完全壊死であった。術後に化学療法と放射線照射を追加した。日本の両側精巣胚細胞腫瘍109例の文献的検討を付している。
pmid-2469323.summary_en: A 23-year-old man with bilateral testicular seminomas and huge abdominal metastases is described. The retroperitoneal mass shrank 85.5% after four cycles of VAB-6 chemotherapy. Residual tumor could not be fully resected despite retroperitoneal lymph node dissection, but histology showed complete necrosis. Adjuvant chemotherapy and irradiation followed. The authors also review 109 Japanese cases of bilateral testicular germ cell tumors, illustrating the marked response of bulky metastatic disease to combination chemotherapy.

pmid-2478355.summary_ja: 精巣奇形腫由来のヒト卵黄嚢腫瘍細胞（壁側内胚葉様）が、無血清培地でビトロネクチンを分泌することを示した研究。ビトロネクチンは胎児性癌細胞の接着と伸展を促し、RGDペプチドは卵黄嚢腫瘍細胞の接着を阻害した。奇形腫の運動性と浸潤への関与が示唆される。
pmid-2478355.summary_en: This study examined human stem-cell lines derived from testicular teratomas. Endodermal sinus tumour cells, unlike embryonal carcinoma or visceral endoderm-like cells, secreted vitronectin, fibronectin, laminin and type IV collagen into serum-free medium. Purified vitronectin supported embryonal carcinoma cell attachment and spreading, and RGD peptides blocked endodermal sinus tumour cell attachment. The authors propose that vitronectin regulates cell motility and the invasion of teratomas in vivo.

pmid-2484653.summary_ja: 奇形腫、卵黄嚢腫瘍、肝芽腫の患者14例を対象に、術後および化学療法中のαフェトプロテイン(AFP)の低下を後方視的に検討した研究。術後AFPは多くで直線的に低下し、半減期は約6日であった。完全切除例では直線的低下のみを示し、AFPの低下パターンと再発との間に関連はなかったが、再発時にはAFPが上昇した。
pmid-2484653.summary_en: This retrospective study of 14 patients with teratoma, endodermal sinus tumor, or hepatoblastoma assessed serum AFP decline after surgery or during chemotherapy. After operation, eight of eleven patients showed a linear AFP decline with a half-life of about 6 days. Incomplete resection produced linear or nonlinear patterns, while complete resection produced only linear decline. The reduction pattern did not correlate with recurrence, but recurrence was accompanied by rising AFP.

pmid-2827883.summary_ja: 悪性卵巣胚細胞腫瘍14例に対し、術後に逐次併用化学療法（POMB/ACE/PAV）を施行した研究。全組織型・進行期を含め高い有効性を示し、14例中12例（86%）が持続的寛解に至った。シスプラチンとブレオマイシンの総投与量を抑えた本レジメンの毒性は中等度で、追跡中央値53か月以上の時点で13例が無病生存していた。他レジメンとの比較も行われた。
pmid-2827883.summary_en: This study reports a sequential short-course chemotherapy regimen (POMB/ACE/PAV) given after surgery to 14 patients with malignant ovarian germ cell tumors. Histologies included immature teratoma, endodermal sinus tumor, dysgerminoma, and mixed germ cell tumor, across stages I to IV. Twelve of 14 patients (86%) achieved sustained remission, with moderate toxicity given low cisplatin and bleomycin doses. After median follow-up of over 53 months, 13 were alive without disease. Results were compared with other regimens.

pmid-2828198.summary_ja: 正常胎盤、胞状奇胎、妊娠性絨毛癌の栄養膜を対象に、リンパ系マーカーに対する単クローン抗体の反応性を検討した研究。NKH-1は胞状奇胎と胎盤栄養膜、両絨毛癌株に反応し、NKH-2とB5は絨毛癌株に反応した。これらの交差反応性抗原は、妊娠性絨毛性疾患における母体免疫との相互作用に関与する可能性が示唆された。
pmid-2828198.summary_en: This study characterized trophoblast-lymphocyte cross-reactive antigens using monoclonal antibodies against lymphoid markers on normal placenta, hydatidiform mole, and gestational choriocarcinoma. NKH-1 reacted with molar and placental villous trophoblast and with both choriocarcinoma lines. NKH-2 reacted with molar trophoblast in three of five moles and with both choriocarcinoma lines. B5 reacted with both choriocarcinoma lines, and MY7 with one. The authors suggest these antigens modulate trophoblast-maternal immune interactions in gestational trophoblastic disease.

pmid-2828199.summary_ja: 高リスク転移性妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍の患者51例を対象に、治療失敗に関連する因子を検討した研究。肝・脳・腸管転移と先行化学療法の失敗は予後不良と関連した。死亡例は寛解例より予後スコアと高リスク因子数が多く、代替の強力な化学療法の開発が求められている。
pmid-2828199.summary_en: This study reviewed 51 patients with high-risk metastatic gestational trophoblastic tumor to identify factors linked to treatment failure. Liver, brain, or intestinal metastases and failure of prior chemotherapy predicted poor outcome. Markedly elevated hCG, a long interval from pregnancy to treatment, and post-term choriocarcinoma were not independently associated with failure. Patients who died had higher prognostic scores and more high-risk factors than those in remission, prompting a call for alternative intensive chemotherapy.

pmid-2828695.summary_ja: 臨床病期Iの精巣胚細胞腫瘍患者で、精巣摘除術後に能動的治療を受けていない連続56例の血液を用い、EBV・CMV・肝炎ウイルスの抗体を調べた研究。ホジキン病との疫学的類似性から感染因子の関与を検討した。EBVの既往感染が80%に認められ、精巣がんの感染起源仮説を支持した。
pmid-2828695.summary_en: This study screened blood samples from 56 consecutive patients with clinical stage I testicular germ cell tumors, obtained after orchiectomy without active therapy, for EBV, CMV, and hepatitis A and B viruses. Given epidemiological similarities to Hodgkin's disease, the authors tested an infectious origin. Eighty percent showed previous EBV exposure, supporting a possible infectious origin of testicular carcinoma.

pmid-2829961.summary_ja: 1つの施設で26年間に治療された、妊娠性絨毛性疾患後に肺転移を発症した97例を検討。多くは胞状奇胎の既往があり、子宮内の絨毛癌病変は大半で認められなかった。化学療法が主な治療で、孤立性肺結節には選択的開胸術が有効だった。2年全生存率は65%。予後不良は、満期産の既往、診断まで1年超の間隔、多発病変、脳転移と関連した。
pmid-2829961.summary_en: This review of 97 women who developed pulmonary metastases after gestational trophoblastic disease, treated at one center over 26 years, found that most had an antecedent molar pregnancy and lacked a uterine choriocarcinomatous lesion. Many lung lesions were asymptomatic. Chemotherapy was the main treatment, while selective thoracotomy for solitary nodules shortened treatment and reduced the need for multidrug regimens. Two-year overall survival was 65%. Poorer outcomes were linked to term antecedent pregnancy, an interval over one year, multiple lung lesions, and cerebral metastases.

pmid-2830183.summary_ja: 精巣内外のジャーミノーマ18例で、アンジオテンシンI変換酵素(ACE)を免疫組織化学と酵素活性測定により検討。ACEはジャーミノーマと正常胚細胞に検出され、他の精巣腫瘍には認められなかった。酵素は一部が膜結合型と考えられる。血漿ACE値は正常で、診断やフォローアップへの有用性は低い。ただし、特に性腺外病変の組織診断の補助になりうる。
pmid-2830183.summary_en: This study examined angiotensin-I-converting enzyme (ACE) in 18 germinomas, both testicular and extratesticular. Immunohistochemistry and enzyme assays detected ACE in germinomas and normal germ cells, but not in other testicular tumors. The enzyme appears partly membrane-bound. Plasma ACE levels were normal, so serum measurement would not aid diagnosis or follow-up. However, ACE staining may help histologically distinguish germinomas from other germ cell tumors, especially extragonadal ones.

pmid-2830693.summary_ja: 混合型非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍における炎症性細胞浸潤を免疫組織学的手法で解析。浸潤の分布はセミノーマに比べ変動が大きく、特定の組織型との明確な関連は認められなかった。B細胞とT細胞はほぼ同数で、抑制性/細胞傷害性リンパ球よりヘルパー/誘導性T細胞が多かった。炎症領域内のサブタイプ構成は純粋セミノーマと類似していた。
pmid-2830693.summary_en: Immunohistological methods were used to characterize inflammatory cell infiltrates in mixed non-seminomatous germ cell tumors. Infiltrate distribution was more variable than in pure seminomas and did not correlate clearly with any single histologic component. B and T cells were present in roughly equal numbers, with helper/inducer T cells outnumbering suppressor/cytotoxic cells. Subtype composition within these inflammatory areas resembled that in pure seminomas.

pmid-2831159.summary_ja: 精巣がん患者117例(セミノーマ、胎児性癌など)と年齢対応男性対照100例で、9種の病原体に対する抗体価を比較。多くの病原体では一貫した差はなかった。水痘帯状疱疹ウイルスと単純ヘルペスウイルスの抗体価はセミノーマ患者で高く、サイトメガロウイルスが最も強く関連し、抗体価に応じたリスク上昇傾向が見られた。交絡因子は除外できていない。
pmid-2831159.summary_en: A serologic case-control study compared antibody titers to nine infectious agents in 117 testicular cancer cases (seminoma, embryonal carcinoma, and others) and 100 age-matched male controls. No consistent differences were found for most agents. Varicella-zoster and HSV titers were elevated in cases, especially seminoma patients. Cytomegalovirus showed the strongest association, with a dose-response gradient across titer quartiles. The authors suggest delayed CMV exposure may relate to risk, though confounding was not excluded.

pmid-2831319.summary_ja: 甲状腺機能亢進症と頸部甲状腺への低い131Iの取り込みを示した閉経後女性の症例。骨盤部のシンチグラフィで卵巣腫瘍に取り込みが認められ、術前に卵巣甲状腺腫と診断できた。卵巣甲状腺腫は甲状腺組織を含む稀な卵巣奇形腫である。原因不明の甲状腺機能亢進症で頸部の取り込みが低い女性では、骨盤部画像検査を考慮すべきと提言している。
pmid-2831319.summary_en: A postmenopausal woman presented with hyperthyroidism and low cervical radioiodine uptake. Pelvic imaging with technetium-99m pertechnetate and 131I showed uptake in an ovarian tumor, enabling preoperative diagnosis of struma ovarii, a rare ovarian teratoma containing thyroid tissue. The authors recommend considering pelvic imaging in females with unexplained hyperthyroidism and low cervical thyroid 131I uptake, since this can reveal an ovarian source of thyroid hormone production.

pmid-2831487.summary_ja: 未治療の転移性妊娠性絨毛性疾患138例に対する初回化学療法の成績を検討。93%が持続寛解に至った。予後不良因子は、複数臓器への転移、4か月を超える罹病期間、非胞状奇胎の先行妊娠、絨毛癌の診断であった。初診時のヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)値と転移部位は生存に影響しなかった。単剤化学療法で失敗しやすい患者を基に初回治療を選択すべきと結論している。
pmid-2831487.summary_en: This study reviewed 138 previously untreated patients with metastatic gestational trophoblastic disease who received primary chemotherapy at one center. Sustained remission was achieved in 93%. Poor-prognosis features included multisite metastases, disease duration over four months, antecedent nonmolar pregnancy, and a choriocarcinoma diagnosis. Duration over four months combined with nonmolar antecedent pregnancy carried the highest risk. Initial hCG level and metastasis site did not affect survival. The authors advise choosing initial therapy based on prognostic factors.

pmid-2832714.summary_ja: レックリングハウゼン病(神経線維腫症)の患者に混合型胚細胞腫瘍の精巣腫瘍が発生した。神経線維腫症と精巣の混合型胚細胞腫瘍の併存を示した初の文献報告である。神経線維腫症で増加する悪性腫瘍は神経組織由来のものだけでなく、精巣胚細胞腫瘍のような非神経性の悪性腫瘍にも及ぶことを示唆している。
pmid-2832714.summary_en: A man with neurofibromatosis type 1 (von Recklinghausen's disease) developed a testicular tumor diagnosed as a mixed germ cell tumor. The authors report this as the first documented case of neurofibromatosis coexisting with a mixed germ cell tumor of the testis. They suggest the excess of malignancies in neurofibromatosis may extend beyond neurogenic tumors to non-neurogenic cancers such as testicular germ cell tumors.

pmid-2832992.summary_ja: 男性の胚細胞腫瘍107例を電子顕微鏡で解析し、組織発生の関係と診断基準の整備を目指しています。セミノーマ47例、胎児性癌26例、卵黄嚢腫瘍10例、混合型胚細胞腫瘍24例が対象です。セミノーマのうち4例は、早期の癌化を示唆する細胞表面の特徴を示しました。これは、セミノーマと非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の関係が従来考えられていたより近いことを示唆します。また、電子顕微鏡はセミノーマとリンパ腫の鑑別にも有用でした。
pmid-2832992.summary_en: This 1988 study examined the ultrastructure of 107 male germ cell neoplasms, including 47 seminomas, 26 embryonal carcinomas, 10 endodermal sinus tumors, and 24 mixed germ cell tumors. Four seminomas showed cell surface features suggesting early carcinomatous transformation, supporting a closer relationship between seminoma and nonseminomatous germ cell tumors than previously recognized. Electron microscopy also showed a continuum of morphology among nonseminomatous subtypes and proved useful for differentiating seminoma from lymphoma. The findings aim to refine histogenetic relationships and diagnostic criteria.

pmid-2833339.summary_ja: 基底膜成分を豊富に産生する2種類のヒト腫瘍、腺様嚢胞癌と卵黄嚢腫瘍を検討しました。両者はヌードマウスに異種移植され、3世代の継代を通じて組織像と基底膜成分を保持しました。ラミニンとIV型コラーゲンを得ることができ、マウスをラチリズム処理することで収量は増加しました。抽出されたヒト蛋白質はマウス由来のものとSDS-PAGE上で同一でした。これらの腫瘍は、ヒト基底膜蛋白質の供給源として利用できる可能性があります。
pmid-2833339.summary_en: This 1988 study investigated two human tumors, an adenoid cystic carcinoma and a yolk sac tumor, that produce unusually abundant basement membrane matrix. Both were established as xenografts in athymic nude mice, retained their histology and basement membrane components through three transplant generations, and yielded laminin and type IV collagen. Yields were increased by lathyritic treatment of the mice, and the extracted proteins matched murine counterparts by SDS-PAGE. The authors suggest these tumors could serve as a source of human basement membrane proteins for research.

pmid-2833344.summary_ja: 同一患者の精巣原発非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍と、化学療法後に残存した成熟奇形腫について、核型とDNA量を比較検討しました。この対の検体の解析により、精巣胚細胞腫瘍で治療後に分化が生じる機序を明らかにすることが目的です。著者らは、化学療法が成熟奇形腫への分化を促す可能性について考察しています。非セミノーマの治療後に残る腫瘤を理解する上で関連する報告です。
pmid-2833344.summary_en: This 1988 study compared the karyotypes and DNA content of a primary testicular nonseminomatous germ cell tumor with the residual mature teratoma found after chemotherapy in the same patient. Analyzing this paired sample set was intended to clarify the mechanism of therapy-related differentiation in testicular germ cell tumors. The authors discuss how chemotherapy may drive differentiation toward mature teratoma. The report is a brief case-based analysis and is relevant to understanding residual masses after treatment of nonseminomatous tumors.

pmid-2833818.summary_ja: 1つの小児病院で19年間に治療された卵巣腫瘍の小児30例を検討しています。良性22例、悪性8例で、悪性のうち6例は胚細胞腫瘍でした。主な症状は疼痛や腹部腫瘤で、超音波検査などが術前診断に有用でした。悪性例は卵巣摘出術または卵管卵巣摘出術の後、化学療法とセカンドルック手術が行われました。生存期間は5か月から9年で、平均は46か月でした。
pmid-2833818.summary_en: This report reviews 30 children with ovarian tumors treated over 19 years at a single children's hospital. Twenty-two tumors were benign, and eight were malignant, six of which were germ cell tumors. Presenting symptoms included pain and palpable masses, and imaging such as ultrasonography aided diagnosis. Malignant cases were treated with oophorectomy or salpingo-oophorectomy, followed by chemotherapy and second-look surgery. Survival ranged from five months to nine years, averaging 46 months, with four patients dying.

pmid-2834473.summary_ja: 胞状奇胎、侵入奇胎、絨毛癌の患者の尿中ヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)について、分子量と断片化をSDS-PAGEとウエスタンブロッティングで解析しました。胞状奇胎のhCGβは標準品と同じ分子量でしたが、絨毛癌では症例ごとに差がみられました。還元条件下では、侵入奇胎と絨毛癌のhCGはCTP'を遊離しやすいことが示されました。これらの構造変化は悪性転化を反映している可能性があり、侵入奇胎と絨毛癌の診断に有用と考えられています。
pmid-2834473.summary_en: This Japanese study analyzed the molecular weight and fragmentation of urinary hCG from patients with hydatidiform mole, invasive mole, and choriocarcinoma using SDS-PAGE and Western blotting. Hydatidiform mole hCG beta matched standard hCG beta, while choriocarcinoma samples varied individually. Under reducing conditions, hCG from invasive mole and choriocarcinoma was more readily cleaved to release a low molecular weight carboxy-terminal fragment. The authors propose that these structural changes, possibly from malignant transformation, may aid diagnosis of invasive mole and choriocarcinoma.

pmid-2834730.summary_ja: セミノーマ由来のNagaoアイソザイムをコードする遺伝子を、胎盤型アルカリホスファターゼcDNAをプローブとしてクローニングしました。遺伝子は11のエクソンからなり、タンパク質レベルで胎盤型と98%の相同性を示しました。2か所の変異を持つペプチドに対する抗体は、セミノーマのアイソザイムに特異的に反応し、胎盤型とは反応しませんでした。この結果から、腫瘍および正常精巣のNagaoアイソザイムは胚細胞型アルカリホスファターゼ遺伝子にコードされると結論づけられています。
pmid-2834730.summary_en: This 1988 study cloned the gene encoding the Nagao isozyme of alkaline phosphatase from a seminoma, using a placental alkaline phosphatase cDNA probe. The gene spans 11 exons and is 98% homologous to the placental gene at the protein level, with 12 differing residues. A peptide-based antibody raised against a region with two mutations reacted specifically with the seminoma isozyme but not placental alkaline phosphatase. The authors conclude that the tumor, and possibly normal testis, Nagao isozyme is encoded by a distinct germ-cell alkaline phosphatase gene.

pmid-2835441.summary_ja: 進行性胚細胞腫瘍の化学療法試験において、予後不良群の適格基準を4種類比較した研究である。118例中44%で基準間の危険度判定が不一致であった。予後不良とされた患者の初回完全奏効率は38～62%と幅があり、適格基準が試験結論に影響しうることを示した。無作為化試験の必要性を指摘している。
pmid-2835441.summary_en: This study compared four sets of eligibility criteria for poor-risk trials in 118 patients with advanced germ cell tumors. Criteria assigned patients to different risk groups in 44% of cases, and initial complete response rates in poor-risk patients ranged from 38% to 62%. Substantial differences in sensitivity, specificity, predictive value, and survival were observed. The authors conclude that randomized trials are needed to limit the influence of eligibility criteria on outcomes.

pmid-2836349.summary_ja: 絨毛癌由来の4株の細胞株について、メトトレキサート感受性を比較した基礎研究である。NaUCC-1株の耐性は、ジヒドロ葉酸還元酵素遺伝子のコピー数増加ではなく、薬剤取り込みの低下によると結論づけた。絨毛癌の化学療法耐性機序を理解するうえで意義がある。
pmid-2836349.summary_en: Four choriocarcinoma-derived cell lines were compared for sensitivity to methotrexate. The authors examined dihydrofolate reductase gene copy number to determine whether gene amplification explains the relative resistance of the NaUCC-1 line, which is 4- to 5-fold more resistant and shows reduced [3H]MTX uptake. Dot blot and Southern blot analyses revealed no copy number differences among lines. Resistance was therefore attributed to reduced drug uptake rather than target gene amplification.

pmid-2837415.summary_ja: 散発性の異形母斑症候群を有する4例で、精巣のセミノーマまたは胎児性癌が発生した症例報告である。精巣胚細胞腫瘍が異形母斑症候群の関連悪性腫瘍の一つとなりうることを提案した。症例数が少なく因果関係は確立されていない。
pmid-2837415.summary_en: This report describes four patients with sporadic dysplastic nevus syndrome who developed seminoma or embryonal carcinoma of the testis. The authors propose that testicular germ cell tumors represent a further form of cancer associated with dysplastic nevus syndrome. The paper is a brief observational case series and does not establish causality. It highlights a possible addition to the spectrum of malignancies linked to this syndrome.

pmid-2837430.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍203例を対象に、胎盤型アルカリホスファターゼ(PLAP)の免疫組織化学染色を行った研究である。隣接する精細管内悪性胚細胞の99%で陽性を示した。セミノーマと胎児性癌で高い陽性率を示し、PLAPはITMGC、セミノーマ、胎児性癌の感度の高いマーカーであると結論した。
pmid-2837430.summary_en: This immunohistochemical study examined placental alkaline phosphatase (PLAP) expression in 203 testicular germ cell tumors, with focus on intratubular malignant germ cells (ITMGCs). Positive staining was seen in 99% of cases with adjacent ITMGCs. Seminomas and embryonal carcinomas stained in 96%, while yolk sac tumors and mature and immature teratomas stained poorly. The authors conclude PLAP is a sensitive marker for ITMGC, seminoma, and embryonal carcinoma.

pmid-2838064.summary_ja: 原発性非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の縦隔例3例について、コンピュータ断層撮影(CT)所見を検討した報告である。腫瘤は大きく分葉状で、脂肪層は消失していた。心嚢液や胸水を伴う例もあった。若年成人で前縦隔に大きな腫瘤を認めた際には、性腺外胚細胞腫瘍を考慮すべきと提言している。
pmid-2838064.summary_en: This study describes computed tomography findings in three patients with primary non-seminomatous germ cell tumors of the anterior mediastinum. All masses were large, lobulated, and mixed in density, with obliterated fat planes and high-attenuation borders. One patient had pericardial and left pleural effusions with chest wall invasion. The authors suggest extragonadal germ cell tumor should be considered when a large anterior mediastinal mass appears in a young adult.

pmid-2839283.summary_ja: 胞状奇胎、子宮絨毛癌、胃絨毛癌を免疫組織化学的に検討し、トロンボモジュリンの局在をhCGの分布と比較した。胞状奇胎と子宮絨毛癌の合胞体栄養膜細胞にはトロンボモジュリンが認められたが、胃絨毛癌では発現しなかった。hCGは3者すべてで陽性であった。
pmid-2839283.summary_en: The authors used immunohistochemistry to localize thrombomodulin in hydatidiform moles, uterine choriocarcinoma, and gastric choriocarcinoma, and compared its distribution with hCG. Thrombomodulin was expressed in the syncytiotrophoblast of moles and uterine choriocarcinoma, though not uniformly, but was absent from gastric choriocarcinoma. hCG was present in all three lesions. The study highlights differences in placental protein expression among trophoblastic tumors.

pmid-2839284.summary_ja: Gustave-Roussy研究所で治療された絨毛性腫瘍162例を多変量解析した。非胞状奇胎妊娠の既往、初診時の複数臓器転移、化学療法への原発性耐性が、高リスク群の不良転帰と関連する独立した予後因子であった。絨毛癌の組織型と合わせて予後判定に有用とされた。
pmid-2839284.summary_en: This Institute Gustave-Roussy series of 162 gestational trophoblastic tumors reports sustained complete remission in 90 percent of patients. In high-risk patients, multivariate analysis identified an antecedent nonmolar pregnancy, more than one metastatic organ at presentation, and primary resistance to single-agent or multi-agent chemotherapy as independent adverse prognostic factors. Together with choriocarcinoma histology, these factors identified patients with unfavorable outcomes.

pmid-2839526.summary_ja: グリコホルモンの糖鎖の構造と機能を概説し、hCGを中心に扱う。胞状奇胎由来のhCGは正常型の糖鎖を持つが、絨毛癌と侵入奇胎由来のhCGには腫瘍特異的な中性オリゴ糖鎖が認められる。フコシルトランスフェラーゼの増加などが機序と考えられ、診断法への応用も報告されている。
pmid-2839526.summary_en: This review covers the structure and function of sugar chains on glycohormones, with emphasis on hCG. hCG from hydatidiform mole carries normal oligosaccharides, whereas hCG from choriocarcinoma and invasive mole patients carries tumor-specific additional neutral oligosaccharides. The authors propose increased fucosyltransferase activity and ectopic GnT-IV expression as mechanisms, and note that these tumor-specific glycoforms have been used for a new diagnostic test.

pmid-2839586.summary_ja: 絨毛構造を欠く絨毛性疾患の標本として、胞状奇胎の絨毛外栄養膜、絨毛癌、胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍を形態学的および免疫組織化学的(hPL、hCG、SP1)に検討した。絨毛外栄養膜は形態と胎盤蛋白の局在により絨毛癌と区別できたが、胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍とは細胞レベルで区別が難しかった。
pmid-2839586.summary_en: The authors examined trophoblastic specimens lacking villous architecture, including molar extravillous trophoblasts, choriocarcinoma, and placental site trophoblastic tumor, using morphology and immunohistochemistry for hPL, hCG, and SP1. Molar extravillous trophoblasts could be distinguished from choriocarcinoma by morphology and placental protein location. Distinguishing PSTT cells from molar extravillous trophoblasts at the cellular level was difficult.

pmid-2839954.summary_ja: 成熟奇形腫と未熟奇形腫を含む縦隔胚細胞腫瘍に伴う脳脊髄神経炎の症例を報告する。神経症状は腫瘍発見より著しく長く先行した。病理所見は傍腫瘍性脳脊髄神経炎に類似し、辺縁系脳炎、脳幹脳炎、小脳皮質変性、脊髄神経炎を認めた。ウイルス学的・免疫学的検査では原因物質や脳組織反応性自己抗体は証明されなかった。
pmid-2839954.summary_en: A case of encephalomyeloneuritis associated with a mediastinal germ cell tumor containing mature and immature teratoma is described. Neurologic symptoms preceded tumor detection by an unusually long interval. Histopathology showed limbic encephalitis, brainstem encephalitis, cortical cerebellar degeneration, and myeloneuritis, resembling paraneoplastic encephalomyeloneuritis. Virological and immunological studies found no causative agent or brain-reactive autoantibodies.

pmid-2839969.summary_ja: 精巣非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の後腹膜転移に対する化学療法中に腫瘤が増大した5例を報告し、切除標本で成熟奇形腫が確認されたことから、growing teratoma syndromeの概念を示しています。成熟奇形腫は化学療法に抵抗性ですが、外科的切除により4〜27か月後も再発なく経過しました。化学療法中に増大する腫瘤では本症候群を念頭に置くことが重要です。
pmid-2839969.summary_en: This case series describes five patients with nonseminomatous germ cell tumors of the testis who had retroperitoneal metastases that enlarged during combination systemic chemotherapy. Surgical excision revealed mature teratoma, which is resistant to chemotherapy. The authors term this phenomenon the growing teratoma syndrome. Compression of the urinary tract, vessels, or gut was common. All patients were alive without recurrence 4 to 27 months after resection, indicating that surgery is curative and should be considered when enlarging masses persist during chemotherapy.

pmid-2840269.summary_ja: ヒト絨毛癌細胞株JEG-3を用い、EGFやTPAがhCG分泌に与える影響を調べた基礎研究です。EGFとTPAはコレラ毒素で誘導されるhCG分泌とcAMP産生を増強しましたが、IGF-Iは無効でした。作用点はアデニル酸シクラーゼやEGF受容体より下流と考えられます。絨毛癌で腫瘍マーカーとして用いられるhCGの制御機構を理解する上で意義があります。
pmid-2840269.summary_en: This laboratory study examines how epidermal growth factor (EGF), IGF-I, and TPA influence hCG secretion by JEG-3 human choriocarcinoma cells. EGF and TPA markedly potentiated cholera toxin-stimulated hCG secretion and cAMP accumulation, whereas IGF-I had no effect. Potentiation also occurred with 8-bromo-cAMP, suggesting a site of action downstream of adenylate cyclase and the EGF receptor. The findings clarify growth factor regulation of trophoblastic hormone production, a marker used in choriocarcinoma management.

pmid-2840997.summary_ja: 精巣の病期I非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍46例を、精巣摘除術後に積極的監視で追跡した報告です。再発は28%で、多くは術後8か月以内に後腹膜や肺に生じました。T2〜T4腫瘍で再発率が高い傾向がありました。著者らは、監視療法はまだ標準とは言えず、安全性と実施方法の継続的な検討が必要と結論づけています。
pmid-2840997.summary_en: This series followed 46 patients with clinical stage I testicular nonseminomatous germ cell tumors under active surveillance after orchiectomy, with a median follow-up of over 40 months. Relapse occurred in 28%, mostly within eight months and predominantly in retroperitoneum and lung. Relapse was more frequent in T2 to T4 tumors (5 of 10) than in T1 tumors (7 of 35). Patients not undergoing lymphography relapsed more often, though not significantly. The authors conclude that surveillance is not yet state of the art and needs ongoing scrutiny.

pmid-2842031.summary_ja: 原発性縦隔胚細胞腫瘍25例の治療経過を検討し、剖検で治療失敗の組織像を解析した報告です。奇形腫の一部が非胚細胞性悪性腫瘍に転化した例が17例中5例(29%)ありました。原発巣に成熟奇形腫が存在すると予後不良が示唆されました。化学療法のみでは幹細胞の分化を誘導しにくいと考察されています。
pmid-2842031.summary_en: This Roswell Park series reviewed 25 patients with primary mediastinal germ cell tumors treated with surgery and chemotherapy, with or without radiotherapy. Of 17 analyzable patients, five (29%) developed nongerm cell malignant transformation of a teratoma, including adenocarcinomas and sarcomas, and one developed leukemia. Metastases most often involved lungs and mediastinal nodes. The presence of mature teratoma in the primary lesion suggested a poorer prognosis, and chemotherapy alone seemed unlikely to induce differentiation.

pmid-2842034.summary_ja: 精巣摘除術のみを行い監視した臨床病期I非セミノーマ性および混合型胚細胞腫瘍93例の研究です。リンパ管侵襲のある症例では62%に遠隔転移が生じ、ない例では18%でした。胎児性癌の成分も独立した予後不良因子であり、胎児性癌を含む例では35%に転移を認めました。リンパ管侵襲と胎児性癌が予後不良因子と結論づけられています。
pmid-2842034.summary_en: Ninety-three patients with clinical stage I nonseminomatous and mixed testicular germ cell tumors were followed under a surveillance protocol after orchiectomy alone, to evaluate pathologic prognostic factors. Lymphatic invasion was associated with distant metastasis in 62% of patients, versus 18% without it. Embryonal carcinoma was also linked to metastasis, occurring in 35% of patients with that component and none without it. The authors identified lymphatic invasion and embryonal carcinoma as poor prognostic factors.

pmid-2842210.summary_ja: 胎児性癌(EC)細胞を対象に、FGF関連増殖因子の産生と受容体を解析した基礎研究。複数のEC細胞株がFGFと免疫学的に関連する因子を産生し、分化に伴い産生は低下した。分化細胞はFGF受容体が約10倍多く、FGFに応答して増殖が促進された。
pmid-2842210.summary_en: This study examines growth factors related to fibroblast growth factor (FGF) in embryonal carcinoma (EC) cells, a germ cell tumor model. The authors found that several EC cell lines, including a multipotent human line, produce a heat-labile, heparin-binding factor immunologically related to FGF. Production decreased as the cells differentiated. Differentiated cells showed growth stimulation in response to FGF, with about 10-fold higher receptor levels than undifferentiated EC cells, suggesting the FGF-related factor may influence EC cell growth.

pmid-2842342.summary_ja: 絨毛癌由来のJEG-3細胞で、ポリアミンがhCG産生を制御する機序を検討した基礎研究。ODC阻害によりポリアミンが枯渇し、hCG産生は70～80%低下した。プトレシン投与で回復し、dibutyryl cAMPはポリアミン要求性をある程度回避できた。
pmid-2842342.summary_en: This basic research study investigates how polyamines regulate human chorionic gonadotropin (hCG) production in JEG-3 choriocarcinoma cells. Inhibiting ornithine decarboxylase with DFMO depleted polyamines and reduced hCG production by 70-80%, along with its subunit mRNAs. Exogenous putrescine restored hCG output, whereas other diamines did not. Dibutyryl cAMP stimulated hCG expression and partly bypassed the polyamine requirement, indicating that polyamines play a fundamental role in hCG biosynthesis.

pmid-2842463.summary_ja: 1972～1982年にノルウェーの病院で治療された精巣がん1,008例のうち、初回治療後36か月以上で再発した15例を後方視的に解析した研究。再発の多くは症状により発見された。能動的なフォローアップは正当化されず、再発症状を患者に周知すべきと結論づけた。
pmid-2842463.summary_en: This retrospective study from the Norwegian Radium Hospital reviewed 15 testicular cancer patients who relapsed 36 months or more after primary treatment, out of 1,008 treated from 1972 to 1982. Six pure seminoma patients relapsed at a mean of 54.5 months, and nine nonseminoma patients at 85 months. Most relapses were detected through symptoms. Seminoma patients with nodal-only relapse had a good prognosis. The authors conclude that active follow-up for relapse detection is not justified, and patients should be taught to recognize symptoms.

pmid-2842544.summary_ja: ヒト胚細胞腫瘍から樹立された新規細胞株4種(NCC-EC-1～3、NCC-IT)の特性を、形態学的観察とヌードマウス移植により解析した研究。NCC-EC-1・2は胎児性癌様の性質、NCC-EC-3は栄養膜様の分化、NCC-ITは多能性を示した。
pmid-2842544.summary_en: This study describes four newly established human germ cell tumor cell lines: NCC-EC-1, NCC-EC-2, NCC-EC-3, and NCC-IT. Morphology and nude mouse xenografts indicated that NCC-EC-1 and NCC-EC-2 resemble developmentally nullipotent embryonal carcinoma, while NCC-EC-3 shows trophoblastic differentiation. NCC-IT is developmentally pluripotent, forming embryonal carcinoma, yolk sac tumor, immature somatic tissue, and trophoblastic giant cells in xenografts. The authors conclude that human EC lines may be nullipotent, restricted, or pluripotent.

pmid-2843208.summary_ja: セミノーマの悪性胚細胞に反応するモノクローナル抗体M2Aを、成人精巣の上皮内癌(CIS)胚細胞の診断マーカーとして評価した研究。CIS20例中19例で陽性、CISのない39例では陰性であった。浸潤性精巣胚細胞腫瘍の前駆病変の検出に有用と考えられる。
pmid-2843208.summary_en: This study evaluates the monoclonal antibody M2A, previously developed against malignant germ cells of seminoma, as a marker for carcinoma in situ (CIS) germ cells in adult human testis. Using immunoperoxidase staining on tissue sections, M2A reacted with CIS cells in 19 of 20 specimens and showed no staining in 39 biopsies without CIS. The authors conclude that M2A may serve as a diagnostic marker for detecting CIS, a precursor of invasive testicular germ cell tumors that is often missed by conventional histology.

pmid-2843611.summary_ja: 臨床病期I非セミノーマ性精巣胚細胞腫瘍60例を対象に、原発巣の病理所見から後腹膜リンパ節転移と再発の予測因子を検討した。病理学的病期2以上、脈管侵襲、奇形腫成分50%未満をリスク因子とし、そのリスク数に応じた治療方針のモデルを提案した。リスク因子がない症例は精巣摘除術と経過観察、1〜2個は後腹膜リンパ節郭清、3個すべてでは郭清または化学療法を推奨する内容である。
pmid-2843611.summary_en: This study of 60 patients with clinical stage I nonseminomatous testicular germ cell tumor examined primary tumor histopathology to predict retroperitoneal nodal metastasis and relapse. Pathologic stage of at least 2, vascular invasion, and less than 50% teratoma were identified as risk factors for nodal metastasis. Based on these, a risk model was proposed. Patients with no risk factors could undergo orchiectomy with surveillance, those with one or two risk factors were advised to undergo RPLND, and those with all three were advised to undergo RPLND or chemotherapy.

pmid-2844110.summary_ja: 精巣・卵巣・性腺外の再発胚細胞腫瘍56例を対象に、シスプラチンと、エトポシドまたはビンブラスチンにイホスファミドを加えた救済療法の第II相試験である。化学療法のみで12例が完全寛解し、残存腫瘍の切除後にさらに8例が無病となった。無病率は36%で、3次以降の治療で持続する寛解が得られると結論づけている。
pmid-2844110.summary_en: This nonrandomized phase II trial evaluated adding ifosfamide to cisplatin plus etoposide or vinblastine in 56 evaluable patients with recurrent germ cell tumors of testicular, ovarian, and extragonadal origin after prior cisplatin-based therapy. Twelve patients achieved complete remission with chemotherapy alone, and eight more became disease-free after resection of residual teratoma or carcinoma, giving a 36% disease-free rate. Median survival was 12.7 months, and hematologic and nephrotoxicity were the main toxicities. The authors concluded that ifosfamide-containing third-line or later therapy can produce durable remissions.

pmid-2844125.summary_ja: 絨毛性疾患31例（胞状奇胎20例、侵入奇胎4例、絨毛癌7例）と非絨毛性婦人科悪性腫瘍32例で血清PP14を測定した。胞状奇胎と侵入奇胎では治療前に高値を示し、治療後は2週間以内に急速に低下した。絨毛癌では中等度の上昇を示し、寛解とともに低下した。非絨毛性婦人科腫瘍の治療前値は正常対照と差がなかった。
pmid-2844125.summary_en: This study measured serum placental protein 14 (PP14) by radioimmunoassay in trophoblastic diseases and non-trophoblastic gynecologic malignancies. In 31 patients with trophoblastic tumors, PP14 was markedly elevated in hydatidiform moles and invasive moles and moderately elevated in choriocarcinoma, and it fell after therapy as disease remitted. Levels in 32 non-trophoblastic gynecologic tumors were similar to normal controls. The findings indicate that PP14 changes in parallel with the course of trophoblastic tumors.

pmid-2844644.summary_ja: 卵巣1例と精巣2例の性腺胚細胞腫瘍について、連続切片で「胚様体」を組織学的・免疫組織化学的に検討した。胚様体は腸管様構造、肝細胞巣、表皮巣と連続していることが多く、正常胚と異なり胚盤とは独立して分化していた。著者らは、真の胚や奇形腫性の胚ではなく、胚性腸管由来と考えられる上皮からの腸と肝への分化の産物であると結論している。
pmid-2844644.summary_en: Using serial sections of three gonadal germ cell tumors (one ovarian and two testicular), the authors studied so-called embryoid bodies histologically and immunohistochemically. Embryoid bodies were usually contiguous with intestinal ducts, hepatic nests, or epidermal cell nests, and their differentiation occurred independently of an embryonic disc, unlike in a normal embryo. The authors conclude that embryoid bodies are not real or teratomatous embryos but reflect divergent differentiation into intestine and liver from an embryonic gut-derived epithelium.

pmid-2844818.summary_ja: 絨毛癌細胞株において、プロテインキナーゼA活性化薬（フォルスコリン）とプロテインキナーゼC活性化薬（PMA）がhCGのα・βサブユニット遺伝子発現に与える影響を検討した。単独では2〜3倍、併用では約9倍のmRNA増加を示し、相乗効果が認められた。PMAは細胞内cAMPを上昇させず、両経路はcAMP産生後に相互作用すると考えられる。
pmid-2844818.summary_en: This study examined how protein kinase A and protein kinase C activators regulate expression of the alpha and beta subunit genes of human chorionic gonadotropin (hCG) in choriocarcinoma cell lines. PMA and forskolin each increased hCG mRNA two- to threefold, while combined treatment produced a ninefold increase, indicating synergy. PMA did not raise intracellular cAMP, suggesting that the pathways interact after cAMP generation. The alpha subunit gene showed synergistic transcriptional activation, whereas the beta gene response was not synergistic, implying additional post-transcriptional regulation of beta mRNA.

pmid-2845154.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍の男性21例と、腫瘍のない精巣探索を受けた対象者25例で血清LDHアイソザイム1を測定した。腫瘍患者15例で精巣摘除術前に高値を認め、病期III では高値の頻度と程度がより大きかった。術後には病期I症例の多くで正常化し、病期II・IIIでは高値が持続した。精巣胚細胞腫瘍の有用なマーカーであると結論している。
pmid-2845154.summary_en: This study measured serum lactate dehydrogenase isoenzyme 1 in 21 men with testicular germ cell tumors and 25 controls undergoing testicular exploration without neoplasia. Elevated LDH1 was seen before orchiectomy in 15 tumor patients, and more often in stage III disease. After orchiectomy, levels fell to normal in most stage I patients but remained elevated in most with stage II or III disease. The authors conclude that LDH1 is a useful marker of testicular germ cell tumor.

pmid-2845172.summary_ja: 1962年から1986年に長崎大学病院と関連施設で治療した精巣腫瘍90例（胚細胞腫瘍75例）を再評価した。セミノーマの5年生存率は病期Iで100%、病期IIIで約50%であった。非セミノーマでは病期Iの全例が5年生存し、病期IIIでは約48%が4.5年生存した。進行非セミノーマでは、シスプラチンを用いた化学療法を受けた患者で生存が良好であった。
pmid-2845172.summary_en: This retrospective review covers 90 patients with testicular tumors treated at Nagasaki University Hospital and affiliated hospitals between 1962 and 1986, including 75 germ cell tumors. Five-year survival was 100% for stage I seminoma and about 50% for stage III seminoma. All stage I nonseminomas survived five years, whereas about 48% of stage III nonseminomas survived 4.5 years. Many stage I patients were treated with orchiectomy alone, and advanced disease received combined lymph node resection, radiotherapy, or chemotherapy. Advanced nonseminoma patients given cisplatin-based chemotherapy had better survival.

pmid-2845772.summary_ja: 未熟奇形腫9例の未熟神経成分を、免疫組織化学（GFAP、NSE、ニューロフィラメント、クロモグラニン、ビメンチン）と電子顕微鏡（8例）で検討した。全例がGFAPとNSEに陽性で、クロモグラニンは全例陰性であった。電子顕微鏡では発達途上のアストロサイトや乏突起膠細胞、シナプスを伴う神経突起を認め、上衣分化は2例で観察された。
pmid-2845772.summary_en: This study examined immature neural elements in nine immature teratomas using immunohistochemistry for GFAP, NSE, neurofilament, chromogranin, and vimentin, and electron microscopy in eight cases. All tumors were reactive for GFAP and NSE, and most were reactive for vimentin, while chromogranin was negative in all. Electron microscopy showed developing astrocytes and oligodendroglia, neuronal processes with synapses, and ependymal differentiation in two cases. No ambiguous hybrid cells were identified, and cellular interactions resembled normal adult brain.

pmid-2846127.summary_ja: 4種類のヒト胚細胞腫瘍由来細胞株について、光学顕微鏡と電子顕微鏡を用いて分化に伴う超微細構造の変化を検討した。DMSOおよびレチノイン酸では変化が見られなかったが、ホルボールエステルのTPAは一部の株で微絨毛の消失や細胞質空胞の増加を引き起こした。TPAが一部の胚細胞腫瘍由来株の分化を誘導しうることが示された。
pmid-2846127.summary_en: This study examined ultrastructural differentiation in four human germ cell tumor-derived cell lines (1618K, 833KE, 1777Ndif, 2806B) using light and electron microscopy. Cells were exposed to DMSO, retinoic acid, or the phorbol ester TPA. DMSO and retinoic acid induced no changes in any line, while TPA caused microvillus loss, increased heterochromatin, or increased cytoplasmic vacuoles, depending on the line. The authors conclude that TPA can induce differentiation in some germ cell tumor-derived lines, making them potential models of embryonic differentiation.

pmid-2846145.summary_ja: 精巣に生じた混合型胚細胞腫瘍1例について、両組織成分の細胞遺伝学的解析を行った。両成分に共通する唯一の構造異常はi(12p)であり、これは精巣胚細胞腫瘍でしばしば見られる指標である。この結果は、混合腫瘍の2つの組織成分が共通のクローン起源を持つことを示唆する。単一症例の報告であるため、一般化には限界がある。
pmid-2846145.summary_en: This brief cytogenetic study analyzed both histologic components of a single combined germ cell tumor of the testis. Karyotypic examination revealed that the only structural chromosomal abnormality common to both components was an isochromosome 12p, i(12p), a marker frequently seen in testicular germ cell tumors. The finding supports a shared clonal origin for the two histologic components. Because the report describes a single case, its generalizability is limited.

pmid-2846146.summary_ja: i(12p)を欠く精巣胚細胞腫瘍7例を細胞遺伝学的に解析した。内訳はセミノーマ3例、原発非セミノーマ2例、化学療法後の成熟残存奇形腫2例である。著者らは、i(12p)陰性の精巣胚細胞腫瘍はi(12p)陽性例と臨床経過が異なる別の亜群を形成する可能性を提唱している。症例数は少なく、要旨には転帰データは示されていない。
pmid-2846146.summary_en: This cytogenetic study analyzed seven testicular germ cell tumors lacking an i(12p) chromosomal abnormality: three seminomas, two primary nonseminomas, and two mature residual teratomas following chemotherapy. The authors propose that i(12p)-negative testicular germ cell tumors may form a distinct subgroup, potentially differing in clinical course from i(12p)-positive tumors. The sample is small, and the abstract presents no outcome data to confirm this clinical difference.

pmid-2846414.summary_ja: 高リスク妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍の患者36例に対しEMA/CO療法を施行した成績を報告している。22例は初回治療、14例は二次治療として投与された。全例が治療開始時に転移を有し、19例は絨毛癌と組織学的に確認された。奏効率は86%、中央値32か月の観察期間で生存率は81%であった。著者らは、高リスク例に対しEMA/CO療法が最良の選択肢であると結論している。
pmid-2846414.summary_en: This study reviews 36 patients with high-risk gestational trophoblastic tumor treated with Bagshawe's EMA/CO regimen, 22 as first-line and 14 as second-line therapy. All were metastatic at treatment start, and 19 had histologically confirmed choriocarcinoma. The overall response rate was 86%, with 81% survival over a median observation time of 32 months. Only one high-risk patient developed drug resistance, and the authors conclude that EMA/CO is the best choice for high-risk GTT.

pmid-2847848.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍120例のうち6例（5%）が対側に腫瘍を発症した。転移性疾患に対しシスプラチンを含む併用化学療法を受けた63例では、対側発症は認められなかった。一方、精巣摘除術単独または腹部放射線療法を受けた57例では8.8%が対側に発症した。シスプラチン併用化学療法が対側精巣腫瘍の予防に有効であることが示唆される。
pmid-2847848.summary_en: This study reports 120 patients with testicular germ cell tumours, of whom six (5%) developed contralateral tumours. Sixty-three patients with metastatic disease received cisplatin-based combination chemotherapy, and none developed contralateral disease. In contrast, 8.8% of 57 patients treated with orchiectomy alone or abdominal radiotherapy developed contralateral disease. The title highlights an increasing incidence of bilateral tumours, and the authors suggest chemotherapy may prevent contralateral tumours.

pmid-2849226.summary_ja: 32歳男性に、左側は純粋セミノーマ、右側は悪性転化を伴う成熟奇形腫という組織型の異なる同時性両側精巣胚細胞腫瘍が認められました。文献上の151例のレビューでは大半が両側セミノーマでした。著者らは組織型が異なる場合、両側精巣摘除術と両側後腹膜リンパ節郭清を推奨しています。症例報告と文献レビューです。
pmid-2849226.summary_en: A 32-year-old man presented with simultaneous bilateral testicular germ cell tumors of dissimilar histology: pure seminoma in the left testis and mature teratoma with malignant transformation in the right. The authors review 151 previously reported synchronous bilateral germ cell tumor cases, most of which were bilateral seminoma. They recommend bilateral orchiectomy and bilateral retroperitoneal lymph node dissection for such cases with dissimilar histology. This case report and literature review provides management guidance for synchronous bilateral tumors.

pmid-2849300.summary_ja: モノクローナル抗体Ber-H2を用い、非造血系腫瘍117例でCD30（Ki-1）発現を検討しました。胎児性癌の8/10例、混合型胚細胞腫瘍の胎児性成分の4/4例で陽性でした。他の胚細胞腫瘍や正常精巣・胎盤では陰性でした。CD30は胎児性癌の免疫組織化学マーカーや原発不明腫瘍の診断に有用な可能性があります。
pmid-2849300.summary_en: This study examines CD30 (Ki-1) expression across 117 nonhematopoietic tumors using monoclonal antibody Ber-H2. CD30 was regularly expressed by embryonal carcinomas (8 of 10) and by the embryonal components of mixed germ cell tumors (4 of 4), but not by other germ cell tumor types. Normal testes and placenta were negative. The findings suggest CD30 may be a useful immunohistochemical marker for embryonal carcinoma and for diagnosing tumors of unknown origin, and they bear on theories of Reed-Sternberg cell origin.

pmid-2850328.summary_ja: 正常胎盤、胞状奇胎、絨毛癌における c-myc, c-fms, c-sis 癌原遺伝子転写産物を、ノーザンブロットとin situ hybridizationで解析した研究です。c-myc と c-fms は奇胎および絨毛癌で発現が認められました。c-sis は初期胎盤の細胞性栄養膜のみで検出されました。著者らは、c-myc と c-fms が絨毛性疾患の腫瘍形成や進展に関与する可能性を示唆しています。
pmid-2850328.summary_en: This Japanese study uses Northern blotting and in situ hybridization to localize c-myc, c-fms and c-sis proto-oncogene transcripts in normal placenta, hydatidiform mole, and choriocarcinoma. c-myc was found in cytotrophoblast of early placenta and in mole and choriocarcinoma; c-fms localized to syncytiotrophoblast and mole/choriocarcinoma. c-sis was seen only in early placental cytotrophoblast. The authors conclude that stage- and site-specific expression relates to normal trophoblast development, and that c-myc and c-fms may contribute to tumorigenesis and progression of trophoblastic disease.

pmid-2850705.summary_ja: ヒト胚細胞腫瘍の手術検体、培養細胞、異種移植腫瘍を用いてβ-hCG産生を検討した。絨毛癌の合胞体栄養膜細胞と中間型栄養膜細胞で最も頻繁に認められ、胎児性癌に伴う合胞体巨細胞でも検出された。胎児性癌におけるβ-hCG産生は栄養膜細胞への分化を反映し、絨毛癌より多くの因子で調節されると考察している。
pmid-2850705.summary_en: This 1988 study examined beta-hCG production by human germ cell tumors using surgical specimens, cultured cells, and xenografts. beta-hCG was detected most frequently in the syncytiotrophoblastic and intermediate trophoblastic components of choriocarcinoma, and occasionally in syncytiotrophoblastic giant cells associated with embryonal carcinoma. Less often it was seen in yolk sac tumor, seminoma, and dysgerminoma. The authors propose that beta-hCG expression by giant cells in embryonal carcinoma reflects trophoblastic differentiation, and that hCG production in embryonal carcinoma is regulated by more factors than in choriocarcinoma.

pmid-2851788.summary_ja: 精巣生検で見つかった精細管内悪性胚細胞(ITMGC)の8例を追跡し、胎盤性アルカリホスファターゼ(PLAP)の診断的有用性を検討した。未治療例の多くはセミノーマへ進展し、即時に精巣摘除術を受けた例では浸潤性セミノーマが確認された。PLAP免疫染色はすべてのITMGCで陽性、対照471例では陰性であった。
pmid-2851788.summary_en: This study followed eight patients with intratubular malignant germ cells (ITMGCs) found on testicular biopsy and evaluated placental alkaline phosphatase (PLAP) as a marker. Four untreated patients showed variable outcomes, with several progressing to seminoma, while four underwent immediate orchiectomy revealing invasive seminoma or residual ITMGCs. PLAP immunostaining was positive in all ITMGC biopsies and absent in 471 control biopsies. The authors conclude that ITMGCs often progress to invasive disease, though the course can be indolent, and that PLAP is a sensitive and specific diagnostic marker.

pmid-2852202.summary_ja: 正常妊娠および胞状奇胎、妊娠性絨毛癌などの栄養膜疾患の栄養膜細胞について、HLA-DPおよびHLA-DQ抗原の発現を免疫組織化学的に検討した。いずれの栄養膜細胞にも発現は認められなかった。HLA-DRの陰性所見と合わせ、栄養膜上のHLA-D領域抗原に対する遮断抗体は生じにくいと考察している。
pmid-2852202.summary_en: This immunohistochemical study examined HLA-DP and HLA-DQ expression on trophoblasts in normal pregnancy, complete and partial hydatidiform moles, and gestational choriocarcinoma. Using monoclonal antibodies, neither HLA-DP nor HLA-DQ was expressed on any trophoblast in normal pregnancy or trophoblastic disease. Combined with the absence of HLA-DR, this suggests that blocking antibodies against HLA-D locus antigens on trophoblasts are unlikely to be generated, informing understanding of maternal-fetal immune tolerance.

pmid-2852334.summary_ja: 資源の限られたアジアの地域で実施可能な栄養膜疾患の管理法をまとめた総説である。超音波検査による診断、胞状奇胎への子宮摘出術や吸引掻爬、高リスク例への予防的化学療法、ヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)検査キットを用いたフォローアップなどを提示している。高リスク例には多剤併用化学療法を第一選択とすることも提案されている。
pmid-2852334.summary_en: This review outlines practical management strategies for trophoblastic disease suited to resource-limited settings in Asia, where funding and patient follow-up are often limited. Recommendations include routine ultrasound for irregular bleeding with amenorrhea, hysterectomy or suction curettage for hydatidiform mole, prophylactic chemotherapy for high-risk cases, hCG-based follow-up, and chemotherapy with hysterectomy for choriocarcinoma. It also proposes multiagent chemotherapy as first-line for high-risk disease and investigation of 5-FU, based on results in China.

pmid-2852336.summary_ja: 血清ヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)値が低値または検出不能となる潜在性絨毛癌を主題とした総説である。そのような病変の所在を同定するための現行の方法を概観している。血清マーカーで捉えられない病変の検出が臨床上の課題であることを示している。
pmid-2852336.summary_en: This review addresses occult trophoblastic neoplasia, in which occult choriocarcinoma may present with low or undetectable serum human chorionic gonadotropin levels. It surveys the currently available methods for identifying foci of choriocarcinoma in such patients. The clinical challenge lies in detecting disease that serum markers may fail to reveal, and the diagnostic approaches are discussed as a practical guide for clinicians managing trophoblastic neoplasms.

pmid-2853976.summary_ja: 1988年の総説で、腫瘍由来糖蛋白質の糖鎖変化と悪性転化への関連を述べている。絨毛癌患者のヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)は妊婦由来hCGと異なる新規オリゴ糖を含み、N-アセチルグルコサミニルトランスフェラーゼIVの異所性発現が原因とされた。この糖鎖変化を利用して絨毛癌の新しい診断法が確立された。
pmid-2853976.summary_en: This 1988 Biochimie review describes altered N-glycosylation in tumor glycoproteins, including increased complex-type sugar chains linked to tumorigenicity and metastatic potential. It reports that hCG from choriocarcinoma patients carries novel oligosaccharides compared with pregnancy-derived hCG, attributed to ectopic N-acetylglucosaminyltransferase IV expression. The authors used this altered glycosylation to establish a novel diagnostic method for choriocarcinoma, making the paper directly relevant to germ cell tumor marker research.

pmid-2854363.summary_ja: 1979年から1987年に治療した精巣胚細胞腫瘍31例(セミノーマ17例、非セミノーマ性14例)の臨床成績を報告している。病期別分布、精巣摘除術や化学療法などの治療、5年生存率を示した。進行非セミノーマ性腫瘍の5年生存率は40%であった。進行セミノーマには併用化学療法と後腹膜リンパ節郭清(RPLND)や放射線療法、進行NSGCTには補助化学療法後のRPLNDが有効と結論している。
pmid-2854363.summary_en: This 1988 Japanese clinical series reviews 31 patients with testicular germ cell tumors treated between 1979 and 1987, comprising 17 seminomas and 14 non-seminomatous germ cell tumors. It details stage distribution, treatment approaches including orchiectomy, radiation therapy, RPLND, and chemotherapy, and five-year survival. Stage I patients had excellent outcomes, while advanced non-seminomatous tumors had only 40% survival at five years. The authors conclude that combined chemotherapy with RPLND or radiation is effective for advanced seminoma, and that adjuvant chemotherapy followed by RPLND benefits advanced NSGCT.

pmid-2854968.summary_ja: 精巣腫瘍50例の精巣摘除術前に、LDH1アイソザイムを腫瘍マーカーとして評価した研究である。LDH1はセミノーマの12/19例で上昇した。ヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)やαフェトプロテイン(AFP)は非セミノーマ性腫瘍で高頻度に上昇した。3つのマーカーの併用で、陽性率はセミノーマ63%、非セミノーマ性または混合型87%に達した。
pmid-2854968.summary_en: This 1988 Australian and New Zealand Journal of Surgery study evaluated lactate dehydrogenase isoenzyme 1 as a tumor marker in 50 men with testicular tumors before orchidectomy. Elevated LDH1 occurred in 12 of 19 seminomas and 7 of 31 non-seminomatous or mixed tumors. Serum hCG and AFP were elevated in most non-seminomatous cases. Combining all three markers, positivity reached 12 of 19 seminomas and 27 of 31 non-seminomatous or mixed tumors, supporting multi-marker assessment in testicular germ cell tumors.

pmid-2856445.summary_ja: ヒト胚細胞腫瘍の分化能を検討した総説である。ヒト胎児性癌細胞から作製したモノクローナル抗体を用い、腫瘍細胞の分化を解析している。これらの抗体の一部は正常組織の発生段階の特定に有用であることが示された。ヒト胚細胞腫瘍は、腫瘍と体細胞の分化を研究する優れたモデルと位置づけられている。
pmid-2856445.summary_en: This Japanese review of human germ cell tumors discusses monoclonal antibodies raised against human embryonal carcinoma cells. The authors explain that cell surface antigens expressed sequentially on embryonic cells can serve as markers of differentiation. They use these antibodies to study the differentiation capacity of human germ cell tumor cells and show that some antibodies can identify the developmental stage of normal tissues. The article highlights human germ cell tumors as a model for both tumor and somatic cell differentiation.

pmid-2900171.summary_ja: 1988年に行われた後方視的レビュー。手術で診断された96例・120個の卵巣腫瘍を分析した。良性嚢胞性奇形腫が最も多く（30%）、主に20〜30歳の女性に見られた。悪性腫瘍は8.3%と少なかったが、良性嚢胞性奇形腫の8.3%に悪性化が認められた。良性卵巣腫瘍患者で最も多い症状は腹痛と腹部の腫脹であった。
pmid-2900171.summary_en: This 1988 retrospective review of 96 patients with 120 ovarian neoplasms identified at surgery found benign cystic teratoma to be the most common tumor, at 30%, mostly in women aged 20 to 30. Malignancy was uncommon at 8.3%, but malignant change occurred in 8.3% of benign cystic teratomas. Abdominal pain and swelling were the most frequent symptoms among patients with benign ovarian neoplasms.

pmid-2902206.summary_ja: 2歳児の腹腔内の未下降精巣に生じた卵黄嚢腫瘍の症例報告。腫瘍は大きく血清AFPも高値で、受診は遅れていたが病期Iであった。外科的切除と化学療法に良好な反応を示した。同年齢での報告は他になかったとされる。
pmid-2902206.summary_en: A case report of a 2-year-old child with a large yolk sac tumor arising in an undescended intraabdominal testis. Despite the large primary tumor, markedly elevated serum AFP, and relatively late presentation, the lesion was stage I. The child responded well to surgical resection followed by chemotherapy. The authors note that no similar finding had been reported in a child this young.

pmid-2904911.summary_ja: 胎児の仙尾部奇形腫による予期せぬ難産の管理に成功した1例の報告と、最近の報告例の検討。このような難産はまれで乳児死亡率が高いが、適切な管理により母児の予後が必ずしも不良ではないとされる。母体超音波検査の普及で遭遇は減っている。管理に関する提言も示されている。
pmid-2904911.summary_en: This report describes successful management of unexpected dystocia caused by a fetal sacrococcygeal teratoma, alongside a review of recently reported cases. Such dystocia is rare and has historically carried high infant mortality. The authors argue that prognosis need not be poor for mother or infant when the case is managed appropriately. Increasing maternal ultrasonography has made unexpected presentation less likely. The paper offers management recommendations.

pmid-2904916.summary_ja: 片側性の純粋卵巣未分化胚細胞腫の症例で、血清LDHが著明に上昇していた。完全切除後にLDHは速やかに正常化した。アイソザイムは術前は正常範囲内だったが、術後1週間でLDH-1と-2が増加した。既報17例の検討も含め、血清LDHとアイソザイムは診断と経過観察に有用な腫瘍マーカーと結論付けられている。
pmid-2904916.summary_en: This report describes a case of unilateral pure ovarian dysgerminoma with markedly elevated serum LDH that returned to normal promptly after complete tumor excision. Preoperative LDH isoenzyme patterns were normal, but LDH-1 and LDH-2 rose one week after surgery. The authors reviewed 17 prior English-language cases of ovarian dysgerminoma with elevated LDH. They conclude that serum LDH and its isoenzyme pattern are useful tumor markers for diagnosis and postoperative surveillance.

pmid-2906253.summary_ja: 胞状奇胎の後に発症した原発性絨毛癌2例を遺伝学的に解析した研究です。腫瘍はいずれも父親由来の多型のみを示すアンドロゲネシス起源でした。一方はヘテロ接合体、もう一方は全多型でホモ接合体でした。完全奇胎はヘテロ接合性・ホモ接合性のいずれでも絨毛癌に進展しうることが示されました。
pmid-2906253.summary_en: This study examines two cases of primary choriocarcinoma that followed a hydatidiform mole. Restriction fragment length polymorphism analysis of tumor, patient and partner DNA showed that both tumors were androgenetic, carrying only paternal alleles. One tumor was heterozygous, with two paternal alleles detected by some probes, while the other was homozygous for all informative polymorphisms. The findings indicate that choriocarcinoma can develop after a complete mole that is either heterozygous or homozygous, which is relevant to understanding the origin of gestational trophoblastic tumors.

pmid-3041405.summary_ja: 胞状奇胎と絨毛癌で胎児栄養膜抗原と母体白血球浸潤を免疫組織化学で比較した研究です。奇胎の栄養膜は正常妊娠に類似していました。絨毛癌は正常の栄養膜表現型をすべて示し、悪性栄養膜の多様な分化を示唆しました。奇胎の脱落膜にはT細胞やマクロファージが存在し、絨毛癌では認められませんでした。
pmid-3041405.summary_en: This study uses immunohistochemistry to compare fetal trophoblast antigens and maternal leucocytic responses in molar pregnancy and choriocarcinoma. Trophoblast antigen phenotypes in complete, partial and invasive moles resembled those of normal pregnancy. Choriocarcinoma showed all normal trophoblast phenotypes, suggesting heterogeneous differentiation in malignant trophoblast. Molar decidua contained T lymphocytes, class II MHC-positive macrophages and endometrial granulocytes, which were absent from choriocarcinoma. The findings clarify immune and phenotypic differences between benign and malignant gestational trophoblastic disease.

pmid-3044277.summary_ja: 1988年の第II相試験は、泌尿生殖器がん109例にカルボプラチンを投与した。進行精巣腫瘍の奏効率は48%で、セミノーマは70%、非セミノーマは27%だった。シスプラチン治療歴のある患者にも奏効がみられた。腎機能障害や聴器毒性は少なかったが、重度の骨髄抑制が認められた。併用療法を含むさらなる検討が推奨された。
pmid-3044277.summary_en: This 1988 phase II trial evaluated carboplatin in 109 patients with genitourinary cancer. Response rates were 48% in advanced testicular tumors, 70% in seminomas, and 27% in nonseminomas. Responses were also seen in some patients previously treated with cisplatin. Transitional cell carcinoma responded in 18%, and prostate cancer did not respond. Carboplatin was well tolerated without significant renal or ototoxicity, though severe myelosuppression occurred. The authors concluded it warrants further study, especially in combination therapy.

pmid-3044584.summary_ja: 1988年の本研究は、胚細胞腫瘍29例で血液型関連抗原を免疫組織化学的に検討した。胎児性癌と卵黄嚢腫瘍はK-21抗体で強陽性を示し、多くがH抗原陽性だった。典型的セミノーマは陰性で、非定型例では不均一な染色を示した。K-21とH抗原は非セミノーマとセミノーマの鑑別マーカーとなりうると提案されている。
pmid-3044584.summary_en: This 1988 Cancer Research study used monoclonal antibodies and lectin to map blood group antigens in 29 human germ cell tumors. Embryonal carcinomas and yolk sac tumors strongly expressed type I precursor antigen detected by K-21, and most expressed antigen H. Classic seminomas were negative for these markers, while atypical seminomas showed heterogeneous staining. The authors suggest K-21 and antigen H may distinguish nonseminomatous germ cell tumors from seminomas. Atypical seminomas may show differentiation toward nonseminomatous histology.

pmid-3045784.summary_ja: 1988年の本研究は、術前に診断された後腹膜の胎児内胎児を病理学的に検討した。血管茎と被膜に神経支配があり、弾性板や血管の構造も確認された。これらの所見は、胎児内胎児が高度に分化・組織化された奇形腫であるとする説を支持する。胎児内胎児と奇形腫は同一のものであるという見解が示された。
pmid-3045784.summary_en: This 1988 Pediatric Pathology report examined a retroperitoneal fetus in fetu diagnosed before surgery. The study identified nerve innervation and well-defined elastic lamina and vasa vasorum in the vascular pedicle and capsule, structures previously assumed to be umbilical cord or amnion. These findings support the view that fetus in fetu is a complex, well-differentiated, highly organized teratoma. The authors present further arguments that fetus in fetu and teratoma are identical entities.

pmid-3047360.summary_ja: 1988年の本研究は、施設で58年間に治療された頸部奇形腫9例と、文献212例を解析した。出生時の状態、診断時年齢、呼吸窮迫の有無に基づく分類を提案した。死亡率は群により大きく異なり、死産・瀕死の新生児では100%、呼吸窮迫のない新生児では2.7%だった。早期切除の手術死亡率は低かった。
pmid-3047360.summary_en: This 1988 Journal of Pediatric Surgery study analyzed nine cervical teratomas treated at one institution over 58 years and reviewed 212 additional literature cases. The authors propose a classification based on birth status, age at diagnosis, and respiratory distress. Mortality varied widely across groups, from 100% in stillborn or moribund newborns to 2.7% in newborns without respiratory distress. Early excision was associated with low operative mortality. The classification is intended to provide prognostic value beyond previous schemes.

pmid-3047500.summary_ja: 1988年の本研究は、1979〜1986年に治療されたノルウェーの若年精巣がん597例を検討した。術前にAFPまたはhCGの上昇が67%で認められた。臨床病期I非セミノーマでは、術後マーカー低下不良と小血管浸潤が後腹膜転移を予測した。治療毒性として悪心、骨髄抑制、末梢神経障害などが報告された。
pmid-3047500.summary_en: This 1988 Journal of Surgical Oncology report reviewed 597 Norwegian men aged 15-45 with testicular cancer treated from 1979 to 1986. Elevated AFP or hCG was present in 67% before orchiectomy. Abnormal postorchiectomy marker decline and small vessel invasion predicted retroperitoneal metastases in clinical stage I nonseminoma. Five-year survival was 99% for seminoma stage I/IIa after radiotherapy and 100% for nonseminoma pathological stage I/IIa. Cisplatin-based chemotherapy was used for advanced disease, and the authors describe acute and late treatment-related toxicities.

pmid-3047782.summary_ja: 1988年の本研究は、仙尾部奇形腫の胎児15例の出生前超音波所見を検討した。嚢胞と充実の混在、充実優位、単房性嚢胞の3パターンが認められ、6例で石灰化がみられた。超音波像は未熟成分や悪性成分の有無と相関しなかった。大きな腫瘍では帝王切開による分娩が推奨された。
pmid-3047782.summary_en: This 1988 Radiology study reviewed prenatal sonograms of 15 fetuses with sacrococcygeal teratoma. Tumors showed cystic-solid mixed, predominantly solid, or unilocular cystic patterns, and calcifications were seen in six cases. Sonographic appearance did not correlate with immature or malignant components. Ultrasonography revealed an intraabdominal component in six cases. The authors recommend prenatal measurement of the external component to plan delivery, with cesarean section advised for large tumors to avoid dystocia and hemorrhage.

pmid-3048084.summary_ja: 胃原発の絨毛癌の1症例を報告。腹痛、体重減少、心窩部腫瘤、消化管出血が主症状で胃腺癌との鑑別が困難。腺癌・胎児性癌・絨毛癌が混在する組織像から、胃腺癌の脱分化による発生が示唆された。併用化学療法でも予後は改善せず、診断後平均2か月未満の生存であった。
pmid-3048084.summary_en: This report describes a patient with primary gastric choriocarcinoma, a rare germ cell tumor. Symptoms included abdominal pain, weight loss, an epigastric mass, and gastrointestinal bleeding, which mimic gastric adenocarcinoma. Histology was mixed, containing adenocarcinoma, embryonal carcinoma, and choriocarcinoma components, suggesting dedifferentiation of gastric adenocarcinoma. Patients typically survived under two months, and combination chemotherapy had not improved survival.

pmid-3048795.summary_ja: 45,X型ターナー症候群に生じたディスジャーミノーマの第4例目の報告。典型的なターナー像に加え、乳房発育、初経、続発性無月経を認めた。ゴナドトロピンの上昇と低エストラジオールは思春期後のターナー症候群に一致した。染色体分染法でY染色体由来物質は否定された。Y染色体がなくても胚細胞の異常分化が起こりうることが示唆された。
pmid-3048795.summary_en: This case report describes dysgerminoma in a woman with 45,X Turner syndrome, the fourth such case reported. Despite typical Turner features, she had breast development, menarche, and secondary amenorrhea. Gonadotropin levels and low estradiol were consistent with post-pubertal Turner syndrome. Chromosome banding excluded Y chromosome material. The authors conclude that a Y chromosome is not required for abnormal germ cell differentiation, which may lead to gonadoblastoma.

pmid-3048937.summary_ja: 直腸ポリープからの出血として発症した良性嚢胞性卵巣奇形腫の症例を報告。このような臨床像の報告は既になかった。大腸浸潤を伴う良性卵巣奇形腫について英語文献をレビューし、原因、臨床像、治療を検討した。消化器症状を呈する患者では、本疾患の診断が困難となりうることを強調している。
pmid-3048937.summary_en: This report presents a case of benign cystic ovarian teratoma presenting as a bleeding rectal polyp, a presentation not previously described. The authors review the English literature on benign cystic ovarian teratomas with colorectal involvement. They discuss the causes, clinical presentation, and management of this condition, emphasizing its diagnostic challenges in patients presenting with gastrointestinal symptoms.

pmid-3050140.summary_ja: 精巣がんの治療は、病期分類、手術手技、全身化学療法の進歩により15年間で大きく改善したと概説。低腫瘍量症例に対する低侵襲な治療や、予後不良の転移例への有効な治療など未解決課題を提示。縦隔原発胚細胞腫瘍と非胚細胞性癌やクラインフェルター症候群との関連が、分化を決定する因子の解明につながる可能性を指摘している。
pmid-3050140.summary_en: This editorial reviews progress in testicular cancer treatment over 15 years, attributed to improved staging, surgery, and systemic chemotherapy. It highlights unresolved issues, including minimally morbid therapy for low-volume disease and effective treatment for poor-risk metastatic patients. It also notes the association of primary mediastinal germ cell neoplasms with non-germ cell cancers and Klinefelter syndrome, which may help clarify differentiation factors.

pmid-3053595.summary_ja: 精巣がんの病期別の根治的治療をまとめた総説。病理学的病期Iではほぼ100%の治癒率が得られ、臨床病期Iの経過観察では20～30%が再発する。病期IIは高い治癒率を示し、進行例は全身化学療法が基本となる。奇形腫を含む症例は、6～8年後の再発もあるため長期フォローアップが重要であり、原発部位が不明な場合は根治的精巣摘除術が推奨される。
pmid-3053595.summary_en: This review covers curative treatment for testicular germ cell tumors across stages. Most patients present with low-volume disease; pathologic stage I carries near-100% cure, while clinical stage I surveillance has a 20-30% relapse rate. Stage II is highly curable, and advanced disease is treated with systemic chemotherapy. The authors stress long-term follow-up, since teratoma-containing specimens can recur up to 8 years later, and advise radical orchiectomy when the primary site is unclear.

pmid-3053596.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍の管理において、αフェトプロテイン(AFP)とβ-hCGが現在最も有用な血清腫瘍マーカーであると述べる。治療反応のモニタリングには連続測定が不可欠である。マーカーの上昇は再発の最初の徴候となることが多く、腫瘍量が極めて少ない段階で治療を開始でき、完全寛解の可能性が高まる。
pmid-3053596.summary_en: This brief review addresses serum markers in testicular germ cell tumors. It states that alpha-fetoprotein and beta-HCG are currently the most useful markers for managing these tumors. Serial measurements are essential for monitoring response to therapy. A rising marker is often the first sign of recurrence, allowing treatment while tumor burden is very low, which improves the chance of complete remission.

pmid-3054910.summary_ja: 1988年の報告。臨床病期I・低病期IIおよび化学療法後の病期IIIの非セミノーマ性精巣がんに対し、神経温存後腹膜リンパ節郭清の治療的・予後的価値を検討している。著者らは、病理学的病期分類と同等の精度を得るため、より感度・特異度の高い非侵襲的検査法の開発が必要だとしている。抄録は簡潔で、症例数や成績の詳細は示されていない。
pmid-3054910.summary_en: This 1988 report examines nerve-sparing retroperitoneal lymphadenectomy (RPLND) in patients with nonseminomatous testicular cancer at clinical stage I, low-stage II, and stage III after chemotherapy. The authors argue that the procedure has therapeutic and prognostic value and can guide decisions about further treatment. They emphasize that more sensitive and specific noninvasive methods are needed to match the accuracy of pathological staging. The abstract is brief and gives no details on patient numbers, outcomes, or surgical technique.

pmid-3055609.summary_ja: 1988年の報告。精巣腫瘍の患者56例を対象に、コンピュータ断層撮影(CT)による病期分類の有用性を、後腹膜リンパ節郭清による組織学的結果と比較した。CTの正診率は68%で、偽陽性3例・偽陰性13例があった。臨床病期Iの約40%が監視療法下で進行したと推定され、監視療法は長期観察体制と高い患者遵守が保証された施設に限るべきとしている。
pmid-3055609.summary_en: This 1988 study evaluated computed tomography (CT) for staging testicular tumors in 56 patients, all of whom underwent retroperitoneal lymph node dissection. CT correctly staged 68% of patients but produced 3 false-positive and 13 false-negative results. Nearly 40% of patients with clinical stage I disease would likely have progressed under surveillance. The authors conclude that surveillance should be limited to specialized centers with reliable long-term follow-up and high patient compliance.

pmid-3055813.summary_ja: 1988年の症例報告。近親婚から生まれた非双生児の兄弟2例に、知的障害とてんかんを伴う悪性精巣腫瘍がみられた。一人は奇形癌、もう一人はセミノーマであった。文献的検討をもとに、精巣腫瘍の発生における遺伝的要因について考察している。
pmid-3055813.summary_en: This 1988 case report describes malignant testicular tumors in two non-twin brothers born to a consanguineous marriage, both with intellectual disability and epilepsy. One brother had teratocarcinoma and the other had seminoma. Drawing on a literature review, the authors discuss possible genetic contributions to testicular neoplasia. The report is brief and centers on the familial occurrence of these tumors.

pmid-3059662.summary_ja: 触知できない精巣腫瘍2例が、日常的な陰嚢超音波検査により偶発的に発見された症例報告である。1例では、対側の根治的精巣摘除術後3か月のフォローアップ超音波検査で、触診上正常な精巣に2つ目の原発性精巣胚細胞腫瘍が認められた。著者らは、陰嚢超音波検査が陰嚢内腫瘤の診断に正確で、触診で見逃される潜在病変も検出できると論じている。
pmid-3059662.summary_en: This report describes two patients whose impalpable testicular germ cell tumors were detected incidentally by routine scrotal ultrasonography. In one patient, a second primary tumor arose in a palpably normal testis three months after contralateral radical orchiectomy, identified during routine follow-up ultrasound. The authors argue that scrotal ultrasonography is accurate for intrascrotal masses and can detect occult lesions missed on clinical examination, supporting its role in surveillance of patients with testicular tumors.

pmid-3060042.summary_ja: 1988年の症例報告。26歳男性の後腹膜原発の大きな腫瘍で、胎児性癌と卵黄嚢腫瘍の両成分を示した。経過は侵攻性で、発症から8か月以内に死亡した。Schiller-Duval小体と腺癌様分化がみられ、αフェトプロテイン(AFP)はびまん性に、ヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)は一部の細胞で発現していた。著者らは、腫瘍の組織発生を全能性の胚細胞由来ではなく、胚発生の極初期を反映したものと解釈している。
pmid-3060042.summary_en: This 1988 case report describes a 26-year-old man with a large primary retroperitoneal tumor showing both embryonal carcinoma and yolk sac tumor patterns. The disease followed an aggressive course and led to death within eight months of symptom onset. Histology showed Schiller-Duval bodies and adenocarcinomatous differentiation, with diffuse alpha-fetoprotein and hCG expression in isolated cells. The authors propose that the tumor's histogenesis reflects very early embryonic development rather than a totipotent germ cell origin.

pmid-3060153.summary_ja: 本総説は精巣がんを扱い、1970年代以前は転移性非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の治癒率が10%未満であったが、現在は約90%が根治可能になったことを述べている。化学療法により手術や放射線療法の位置づけが見直され、早期病変での経過観察が導入されたことを論じている。化学療法後の残存腫瘤切除、妊孕性の回復、患者の心理社会的負担についても検討している。
pmid-3060153.summary_en: This review summarizes testicular cancer, the most common malignancy in men aged 20-34. Before the 1970s, fewer than 10% of men with metastatic non-seminomatous germ cell tumors were cured, whereas about 90% are now potentially curable with modern chemotherapy. The authors discuss how chemotherapy changed the roles of surgery and radiotherapy, the adoption of surveillance for early-stage disease, residual-mass surgery after chemotherapy, fertility recovery, and the psychosocial burden on patients.

pmid-3061558.summary_ja: 本報告は原発性縦隔セミノーマの新規2症例を記載し、文献上の126例を解析したものである。放射線療法の単独または手術との併用が治療の第一選択とされる一方、化学療法の役割は不確かであると述べている。著者らは治療法の比較と有効性の評価を可能にする分類法を提案している。
pmid-3061558.summary_en: This report describes two new cases of primary mediastinal seminoma and analyzes 126 previously published cases. Some authors consider radiotherapy, alone or combined with surgery, the treatment of choice, while the role of chemotherapy remains uncertain. The authors propose a classification system that allows different therapeutic approaches to be compared and their value to be assessed. The rare tumor is examined mainly from the standpoint of treatment strategy.

pmid-3066213.summary_ja: 62歳男性が陰茎体のびまん性硬結を主訴に受診した症例報告である。海綿体と鎖骨上リンパ節の生検で転移性セミノーマが確認されたが、両側精巣に異常はなかった。胸部X線で上部前縦隔に腫瘤があり、縦隔が原発巣と考えられた。患者は肝硬変で死亡し、剖検は得られなかった。
pmid-3066213.summary_en: This case report describes a 62-year-old man with diffuse induration of the penile shaft, a rare site of metastasis. Biopsies of the corpora cavernosa and a supraclavicular lymph node showed metastatic seminoma, while both testes appeared normal. Chest radiography revealed an anterior upper mediastinal mass, so the mediastinum was considered the likely primary site. The patient died of liver cirrhosis, and autopsy was not obtained.

pmid-3067170.summary_ja: 胞状奇胎を完全奇胎と部分奇胎の2つの症候群に分け、遺伝学的・形態学的・臨床的に異なることを示した総説。絨毛癌は完全奇胎にのみ関連して報告され、残存トロホブラスト性疾患はどちらの型からも生じ、局所浸潤性の非塞栓性挙動をとる。奇胎の亜型による診断と予後評価の違いを整理した内容である。
pmid-3067170.summary_en: This review examines the clinical pathology of hydatidiform moles, distinguishing complete and partial syndromes as genetically, morphologically and clinically distinct entities. Choriocarcinoma is associated with complete moles but has not been described with partial moles. Residual trophoblastic disease can follow either type and typically shows locally invasive, nonembolic behaviour. The article is a concise overview from a 1988 clinics volume on trophoblastic disease, emphasizing the diagnostic and prognostic distinctions between mole subtypes and their potential progression to malignant gestational disease.

pmid-3069998.summary_ja: 卵巣と精巣は妊娠4か月頃まで発生が類似しており、この共通性から各臓器に生じる腫瘍の起源を説明する総説。胚細胞由来の腫瘍は両臓器に生じ、卵黄嚢腫瘍や絨毛癌は胚外組織に由来する。残存する胚性細胞が両臓器で類似腫瘍を生じる可能性も論じられている。
pmid-3069998.summary_en: This review traces embryonic development of the ovary and testis, which are similar until about the fourth month, to explain why certain tumors occur in each gonad. Common epithelial tumors arise in the ovary from embryonic surface mesothelium, which disappears from the testis, explaining their absence there. Germ cell and sex cord tumors arise in both gonads from primitive germ cells and gonadal tissue. Extraembryonic components produce endodermal sinus tumors and choriocarcinomas. Residual embryonic cells may explain the similar tumors occurring in ovary and testis.

pmid-3070891.summary_ja: 血痰と上大静脈症候群で発症した縦隔セミノーマの症例を報告し、文献的に考察した。血痰を呈した縦隔セミノーマは従来1例のみ報告されていた。精巣外胚細胞腫瘍の一型として、呼吸器症状や血管圧迫で発症しうることを示す。縦隔に生じる胚細胞腫瘍の臨床像を理解する上で有用な報告である。
pmid-3070891.summary_en: This case report describes a mediastinal seminoma presenting with hemoptysis and superior vena cava obstruction. The authors note that only one previous case of mediastinal seminoma with hemoptysis had been reported in the literature. They review relevant published cases to place this presentation in context. The report highlights that mediastinal seminomas, a form of extragonadal germ cell tumor, may present with respiratory symptoms and vascular compression. It is a brief clinical report with limited treatment detail given the abstract scope.

pmid-3071947.summary_ja: 右季肋部痛で受診した25歳男性の原発性後腹膜奇形腫の症例。超音波、コンピュータ断層撮影(CT)、磁気共鳴画像法(MRI)で右副腎窩に脂肪成分に富む多房性の嚢胞性腫瘤を認めた。胸腹部アプローチで摘出した標本では悪性転化を伴わない嚢胞性奇形腫と診断された。稀な成人の後腹膜奇形腫の画像所見を示す報告である。
pmid-3071947.summary_en: This report describes a 25-year-old man with a primary retroperitoneal teratoma presenting with right hypochondralgia during exercise. Ultrasonography, computed tomography and magnetic resonance imaging revealed an expansive, heterogeneous, fat-rich mass with multiple cystic lesions in the right suprarenal fossa. Sagittal, transaxial and coronal MRI clearly delineated the tumor extent and character. Histology after removal through a thoracoabdominal approach showed cystic teratoma without malignant transformation. The case illustrates the imaging features of rare adult retroperitoneal teratoma.

pmid-3126587.summary_ja: 1965年から1984年にNYU/Bellevueで治療された病期IおよびIIの精巣セミノーマ患者79例を対象とした後方視的検討である。標準治療は根治的鼠径精巣摘除術と補助放射線照射であり、病期IIでは縦隔照射が追加された。大きな合併症はなく、病期I患者は中央値8年の追跡で再発がなかった。病期II患者では4例がセミノーマで死亡した。予防的縦隔照射と経過観察のみの方法の是非を論じ、前向き試験による検証が必要とされている。
pmid-3126587.summary_en: This retrospective review analyzed 79 patients with stage I and II testicular seminoma treated at NYU/Bellevue from 1965 to 1984. Standard care was radical inguinal orchiectomy followed by adjuvant radiation, with mediastinal radiation added for stage II. No major complications occurred. All stage I patients remained free of recurrence at a median follow-up of eight years, and four stage II patients died of seminoma. The authors discuss prophylactic mediastinal radiation versus observation alone and call for prospective trials.

pmid-3129752.summary_ja: 1961〜1985年に放射線療法を受けたセミノーマ90例を後方視的に検討した研究である。古典型と未分化型を比較し、10年無再発生存率は古典型94%、未分化型70%だった。差は病期Iで特に大きく、両者の予後の違いが示唆された。
pmid-3129752.summary_en: This retrospective study analyzed 90 seminoma patients treated with radiation therapy between 1961 and 1985, comparing classical (71) and anaplastic (19) histology. The 10-year relapse-free survival was 94% for classical and 70% for anaplastic seminoma, with the difference most evident in stage I disease (98% vs 64%). Stage II relapse-free survival was similar (84% vs 75%). Relapses occurred in 6% of classical and 21% of anaplastic cases, suggesting a true prognostic difference between the two subtypes.

pmid-3130349.summary_ja: 侵入奇胎および絨毛癌患者の尿中ヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)を、正常妊婦や胞状奇胎患者のものから識別する新手法の報告である。Datura stramonium agglutinin(DSA)は侵入奇胎・絨毛癌由来hCGの糖鎖に結合し、他群には結合しない。固定化DSAカラムにより、各種栄養膜疾患由来のhCGを区別できることを示した。
pmid-3130349.summary_en: This study developed a method to distinguish urinary human chorionic gonadotropin (hCG) from patients with invasive mole and choriocarcinoma from that of normal pregnant women and patients with hydatidiform mole. Datura stramonium agglutinin (DSA) binds the asparagine-linked sugar chains found in hCG from invasive mole and choriocarcinoma, but not in the other groups. An immobilized DSA column therefore discriminates hCG from various trophoblastic diseases. As a short report, the paper focuses on the technique and provides limited clinical detail.

pmid-3131957.summary_ja: 精巣の上皮内癌(CIS)患者7例の生検材料を用い、8種類のレクチン結合を比較した組織化学研究である。CIS細胞の糖鎖パターンは浸潤性セミノーマ細胞と類似しており、CIS細胞の悪性の性質を支持する。一方、正常精子形成細胞との差異があるため、起源の判断は困難とされた。
pmid-3131957.summary_en: This comparative histochemical study examined lectin binding in seven patients with testicular carcinoma-in-situ (CIS) and in invasive seminoma. Eight fluorescein-labelled lectins showed that CIS cells had abundant Con A and LCA binding sites, plus perinuclear WGA and RCA I staining, a pattern similar to invasive seminoma cells. This supports the malignant nature of CIS cells. However, differences from normal spermatogenic cells mean the origin of CIS cells cannot be determined from lectin patterns alone.

pmid-3133101.summary_ja: 難治性胚細胞腫瘍21例に、エトポシド、イホスファミド、高用量シスプラチンを組み合わせたVIhPレジメンを投与した治療成績の報告。完全寛解率は約42%で、一部は残存腫瘍切除後に寛解が得られた。一方で骨髄抑制、腎障害、末梢神経障害などの毒性が強く、通常用量と比べて奏効率は向上しなかった。初回治療としての有用性は今後の検討課題とされている。
pmid-3133101.summary_en: Twenty-one patients with refractory germ cell tumors received the VIhP regimen, combining etoposide, ifosfamide with mesna, and high-dose cisplatin. Nineteen were evaluable, and a 42% complete remission rate was achieved, including responders after resection of residual masses. Toxicity was heavy, with severe myelosuppression, sepsis, renal toxicity and peripheral neurotoxicity. High-dose cisplatin did not appear to improve response compared with conventional dosing. The authors suggest VIhP deserves further study as first-line therapy for poor-prognosis advanced disease.

pmid-3135693.summary_ja: 卵巣未熟奇形腫の15歳女児の症例報告。化学療法および全身放射線照射を含む大量化学療法と骨髄救援を受けた後、8か月で骨髄単球性急性白血病を発症した。ヒドロキシウレアで一時改善したものの死亡した。原発腫瘍、化学療法、骨髄移植のそれぞれが白血病発症にどう関与したかを考察している。
pmid-3135693.summary_en: A 15-year-old girl with immature ovarian teratoma received adriamycin, cyclophosphamide and cisplatin, followed by intensification with cyclophosphamide, total body irradiation and marrow rescue. Eight months later she developed myelomonocytic acute leukemia. Hydroxyurea produced transient improvement, but she died. The authors discuss the respective contributions of the primary tumor, chemotherapy and marrow transplantation to the development of leukemia after treatment for a solid tumor.

pmid-3139277.summary_ja: セミノーマ術後に横隔膜下放射線療法を受けた患者で、散乱線による精巣被曝と精子への影響を経時的に評価した。平均被曝線量は62cGyで、精子数は約7か月で最低値となり約12か月で回復した。回復後も運動率は有意に低下していた。FSHの上昇は散乱線量と相関せず、放射線による精子形成障害の実態を示した。
pmid-3139277.summary_en: Semen and blood were serially sampled in patients receiving subdiaphragmatic radiotherapy after orchiectomy for seminoma. Scatter radiation to the testes averaged 62 cGy. Sperm counts fell to a nadir around seven months and recovered by about twelve months, with peak FSH at about seven months. Motility remained significantly reduced after recovery, though the FSH rise did not correlate with scatter dose. The study characterizes radiation-induced spermatogenic toxicity.

pmid-3141102.summary_ja: 精巣腫瘍81例に、前方単一照射野（16 MV）による傍大動脈・腸骨リンパ節照射を行った。胃十二指腸合併症はセミノーマで18%、奇形腫で58%にみられ、用量依存性であった。平均4.3年の観察で長期的な後遺症はなかった。前方の臓器が節より高線量を受けるため、必要線量が4000cGyを超える場合は本法は不適当と結論づけている。
pmid-3141102.summary_en: Eighty-one patients with testicular tumours received para-aortic and iliac nodal irradiation through a single anterior 16 MV field. Gastro-duodenal complications occurred in 18% of seminoma and 58% of teratoma patients, were dose-related, and had no long-term sequelae over a mean 4.3-year follow-up. Because anterior structures receive higher dose than the nodes, the authors conclude the technique is unsuitable when the required dose exceeds 4000 cGy.

pmid-3145683.summary_ja: 62歳女性の左上腹部腫瘤で、コンピュータ断層撮影(CT)にて左腎上方の後腹膜に嚢胞性腫瘤を認めた。胸腹部アプローチで摘出し、良性嚢胞性奇形腫と確定した。術後、ドレーン排液が乳び様となり1日約400mlに達したため乳糜腹水と診断した。完全静脈栄養を行い、術後21日目にドレーンを抜去した。
pmid-3145683.summary_en: A 62-year-old woman presented with a left abdominal mass, and CT showed a cystic retroperitoneal lesion above the left kidney. Surgery via a thoracoabdominal approach resected a well-demarcated benign cystic teratoma. Postoperatively, drainage fluid became lipemic and rose to about 400 ml daily, leading to a diagnosis of chylous ascites. Total parenteral nutrition was given, and the drain was removed on postoperative day 21.

pmid-3148467.summary_ja: 完全型アンドロゲン不応症候群の2症例で、予防的性腺摘出術により胎児性癌が発見された。1例では未分化セミノーマを伴っていた。非腫瘍性の性腺組織は典型的なAIS像を示し、症例2では間質の萎縮が術前内分泌プロファイルの違いを説明しうるとされた。思春期以降の悪性腫瘍リスクの高さを強調している。
pmid-3148467.summary_en: Two cases of complete androgen insensitivity syndrome were found to harbor embryonal carcinoma on prophylactic gonadectomy. In one case the tumor was accompanied by anaplastic seminoma. Non-neoplastic gonadal tissue showed typical AIS morphology, with hypotrophic interstitial cells in case two that may explain differing preoperative endocrine profiles. The authors highlight the substantial malignancy risk after puberty in AIS, alongside psychosexual concerns.

pmid-3152390.summary_ja: 超音波検査で出生前に診断された、仙尾部および咽頭部の胎児奇形腫4例の報告。診断、治療、腫瘍のグレードを既報と比較した。咽頭病変は仙尾部奇形腫より生存予後が悪かった。仙尾部例では無外傷分娩と早期の病変修復が長期生存と合併症のないことに関連していた。
pmid-3152390.summary_en: This report describes four fetal teratomas arising from the sacrococcygeal or oropharyngeal regions, diagnosed antenatally. The authors compare diagnosis, management and tumor grade with prior literature. Pharyngeal lesions carried a worse survival prognosis than the more common sacrococcygeal teratoma. Atraumatic delivery and early repair were associated with prolonged survival and absence of complications in sacrococcygeal cases.

pmid-3152398.summary_ja: 本研究は高周波超音波で468例の陰嚢を評価し、陰嚢内石灰化の所見を分析した。精巣実質内、特に多発・集簇する石灰化は悪性を強く疑う所見とされた。手術された9例の病理では、壊死性の胚細胞腫瘍や管内性の潜在性セミノーマなどが確認された。精巣外の孤立性の大きな石灰化は良性と考えられ、フォローアップ検査で変化はなかった。
pmid-3152398.summary_en: This 1988 study evaluated 468 patients with high-frequency scrotal ultrasound to characterize scrotal calcifications. Calcifications within testicular parenchyma, especially multiple or grouped ones, were highly suspicious for malignancy. Surgical pathology of nine operated patients confirmed necrotic germ cell tumors, a germ cell tumor scar with occult intratubular seminoma, and several benign lesions. Extratesticular, solitary, large calcifications in the remaining patients were considered benign and showed no change on follow-up.

pmid-3154023.summary_ja: 本研究では絨毛癌細胞株ENAMI-1をメトトレキサート(MTX)で処理した。MTXが高濃度では細胞増殖は抑制されたが、hCG-β産生は著しく増加した。hCG陽性細胞はG1期に蓄積し、高濃度MTXではS期で停止した。著者らはhCGが絨毛癌の有用な腫瘍マーカーであると結論づけた。
pmid-3154023.summary_en: This study used the human choriocarcinoma cell line ENAMI-1 treated with methotrexate at varying concentrations. Growth was inhibited above 10^-7 M, yet hCG-beta levels rose markedly. Flow cytometry and BrdU immunostaining showed hCG-positive cells accumulated in G1 phase, while higher methotrexate concentrations arrested cells in S phase and blocked progression to G2/M after removal. The authors concluded that hCG is a useful marker for choriocarcinoma.

pmid-3162214.summary_ja: 本研究は、マウス胎児性癌細胞株(PCC3、PCC4、F9)における3β-ヒドロキシステロイド脱水素酵素活性を報告した。NADH染色とΔ4-アンドロステンジオンのRIAにより活性を確認した。非悪性の線維芽細胞や筋芽細胞でも同様の活性が認められ、ホルモン分泌細胞に特異的な現象ではないと示唆された。胎児精巣の組織形成に先立つ可能性も提案された。
pmid-3162214.summary_en: This study reports steroidogenic activity in established murine embryonal carcinoma cell lines (PCC3, PCC4, F9). The authors detected 3 beta-hydroxysteroid dehydrogenase activity by NADH staining and radioimmunoassay of delta-4-androstenedione. Nonmalignant fibroblasts and myoblasts also showed this activity, suggesting it is a general phenomenon rather than specific to hormone-secreting cells. The authors propose that the activity may precede histologic organization of the embryonal testis.

pmid-3163141.summary_ja: 卵巣嚢胞性奇形腫の内部から歯牙が見つかった症例報告である。組織学的解析により、硬組織は少量の歯槽骨を伴う乳犬歯と同定された。抄録は簡潔で臨床情報は限られる。奇形腫の成分として歯牙が形成されていた点を記録した報告である。
pmid-3163141.summary_en: This short report describes a tooth found within an ovarian cystic teratoma. Histologic analysis identified the hard tissue as a deciduous canine with a small amount of alveolar bone. The abstract is brief and provides limited clinical detail. Its relevance lies in documenting tooth formation as a component of an ovarian teratoma.

pmid-3166874.summary_ja: 未治療の非セミノーマ性精巣腫瘍283例を対象に、胸部X線とCTを後方視的に比較した。胸腔内転移は47例に認められ、うち20例はCTでのみ陽性であった。縦隔リンパ節転移は13例で、後縦隔と横隔膜脚後方のリンパ節が最も多く腫大していた。これらは単純X線で最も検出困難であった。
pmid-3166874.summary_en: This retrospective study compared chest radiography and CT in 283 patients with untreated non-seminomatous testicular tumor.
